tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 gsung 'bum/_shes rab rin chen/ (sa skya rgyal yongs gsung rab slob gnyer khang gi glog klad par ma/)

tei:div.tei:p: gsung 'bum/ shes rab rin chen/ (sa skya rgyal yongs gsung rab slob gnyer khang gi glag klad par ma/ )jusa~X//rdo15khri|sdu spung /sdungs/shā/0bzlo( ri ma ri 55mdzoḥsmo ma/50baḥri ཿ ri pasaḥs ma'iri 106ཿsa50dzo
— k+ṣi kho ngari 4 yos gsunganga' c-i

stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi gsung skor pod ka ba'i dkar chag /she) dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho/ 1 — 70she) rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ 71 — 94sheg rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi rnam par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga'/ 95 1694na/ grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos dang / de'i rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho/ 171 — 447
/) rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ 449 — 540bu) gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs so// 541 601
༄༄༄/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rabs 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

go༅༅/ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i 'khon gyi gdung rabs 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/'jam pa'i dgrangs kyi phyin las chos 'byor 'gran zla dang bral ba rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phun tshogs tshogs gnyis rin chen bye ba'i dpal gyis bsgrubs/ /don gnyis gnyis med ye shes bang rem mngon par mtho/ /chos rgyal rgyal ba'i ri gling dbus na lham me ba/ /thub mchog mchog tu brtse chen lhun po rgyal gyur cig /dge legs chu klung mtha' dag kun nas 'byil/ /yon to bsam 'phel nor bus lhag par bltams/ /legs bshad dbu ma'i 'dzum dkar rol pa can / /mtsho chen gzhon nu'i gzugs ༅ 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /mgon de'i thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'thug po las/ /mkhyen rtse'i klog phreng gsar pas mkha' ngos 'gengs/ /legs bshad snyan pa'i 'brug

ra༅༅/ /sgras sa gsum bskyod/ /phun tshogs dpal 'byor char chen g.yos pa yis/ /phan bde'i skyed tshal mtha' dag rgyas mdzad pas/ /sa steng 'di na 'gran zla bral lo zhes/ khor phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthas btugs skye rga yis / /zhabs pad spyi bor bslangs pa'i sa skya pa/ /dri med 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rim pa la/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen po phyag btsal nas/ /de yi gdung rabs rnam par thar pa rnams/ /'dus gsal go bder 'chad la spro bar gyur/ /la las yon tan yod kyang rjod mi shes/ /kha cig rjod tshul mkhas kyang brjod byas stongs/ /deng 'dir brjod bya rjod byed mtshungs bral phyir/ /mkhas rmongs mtha' dag dga' ba cis mi skye/ /de yang thog mar gleng bslang zhing 'brel btsal ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad/ de las sngar 'das lhag lus kyi rnam gzhag bstan rtsis su grags pa brjod par rigs pa las/ rgyas par gzhan du rjod zin pas 'dir mdor bsdus shig rjod na/ gnas tshad ni mdo sde gzhan du lo sto nga dang / phyed dang nyis stong dang / sum stong sogs su bshad pa yod kyang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa dang / bstan pa yongs rdzogs la dgongs pa dang / sngar ko'u shaṃ bhir bstan pa bsdud thengs gcig byung ba lta bu yul khyad par ba rnams su bstan pa bsdus pa sogs la dgongs par gsal la/ lung phran tshegs dang / sangs rgyas drin lan gsab pa'i mdo ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa dang / 'bum ṭīka mkhan po ste/ bstan bcos mkhan po

gnyis rnams mthun par lo lnga stong du gnas pa la lnga brgya pa phrag bcur phye nas/ dgra bcom pa dang phyir mi 'ong dang / phyir 'ong rgyun zhugs te 'bras bu la gtso bor spod pas 'bras bu'i dus kyi phrag gsum dang / shes rab/ ting nge 'dzin/ tshul khrims gsum la spyod pas sgrub pa'i gsum/ mdo sde/ mngon pa/ 'dul ba gsum la spyod pas lung gi gsum/ tha ma rtags tsam/ 'dzin pa dang bcur mdzad zlo dus 'khor na dngos su mi gsal yang don gyis thob pa/ kla klos nyams par ma byas kyi bar la/ chos rgyal 〉gi rigs drug rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lnga/ drag po 'khor lo can te/ so gnyis kyis lo brgyad brgyar chos bstan pas sum stong nyis brgya/ 'khor lo can gyis kla klo bcom nas/ stong brgyad brgya bsdoms pas lnga stong du nges la/ de gnyis la snga dar phyi dar gyi tha snyad kyang byar rung ngo / /de las sngar ji tsam 'das na yongs grags dang dus 'khor lugs gnyis mi mthun te/ snga ma ltar na sum stong drug brgya dang gcig phyi ma ltar na nyis stong dang gsum brgya zhe gsum / 'angs ma thag pa'i me ngedzi ji rngoX na na la 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /'di gnyis la lo stong dang nyis brgya bdun gyi khyad par byung bas gang rung gcig ma dag par gsal la/ de yang dus 'khor lugs ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na 'jorim dpa wa gras/sa pa byon pa dang / des lo brgyar rtsa rgyud bsta na nas/ sa da dkar wa gdan sa gtad/ de nas lo brgyad brgya na kla klo byung ba dang / de nas da lta'i bar sa ris la /'char ba'i (rung dang / de las lo gabo gi mang nyung byas

ra༅༅/ /na yang mig skar dang gzas 'dzin mi 'grig pa sogs kyi rigs pas grub pas 'thad ldan yin zhing / paṇa chen tshodzi shrī dang / bcom ldan rigs ral ya/nga 'di nyid 'thad ldan du bzhed do/ /lugs snga ma ni/ chos rje sa paṇa bzhed de/ paṇa chen stadzi shrīs mdzad pa de/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po'i rgyu cha spungs nas bzhag pa rnams la rang byon du byon pa'i nub mo nas bgrangs pa'i zhag grangs lo grangs yin pas/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa gzhan rnams lugs snga ma bzhed do zhes gsung la/ 'di'i lugs kyi thub pa sa pho 'brug lo par mdzad/ jo bo chen po yang / de las lo bzhis snga ba'i shing pho nyi ba la sangs rgyas 'khrangs par mdzad nas de dang mthun shas che bar snang bas/ lugs de bzhed pa po ni tshad ldan rtsod med du 'dug mod sri dus 'khor dang 'gal bar ma zad pa'i gnod byed mang du snang bas na/ 'jig rten rnams skyo ba bskyed bi+o dgongs pa dang / brgya gar na bgrod pa re la lo rer byed pa yun ring du byung snang bas de dgongs gzhir mdzad pa'i drang don du mdzad par gsal ste/ rgyal ba nyid kyis kyang / ston pa'i bstan pa yang yun ring du mi sanas so zhes dang / mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis kyang / de ltar thub pa dag gi bstan pa ni/ /lkog mar srog phyin 'dra dang zhes sogs gsu/ngas pa bzhin dang / gnod byed ji ltar yod snyam na/ rgya gar gyi dzol rabs las/ rgyal ba 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu ni chos rgyal mya ngan med byon zhing / de rjes rgyal po tsan+d+ra'i ming can bdun dang / pā la'i ming can bdun

dang / se na 'i ming ༅ bzhi la sogs pa byung bar bshad pa'i tsan+d+ra bdun dang / go mi tsan+t+ra ni/ dza lan dha sgo pa'i slob mar bshad la/ de ni dril bu pa'i dngos slob rus sbal zhabs kyi dngos slob yin par dang / rgyal po de'i bu brgyud btsun mo klu ru skyes pa gcig gis zos nas/ rgyal po re mos byed dgos pa byung ba'i tsha/ ba lang rdzi gcig gis re mos la klu mo thul nas des rgyal po yun ring byas pa ni pā la dang po go pā la yin/ de'i dus su grub chen lwa ba pas grub pa thob nas/ da bya ba gang byas na bstan pa la phan gzigs pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs na phan par gzigs nas/ rgyal po go pā la'i sras su bsams bzhin du skye ba bzhes nas/ bi ka ma la'i chos sde 'dzugs pa po ni/ pā la gnyis pa dharma pā la yin/ lwa ba pa yang dril bu zhabs sogs dang dus mnyam/ dharma pā la dang / bod kyi chos rgyal sad na legs dus mnyam par yar lung bang po'i 'gram gyi rdo ring la bris yod par grags pas/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po dgu'i ring la lo phyed dang sum stong 'gro ba mi rigs pa'i phyir na/ rgya hor gyi༄ la rabs rnams 'as sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa gsum du byon nas yum la chos su/ lha yul du dbyar gnas zla ba gsum bzhugs pa'i ring la/ rgya gar rgyal po rnams kyis sku 'dra mang du bzhes pa'i nang nas phyin lasashin tu che ba ni/ yi so rku tra spo nas bdengs sa 'i tsan+dan ngobo / da lta rgya ༄ la na bzhugs sa 'di yi na/ 'di bzhengs tshar nas sto na sa lha ༄ la nas be bas te rma jal ba zha / 'dis bdengs te dbu btud pa 'i spyi bor ston pas phyag bdag nga mya ngan las

go༅༅/ /'das nas lo stong na/ 'dis rgya nag gi yul du sems can gyi don byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ de mthun rgya nag tu phebs/ hor se chen rgyal po rgyal sar phebs nas lo ngo gsum song ba chu mo phag la chus pas / tsan+dan jo bo bzhengs nas lo nyis stong brgya nga lnga song / sangs rgyas 'das nas lo nyis stong brgya so dgu las ma song / de nas tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes me pho khyi la chus pas brgyad cu gya bzhi song / de nas da lan gyi me pho khyi'i bar la lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig bsdoms pas 'di'i lugs la sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong sum brgya zhe gsum las ma song 'dug pa'i phyir dang / bod kyi rgyal rabs dag pa rnams las/ rje gnya' khri pa' po sangs rgyas dang dgung mnya gyi rgyal po bzhi'i nang nas/ rgyal po shar ba'i bur stod pa lad cing / de nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun na/tho tho ri gnyan ba' gyis dgung lo zhe gnyis bzhes pa'i sa pho spre'u'i lo la dam pa'i mos kyi dbu brnyes/ nyer bdun i gnam gyi khri bdun la sogs pa rnams/ sras kyis chibs kha 'khrun pa tsam la yab gshegs pa sogs sku tsha ring po yang ma byung bar bshad pas / rgyal po nyer bdun gyi ring la lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'gro ba mi rigs shing / de bar la lo dgu brgya re drug las ma song bar kod pa yang 'dug pas/ bu mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi chos yul du dam pa'i mos khung ngo zhes stod pa yang 'gyur skyon du snang bas/ stong

dang sum brgya zhe lngar gsal ba'i phyir dang / thogs med sku mched rgyal ba 'das nas lo stong du nye ba na 'byung bar bshad cing / dbyig gnyen gyis sku tshe ring po ma bzhugs par mkhas pa la grags la/ de dang zla grags/ birla pa rnams dus mtshungs su 'jug 'grel las bshad/ paṇa chen shwakya shrī byon nas lo phyed dang sum brgya skor las mi 'gro zhing paṇa chen dang birla pa'i bar na/ so thar sdormo brgyud la/ yon to bdag med dang / chos kyi phreng ba dang / zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa ste gsum las med/ bod kyi lo tsā ba 'brog 'gos dmar gsum paṇa chen las cung snga yang 'gos dang zla grags kyi bar na slob pa rdo rje/ nag po spyod pa/ btsun mo can dang gsum/ 'brog mi dang / birla pa'i bar na'ang bzhi las med pa sogs dang / dbyeg gnyen gyi dngos slob thang zim lo tsā bas/ rgya pa skong tso chen mo'i yab thang tha'i dzung gi rgyal po'i ring la rgya nag tu sems can gyi don byas par bshad pa dang / dbyeg gnyen gyi dngos slob gang spel gyi slob ma dzi na mi spris bod kyi ka lcog zhang gsum dang lo paṇa mdzad nas chos bsgyur bshad mang du mdzad pa rnams kyis phyir ro/ /de ltar na/ rang lugs mdor bsdus tshigs bcad du brjod na 'di lta ste/ bdag cag rnams kyi ston mchog de/ 'ang pho khyi ba'i lo la bltams/ /sa mo phas la mngon sangs rgyas/ /rim gsum chos 'khor rdzogs pa'i mthar/ /ngon dgu pa la dus 'khor gsungs/ /sa'acha du smra la sanong bre+ong mang / /lo sanyis bar du zla bzang yis/ the bha la ru rtsa rgyud bstan 'grel chen stong phras dus cu

ra༅༅/ /pa/ /gzhal med khang dang bcas pa mdzad/ /de nas shing pho spre 'u nas/ /lha dbang la sogs stak+ṣa'i rigs/ /drug gis/ lo brgya lo brgyar bstan/ /slar yang shing pho spre'u la/ /rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags pa yis / rtswa rgyud lo brgyar bstan pa'i mthar/ /bsdus rgyud bsdus nas sras la gtad/ /pad dkar la sogs brgyad po yis/ /brgya brgyar bstan mthar shing sprel la/ /rgya mtsho rnam rgyal ston pa pos/ /gyur pa'i lo der kla klo yi/ /ston pa sbyang rtsi'i blo gros byung / /de nas des kyang lo brgya'i mthar/ /rgyal gas chos bstan ༅gnyis song / /mi zad ces bya me pho khyi/ /rtsis kyi lo dag thog ma yin/ /de nas nyis brgya nyer gcig 'das/ /rab byang lo/ la dus 'khor rgyud/ /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phebs/ /de nas brgya dang nga drug lo/ /'das pa chu pho stag lo la/ /chos rje sa paṇa mi yul byon/ /bdun cu lcags mo phag la gshegs/ /so brgyad 'das pa'i lcags stag la/ /kurno mkhyen bu ston 'khrangs nas des/ /drug cu 'das pa'i lcags stag la/ /lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can 'khrangs/ /de yis nga gsum bzhes pa yi/ /chu pho rta la chos 'khor btab/ /de nas re lnga 'das pa yi/ /da lta'i lo 'di me mo phag /thams cad 'dular+sha sa bya ba yin/ /zhes pa dus 'khor gtso bor byas pa ste/ 'di dang bstun nas bod kyi bstarno pa snga dar phyi dar gyi mes dbon dang lo tsā ba byon tshul la sogs pa ni/ rgyal ba zhi bar bzhugs pa yi/ /phyis lo shing pho spre 'u nas/ /stong dang sum brgya zhe lnga 'das/ /sa

pho spe 'u'i lo ma kho+o la/ /kha ba can du dam chos byung / /de nas brgya dang zhe dgu 'das/ /me mo glang la srong btsan 'khrangs/ /de yis nyer gnyis bzhes pa yi/ /sa pho khyi la lha sa btab/ /de nas brgya dang nga gnyis 'das /wa/lo n+de brtson 'khrangs/ /de yis nyi shu bzhes pa yi/ /lcags pho stag la bsam yas bzhengs/ /de nas brgyad cu 'das pa sh+lau/ /lcags mo phag la 'u shang rdo/ /de nas bcu gnyis 'das pa yi/ /chu mo phag zlo glang dar mas/ /chos bsnubs lo gsum me stag me+e/ /sdig rgyal de yang pha rol bsgral/ /chu phag de nas re bdun par/ /bod du dam chos sgron me nub zer bar gyur/ dmar g.yo gtsang dang bla chen gyis/ /khams su mar me cung zad gsos/ /dbus gtsang mi bcu la sogs kyis/ /blangs nas lcags pho rta lo la/ /slar yang dbus su sgron me byon/ /de nas zhe gsum 'das pa'i lo/ /chu mo glang la jo bo rje/ /mnga' ris phebs nas dag par mdzad/ /de nas brgya dang go gsum pa/ /me stag kha che paṇa chen gyis/ /phebs nas sa paṇa bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ /jo bo phebs pa'i chu glang nas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig 'das pa yis/ 'ang pho khyi la sa skya pa/ /dkon mchog rgyal po mi yul byon/ /de yis bzhi bcu bzhes pa yi/ /chu mo glang gi lo mchog la/ /bod kyi ma ga dha rer/ po// //nga/pal ldan sa skya che sa par ba'ib/ de za sto/ ba'i bstan rnga ni 'dzi grangs nyi sto nga lnga bcus chad / /'das/ pa dus 'bor lu gas mi na la / /boke du lnge dar bani brgya dang / /so lnga byung ning phyi dar wa/ /brgya dngabadun cude tshe

༄༄༄/ /'das/ /sa skya btab nas brgya dang bcu/ /chu pho stag la paṇa chen 'khrangs/ /man chad snga ma ji bzhin te/ /des na sa skya btab pa nas/ /da lta'i me mo phag 'di'i bar/ /lo grangs sum brgya go bzhi song / /gzhan gyis gzhan du bshad pa rnams/ /rigs pas brtags na 'thad pa med/ /blo ldan rnams kyis 'di snyad blang / /mdor na rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni/ /nyis stong sum brgya zhe gsum 'das/ /nyis stong drug brgya nga bdun lus/ /des na ding sang lnga brgya pa / /lnga pa'i sked yin 'thad ldan no/ /yongs grags ltar na sum stong dang / /drug brgya gcig 'das stong dang ni/ /bzhi brgyar gcig chad lus pas na/ /lnga brgya brgyad pa'i steng du slebs/ /gang 'thad gong bzhin dpyad pas shes/ /de ltar na / bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ rigs gsum mgon po/'i rnam 'phrul chos rgyal byang chub sems/ dpa' yon mchod thugs rje las sprul pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa sngar med gsar du btsugs/ gtsang gaḥro+o dmar gsum bla chen mkhan brgyud rnams kyis sngar yod nyams pa gsos/ lha btsun khu dbon/ jo bo yab sras/ 'brog 'gos mar gsum/ pa tshab rngog khyung / ra 'bro la sogs pas shin tu dar bar mdzad mod rdze phal cher mdo dang sngags kyi phyogs re ba tsam du zad la / dus phyis/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid/ 'khon gyi gdung brgyud kyi tshul bzung nas/ phyi nang mdo sngags bshad grub kyi bstan pa mtha' dag 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas ches

zhin tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i rma thas gtugs pa'i 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi skye rgu thams cad chos dang zang zing gi dpal 'byor bzang pos legs par bskyangs pa ni ngo mtshar zhing bka' drin shin tu che bas/ gdung brgyud rin po che'i byon tshul dang / rnam par thar pa 'chad pa dang nyan pa la 'bad par rigs so/ /de la 'di'i rigs ni bod du bram ze'i rigs su gsal ba rma byung bas/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ dmangs rigs gsum las/ zhang blon rje'u rigs yin te/ mi'i gdung rabs thog ma rje gung stag tu grags pa'i phyir ro/ /rus ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi dang / mi bu rus drug tu grags pa sogs las chad pa ma yin gyi/ gdung rus gtsang ma lha las babs pa yin te/ gnam lha lce rings / g.yu rings/ dbu se ste/ mched gsum du grags pa mi yul du babs pa la mi'i rje zhus pas/ chung bas mi'i rje mdzad/ sras se ji le spun bzhir grags pa byung / de dag gis ldong rus chen bco brgyad dang 'thabs/ de'i grogs la gnam lha bar pas byon/ ldong btul nas bran du byas/ 'dis smu'ibu mo smu pa ldem bu khab tu bzhes pas sras ma sangs spun bdun du grags pa byung / bdun pas mi yul du bzhugs/ gzhan rnams lha yul du thegs/ bdun pas thog lha 'od ren gyi bu ma thos lce 'ur ma khab tu bskyes pa la sras thos tsha ngapa' bo 'khrungs/ des klu'i bu ro/ klu lcar/byu bra ra/byu lab tu bzhes/ nga/ la/ klu tsha rta ngo rad chen byung de yan chad bar snang 'a bzhusas / des mon bza' ma tsho mo bya ba bab tu bzhes grwa la sra sa

ra༅༅/ /gcig g.ya' dang spang gi mtshams su skyes shing / 'di 'dra re re tsam yin byas pas mtshan g.ya' spang skyes gcig tu btags/ 'di gnas pa'i ri/ g.yas ru shangs kyi nub byang na byang ri kun las mtho zhing mdzes pa gcig yod/ ri de la yang g.ya' spang du grags/ lha 'dis/ srin po skya rengs khrag med ces bya ba la/ chung ma g.ya' 'brum sil le ma zhes ba shin tu mtshar ba gcig yod pas/ srin po dang 'thab rol byas/ khyo bsad/ chung ma khab tu bzhes pa la sras gnyig 'khrangs pa lha dang srin mo 'khon pa'i bar du byung bas/ g.ya' phrug 'bon bar skyes su btags/ gdung brgyud 'di la 'khon gyi ma yang de nas byung ste/ shāka rigs bzhin no/ /ma sras de gnyis g.ya' spang gi nub byang na/ gangs ri'i phreng dro chen po'i nang na shin tu mdzes shing mtho ba shel tsha rgyal mo'i sangs su grags pa dang / g.ya' spang gi lho 'gram na sa skya pa'i bla mtsho yang yod do/ /lha de yan chad gdung rabs drug ste/ gnam la g.yu rings ma sangs spun bdun dang / thog tsha dpa' bo klu tsha rta pho dang / /g.ya' spang skyes gcig g.ya' phrug zhabon bar skyes/ /lha yi gdung rabs drug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin mi yi gdung rabs rkyang 'ded ni/ ston pa gung stag rdo rje rin po che/ shes rab yon tan tshul khrims rgyal po dang / /gtsug tor shes rab dge skyabs dge mthong dang / /bal po stag blo dkon mchog rgyal po dang / /kun snying dpal chen 'od po bsod rgyal zhabs/ /ye 'byung bzang dpal kun legs grags rgyal dang / /rnam

zlurme snom legs nam rbal nam rin mched/ /mir gyur gdung rabs nyer gcig la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya'o/ /lha 'khon bar na skyes des btsan bza' smon bu sgron khab tu bzhes pa la mi'i mchog gcig 'khrangs pa ni/ mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul che ba/ blo dang rig padro ldan pa/ gzugs dang lang tshor 'dzom pa/ kun gyi yid 'phrog pa zhig 'byung bas 'di 'dra mi yul du 'byung ba dkomyo byas nas ma dkon pa rje gung stag ces btags so/ /'di yurmi 'tshol du gtang bas/ bsam yas la yul gyi dge'am yon tan bcu ka tshang ste/ rgyal pos bzung tshar/ la stod gnyan gyi thar ma ya changs la yul gyi dge brgyad tshang bar gzigs nas bzung / dge brgyad ni/ sa'i dge khang sa ngang zhing sa/ chu'i dge 'thung chu zhing chu/ shing gi dge khang shing dang 'bud shing / rtsa'i dge gam 'brog dang rgyang 'brog go /brgyad po'i steng du/ kha cig phu na la sgo mda' na gru sgo yod pa zer mod kyang / de gnyis bcud kyi yon to yin pas mi 'thad zhi gzhan brgyad snod kyi yon to yin pa bzhin du/ rdo'i dge khang rdo dang 'ashāg rdo zhes bya'o/ /gnyis tshan nang phan tshun tsho+ogs pa shin tu 'gal bas/ gcig yod pa na gcig shos yod pa shin tu dkon pas/ dge bcu tshang ba dka' ba yin no/ /rje 'dis bsam yas kyi chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi thugs zin/ nang blon bcol/ nga pal 'byor shin tu 'phel bas/ 'khon dpal po che zhes bya bar grasas/ shing 'alon gyi ma/tshan gragaso de nas byung ngo / /'dis glang 'ab/ rma pa lo tsā ba'i lcam mo glang bza' sne chung ma khab tu bzhes pa la

ra༅༅/ /sras gnyis 'khrangs pa'i che ba la/ 'bon lo tsā ba klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ chung ba zhabon rdo rje rin po che zhes bya'o/ /kha cig sras khri mdzes lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug klu'i dbang po/ tshe 'dzin dang bzhi byung ba'i tshe 'dzin dang / rdo rje rin chen gcig par 'asdod pa dang / de gnyis yab sras su 'dod pa sogs mang du snang yang / gdung rabs dag pa rnams las snga ma nyid 'byung bas de bzhin 'thad pa yin zhes sa lo chen po'i gsung las 'byung ba ltar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyang bzhed pa legs so/ /de yang klu'i dbang po bsrang ba ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs za hor gyi mkhas grub chen po gangs can gyi dpal mgon mkhan chen zhi ba mtshos bod la rab byung rung mi rung nyams sad pas / rung bar gzigs nas gnang / bod kyi rab byung gi thog ma sad mi mi bdun du gragasaji lo tsā ba khyad par can sngal pa'i gang zag bdun la/ rgan gsum/ gzhon gsum/ bar pa gcig rnams byung ba'i gzhon gsum gyi bar pa 'khon nā gen+t+ra rok+ṣi ta zhes bya ste/ bod skad du klu'i dbang po bsrung ba'o/ /kha cag 'di khong rang gi zhang po las rab tu byung zhesaze ra ba ni/ sad mir 'dod pa dang 'gal zhing mtshan gyis kyang mkhan chen gyi sdom drug tu gsal lo/ /des na mkhan chen dang zhang pa las chas mang du bslabs/ lo tsā legs par mkhyen/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma la yang gdam ngag nod/ yer pa'i brag la sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa thob/ mkhas grub kyi grags pa cher byung bas 'khon chos kyis che ba'i thog ma yin no/ /

gcung rdo rje rin po ches kyang slob dpon pad+ma la gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos mang du gsan zhing bslabs/ grub pa yang ci rigs pa thob/ mtshan grags thon/ 'dis yab yul tu 'bro dgra 'dul gyi bu mo 'bro bza' g.yang lon skyid khab tu bzhes pa la sras/ bdun byung zhing / zhang po de bod kyi gyad pa'i brgyud yin pas zhang rigs kyi sku rtsal shin tu che bar byung / de'i tshe 'bro gnyan rtser ltad mo nyi ma gsum byung ba la/ sku mched bdun pos rta dang lus chas nyin re bzhin 'dra 'dra spos nas rta rgyugs / tshabs 'gran pas khrom thog chod pa byung ba na/ zhang po la 'bras 'dzugs par go nas zhang pos dmag bsags/ 'thab mo byed zer byung ba la/ gcig par zhang po rayin/ gnyis par khyim mtshes yun ring 'grogs nas/ rgyal khams yangs po la dge 'tsher byed don med zer nas che ba mnga' ris mang yul/ de 'og mnga' ris gung thang / de 'og srad/ de 'og nyang shab tu byon te/ yul so sor bzung bas de rnams las gyis pa'i 'khon tsho mang du 'phel te grags can ma byung / chung bas pha yul rang du bzhugs/ 'bro dang 'khrug pa yang spyad de las gyes pa gnyan rtse rang na ma khrigs sde gsum du grags pa byung ngo / /drug pa shes rab yon tan gyis grom pa g.ya' lung du bzhugs/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i chung bas khab so stag thog tu byon/ de las gyes pa la stod byang si 'khon tsho rnams yin/ che ba tshul khrims rgyal po la sras gsum byung ba'i bar pas brdal chang chang du byon che ba satsus tor shes ririb dang / chung ba g.ya 'a ru nga rang du

༄༄༄/ /bzhugs/ gtsug tor shes rab la sras bdun/ khu bo dang bcas pa nas gyis pa la 'khon tsho brgyad du grags/ bdun po lnga pa 'khon dge skyabs kyis phyis shab tu byon/ de las sras gnyis byung ba'i chung ba la shab stod kyi 'khon mi rnams gyes pa yin/ che ba dgetsho mthong la sras gcig byang ga la 'khon ston bal po zhes bya ba/ tsha mo rong gi brag la yang phur gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas grub pa brnyes/ bstan ma bcu gnyis bran du 'kho'// de las sras shākya blo gros 'dis bya rung khung pa dang shab stod smad bzung / phrin las che baX /nga / sku tshe'i smad la yab mes kyi yul g.ya' lung mkhar thabs bzung / sras gnyis byang ba'i che ba 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ chung ba 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'o/ /gnyen gyis lo ston rdo rje dbang phyag gi mkhan bu zhu ston brtson 'grus drung du/ gzhon nu nas go mi'i dge bsnyen mdzad/ tshangs spyod shin tu btsun pas sras med/ yab mes kyi chos la mkhas/ rdo rje phur pa'i grub pa thob/ mthu dang rdzu 'phral bsam gyis mi khyab par grags so༄/ /de yan chad zhabon rim par byon pa rdo rje rin chen nas gdung rabs dgu song / kha cig shes gcib yon tan gyi sras yon tan 'byang gnas/ de'i sras tshul khrims rgyal po yin zer ba'ang gdung rabs dag pa snams las mi byung ngo / /de ltar 'khon rog yan rnams kyis phar phyin sogs phyi mtshan nyid kyi skor ci rigs pa dang / sngags la gsang ba sde drug snga 'gyur lnga/ khyo 'gyur bcu gsum/ phra mo nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i gsang sngags snga

'gyur la shin tu mnyes shing yang dag dang phur pa la thugs dam gyi mthil mdzad pas grub pa brnyes/ chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla dang / bdud mgon la mdzad pas nus pa thon pa sha stag go /dkon mchog rgyal po ni zhabon sa skya pa zhes grags pa'i thog ma rang yin te/ shing pho khyi la sku 'khrangs/ gzhon nu nas yab dang gnyen la dbang bshad man ngag mang du gsan/ yab mes kyi chos la mkhas par sbyangs/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur la yang thugs mos par yod pa'i skabs su/ 'brog ske lungaston chen mo gcig byung sar byon rmis/ ltad mo sna tshogs 'dug pa'i nang nas sngags pa mang pos dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi mgo brnyan rgyu+on/ phyag ma so sor khyer/ ma mo ral pa can gyi rnga stabs dang bcas nas 'cham gyi 'dug pas / ltad mo yang de ka che/ khrom thog kyang des chod song / de'i rgyu mtshan rnams gcen la zhus pas/ da gsang sngags 'chol par spyod pa zhes bya ba'i dus byung bas/ da phyin chad rnying ma ba la grub thob mtshan nyid pa dkon pa yin paṅge mi yong / rang la dbang yod pa rnams rang nyid dbang che ba yin pas/ nga rang gi dpe cha rten gsum rnams gter du sbed gsungs nas sbas pas yang phur gnyis chos skyong gnyan nas sbed ma thub pa/ phyis kyi gdung brgyud rnams kyis kyang 'di gnyis la thugs dam dang / chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla lcam sring la dus gtor ma chag pa 'di byung ba yin no/ /de bzhin du gcen gyi 'al nas nga ni rgas 'dug khyod gzhi+on pa yin pas gsang sngags gsar 'gyur slobs/ de yang da lta 'brog mi shwakya ye

ra༅༅/ shes mkhas pas der rgyugs gsung ba la der ma thon/ 'khyin lo tsā ba la skya'i rdo rje'i dbang zhus/ rgyud gsan/ rgyud cung ma rdzogs pa la 'khyin lo grongs/ chos/ 'phro 'brog mi'i drung du zhus gsung ba ltar zhur byon pas / khyod kyis pha shi nas mes po bsnyegs pa legs gsungs nas dgyes/ phyis yul zhing 'ga' btsongs nas rta bcu bdun dang / rtsa rin nor bu'i phreng ba dang bcas pa phul/ gsung ngag rin po che zhus/ lam skor cha lag 'ga' re gnang khyad par rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa rgyas par gnang nas/ bshad bka' 'dzin pa'i bu chen lnga'i nang nas mchog tu gyur/ gzhan yang 'gos lo tsā ba la gas/nga 'dus kyi skor gsan/ ā/ rgyan gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab gsang ba la thig le lnga'i skor rma lo tsā ba la bde mchog dang grub rtsing gi skor la sogs pa gsan/ gzhan yang mal lo tsā ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ pu rangs lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa ska mched/ 'khon dge bcu ba/ skyu ra a seng la sogs pa bla ma dam pa mang po la sems bskyed dbang bshad man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan nas sngags gsar rnying mtha' dag gi bdag por gyur/ zhang yul g.ya' lung 'jag shongs su yab darngo gcen gyi phyi rten bzhengs/ de'i nang du seng ldeng gi phur pa byin rlabs can gcig bzhugs/ 7bra mo lung par dgon chung gcig btab nas lo 'ga' bzhugs pas ding sang sa skya gog por grags so/ /de'i tshe dpon slob rnams kyis skyo bsang la byon/ ri /ba nas gzigs pas/ dpon po ri glang po che nyal ba 'dra ba'i mkhal khung

g.yon pa'i thad na sa dkar zhing snum pa chu g.yas su 'bab pa la sogs pa bkris dang dge mtshan du ma dang ldan par gzigs nas/ 'dir dgon pa gakhog btab na bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya cher 'byung bar dgongs te/ de sko ra gyi sa cha spyi'i bdag pojo bo gdong nag pa la zhus pas/ kyang gnang / dgos kyi bdag po zhang zhung gu ra ba dang ban dhe grong bzhi lha mi grong bdun bya ba yod pa la/ nga 'dir dgon chung gcig byed 'dod pas/ khyed rnams la 'gal ba mi yong na khyed rnams la rin gcig kyang 'jal gsungs pas/ rin ye mi 'tshal cis/ kyang mdzad par zhu zer/ 'on kyang phyi rabs tshun chad la 'thad gsungs nas/ rgod ma dkar mo gcig nor bu'i phreng ba/ mo gos gcig la sogs pa gnang nas/ mon grog man / 'bal grog yan bla ma ba bdag par byas/ bla ma 'dis dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa/ dbang phyug bag yod ces bya ba chu mo glang gi lo/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'angs nas/ bstan rtsis yongs grags ltar na lo sum stong nyis brgya re bzhi / 'thad ldan ltar na nyis stong dang bcu 'das pa'i tshe/ 'dzam gling na nyi zla ltar grags pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i gang zag bgrang ba las 'das pa 'dus pa'i skyed tshal/ chos nga nga zang zing gi dpal 'byor 'gran zla dang bral ba'i gnas dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen po thog mar btab pa yin no/ /'di nas bzung ste dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung brgyud ces nyi zla ltar grags so/ /de lta bu'i bla ma des dgung lo ba'i bcu pa nas/ re dgu'i bar lo sum cu tham pa gdan sa

ra༅༅/ /mdzad/ gdul bya dpag med smin grol la bkod nas re dgu pa lcags pho rta'i dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ sa skya nyid du bde bar gshegs so/ /bla ma de'i jo mo rdo rje phyag mo la sras ye ma byang ba'i ngang nas dgung lo nga dgu bzhes pa'i dus su/ bla ma gnam kha'u pas thabs legs kyis nyo chang dang zhag pa 'tshol du bcug nas mkha' 'gro ma'i rnam rol/ gung ra ma jo mo zhad mo'i sar zhag gcig bzhugs nas sras (khog 'khrungs pa ni/sta rnal 'byor dbang phyug birla pa'i rnam 'phral sa chen kun dga' snying po yin no/ /'di cung zad mngon du gyur pa na bla ma la zhus pas/ de yongs su re nas thabs bos pa yin/ da nga rang gis bskyar nas mthar phyin pa byed pas kha'u skyed lhas kyi sgrub khang dang nye ba'i dben par khang chung zo~X gsungs/ der gsang thabs su bzhugs pas chu pho spre'u la 'khrangs/ 'khrangs nas kyang rdo rje phyug mo la gsang ba khong gis tshor nas/ske khyed kyi rgedung brgyud 'di chad du 'phangs pa yin / zhang mo la sras yod 'dug pa legs nga la gsang mi 'tshal/ da nga la nor gzhis mi dgos pa yin zer nas sa skya'i rmichod zhing chesna mo ma gtogs/ sa zhing dang nor rdzas thams cad zhang mo la gtad do/ /de nas dgung lo bcu gcig gi bar la yab kyis legs par bskyangs te/ dbang bshad man ngag phal mo che gnang / bcu gcig pa la yab gshegs/ zhal chems la dgon pa 'di klu rgyal gtsug na ren chen gyi pho brang steng na yod pas dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa 'byung

yas / la me+o yong nyen yod pas nga'i phung po ma khos pa 'di grog po mgo ldum lta bu 'di'i ya snar mchod rten rtsig la zhog gsungs pa dang mthun par/rtsis mkhan gyis kyang tshogs rdzongs kyi chos 'khor dang /sa/dan sa bsko ba dang / phyi rten rtsig pa rnams dus ma wo na grub na/ dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa bong zhes lung bstan pa bzhin du/ yum na re/thogs tsog la gdan sa gzhan snyag ma btsal na/jo sra/sa kyi slob gyer la gnod zer nas/ba ri lo tsā ba g.yu mkhar mo na bzhugs pa gdan drangs nas gdan sar bsko ba dang /gong brag dmar gnyis kyis dge 'dun bsags nas chos 'khor byed pa/ zhal chems dang mthun pa'i phyi sten bzhengs pa rnams i gcig la bsgrubs pas phun tshogs kyi 'gram thams cad things so/ /bla ma 'di la sku che ba'i yon to bsam gyis mi khyab ste/gdung brgyud thams cad kyi nang na 'di i mchog tu gyur par byed pas rnam thar rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya la/'dir mdor bsdu na/ rang don dang gzhan don gyi yon tan no/ /dang po la lung dang rtogs pa'o/ /lung la thun mo nga ba ni/gzhon nu nyid nas klog dang yig rtsis/ bzo dang gso spyad/lugs kyi bstan bcos sogs la shin tu mkhas pas kun gyis ya mtshan du 'dzin no/ /thun mong ma yin pa sna/ ba ri lo tsā ba'i zhal nas khyed jo sras kyi bya ba slob gnyer byed dgos/ de la shes rab dgos de'i lnga 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin pas r+sām khungs a ra pa tsa na 'di sgrubs gsungs nas rjes gnang mdzad/lam stongs brag phub

ra༅༅/ /tu sgrub pa zla drug mdzad pas/ zhal mngon sum du gzigs nas/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kha nas ral gri bdun brgyud gcig byon pa thugs khar thim/ de bla ma la zhus pas khyed kyi brgyud pa 'di la 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud gcig 'byon par 'dug gsungs/ sngon jo bo chen pos kyang / sa skya yong pa'i yul phyogs la phyag mdzad nas 'dir 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun 'byon par 'dug gsungs pa dang mthun/ bdun po ni/ sa chen yab sras gsum / chos rje khu dbon gnyes/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa sku mched gnyis rnams la byed/ kha cig sa chen rang mi bgrang bar ti shrī kun blo ba'ang 'dug go /'jam dbyangs grub nas gsan sbyong la mdo'i phyogs ni/ rong dur smige gi brang ti dar ma snying po/ de'i zur chos pa bla chen mi dig byang chad la khyung rnams las sde lnga sdom rnam gnyis la sogs pa chos mngon pa mtha' dag gsan/ nyang stod pa khyung rin chen grags/ grom pa g.yu rtse ba mes lhang tsher la tshad ma rnam nges / rigs thigaso/ chos mchog che chung / dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum la sogs pa dbu tshad ma lus pa gsan/ gnam kha'u pa la byams chos/ bslab spyod/ dkon brtsegs/ phal chen la sogs pa spyod phyogs ma lus pa gsan / sngags kyi phyags la/ yab dang 'khon dge chung ba la/ pha chos yang phur bde dgyes rgyud gsum la sogs pa ma lus pa dang / bla ma gnam kha'u pa la gsang 'dus lugs gnyis 'grel pa cha lag dang bcas pa sogs dang / bya spyod yo

rgo'i skor ma lus pa gsan/ mal lo tsā ba la bde mchog tso bor byas pa'i rgyud dang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ ba ri lo tsā ba la yang gsang 'dus dang gshin rje gshed skor/ mahā mā ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ rdo rje gdan bzhi la sogs pa mtha' yas pa gsan zhing / rgya gar shar nub sogs kyi mchod rten byin rlabs can thams cad kyi sa sna bsdas nas sa skya'i rnam rgyal 'bum par grags pa bzhengs/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi sku gdung la sogs pa ska gdung ring srel rten gsum byin rlabs can mtha' yas pa bzhugs pas byin rlabs shin tu che bar grags pa 'di/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas gtso bor bdag rkyen mdzad nas bsgrubs te/ sa skya'i gdan sa lo brgyad mdzad nas/ sa chen dgung lo nyi tshos stong du che 'don bsko bzhag mdzad de / ba ri ba nyid bar phug tu gshegs so/ /zhang ston chos 'bar la gsung ngag rin po che lam skor cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad ma lus pa gas na te/ de ltar na sa chen 'di/ dang por mdo sngags phyi nang lung rigs kyi gsung rab mtha' dag tshar re gsan pa tsam gyis mkhyen pas/ ma gsan pa'am mi mkhyen pa gang yang med par 'chi ba gzigs pas/ snying rje dang bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i lhag bsam gyis 'brum bus na ba'i nad g.yog mdzad pas lags par gsos nas rang nyid la 'gos te/ grongs la thug pa'i sdag bsngal dang du blangs shing / gzhan yang slob gnyer gyi dus na yang bdag pas gzhan gces mang du mdzad/ phyis gzhan don gyi tshe ni shin tu mang bar mdzod/ sbyor ba la bslab pa gsum las tshul khrims kyi

ra༅༅/ /bslab pa ni/ so sor thar pa'i dbang du byas na/ bla ma dge chu ba gshegs khar/ kun dga' snying po khyod rab tu byung nas 'bon tsho'i sde pa 'di skyongs shig gsung ba'i zhal chems byung ba ltar/ rab byung bsnyen dzogs la thugs shin tu spro yang / bla ma gnam kha'u pas bla ma mnyam po la nga gson po'i kha la nyon/ khyod rab tu byung ba bas ma byung na bstan pa la phan gsu/nga ba'i rkyen gyis rab byung mdzad dbang ma byung na'ang / dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs kyi sdom pa shin tu dag cing / tha na dge bsnyen gyi skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya lhan pa ser po la yang mi 'gom/ btsun chung rnams rdo sgor rgyag sar byon nas/ tshe dang ldan pa bla gos gcig bzhes cig dge bsnyen rgad po gcig 'tshal ba yin no gsung tshung legs par gus pa'i phyag mdzad/ gzhan de lta bu'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bstan 'dzin kun gyi bla mar gyur pa sus kyang tshul de lta bu rmi lam du'ang bsgrub par mi/ nus/ so/ /de bzhin du byang sems dang / gsang sngags kyi sdom pa 'khor dang bcas pa la nyes lhung phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i blang dor zhen tu bya dka' ba mdzad pas tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rdzogs so/ /lhag pa ting nge 'dzin la/ spyir mnyam rjes kun tu zhi gnas khyad par can gyi nyams dang mi 'bral/ khyad par rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar son/ yi dam dang bla ma zhi bar gshegs pa kun mnal lam dang mngon sum ci rigs par byon nas chos gsung / the tshom gcod/ yang dgos rnal 'byor dbang phyug birla pas rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis la sogs rgyud lung ma na ngag

mtha' yas pa dngos su 'doms par mdzad/ lhag pa shes rab ni/ gsung rab mtha' dag gi tshig dang don la chags thogs cung zad kyang mi mnga' zhing / ma rtogs pa dnge log parartogapadang thetshomamatha'adanyemyuradugacod nus pa'i yang dag pa'i nges pa brtan po dang ldan zhing / chos gsung ba thams cad kyang thugs nas gsung / ji lta ji snyed la gzigs pa rnam par dag khyad par slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i lugs kyi dbu ma chen po'i lta ba khyad par can mnga' bar brtsams chos las shes shing / dbon sras 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i bar du de ltar snang bas ding sang sa skya pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin par khas che zhing / nga rgyal byas nas lta ba rang rgyud pa byed pa dag ni lugs dang mi mthun no/ /nang na rtogs pa khyad par can mnga' ba ltar/ phyi rol du grub pa'i rtags bstan pa yang / gzhan don mdzad dus nyin gcig la sku lus drug sprul te/ sa skya/ mnga' ris mchar kha/ zangs gdong ru khrod rnams su gdul bya mang po la lam 'bras gsung ba gsum/ gung thang du bla ma mal gyi drung du dril bu chos skor gsan pa/ shab sgo lngar chos 'khor bskor ba 'bring mtshams 'bron lha lcam gyi lha khang la rab gnas mdzad pa rnams dus tshod tshes grangs gcig la mdzad/ sku gshegs dus kyang sku'i bkod pa bzhi bstan te/ bde ba can/ gcig po ta la/ gcig 56 6na/ gcig gser mdog can du gshegs/ pur bzhu dus kun gyis kye rdor zhal bzhi par mthong / la las brgyad pa ra mthong ba yang bstan pa sogs gyub rtags bsam

༄༄༄/ /gyis mi khyab bo/ /gzhan don la sku dngos kyi gdul bya/ bla ma dge chu ba la dbang gsan pa'i sta gon gyi mnal lam dang mthun par/ zhang ston mnga' brnyes chos 'bar gyis gsung ngag mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mjug tu lung bstan mdzad pa bzhin/ lus ma spangs par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa gsum/ bzod pa thob pa bdun/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgya phrag mkhas shing grub pa thob pa mtha' yas pa byung ste/ gsum ni ming gha la'i a tsa ra / byang chub sems dpa' stag sgom pa kyi 'bar ro/ /bdun ni rje btsun pa/ zhu yas/ shing dga' ston rdo rje grags/ nags sgo bsod rgyal/ mtshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ sgom pa 'od zer grags/ a ce mang chung ma rnams so/ /phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du brtsams chos kyang rgyud gsum/ bde mchog rtog bdun la sogs pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ku nag po gzhung drug la sogs pa'i rgya gzhung gi bshad pa/ spyir zab chos mang po/ sgos chos skyong gi sgrub skor/ yang sgos lam 'bras kyi zan bzhi rnam 'grel 'khrid yig kyang bcu gcig tsam mdzad de/ thams cad kyang tshig 'dus shing gsal ba/ don rgyas shing zab pa mkhas pa kun gyi yid 'phrog par mdzad pas snyan pa'i grags pa yang / ding sang bod na dpal ldan birla pa'i sprul pa zhig gis bstanapa rin po che la bya ba khyad par can byed do zhes rgya gar shar nub tshun chad du grags so/ /phyag rdzas kyang 'di che ste/ chos skyong che chung gnyis ka 'dis rnyed pa'i phyir/ mal gyis/ rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs sgo bsrung ba'i

gur mgon gyi bse 'bag 'phur shes sogs gnang / phyi la legs par brdzangs/ gnam kha'u pas zhal bzhi pa legs par gnang ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i bla ma des dgung lo nyi shu pa nas re bdun gyi bar zhe bdun gdan sa mdzad nas/ sa pho stag gi lo dbyug gu'i bcu bzhi la skya 'o kha gdang/ g.yung mo mkhar du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag med dang bcas te zhi bar gshegs so/ /bla ma 'dis btsun mo gnyis bzhes pa'i jo mo lcam phur mo la sras gakhog 'khrangs pa dkon mchog 'bar zhes pas rgya gar du slob gnyer la byon/ legs par mkhyen pas phyir 'byon khar rdo rje gdan du gshegs so/ /tsha mo rong pa ma gcig 'od sgron bya ba la sras gsum 'khrangs pa ni/ slob dpon bsod rtse/ rje btsun sgrogs rgyal/ dpal chen 'od po ste / rim pa bzhin yab dgung lo nga gcig nga drug nga dgu pa ste/ chu pho khyi/ chu mo yos/ lcags pho rta rnams la 'khrangs/ gcen ni rgya gar gyi grub cherno mi thub zla ba'i sprul par grags/ 'dis lo bcu bdun gyi bar la yab bzhugs pas / yab la zab rgyas kyi chos mtha' dag dang / de ting cha pa chos kyi seng ge la dbu tshad/ byams chos sogs legs parado tasan pas mtshan nyid kyi chos la shin tu mkhas/ ston pa bzang bas jo sras gsum gyi gcig tu byed/ cha pa la gser gyi 'gan ji ra dang / yum rgyas pa sogs 'bul ba dang bsnyen bskur mang pos mnyes par mdzad/ nge rting dpal ldan sa skyar mkhas grub kyi skye bo mtha' ya/sa nga/ bsdus te sngags ma tshan nyid kyi 'chad rtsod rtsorma gsum dri ma med pa dang / zab rgyas

ra༅༅/ /kyi thugs dam zab mos nyin mtshan ska da cig kyang mi g.yel ba'i ngang nas gdan sa lo sum cu mdzad zer mkhan yod kyang nyer gsum mdzad nas/ dgung lo zhe gcig pa chu pho stag gi smal zla'i tshes bcu gcig la dpal sa skyar zhi bar gshegs te/ rgyas par rnam thar chen mo rnams su blta'o/ /rje btsun chen po ni/ lo 'di'i rjes la 'di mdzad la sogs pa'i rgyas pa ni rnam thar chen mo rnams su blta bar bya la/ 'dir ni mdor bsdus te dad pa dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / gtong ba dang / shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rnams kyis shes par bya ste de yang / dang por dkar chos mtha' das gi rtsa ba dad pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ spyir bla ma dang dkon mchog la shin tu mos pas sku tshe ril po bla ma rnams kyi ched du rten gsum khyad par can bzhengs pa dang / dus mchod 'dzugs pa dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang / tha na rten gyi drung du mchod pa bshom pa tshun chad la rtsal du 'don zhing / khyad par bla ma yab sras la rdo rje 'chang gi 'du shes khor yug tu mdzad nas zhal bzhugs pa'i ring la'ang bka' gang gnang sgrub pa'i sgo nas legs par mnyes par byed/ sku'i rgyab mi ston/ ku re'i phyir yang bka' mi zlog mi mnyes pa cung zad kyang mi sgrub/ zhi bar gshegs nas kyang gsol ba rgyun mi 'chad du 'debs pas sku'i snang ba dang mi 'bral/ gsung rab la the tshom gang byung thams cad maṇ+ḍal phul nas bla ma yab sras kho na la gsol ba 'debs/ mdor na dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul la bod du 'di las

lhag pa ma byung bar grags so/ /tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dgung lo brgyad pa la byang sems zla rgyal gyi drung du tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa legs par nod de/ rten skya bor bzhugs pa tsam ma gtogs/ sha chang sgong gsum zhal la mi reg dge slong khyad par can gyi thugs nyams dang mi 'bral/ sku 'bor gyi gtso bo yang rab byung la mdzad/ khyed rnams kyis gso sbyong ma chag pa gyis ja ngas 'dren gsungs nas rab byung 'ba' zhig la dgyes/ mdor na sdom gsum legs par nod nas nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos par mdzad do/ /thos pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas klog dang yig rtsis sogs tshogs chung ngus mkhyen cing / yab dang gcen la dbang bshad man ngag ma lus par gsan/ khyad par dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la sdom pa nyi shu pa dang / sgrub thabs mtsho skyes thugs las gsungs/ bcu gsum pa la rgyud gsum gyi po ti zhal du gsol ba'i mnal lam byung ba bzhin du tshil don mtha' dag thugs la chud de/ yab gshegs pa'i chos 'khor la tsholas su gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te/ blo gros chen por mtshan gsol/ mdor na bla chen yab sras rje btsun rin po che/ gnyan gtsug tor rgyal po/ gnyan dbang rgyal/ zhang btsun tshul grags/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na/ lo tsā ba ngar ma yon smo/ sum pa lo tsā ba dang dpal mchos dang po'i rdo rje la sogs pa 'a/ rgya gar nas/ 'gyur ba'i mdo bstan bcosku/ rgyud ma na ngag ma tha' ya sa pa gcig gsan cing legs par sbyangs/ ma gsan pa 'ga' re yang

༄༄༄/ /gzigs rtog legs par mdzad de/ nga thos rgya can min kyang mthong rgya can yin/ ngas dge slong gcig 'grub tu re nas 'dul ba lung 'di yun ring por blta ba ma grub/ dge slong mi grub par shes nas legs par bltas zhes gsungs/ mdor na ma gzigs pa'am mi mkhyen pa'i chos cung zad kyang med pas/ thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /zhes pa'i sa gsum pa'i yong sbyong rdzogs par mdzad do/ /gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa ni dge 'dun mang du bsags pa'i chos 'khor lan gsum mdzad/ rgyun ldan du dge 'dun brgya phyag tsam gyi 'tsho ba sbyor/ dbu rtse rnying mar grags pa'i gtsug lag khang / yab kyi nang rten bkra shis sgo mangs/ mes kyi nang rten gser 'bum chen mo/ gnyen dang gcung gi nang rten gser sku chen mo re re/ de dag gi drung du dkar me mtshan thub brgya rtsa 'chag med kyi rgyun/ gzhan yang chen po la 'os pa'i bla re yol ba/ 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan/ dril bu'i sdang rings/ gser gyi mdo mangs dang rgyud 'bum la sogs pa'i bka' 'gyur phal cher gsar du bzhengs/ gzhan gyis phul ba'i 'bum cha sum brgya tsam byung ba'i steng nas brgya phyag gcig gtsug lag khang der bzhugs su gsol nas/ nyis brgya dge 'dun gyi sde so sor bstan pa'i rgyun la phul / mdor na chos dang zang zing gi dpal 'byor gang la'ang 'dzin chags cung zad kyang mi 'dzin par sbyin gtong kho na la dgyes pa 'dra ba/ sku gshegs khar na bza' phrugs gasdig las ma lus par grags so/ /khyad par chos kyi sbyin pa la mchog

tu dgyes pas gang zhus de ma thag thugs nas gsung ba ma gtogs/ phyis bya gsung ba mi srid/ dus nam yang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum kho nas 'dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gang gzigs pa thams cad kyi tshig don la chags thogs cung zad kyang mi mnga' bar so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis legs par dpyad nas ma rtogs log rtog dang the tshom gyi dri ma cung zad kyang med par thugs su chud pas/ chos rje pas/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa / /zhes bstod pa mdzad cing 'jam dbyangs dngos su gzigs so/ /de ltar rang gi mkhyen cing gzigs pa thams cad gcung dang chos rje pa dang / dga' ston bdud rtsi grags sogs grags pa'i mtha' can rnams/ pho rog pa chen po la sogs pa dngos kyi gdul bya rnams la nyin mtshan kun tu zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos 'khor bskor zhing / dngos brgyud mtha' dag gi ched du legs bshad mtha' yas pa brtsams te/ yab sras khu dbon gyi nang na 'di nyid kyi brtsams chos mang bar bzhugs so / /mdor na bla ma'i mos gus thugs dam thos bsam/ gzhan phan lhag bsam rnams nyin par dza/gas shin tu che bas mtshan mo mnal lam du yang mtshan brjod la sogs pa'i zhal 'don thugs dam mang po dang / gzigs rtog dang rtog dpyod mtha' yas pa 'byung zhing / sa chen gyis thugs kha nas bla ma 'khor bcas kye rdor gyi ngakyil 'khor ston pa tshog thub 'khor bcas sprul nas khyod ngabang zhu na su la zhu/ rab byung che na na su la len 'domang shig ces gsu nga ba la / de thams cad bla ma

rir༅༅/ /rje btsun khyed rang nyid la zhu ba lags/ zhes zhus pas dgyes nas dbugs dbyung / khyad par chos thams cad gnad bsdas pa'i tshigs bcad gnang / yang sgos dbang bzhi pa'i lam zab lan mang du gsungs/ lha rnams kyis bde ba can dang mkha' spyod du 'byon pa bskul ba na/ bdag la ltos pa'i 'gro ba mang du yod pas mi 'gro zhus pa dang / gzhan yang srid pa'i rgya mtsho las 'gro ba marnga ri po sgrol ba'i mtshan ltas la sogs pa mnal lam gyi rnam par thar pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin mtha' yas pa'i ngang nas/ gdan sa gcig gshegs pa nas brtsis na so lnga/ lo bcu'i gong du khur ba nas brtsis na zhe lnga mdzad de/ dgung lo bdun cu pa me pho khyi ba'i dbo zla'i tshes bcu gnyis la kho bo 'di nas bde ba can dang / de nas gser mdog can du 'khor los bsgrar ba'i cha byad kyis zhing sbyong / lus gsum pa la lus de nyid kyis phyag rgya chen po 'grub bo zhes gsungs nas gshegs so/ /bcu pa dpal chen 'od po ni/ thugs brtan zhing yangs pa ngo tsha dang khrel yod shas che ba/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus4 8na sum tshogs pas yab mes kyi chos la legs par sbyangs shing / khyad par sman spyad la mkhas pas gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bstan bcos 'ga' re brtsams shing sman gyi sgo nas gzhan don mang du mdzad de/ dgung lo nga bzhi pa chu mo phag gi zla ba lnga pa'i nyer gcig la gshegs te/ mched de gsum dpal ldan sa skya'i gzim khang nyid du

gshegs so bla ma 'di la sres gnyis 'brangs pa ni/ chos rje sa paṇa/ zangs tsha bsod rgyal du grags te/ yum ma gcig gar bu ma nyi khri lcam zhes bya ba'o/ /de yang yab kyis dgung lo so gsum dang so lnga bzhes pa chu pho stag dang / shing pho 'brug la ste/ slob dpon rin po che gshegarmi lo dang / rje btsun rin po che so bdun bzhes dus chos rje 'khrangs pa'o/ chos rje'i rnam thar chen mo rnams dang / bsdus pa chos rgyal mar gsal la 'dir yang bsdus te/ mkhyen brtse phyin las gsum gyis brjod na/ mkhyen pa la rang gi sbyangs pa dang / gzhan la bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ klu'i rgyalarmi sa yum la gnas khang g.yar ba'i tshul gyis bsams bzhin du mngal bzung nas/ dge byed ces bya ba chu pho stag gi khra zla'i nyi shu rtsa drug la yum gyi lus sems bde ba'i nyams dang ldan par sku bltams te/ gog thub pa'i dus sam skṛ ta'i skad gsung zhing rgya yig mang po khris nas bklags na mi 'gom par gsungs pa dang / gzhon nu nyid nas klog yig bzo gso ba skad gnyis kyi rnam grangs la sogs pa tshogs chung dus mkhyen/ rje btsun chen po la dbang bshad man ngag rgyun ma chad par gsan te/ dgung lo brgyad pa la mtsho skyes/ bcu pa la brtag gnyis/ bcu gcig pa la gur saṃ thugs las gsungs pas kun gyis ya mtshan du 'dzin/ mdor na bco lnga pa la rje btsun chen po'i bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs su chud/ bco brgyad pa la a byi 'bum pa'i drung du/ slob dpon stig gasto la mdzod tshar gcis mnal lam du gsan pas thugs su chud/ phyogs kyi glang

ra༅༅/ /po'i phug pa yin zer ba gcig tshad ma'i dpe chas bkang ba'i lde mig gtad pa rmis/ bcu dgu pa la don mo ri pa zhu ston rdo rje skyabs la byams chos rtsa 'grel dang dbu ma mang du gsan/ nyi shu pa la nyang stod skyang thur du 'tshar ston gzhon nu seng ge la tshad ma rnam nges la sogs pa'i dbu tshad mang du gsan/ de'i bar skabs la sa skyar yab gshegs nas byon dgongs rdzogs sku 'dabs bsgrabs/ sku skal yang zhus/ phul/ deḥri rjes bshad gas ra dang bstan nas snga chos phyi chos mdzad de/ rnam nges zla gcig la shin tu rgyas par thugs nas bshad pas kun ya ma tshan du 'dzin par gyur/ de nas khro phur kha che paṇa chen phebs pa'i drung du byoni/ chos mchog rgya skad du gsungs pa la bde dpe bkrams nas gsan cing rgya skad du sbyar bas/ paṇa chen shin tu dgyes nas khong dpon slob rnam sa kyis paṇ+ḍi ta 'a por ma' gsol te rjes su bzung / tshad ma sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa dang / rgyan chos mchog lha shāka la sogs pa'i 'grel pa la 'grel bshad/ de bzhin du mngon pa 'dul ba sngags kyi bde mchog gsang 'dus/ khyad par dus 'khor cha lag sems 'grel gsum la sogs pa gsan/ paṇa chung dā na shi la la yang gtso bor tshad ma rnam 'grel/ gzhin rje gshed skor la sogs pa gsan/ bal po saṃ gha shrī la sgra ka tsan/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod mdos gar la sogs gsan/ spyi lhas pa byang chub 'od dang / rtsis pa dbang phyug seng ge la yang byams chos dbu ma/ bslab spyod la sogs pa dang / khyad par spyi lhas pa la man ngag zhi byed rdzogs

chen / rim lnga/ nā ro ni gu la sogs pa bod na yod tshad gsan te/ lan re zung re tsam gyis rdzogs par thugs su chud do/ /dgung lo nyer bdun pa la paṇa chen gyis mkhan po/ spyi lhas pas las slob/ zhu ston rdo rje skabs kyis gsang ston byas nas dge 'dun grangs dang mtshan nyid tshang pa'i dbus su nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ 'khon sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud kyi nang na ngur smrig gi rgyan 'chang ba'i gtsug rgyan thog ma mdzardo de/ gangs can pa thams cad rab tu byung ba la ches gtso bor gus par bya ba'i rgyun gyis gtso bor 'di 'dzin to/ /de ltar tshangs par spyod pa mtha' dag gi gtso bo dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ so thar yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng du byang sems dang gsang sngags te sdom gsum rdzogs pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung po 'chal tshul gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral bas 'dzam gling byang gi phyogs na tshul khrims bsrang ba mtha' dag gi mchog tu gyur to/ /de ltar rang gi mkhyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas gzhan la ston pa ni/ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas yin pas/ 'chad pa na/ rnam bshad rigs pa sogs nas ji ltar 'byang ba'i tshul dh+ri yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs nas gsung rab gang 'chad kyang / gang nas bshad kyang 'brel/ ji tsam bshad kyang ran / ji ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa'i tshul gyis sna bar snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / yid la 'thad cing 'phrod/ tshisgo gzung sla zhing don rtogs par yang sla bas dngos kyi gdul bya thams cad mkhas pa'i go 'phang la myur du bkod de/ bshad pa'i

༄༄༄/ /bka' babs pa 'u yug rigs pa'i seng ge dang / zhang btsun mdo sde dpal dang / shar pa sher 'byung sogs te/ mdor na khang gnyen zhang gsum/ shar nub gur gsum la sogs pa dang / man ngag gi bka' babs pa dmar ston chos spyo༄ 75 po dang / lho pa kun mkhyen dpal la sogs pa dang / rtogs pa'i bka' babs pa tshogs sgom/ nyan chen/ grub thob yon tan dpal la sogs te/ mdor na mkhas grub kyi bu chen bgrang ba las 'das pa bshad sgru+ob la bkod do/ khom pa ni sgra dang snyan ngag dang ming gi mngon brjod la sogs pa'i bstan bcos du ma dang / rigs pa'i phyogs la sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i don rdzogs par ston pa rig gter rtsa 'grel/ lung gi phyogs la mdo sde rgyan gyi dan 'grel du byas nas chos mtha' dag 'dus pa thub pa dgongs gsal la sogs te/ mdor na mdo sngags lung rigs thams cad kyi don tshig nyung dus 'dus pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog cing / blun pos go sla ba'i brtsams chos mang pos dngos dang brgyud pa'i gdul bya thams cad mkhas pa'i go 'phang la myar du 'god par mdzad/ rtsod pa ni/ spyir sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dngos stobs kyi rigs pa mtha' dag legs par thugs su chud pas bod rgan po'i rtog ge mtha' dag rang blos sbyar ba'i skyon can du gzigs pas/ bod snga ma'i grub mthazlo la dgag pa legs par mdzad pa rnams kun gyis mi bzod/ khyad par de dus kyi 'chad nyan dmar shas dpyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpon slob yin pas shin tu ma bzod nas bu dgu'i

rigs pa bzang shos 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge yin pa/ chos rje la rtsod du btang nas/ chos rar zhag shas bsdad nas 'gal du bsgugs pas ma rnyed cing / rtsod par cung zad kyang ma nus kyi steng nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste zhabs pad yun ring du bsten pas bu chen du gyur pa lta bu dang / gtsang nag phug pas 'jam dbyangs dang zhal mjal 'phro la/ chos rje la skur pa btab pas yun ring du ma mjal/ gsol ba drag tu btab pas khyod kyis nga la 'thabs pa yin gsungs nas/ dang por mjal nas rtsod pa byed 'dod pa/ de nas dad pa lhag par tshud de gdan drangs zla sbrel du chos zhus ca sku 'dra thugs kha na drod yod par grags pa sgu rum na bzhugs pa 'di legs par bzhengs nas/ phyag nas zhus te rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa lta bu dang / mkhasapa su thig yin kyang/ sku mdun mjal ma thag tu nga rgyal zhi bar gyur/ khyad par mu stegs kyi ston pa shin tu mkhas shing nga rgyal gyis dregs pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa drus gis/ rigs gter bod skad las rgya skad du bskyar te rdo rje gdan du phebs pa'i mchod brngod kyi tshig la ma bzod pas rkyen byas nas rtsod du yong bas/ chos rje nyid kyi paṇa'adamishrīdus tshes bsgrigs/ mnga' bdagargyal pos dpang mdzad/ ga' phro ba'i bstanapa la khrug par byas te/ skyid grong du byon nas dri ma med pa'i sdogs pas pham par mdzad nge/ bstan pa'i sor bcug pas 'phags pa'i yul na'ang 'jam dbyangs ngangos su grags so/ /de das ni mkhyen pa'i yon tan yin la/ci brtse ba'i thusas rje ni hor gyi rgyal pos bod kyi ngo lta rma 'jags pa'i skabs

ra༅༅/ /su dmag dpung mang po brdzangs te mthong tshad sod cig thos tshad 'dar bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i lung bud pa rim gyis lag len la bkal ba'i gtam thos pas/ bod 'bangs thams cad sems khong du chud pa'i skabs su / thugs rje chen po 'khrungs te/ dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas / dgung lo bgres po re gcig tu phebs pa na hor gyi rgyal pos gdan 'dren byung pa na/ bod 'bangs thugs kyi dkyil du bcug pa'i brtse ba chen po dang / rje btsun chen po'i lung bstan yod pa bka' bozhin bsgrub pa'i mos gus chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ sku srog yal bar dor ba lta bu'i sku nyen dang dka' spyad khyad du bsad nas/ re gsum pa la btegs nas lo gsum gyi bar la lam gyi gdul bya'i don mdzad / har gyi yul byang phyags rgyal po'i sar byon te/ bod 'bangs bde ba la bkod skad rigs mi gcig pa'i rgyal khams du ma sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas khyab cing 'phral phugs kyi phan bde la bkod do/ /phrin las ni/ gtso bor ji skad bshad pa de dag dang / rje btsun chen po'i nang rten du 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba bzhengs pa sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde gsar du 'dzugs pa dang / rnying pa gso ba dang / chos sde mang po'i zhal bdag mdzad de/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya dang / byang phyogs ling chu rtser khab/ bar pa/ bsam yas/ nyang stod skyang thur/ sha pa sreg shing / chung ba khams gtsang dbus gsum na shin tu mang ba'i bdag nyer mdzad nas spyir —rig

gnas mtha' dgadang mdo sngags/ khyad par rnam 'grel —'dul mngon phar phyin dbu sems dang bde kye gsang gsum yo ga bya spyod sogs mdo sngags zung tshol rtag gnyis kyi bshad srol ding sang gi bar du yod pa ni bdag nyid chen po 'di kho na'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun no/ /khyad par rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi grwa sa/ byang ngam rings/ dbus rtse thang na lan+d+ra/ sku tshal gong zin/ gser mdog ༅/ thub bstan gong / gasmo bya gshongs sogs dang / de dag las mched pa dpal ldan sa skya'i thub bstan rin chen sogs mos grwa mngapo la sogs pa shin tu dar rgyas su gyur/ hor yul la 'byon pa'i tshe sa skyar ma nyid kyi tsho+ogs dpon 'u yug rig seng / sngags kyi tshogs dpon zhang btsun mdo sde dpal/ spyi dpon nye gnas su dge bshes stodzi bzang po bkos nas byon rjes rigs chen pa rang la cha brgyad cu byung par grags pa lta bu bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa'i phrin las ni bla ma 'di kho na tshe'o/ khyad dus gdul bya nyams dma' ba'i skabs su phrin las rnam dag gi rgyun tshugs pa rnam thar gyi gan bo yin byu/ nyid kyis lha dang bla ma mang po gzigs pa sogs ni byis pa mtshar bskyed du zad do/ /de ltar dgung lo so drug pa nas/ bdun cu'i bar so lnga gdan sa mdzad nas/ lcags mo phag gi smal po zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la rjod kyis mi lang pa'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ byang phyogs sprul pa sde'i gzimakhang du bde bar gshegs so/ /gcung zangs tsha bsong rgyal ri/ yab mes kyi chos la sbyangs/ kye rdor ngang phur pa la mnga' brnyes/ zhang po bod kyi gyad pa zangs/ darkar lcog re'i brgyud yin pas lu sa rtsal shin tu che ba'i zhang

ra༅༅/ /rigs su 'khrangs nas/ sku rtsal shin tu che ba'i grags pa byung bas/ lus rtsal gyis nga rgyal ba mang pos 'gran du yongs pa rnams kyis 'gran ma bzod pa'i gtam rgyad yod/ gzhi thog bla brang dang / phyag mdas 'khor tshad kyi lcags ri btab/ chos dpa zang zing gi dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i ngang nas/ dgung lo nga drug pa sa mo phag gi rgyal zla'i nyi shu gnyis la dag pa'i snang ba du ma dang bcas shing / bla ma 'jo 'jam dbyangs dngos/ yin pa/sa khyed rnam sa kyang mos gus de bzhin du gyis/ nga yang mos gus rtse gcig 'di'i ngang nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du lam zab mo sgom zhing / gzhan la yang dbang bskur re tsam byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa gcig tu skye gsungs nas/ la stod ldog gi dpag ri zhes bya bar sku gshegs so/ /bla ma 'di la sras bzhi/ sras mo bzhi ste lcam sring brgyad 'brangs pa'i yongs su grags pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che dang / phyag na rdo rje/ sras gnyis pa ni rin chen rgyal ma dang / ye shes 'byung gnas so/ /snga ma gnyis ni / ma gcig ldog stod ma kun dga' skyid la yab dgung lo nga gnyis pa shing zlo lug gi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes drug la dang / nga drug pa sa mo phag la 'khrangs pa'o/ 'phags pa blo gros rgyal ma dpal bzang po ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi lo ts+tsha ba chen po ka ba dpal rtsegs kyi sku skyer slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan gsal po yod cing / spyan ras gzigs dang gsung gleng rtag pye mdzad pa'i sa ston ri par grags pa cig si sku skye de ma thag par zhal gyis bzhes/ de'i grwa pa

rnams ngo mkhyen pa sogs chung ngu nas byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das/ bslab pa'i gnas dang rgyu rtsal tshegs chung dus mkhyen/ bla ma 'di dang 'gro mgon phyag na ste/ sku mched gnyis mas sgu rum gyi nyi zer la na bza' dang 'khor gsum/ bkal / kun gyis 'di ni 'phags pa'o zhes bsgrags pas 'phags par grags/ dgung lo gsum pa /mo sgrub thabs mtsho skyes/ brgyad pa la skyes rabs/ dgu pa la brtag gnyis thugs las gsungs/ tshogs pa thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar / de ltar na skye stobs kyi thugs rab ni chos rje las kyang lhag par mkhas pa rnams la grags so/ bcu pa la chos rje'i phyag phyir gong du byon pa'i mar lam zul phur/ chos rje pas mkhan po/ zul phu ba na bza' 'phred gsol du grags pa chos dbang bas slob dpon mdzad nas rab tu byung / skyor mo lung pa shes rab seng ge la kā ri kā gsan te lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas/ phyug par mdzad do/ de ltar dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i bar chos rje la dbang 'khrid bshad pa phal cher rdzogs / shin tu brnyes nas chos dung / lhung bzed/ phyag dpe/ tshogs pa rnams gtad/ bstan pa'i khur bkur/ bcu bdun pa la chos rje dang bco brgyad pa la byang phyogs rgyal po go dan yang gshegs/ de nas so chen gan gyis gdan drangs / brtag pa dang dri ba la sogs pa'i sbo nas yid ches shing / btsun mos mtshams sbyar nas mos gus khyad par can tshung/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu mosna glang si lo sasar la/ se chen gan gyis dbang bsku ra zhus/ g.yang tri'u las byas pa mi ge

ra༅༅/ /sa dngarin po che la'i ri mo yod pa'i dam ga phul/ ti shrī'i mtshan gsol/ gser dang mu tig gi rnam sbyar/ sku chos/ phyam tshe/ dbu zhwa/ chags lham/ gzhugs gdan/ gser gyi khri/ gdugs/ sasol zhal / gsol sder la sogs tshang ma/ rnga mo dang phyibs drel gser gyi sga 'khor tshang ma/ gtso bor dbus gtsang gi khri skor bcu gsum/ sgos su gtsang chu mig gi khri skor du gang gtogs phyag phyir phul/ ((de dus kyi dbu zhwa rtse gdong pa la yod/ par gras/ dam ga shar pa dang / sga 'bor zur tsho ba la yod par byed don/ / /phyis lo sta ga lo de la brje shed skyed bod yig tu bris pa dang / dngul bre chen lnga bcu rtsa drug nga mig nyis brgya/ gos yug brgya bcu dang / dar yug stong dang brgya phul lo/ stag lo 'di la rgya gar du tsu mas bzung yod/ mtshams hor dmag khyer/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba gdan drangs par byed/ de bar 'phags pa rin po ches byang dngos su byon/ chos rje'i sku 'bum bzhengs/ 'u yug pa gdan 'dren gtang nas mdo khams su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad rtsis la 'u yug pa grongs/ snye thang pa grags seng gis mkhan po mdzad/ las slob jo gdan byang thang pa bsod rgyal/ gsadza sde yar lungs pa byang rgyal/ dad dge mkhan po sgro dang gnam 'phar ba sogs chos rje'i bu chen mang po bsags nas dgung lo nyer gcig pa shing mo yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ rgya bod kyi mtshams he ce'u dang nye ba'i sar/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi

sdom pa rnam par dag pa bzhes so/ /dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i sprul gyi lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nub mo/ chos rje mngon sum du byon nas/ zab rgyas kyi chos gsungs/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung / bstod pa yang mdzad/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma yang de dus mdzad par byed do/ /de nas hor yig ge med pa la yi ge gsar brtsams/ de'i phud la brje shed skyed thags ma phul/ dbang yon bar ma la bod chol kha gsum/ tha ma la rgya yi mi yugs chen mo phul / bod thams cad sa skya pa'i chos lugs las gzhan pa byed dbang med pa'i lung 'bud gsung ba la/ rang rang gi chos lugs gang yo/da skyong du 'jug pa cis kyang dgos gsungs nas/ yon mchod sanyis ga'i 'ja sags thams cad la rang rang gi chos lugs la 'bad pa thon gsung ba sha stag yod pas dbang sngas shin tu bzang ba yin no/ /rgya nag gi chos lugs sogs par spyod pa'i zin shing ston pa bcu bdun bstan pa la shin tu sdang bar yod pa rnams ni rigs pa rnam dag gis btul nas bstan pa la bcugs te / rgya/ hor/ ljang / yu gur/ spe nyag la sogs pa'i skal ldan snod du rung ba rnams la/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs lo re'i nang du stong phrag re tsam rang gis gnang ba dang / mkhan bu 'dul 'dzin chos mgon zhes bya ba sman rtse'i yul du brdzangs nas/ des kyang rab byung dgu brgya tsam dang / rje nyid kyis gnang ba snga rting gril ba la ba'i stong ba'i brgya nyer lnga mdzad nge/ rgya myos si rgyal lam/sa/ rab byung sis sang bar ma dzad do /ma tsham sa gcig tu hor dang sa skya pa 'brel ba'i snyan pa

༄༄༄/ /sgrogs pa dang / 'ja mo 'dzugs pa la gong ma yon mchod kyi 'ja sar 'khyer nas/ hor gyi mi chen dwasmran zhes bya ba sa skya bar du brdzangs/ 'di hor gyi gserayi ga pa bod la brdzangs pa'i thog ma yin no/ /de nas dgung lo nyer brgyad pa chu pho khyi la char rkyen mang du bskur ba mdzad pa rnams la brten nas/ dpon chen stak+ṣa bzang pos dbu rtse sgo gsum/ gser thog chen po dang bcas pa/ gser 'bum chen mo g.yu thog dang bcas pa dang / thub pa chen po'i gser sku la sogs pa bzhengs/ de'i phyis lo chu mig chos 'khor sngon ma la dge 'dun brgyad khri tsam la 'bul 'gyed gya nom pa gnang / hor yul nas yar byon pa'i lam khar mdo khams gtso mdo gnas gsar du nye gnas chen po rin chen sta na tshul gyis do dam byas nas gser gyi glegs bam phyed nyis stong la sogs pa/ rten gsum sde dgon/ mi nor gyi 'bul ba grangs med pa bzhes nas dgung lo so gcig pa shing mo glang la sa skyar phebs/ gser thog chen po'i bzhugs tshags/ gser 'bum bkris sgo mangs/ rje gong ma'i phye rten skya 'bum bdun la gser gyi gdugs chor ro/ sgos su chos rje'i phyi rten la gser thog bka' 'gyur la sogs pa gser gyi spo sa nyis brgya lhag pa la sogs pa bzhengs/ de lta bu'i bstan pa 'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jig rten gyi gtso bor gyur nas kyang / mdo sngags dbang bshad kyi rgyun zab mo nyams kyi dogs nas/ de dus kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun bzang ba dang / lung rgya che ba chung 'bring mtha' dag bla mar bsten/ rang

bzhed pa'i chos sde 'edug na lo btsun phal pa gcig la 'dug kyang / nga rgyal dang khengs pa dang gzhan gyi smod pa sogs gang la yang mi dgongs par gus pas gtsug tu bzhes nas chos zhus ste/ de dag gi rnam thar rgyas pa gsan yig sogs na gsal lo/ /chos kyi ched yin kyang 'di lta bu'i che 'jing bcag pa ni gzhan sus kyang sgrub par dka'o/ /dus phyis sgra tshad snyan ngag la sogs pa rig gnas thun mong ba chos 'brel du mi 'gro ba la dgongs nas/ de dag gi 'dzub khrid pa la phyag mi mdzad pa la 'khral nas/ gdung brgyud la khag gtang ba'i zab chos mang po bslabs nas/ chos 'brel du mi rtsi ba byung ba ni rang rang gi khengs pa'i skon no/ /de nas dgung lo so gsum pa me mo yos la 'gro mgon phyag na sku gshegs pa'i chos 'khor chu mig rto mdzad pa la dge 'dun dgu khri la 'bul 'gyed bgrang las 'das so/ /de rjes de ma thag hor gyi gdan 'dren pa nan ches nas lo bzhuṅger+sha de la 'dam du phebs par byon/ phyis lo sa pho 'brag la dpon chen tshodze bzang pos lha khang chen mo bzhengs/ khri skor bcu gsum bskul/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang po dang sbrel nas rdzogs par grub/ rin chen sgang / lha khang bla brang / dus mchod bla brang rnams kyang bzhengs so/ /gong du thobs nas dgung lo so drug pa lcags pho rta la dbang zhus pa'i tshe mi lhag rgya rgod kyi rgyal po'i shel dam la bcos byas nas shel dam gling drug ma dang / mu tig li 'ja sags phul/ gnam gyi 'og sa'i steng na/ rgya sar lha'i sras po/ sprul pa'i sangs rgyas// i be rtsom mi/ rgya' lam so/

༄༄༄/ /'jags su 'jug pa po gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'phags pa ti shri zhes mtshan gsol/ dngul bre chen stong rwa can dang / gso dar lnga khri dgu stong la sogs pa phul/ mjal res kyis mthong phyag dang mjal dar dngul bre 'chag med sogs ma dzad pas/ rgyal po'i 'phral gyi 'bul ba kun gril bsu gser bre brgya lhag dngul bre stong rwa can/ gos dar bzhi khri la sogs pa byung bar bshad do/ /de nas zhe gnyis pa me pho khyi lo la sa skyar phebs/ bod kyi dge bshes skya btsun thams cad la/ bod kyi dbang bshad lung man ngag thams cad nga la yod pas nyan du shog ces bka' gnang nas/ zhe drug pa'i bar la chos dang zang zing gi char phab/ khyad par glang lo la chu mig chos 'khor chen mo la zhag bco lnga'i bar du dge 'dun 'bum phrag gcig la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa mdzad tshul ba sum gyis mi khyab/ de ltar skyangs pa'i slob ma'i mchog kyang shar nub gung gsum/ khang gnyen zhang gsum/ la ru ba/ gnyen chen pa/ sru lung pa/ lo mchog dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ gsal la ba 'dor 'bum/ dbus pa sangs 'bum dam pa kun dkosakho la la sogs pa brgyud pa 'dzin nges kyang mang du byon/ snang ngor bstan pa'i rtogs pa'i yon tan yang 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad du yod pa dang / rnal lam du yang gzhan rgyud dang ga'an gyi rmi lam gang rmi mkhyen pa dang / rma bya chen mo dang / dpal mgon klu sgrub la sogs pa gzigs so/ /de ltar dgung lo bco brgyad pa nas zhe drug gi bar nyi shu rtsa

dgu'i bar la gdan sa ches 'bring chung gsum/ rgya bod kyi chos sde phal mo che'i bdag rkyen bsko bzhag skong dar la sogs pas nyin mtshan bzlas par mdzad nas zhe drug pa lcags pho 'brug gi smal lo zla ba'i nyi shu gnyis la dkon mchog gi drung du mchod pa rgyas par gzhoms gsungs nas rdo rje dkyil krung mdzad/ rdor dril thugs khar bsnol ba'i ngarjo nas —mi bya r+pāmo dang/ dpalamasonaklu sgrubal/so gsapa dngosasugazigs so/ /ngo mtshar gyi bltas du ma dang bcas te/ lha khang che mo'i bla brang du bde bar gshegs so/ /'gro mgon phyag na rdo rje ni/ dgung lo drug pa la chos rje'i phyag phyir hor yul du byon/ gzhon nu nas sems can sbyor sgrol nus/ byang ngos rgyal pos sras mo me ga dun gnang / hor chas su bcug se chen rgyal pos pā len dbang gi lung dang gser dam/ thong phyi g.yas g.yon gyi khrim ra dang bcas pa gnang / sa chol kha gsum gyi khrims bdag tu bkos/ bod la ti'i ngang wang gi las kha byung pa'i thog ma sku mched 'di gnyis yin/ 'di gnyis kyis dam kha gnyis dam 'khor dang bcas pa dang / ti'i kun blo'i la na he'i dam kha/ 'phags pa rin po che'i dbu zhwa rnams rtse gdong pa'i phyag na bzhugs shing / rgya'i wang gi kha/sa kha dang lung gnang sbyin yang nar mar yong ngo / /'gro ma gon phyag na 'di ni dgung lo nyer dgu pa me mo yos la dgu rum gzim khang hūm̐ sku gshegs so/ /'phags pa gshegs pa'i phyis lo bya rog tshang la hor dmag drangs/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang po bkrongs/ nge'i phyis lo chu mis tu tsha gshesas ljong sa kyi chos/ 'khor la khri

ra༅༅/ /phrag bcu gcig tsam gyi dge 'dun bsags nas 'bul 'gyed rgyas pa dang / nang rten chen mo lha chen dpal 'bar las kyang che ba'i gser sku bzhengs so/ /zangs tsho'i sras rin chen rgyan pa dang / ye 'byung ba gnyis yab nga lnga pa'i sras yin/ snga ma'i yum shab kyi jo 'bro ma yin/ phyi ma ni gung thang pa lha lcam mdzes ma'i g.yog mo rdo rje gdan gyi zur bu yin/ lha lcam pa la sras mo bsod nams 'bum dang nyi ma 'bum gnyis las ma byung / rin chen rgyal mtshan pa'i yum la sras mo mdo sde dang / yang jo mo ho ra lcam zer ba gcig sras mo rin chen 'byung gnas te/ zangs tsha la sras bzhi dang sras mo bzhi byung / rin chen rgyal mtshan pa la dpag shi rin chen du grags/ chos rje khu dbon la gcigs/ rab tu byung nas legs par sbyangs pas mkhas grub tu gyur/ 'phags pa bod du 'byon ring la gdan sa shing kun dang me tog ra ba sogs/ kyi gdan sar bskos/ phrin las rgyas pa'i ngang nas dgung lo zhe gnyis pa sa mo yos la rgya nag shing kun tu gshegs so/ /ye 'byung bas kyang gong du byon/ yon to phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan ljang yul gyi dzol po hūm̐ ka ra rje'i bla ma mdzad/ phrin las dang ldan pa'i ngang nas dgung lo so drug pa la mdo khams se ra snar gshegs so/ /'gro mgon phyag na'i 'jo mo mkha' 'gro 'bum la sras gcig 'khrungs pa de sgro bang du byung nas yab gshegs pa'i phyis lo lha khang chen mo'i 'gram ldings pa dang mnyam du 'khrungs pa ni/ dharma pā la rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ste/ dgung lo dgu pa la 'phags pa sa skyar phebs pa

dang 'jal/ dbang bskar byin gyis brlabs/ bcu gsum pa la gdan sa'i khur chen po'i bskur nas 'phags pa zhi bar gshegs/ gshegs rjongs bsgrabs/ chos 'khor la tsho+ogs chos gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ bcu bzhi pa la gong du byon/ se cherno mnyes nas/ bla ma 'phags pa'i gdung gzhugs pa'i shel gyi mchod rten bzhengs/ de bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde chen po me togi ra ba bzhengs/ der thogs gcig byon nas yar phebs pa'i lam mdo khams kyi tre maṇ+ḍal du dgung lo nyi shu pa me mo phag gi smal zla'i tshes bco brgyad la gsol ma 'phrod pas gshegs so/ /de'i jo mo stag 'bum la sras rat+na bha dra zhes bya 'khrangs pa yang gzhon nu nas gshegs te/ yongs su grags pa'i gdung rgyud grags che ba med pa lta bur gyur te/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan pas sa skya'i zhal bdag gser thog g.yu thog gi bcor rnam dang / lha khang chen mo'i gnarmo rgyun/ mchod cha/ thing khang la yo ga'i dkyil 'khor grangs med bzhengs pa/ bdag nyid chen po'i slob gnyer dbu mdon/ rgyal po'i bla ma la sogs pa mdzad dgos pa byang pa'i rnam thar zur pa rnams na gsal lo/ /slob dpon chen po ye 'byung bas dgung lo nyer lnga 'gro ba chu pho khyi lo la bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal ba bo dong e ru 'khrungs/ gangan sa'i gser thog chen mo ba'engs lo dang gcig 'jis rdogung lo bcu drug pa'i tshe 'phags pa rin po che sa sbyar 'phebs/ ngabang bzhed mang du gnang / lan gcis 'ji la yun ring du gzigs nas/ maso res spus mo 'a/ci phab

ra༅༅/ /pa'ang srid/ yon tan 'bungs las slobs phyag na'i ri rgyud yin zer ba gnyis las mi 'dug ye 'byung gi ri rgyud yin zer ba mang du 'dug pa rmis gsung ba'i lung bstan bstsal/ de ltar 'di sgres kyang pha yul mnyam po la yum bzang ngan dang / grags che chung gi phyag na'i sras dharma pa la gdan sar skos/ 'di rang dga' ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa la mi chen a 'bus gdan drangs nas gong du byon/ gong ma'i lung gis re zhig brtag dgos pas sman rtser rgyug gsung nas bcugs pas/ 'dis nyer bdun bzhes pa'i tshes sa skyar dharam pā la grongs/ gdan sa bu chen la bcol nas/ sa skya pa rnams ci bya la gtad pa'i dus/ yar 'brog gi dpon chen zhog glen gyis sems kyis ma bzod/ do dam cher mdzad/ de'i grogs kham pa dpon nag ces bya bas kyang byas nas bka' gros pa rnams la gros bskul/ tizhi grags 'od pa gong na bzhugs pa la zhu yig byas pas/ ti shri ba'i phyags phyi nyi lde ba shes rab dpal dang / mi chen a dus byas nas gong ma la zhu ba nan gyis 'bul ba'i rgyu dang / lcam sring ma spyod nyes gcig kyang hor yul du phebs pa g.yang la lhung nas grongs pa la 'ja' 'od ring bsrel byung bas/ nga'i bla ma'i rus pa yin tsam gyis chog par 'dug pas / bzang po dpal ba mtshol gsung ba'i lung bud/ de dus bla ma 'dis rje btsun ma la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas nyi ma 'char khar tsan+dan sdong po'i steng nas zhal bstan/ bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur zhing / /nor 'dod pas ni nor

rnams nyid thob/ ces gsung byon/ dgung lo so lnga pa la sman rtse nas gdan dra( ris/ so drug pa la gong mas gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad/ 'phags pa tikhri'i dbon po yin nges su 'dug pas gdung brgyud spel ba'i lung bud/ sa skyar mgyogs par byon las gdan sa gyis gsung ba bzhin phebs te gdung rgyud spel ba dang / slob gnyer rnams legs par mdzad/ rgyal po'i lung yod kyang gsan sbyong gi stabs dang / cung zad mi mdzes pa/ la dgongs nas lo bcu'i bar du lha khang bla brang du bzhugs nas gdan sar shar pa rin rgyal ba bzhugs su bcug de ltar na 'dis nyer brgyad pa nas zhe lnga'i bar lo bco brgyad kyi ring la dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa shar pas byas pas/ da lta yang shar pa'i bla ma che 'don grub pa rnams chos khri steng du byon/ chosapa'irgya ma tshanaya nga de yin/ bdag nyid chen po bgres khar nga gnyis pa la rab tu byang / ma tshan a mo gha dh+wa dzar gsol/ thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig bzhugs/ lha khang chen mo'i lcags ri chen mo bzhengs pa sogs kyi phyag rjes kyang bzhag thugs /skyed bzang ba dang bla ma yi dam gyi byin brlabs zhugs shing chos skong 'edi rnams bran du 'khol bas sa skya'i chos dang zang zing gnyis ka 'di'i dus kho na dpal 'byor che bar grags pa'i ngang nas dgung lo re gsum bzhes pa shing pho byi ba la ga'i thog gzim khang du gshegs so/ /the lnga pa la bu yan du rgyal pos gu rtswa'i lung gnang ba nas gshegs gshegs kyi bar gdan sa mdzang do/ /bla ma des rgyal po'i lung ltar gdung brgyud spel/ ba'i phyir du btsun mo drus bab tu bzhes pa

༄༄༄/ /ni/ rgyal pos gnang ba'i hor mo/ dpon chen ag glen gyi jo mo phul ba'i mang mkhar ma kun dga' 'bum/ gzhan yang kun dga' nam mkha'i rgyan/ nam mkha' rgyal mo/ red mda' ma nyi ma rin chen/ zhal lu ma gzhon nu 'bum rnams so/ /dang po la sras bsod nams bzang po/ 'dis sku gzhon dus byang ngos su gu'i gung mdzad/ de rting rgyal po yu pa rtas pā len dbang gi mtshan dang lcam mo gnang / sras rat+na shrī bya ba yang 'khrangs te/ yab khams su gshegs/ sras rgya yul du gshegs nas de las gdung brgyud mched pa med do/ /mang mkhar ma ngang mor grags pa de la sra sa ti'i kun blo ni yab dgung lo so brgyad pa sa mo phag la 'khrangs/ rnam thar thams cajo 'phags rnga/ rin po che dang mtshungs par grags/ gong du byon/ hor ge gan rgyal po'i ti'i mdzad/ bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ yab kyi gshegs rdzongs rten bzhengs/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gdan sa che ba rā skya/ shing kun/ me tog ra ba gsum / bar pa chu mig mdo khams na gtso mdo/ bsam 'grub/ ri 'bur/ gnya' gong / rgya yul byang ngos na ling chu rtsir khab ste drug gzhan yang chos sde du ma'i zhal bdag sko bzhag sku mched rnams la sa cha dngabla brang dam kha la sogs pa saku+o sorasbyar te / yab kyi tshab mdzad nas phrin las phul du byung ba'i ngang las dgung lo nyer dgu nga/ me mo yos la me tog ra bar gshegs so/ /'di la ni gdung sras med do/ /ma gcig nam mkha' rgyal mo la/ /yab zhe bdun pa dang zhe dgu pa'i dus te'u kun

dga' legs 'byung ba dang kun rgyal ba gnyis 'khrengs/ snga mas rgyal po 'ja yan gyi ti'i mdzad/ bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa rta lo la dang / phyi mas rgyal po de dang / rin chen dang / tho gan thi mur gsum gyi ti'i mdzad phrin las rgyas pa'i ngang nas lnga bcu pa phag zlo ste/ de gnyis kyang me tog ra bar gshegs sheng / snga ma la yang brgyud pa ma mched do/ /ma cig nam mkha' rgyal mo la sras gcig byung yang chung ngu nas gshegs// yab zhe bzhi pa dang nga gcig dus/ mkhas btsun nam legs pa dang / nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa gnyis 'brangs/ gcen sles stobs kyi thugs rab che/ chos skyong la nus pa thon/ ku sha la go dan rgyal pos gu shrī'i ma dang / shel dam gnang / gdan sa lo dgu mdzad/ so dag pa la gzhi thog tu gshegs/ gcung bis rgyal po de'i bla mchod mtshu/ dgung lo 6do / pa la pho brang dang nye bar gshegs/ de gnyis kyi bar du sras gcig gzhon nu la gshegs so/ /ma gcis red mda' ma la sras lcam sring gsum 'khrangs pa'irnyi sa che ba gzhon nu nas gshegs/ de 'og slob dpon ma kun dga' 'bum/ chung ba kun dga' legs/ 'di yab zhe bdun pa sa pho spre'u la 'khrungs rgyal potho gan the mur gyis pā len dbang li las kha gser dam/ bod chol kha gsum zlo shes su bcug pa'i lung dbang bsod nams bzang po'i jo mo la gnang ba'i dpon mo bud dha gan dang bcas pa gnang / phrin las rgyas pa'i ngang nas dgung lo nyer dgu pa sa po bri ba la srad kyi sa cha tshags tshigs bya bar sku gshegs/ ma

ra༅༅/ /gcig zhal lu ma gzhon nu 'bum la sras bzhi 'khrangs pa'i che ba/ gu shrī kun dga' nyi ma ni/ yab zhe brgyad pa sa mo bya la 'khrangs/ gzhon nu nas yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ tizhi kun blo ba dang mnyam du gong la byon / g.ying khyung rgyal po'i bla mchod mdzod de/ gzhon nu dgung lo bcug bzhi pa chu pho khyi la pho brang du gshegs so/ /gcung 'jam dbyangs don rme+ordo rgyal mtshan pa yab zhe dgu pa lcags pho khyi la 'khrangs/ 'jam dbyangs dngos su grags / shāka' chen drug la thugs bshad mdzad/ mkhas btsun pa gdan sar bzhugs kyang tshogs chos 'dis gsung / dgung lo so bzhi pa shing pho spre'u la rin chen sgang du gshegs/ spur bzhu ba'i du gsab tu 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rnam par nam mkha' la gshegs par las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong ngo / /de'i gcung bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa ni/ yab nga gcig pa sa pho khyi ba la 'khrangs/ rnam thar rgyas pa du ma las 'byung ba ltar gnyen dang / dpang lo chen po dang / rgyal sras rin po che dang / byang sems chen po bsod grags pa dang / bla ma dpal ldan seng ge la sogs pa mkhas grub kyi bla ma dang / na bza' phrabaca phug pa dang sron pa chos dpal la sogs pa grub thob ku sa la'i bla ma mang du bsten / shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/ dus phyis kyang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du/ mdo sngags thams cad skyar nas gsan zhing sbyangs pas/ rig gnas phyi nang mdo rgyud mtha' dag la ma gsan pa'am/ mi mkhyen pa cung zad kyang med

ceng / de yang re re la 'di kho na mkhas par 'dug snyam pa lta bu'i mkhyen rab yongs su rdzogs/ rigs rus 'gran zla dang bral/ dpal 'byor chab srid kyang sa skya pa ma nyams pa'i dus kyi mangs thang yod kyang / kun spangs bya bral gyi bsam sbor dang / bla ma thams cad kyi bran du gyur pa'i thugs 'dun dang nga rgyal bcag pa'i spyod lam gyis bkur bsti mdzad par ma zad/ 'khor 'bangs phal pa dang spang po yan chad la brnyas bcos kyi spyod pa cung zad kyang mi mdzad par 'og nas 'gro dro chu las med snyam pa'i thugs 'dun rtag tu mnga'/ khyad par hor rgyal pos gdan 'dren des drag lan gsum du byang ba la thabs sna tshogs kyis 'bros bzur mthed/ dwags skong sogs su dben pa bston pa'i ngang nas nyin mtshan chos kyis mda' bar mdzad / ta'i si tu byung ba rgyal mtshan gyis bsam yas kyis chos gzhi dang / sa skya'i skyong dar mdzad pa'i starno bskul gyi zhu yig rim par phul ba la/ thugs khrel bka' skyon thugs 'byang rgi bka' shog na'ang / bya bral gyi ngang nas phyag rdzas gang byung thams cad bas/ma yas la sogs pa'i zhig gsos dang / bo dung bsam yas gnyis su dge 'dun shin tu mang por bsags nas mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor shin tu ngo mtshar ba bskorjo ba'i bsnyen bkur 'bul snod dpag med mdzad pa la sogs pa'i sbyin pa dang / sdom gsum gyi nyes ltung phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i ngang nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stong phrag lnga lhag la sogs pa mtha' yas pa'i mkhan po dang / dbang bskur sems bskyed grangs med pa'i slob dpon mdzad/ tshul khrims rgya
