ra༅༅/ /cher spel ba'i tshul khrims/ de dus kyi sa skya pa'i nang zhig dang / shed che ches chung chung 'dzoms pa'i sde 'khrag la sogs pa'i log sgrub bzod pa'i bzod pa dang / nyin dal ba don med du skad cig kyang mi bzhugs pa'i brtson 'grus dang / sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po gzigs pa dang / sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' mang du mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzirno dang / ji lta ji snyed mtha' dag la chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i shes rab la sogs ste/ lung rtogs kyi yon tan dang gzhan phan phyin las kyi cha la 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che man chad kyi gdung rgyad gang zag sus kyang 'gran par mi nus pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i ngang nas dgung lo re gsum pa lcags mo yos lo zla ba drug pa'i nyer lnga la dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i bla brang bkra shis skang gi gzims khang du gshegs so/ /'di gazlum gyi mched zla gcig chung ngu la gshegs so/ /de ltar ma mi thon pa mi the ba'i bdag nyid chen po'i sras yo/ngas su grags pa dgu ni/ spyi dpon ti'i kun blo / gzhi thog pa mkhas btsun nam legs pa dang / nam rgyal ba gnyis/ lha khang pa kun legs pa dang kun rgyal ba gnyis/ rin chen sgang pa kun dga' nyi ma/ don yod rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma dam pa ste gsum/ dus mchod pa kun dga' legs pa ste dgu'o/ /de rnams las sras ji ltar mched ce na/ kun blo/ kun dga' legs 'byung / kun nyi/ bsod rgyal rnams rab byung gtsang ma yin la/ kun rgyal ma bsnyen rdzogs ma mdzad gong du ma cig byang pa mo la lha khang chos rgyal ba

dang kun spangs pa'i lharme mo la blo gros rgyal ma pa gnyis 'khrangs pa/ gnyis ka la ta dben gu shrī'i mtshan dang las kha byang / gzhung lugs rnams la sbyangs/ mkhas par mkhyen/ bu ston gdan drangs nas lha khang du rdor dbyings kyi blos blangs bzhings/ gcen lcags mo lug lo ba yin/ dgung 'osnya ra bdun pa la gong du byon/ nyer bdun pa sa mo phag la rgya )la du gshegs/ gcung chu pho spe'u lo pa yin/ bzhi thog gdan sa ya nga mdzad/ so bdun pa sa pho spre'u la gshegs so / /chos rgyal bas bsnyen rdzogs ma mdzad gong du ta dben byang pa'i lcam mo la sras gnyis 'khrangs pa ni/ theg chen chos rje kun bkras pa dang / bdag po bathed bkras pa ste/ snga ma sa mo glang la 'khrangs/ gzhi+on nu nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi skyes stobs kyi bag chags gsal/ sbyor byang gi nan tan 'grub/ dbyar dpal ldar+sha bla ma dam pa la sogs pa'i dam pa mang po gus pa'i gtsug gis bsten/ 'od gsal dang rnal lam la/ sosgos pa'i thugs dam bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan/ mngon tshan chung zhing sa chod che ba'i cha lugs dang gnas dang grogs la sogs pa bsten pas thugs rgyud legs par smin nas dgung lo re bzhi pa chu pho 'brug lo la rgya nag ta'i ming rgyal pos/ ta'i twa bzhin dang a nu dre bos la sogs pa sngags te gdan drangs gus pa chen pos bla mar khur/ lnge /cing gyo/ twa'i ching / hwa wi/ swe zen/ shwang r+shan/ sko ṭ+wāṃ/ ta'i r+ghoṃ rkyong mi/ ba ho tre bong ska rnga du bsgyur na phrin 'ag sa sna tshogasag rgyas pa / dam chos rma chog tu rgyal

ra༅༅/ /ba/ yang dag pa'i ye shes/ snying rje rgya chen kun nas rgyas par phan pa/ zhing bsrang zheng bstan pa bshad pa/ yang dag par rig pa/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ nub kyi mchog tu dge ba/ rdo rje kun khyab/ 'od zer chen po'i sangs rgyas/ zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ shel dam dang lung bzang po/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibazlo stong la sogs pa'i 'bul ba'i rnam grangs brjod kyis mi lang pa phul te/ mdor na 'phags pa rin po che dang 'bul ba mnyam par grags / khyad par lha khang chen mo phag gru pa'i lag nas nan gyis blangs te phul/ sa skya pa chus khyer gyis skra nas zin/ rgya nag tu lo ngo gsum bzhugs nas shing pho rta lo la bod du phebs/ dgung lo 33 bdun pa shing mo sbrul la lha chen du gshegs so / /gcung bsod bkras pa thugs rab gcen las che/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor par byed/ bstan pa dang 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ byang pas lha rtse bzung / bzang brtson gyi ngang nas rgyang 'bum chen gyi phyi nang cha rkyen dang bcas pa legs par sbyangs / chu pho 'brug lo/ nga drug bzhes pas sa pho byi ba la lha rtser gshegs so/ /bla cha/ 'di gnyis kyi mched ya/ dpo na yan dbang phyug dpal gyi jo mo la byung ba/ dharma pa dang rdo rje rin chen pa gnyis/ snga mas mdo khams su gdul bya bskyangs/ phyag rdzas mang du ston/ gser dngul sogs kyi 'gyod chen byas/ bka' gros pa'i dam bzhag bcugs pas bka' drin che bar byed/ bdag po bsod bkras pa'i sras bde legs bkra shis pa/ bla ma lha bzang pa dang / dpon gnyer

ma mthun pa'i rkyen gyis la stod byang pa'i sa cha gcig na bzhugs sam zer te/ lha khang chen mo nyi gnas kyis 'dzin to/ /bzhi thog pa mkhas btsun chen pos dus mchod pa'i jo mo dbe 'dun 'bum/ la sras gcig byon pa bzhi thog pa bdag chen kun rin par grags pa sa mo yos la 'khrangs/ chos rje bla ma dam pas dbu ston/ legs par sbyangs/ rgyal pos ta'i dben gu shri'i mtshan dang / lung gnang / bzhi thog gi gdan sar skos/ yun ring po mdzad/ re gcig pa la bzhi thog tu bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i sras gu shrido so gros rgyal mtshan pa rta lo la 'khrangs/ bzhi thog tu bzhugs/ lnga bcu la gshegs so/ /de'i sras dbang phyug rgyal mtshan pa/ rgyal mkhar rtse bas zhabs tog dbu 'don/ bzhi thog nang chen mdzad nas bzhi thog tu bskos/ thugs dam shin tu 'phel/ kha'u skyed las kyi mgosno khang zhig gsos sus kyang ma nus pa gso ba sogs grub rtags du ma mdzad nas bde bar gshegs shing sras med do/ /bdag po kun rin pa'i sras grags pa blo gros pa lug lo la 'khrangs / phag mo gru pa la thugs gtad/ gong ma grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sku mched kyi bla ma dang gshegs rdzongs kyi tshogs dpon la sogs pa mdzad/ shab sma da dang chu smig tu bzhugs/ chos skyong la shin tu mnga' brnyes/ bdag gis kyang 'jo'i drung du/ chos skyong che chung bi dbang dang gdams ngag la sogs bod na gang yod thob/ don gcig pa sprul lo la/ gshegs/ de'i sras chu smig pa bu+o gros ngabang phyug pa ni/ sa'orma nu ras/ rab tu byung / ngor du yun ring bzhugs/ ra/las/ci

ra༅༅/ /btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa da lta yang bzhugs so/ /'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa rab byung ma mdzad gong du ma gcig zhal lu ma la bla chen kun rgyal bar grags pa 'khrangs/ shing khang bla brang zhal lu khang gsar dang bcas pa dang / bsam yas dge sdings la sogs pa bzung / shab dge sdings pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa dang / bdag po zhal lu ba bsod rgyal ba gnyis byon/ snga ma'i sras rgya gar pa sdang blo gros pa/ phyi ma'i sras rgya nag pa / grags rgyal ba rnams da lta bzhugs so/ /dus mchod pa pā len dbang kun dga' legs pa la bdag po kun rin pa dang yum gcig pa'i bla chen bsod nams/ blo gros pa ni/ yab dgu lo nyer lnga pa chu pho spre'u la 'khrangs/ 'di yang chos rje bla ma dam pas bskyangs/ lung rigs man ngag mtha' dag la mkhas/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa la stag tshang rdzong khar phebs/ dgos kyi sa bdag la rin gnang / gzim khang dang gtsug lag khang khyad par can bzhengs/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur dang / zhal lu'i thugs rje chen po'i mched zla spyan drangs/ rdo rje 'chang gi gser sku la sogs pa bzhengs/ thugs dam 'phrin las rgyas pa'i ngang nas dgung lo sum cu la hor tho gan rgyal pos dharma gīrti la sogs pa'i gdan 'dren pa gtang / ti shri'i ma bod nas gsol/ gcung pā len dbang gi las kha dang / chu mig khri skor gyi 'dab sgo gnang nas gdan drangs/ lam khar sma chus rab phye ba la sogs pa'i grub rtags du ma dang bcas te gong du phebs/ ti shri mdzad nas zla ba drug na rgya

yul du gshegs gcung po dbang grarges pa rgyal ma pa ni/ me po phyi ba la yab gshegs nas zla ba drug na 'khrungs/ bla ma dam pa dang gcen dang / chos rje rgyal sras pa la sogs pa mang du bsten/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po sku smad la stag sham yod par grags/ dbang gi las kha dang thong ji g.yas g.yon gyi khrims ra/ hu shrī dbang hu la sogs pa rgyal/ pos gnang / bla ma la mchog tu gus/ khyad par khyung po rnal 'byor gyi sku skye tshul khrims mgon po ba/ skyor mo nas 'bad pa dwa mas gdan drangs/ bde chen gyi gzim khang brtsigs nas phul/ de yang 'u lag dang lhan cig bdag chen nyid kyis sa rdo skyas/ rdzong kha'i gzims khang gi bde chen phyogs la 'chong rtse sasar du gtod nas nang phyag nub phyag rgyas par mdzad pa soshes / thugs dam gyi ngang nas dgung lo zhe gcig pa me pho 'brag lo'i zla ba dang po'i nyer gnyis la rdzong kha'i rnying mar sku gshegs so/ /'di la sras/ gsum byes pa'i byang pa ma cig sras mo lha rin pa la sras ta dben kun legs pa dang / dbang rnam sras pa/ ma cig lha 'dren la/ 'jam dbyangs chos rgyalatrī dang / lcam mo gcig dang / thong ji dpon mo la/ rnam rgyal gling du byon pa'i byang sems batha/da nams rgyal mo ba rnams so/ /ta dben pa ni/ yab dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa mo bya la 'khrungs/ ska yon khyad par car ngang ldan/ rgyal pos gta dben gu shri'i lung sanang / rta nas skor gyi zhal/ bdag ra/dzad dgung tsha/ nyiriri brgyad pa nu rta nag ri khud kyi gzim bang gse ra bang du gshegs so/ /bdag wo rnam sras rgyal mas pa

ra༅༅/ /ni/ yab dgung lo nyer lnga pa lcags pho khyi ba la 'khrangs/ gzhon nu nas hor rgyal po tho gan gyis rang gi sras che ba dang mnyam pa'i las kha/ rī tsi dbang gi mtshan gser dam/ gser sgor/ dngul sgor/ khrims ra brgyad/ khrims kyi thas pa/ phing gcig pa'i hu shri/ nyi ma nub kyi phyogs shezlo su bcug pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang / khrims gnyis kyi phrin las mdzad/ mkhas grub mang du bsten/ khyad par jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam 'phrul lo chen skyabs mchog pa la sangs rgyas dngosakyi dad pa thob/ ci gsung gsan/ chos rje gnam gsum gyis gnam rtse ldeng du chos 'bor mdzad nas/ lo chen 'bri khung pa'i sa char bzhugs dgos pa'i zhu 'bul drag po byung / ngo chen rje btsun tsong kha pas mdzad/ thugs thag chod mtshams/ bdag chen 'dis/ chos 'khor sgang gi gzims khang chen mo 'u lag yang ma bskul sbra cha zer mdzad nas drung skor gyis bzhengs/ gdan 'dren pa/ chos rje seng ge'i mtshan can gyi phyag phyir drung skor drag pa nyi sbrel/ phyibs drel thab 'dzin dang bcas pa rdzangs/ gdan ma 'grongs bar du log ma yong gsung ba'i bsha' nan dang / zhu yig nan to mdzad nas gdan drangs/ stag sna dang ra dum brag la sogs pa'i gzhis sbyar/ gsung chos mang du gsan/ thugs dam la shin tu bco+on pa'i ngang nas/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa sa po sbya ba'i hor zla bzhi pa'i nyer bzhi la ngo mtshar ba'i bltas du ma dang bcas te smon mkhar rtse gdong lhun po rtser gshegs so/ /bdag chen 'a/rmo dbyangs chos kyi

rgyal mtshan pa ni sa mo phag la 'khrangs/ gzhon nu nas yab mes kyi chos/ phar tshad mngon pa/ sngags gsar rnying / khyad par dus 'khor/ mdor na dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bum pa gang byo mkhyen/ de stobs kyis shin tu mnyes pa dang / spyir rin chen sgang pa dang keṃ khang bla brang pa ma 'cham pa'i dus su/ dus mchod pa 'di pas rin chen sgang pa'i phyogs bzung ba'i rkyen gyis bla brang rin chen sgang dang seng ge sgang la gtogs pa'i khang gzhis pa cha thams cad gnang / da lta'i bar du zhal bdag mdzad/ yang dgos gdung brgyud gzhan la med pa'i 'phags pa'i dbu zhwa/ shel dam gling drug pa 'khor bcas/ ti'i kun blo'i shel dam/ phyag na'i shel dam 'khor dang bcas pa 'di pa la yod pa yin no/ /bla ma de ni / 'jig rten la zhal mi 'jugaspyir thugs dam bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyad par sbyor ba yan lag drug pa la mnga' brnyes/ yos zhal la phyag 'phreng gi rjes dod pa la sogs pa'i grub rtags mang du bstan/ gzhan phan dang thugs dam la rtse gcig pa'i sems dpa' chen por bzhugs pa'i ngang nas dgung lo bdun cu pa sa pho spre'u lo/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la me tog la sogs pa'i ya mtshan du ma dang bcas te/ g.yas ru srin po ri'i rnam rgyal sgang gi gzims khang dmar por gshegs so/ /bdag chen rnam sras pa la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i che ba ni/ bdag po kun blo ba ste/ thugs rab che tshad thub/ tshad ma sogs la sbyangs/ thugs dam bzang / rta nas skor du bzhugs/ byin brlabs yin tu che ba'i ngang nas sa

༄༄〉༅/ /skya rin chen sgang du gshegs so/ /bcung dbang nam legs pa ni/ ya 'brog ma gakhrig bsod namasa'abum la/ yab dgung lo bzhi bcu pa sa mo yos la 'khrungs/ sku mdzes/ gsung bzang / thugs gsal/ gzhon nu nyid nas brtag pa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i gsan sbyong yang mdzad/ khyad par bdag gi mkhan po 'brom ston seng ge'i mtshan can la mos gus rtse gcig tu mdzad/ sku pang du dbu brtsugs nas gzims/ gang gsung sgrub/ chos 'khor sgang du ska rim zla ja / na bza' rtsi gos kyi 'gyed nar ma mdzad/ sku bsod 'phel ba'i stobs kyis dgung lo bcu drug pa la/ zhu 'phen sogs 'bad rtsol gang yang mi dgos par/ theg chen chos rgyal rjes zhus nas/ gong ma rta'i ming rgyal pos hu kya hā+o wang r+ghaṃ mtshan dang / gser dam 'ja' sa bod la shes su bcug pa'i lung bzang po stobs che ba/ gzhan yang rgya 'dul yong res kyi 'ja sa/ gnang sbyin dang bcas pa slebs/ rjong lha rtse mnga' zhabs dang bcas pa brtsol med du phyag tu byung / nyang stod du rtse shar nub / yar 'brog hom tu chen pos thog drangs kyi sku ngo rnams dang bcas pa 'dzom nas gdan drangs/ bkur bsti zhabs tog shin tu ya mtshan pa mdzad/ phyis bzhugs pa'i stabs kyis rin spungs nor bu bzang pos gdan drangs nas de bzhin du mdzad do/ /spyi dpon la dgra med du bzhugs pa'i ngang nas dgung lo zhe drug pa shing tho ji ba lo hor zla dang po'i nyi shu gnyis la rnam rgyal rtse'i gzims khang du gshegs so/ /'di la yar 'brog sna dkar rtse ru byon pa'i bdag mo nam mkha' 'bum la sogs pa'i lcam mo lnga

tsam yod do/ /mi dbang 'dis dang por yar 'brog pa bdag mo dpal chen pa khyab kyi bzhes pa la sras mo tsos 'khrungs pa'i che ba yar 'brog stag lung dang / chung ba rgyal mkhar rtse na dpal sti+or chabasridachebarabazhugasaṅge+o///sbyos tswa ga'i tsha lo bzhes pa la yab dgung lo so bdun pa shing mo yos la 'khrungs pa/ dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa ni/ sku lha'i cha byad/ gsung ka la ping ma thugs nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal bas/ chos 'jig rten gang la yang mkhyen pa rgyas / sku'i rgyu rtsal mtha' dag la thogs pa mi mnga'/ dgung lo bdur pa la dpal brtag pa gnyis pa 'dzin pa'i dbu brtsams pa'i snga dro me tog gi char bab/ legs par sbyangs/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la gdan sa chen mor phebs nas bshad pa mdzad/shar pas thog drangs sa skya pa mtha' dag ga gtsug tu khur/ mchog tu ngo mtshar ba mdzad/ khyad par bla ma la gus pas thugs kyi mi dran pa'i dus kyi bla ma la yang sku 'dra bzhengs pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs/bla ma'i gzim mal gyi 'og tu dbu bcug nas byin brlabs zhus/ na bza' dbu la khur/ rgyang ring por gsus skyel mdzad/phyi ru san po 'di rnams chos khos chung sdig pa gsog tu yo nga bas mdzad dka' ba 'dug na'ang nga rang gis/ bdag gir mi byed/ nang du phyag lan ye mi mdzad par zhu zhes gsung / dge 'dun la thugs shin tu mos pas snge longs kyi phyag dang lngang ba mi bzhes/ mang ja sun dang po song ba dang yar khyur phebs nas tshogs phyag gus par mdzad/ gsol ja ba'e/sa 'phro rang si phon tu 'i/ma pa tsha/sa rang jo phangs med du

ra༅༅/ /sbyor/ phal pas sgrub par mi nus pa'i che la'ing bcag pa'i spyod lam du ma mdzad/ de lta bu'i stobs kyis sngar rtsig dbang ye ma byung ba'i lhun po rtse'i rjong ro blang / nang so nor bzang pas gdan drangs/ bkur sti 'bul snod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ khyad par rgyal yul rang na zo bde mo med pa'i skabs su yang / rgyal pos yab la gang gnang gi mtshan dang las kha/ lung bzang po/ ser chas khyad 'phags/ dbang gi skya chas tshang ma gnang sbyin stobs che ba dang bcas pa nyes med du sleb/ sko bsod je rgyas byang / sku tshe ring na bstan pa'i zhabs tog bdag rkyen/ 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad par bzhed pa'i thugs skyed khyad par can dang bcas pa yod pa yin na'ang / ltos bcas yon mchod kyi bsod nams kyi khyon du ma shong bar / dgung 'o snya shu nyer dgur 〉bas tsam chu mo lug gi hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nub mo/ bla ma'i phyogs su dbu sngas bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i mos gus rtse gcig gi ngang nas pho brang lhun po rtser gshegs so/ /'di la yang yar 'brog stag lung du phebs pa'i slob dpon chos skyong bu 'dren pa la sogs pa lcam mo lnga bzhugs so/ /mi'i dbang po 'di'i btsun mo ni/ shangs pa'i bdag mo gzhon pa la sras gcig bgres pa la sras mo gcig rnam rgyal gling rma dpal 'byor bzang mo ba la sras gcig rnams byon pa'i sras che ba/ nam mkha' rin chen rgyal tshab dpal bzang po zhes bya ste/ yab dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu mo bya la/ phyi'i sa spyad bla ma'i rnal lam bzang ba la sogs pa'i ltas dang bcas te 'khrungs/ skyes stobs kyi thugs rab dang sbyangs

stobs kyi brtson 'grus snyas ka phun sum tshogs pas/ gzhon nu nas kya rdor dang /rdo rje phur pa'i thugs dam gtor 'bul/ sngags ring mang i bzlas brjod la shin tu brtson/ yab bde bar gshegs ma thag nas byis pa'i spyod pa khe mdzad / brtag dzoganyis pa la sbyangs/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la sku mched thabs gnyig tu gdan sar phebs/nyi ma gsum sbrel du bshad pa rgyas pa dga' ston bzang po dang bcas pa gnang bas/ sa skya pa thams cad yi rang gdung brgyud kyis chos gsungs pa la 'di las lhag pa'am/ mtshungs pa rgan gyes mi dran pas shin tu ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa dang / gang rung gcig gdan sar mi bzhugs pa'i stabs med ces zhu ba byang / de dang dus mtshungs gdan sa ra 'degs kha rang du rgya yul nas 'bul ba dang / 'ba' hu len mi rdzongs gsungs pa ri rgyal i 'ja sags yang phebs/ yar phyir rtse shar nub dang / gzhis kha bsam rtse nas kyang skye bsu thab 'dzin bkur bsti rjo+o mtshar ba mdzad do/ /ska gzhon pa ni/ nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste/ yab dgung lo nyer bzhi pa/ sa pho stag lo la 'khrungs/byis pa chung ngu'i spyod pa thams cad dang bral thugs khro ba mi mnga' ba lta bu yun ring du byung / da lta'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnarmi tshul yang yab ji lta ba bzhin du ngo mtshar bar bzhugs so / /lo la/ bdag chen mi'i dbang po 'di la yang / /rgya'i rgyal pos yab la ji lngar gnang ba lngar/ dbang gi mtshan dang las kha/'ja sags/wang bzang po/ser chas dang /rdor dril bubs/ rten khebs/ pang khebs/ saser ra / dbang si/

ra༅༅/ /skya chas tshang ma/ ja gos dar gyi gnang sbyin stobs che ba dang bcas pa byung / kye rdor dang phur pa sogs yab mes kyi chos la mkhas/ thugs dam mthil ma lam 'bras la mdzad/ mdor na chos 'jig rten gyi phrin las je rgyas su bzhugs so/ /de ltar na gdung rabs rkang bgrang nyi shu rtsa bdun/ gyis pas bgrang na brgya lhag song 'dug na'ang / stag tshang pa 'di pa las gzhan rnams ni chad du nye bar song 'dug cing / rgya yul sogs na mtshan grags chung bar song 'dug pas / dpon sa g.yog sa kun gyis khur chen bzhes pa'i skabs la bab kyi ma zad mchis pa tsam du gda'/ gdung brgyud rin po che de dag las/ hor rgyal po'i ti'i ba mdzad pa drug rgya rgyal po'i ti'i mdzad pa gcig wang gi las kha hor gyis gnang ba lnga / rgyas gnang ba gsum rnams sngar song / da rung de lta bu'i chen po dang mang po'i 'grodo na dang bstan pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byang bar gyur cig ngo mtshar sna tshogs bkra ba'i mkha' ngos na/ zla skar sprin dang klog gi 'du 'god sogs / /gzugs kyi snang ba bgrang las 'das mod kyi/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i nor bu mchog gis bsgrub/ /thub bstan nam mkha'i lam la zlo med rgyu/ /nag phyogs mun pa'i rtsa lag mthar byed cing / /phan bde'i pad tshal kun skyong nyi ma ni/ /kun gsal 'khon gyi gdung brgyud kho nar zad/ /de dag phan bde'i lo tog rgyas phyir du/ /rtag tu zhabor ba'i 'dren byed rta bdun gli /nang na mchog gyur yar 'brog dpon chen yin/ /de yi brgyud 'dzin rigs gzugs dpal 'byor ldan/ /dad gtong rnam

dpyod nor gyis mdzes pa gang / /chos rgyal mtshan can de yis nan tan gyis/ /legs par bskul ba'i lhag bsam nyi ma yis/ /dri med mang thos chu gter che las 'ongs/ /legs bshad 'dab stong phyogs kyi mtha' gru mjal/ /yul dus grangs la 'khral med ge sar can/ /pradz+nyā rat+na'i rnam dpyod pad mo las/ /gdung rabs sbrang rtsi'i phung po 'byur ba yin/ /'dir 'bad dge dang dge gzhan chu klung kun/ /phan bde gser gyi bye ma 'dren bzhin du/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por myur zhugs te/ /thub bsnyan rlabs 'phreng 'phel ba'i dpal thob shog /skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan gdung brgyud rin po che/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi 'od cher 'bar zhing / /rnyed dang bkur sti'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/ /dge legs 'dod dga'i char chen 'bab gyur cig khor phyogs rgya mtsho'i mthar gcigs 'gro 'di la/ /chos 'byor char chen ji ltar phab pa bzhin/ /slar yang phan bde 'byor pas legs bskyong pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs brgyud pa lhag par 'phel gyur cig /tshul 'jir dad gus 'dun pa'i dpal yon can/ /blo chen sbyin bdag brgyud par bcas pa dang / /chab srid mtha' dag yongs 'du'i ljon pa bzhin/ /phun tshogs lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ gtsung stag tshang gi lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal ma tshan dpal bzang pos thams cad 'dul zhes bya ba/ me me+o phag gi lo'i nag nya'i tshes gsum la/ rdzong dkar nor bu gling gi pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /zhusadag/ /
ra༅༅/ /bibyastanasarbadz+nyamananinārmesādhakanāmasashās+t+robiharatisma//༄༄༄/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs//

go༅༅/ /na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ dpal ldan phun tshogs tshogs gnyis byed pos sprul/ /rig gnas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od 'bar/ /ma rig kun bcom bcom ldan nyi mar ni / /btud nas kun rig rig gnas kun shes brtsam/ /reg pa'i gnas lngar legs par ma sbyangs na/ /dgra bcom gyis kyang kun mkhyen thob mi srid/ /de bas don gnyis mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen lam 'dir mkhas rnams bco+on par rigs/ /don gnyer rjes 'dzin bzo dang gso ba'i dpyad/ /log smra tshar gcod sgra dang gto tshigs te/ /phyi rol rig gnas bzhi dang nangagi don/ /thun mong min pa'i mdo sngags 'dir rig bya/ /lnga po re re'ang gsum gsum nyid du gnas/ /bzo ni lus dang ngag dang yid bzo'o / /gso ba gso bya gso thabs gso ba po/ /sgra ni rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam

ra༅༅/ /'gyur te/ /gtan tshigs mngon gyur lkog gyur shin lkog 'jal/ /nang rig theg pa gsum du grags shing grub/ /de yang brngod bya nyan rang theg chen te/ /rjod byed thun mong ba dang de min la/ khren tu rgyas pa'i mdo dang rgyud sde 'o/ /dang po bzhi yi gsum tshan thams cad kyang / /phyi rol pa la'ang tshang bar yod pa'i phyir/ /rig gnas thun mong ba zhes mkhas la grags/ /gal te phyi pa'i brjod bya rngod byed kun/ /skyon can nang pa'i de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ /thun mong nyid du 'thad pa min zhe na/ /ka lā pa ni slob phan dang bcas la/ /skyon can yin pa'i gtan tshigs ma grub cing / /gong ma gong ma'i rig pas cung zad tsam/ /gnod pas thun mong zhes byar mi rigs na/ /dngos smra sde gsum nang par 'thad mi 'gyur/ /nang pa'i rig gnas bzhi pa ston pa'i gzhung / /sde bdun mdo dang bcas las gzhan med phyir/ /'di dag nang rig yin par 'dod rnams 'khral/ /gsung rab spyi yi dgongs 'grel yin pa'i phyir/ /zer na sgra mdo kun kyang der 'gyur te/ /gsung rab kun gyi tshig gi dgongs 'grel phyir/ /bstan dang ston la yid ches rnyed thabs dang / /bdag med ston dang de mkhyen ye shes te/ sda/ ngos stobs tshad mas 'grub sogs tshad ma mdo'i/ /mchod brdzod don tsam rgyas par bshadapa ste/ /de ltar byas na yan lag brgyad pa dang / khoji pa dang rin chen 'byung gnas sogs/ /nang rig nyid du thal ba bzlog pa med/ /des na dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bo ni/ /gnas gsum gzhal bya rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad/ /

yin phyir thun mong rig gnas nyid du bzung / /dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bos mdo rgyud dang / /mdo la drang nges sde snod gsum dang ni/ /sngags la rgyud sde bzhi ru 'byed phyir ro/ /zhalor ba kun las nges 'byung bsam pa dang / /bdag pa'imi gzhan gces theg chen byang chub sems/ /bden bzhi'i de nyid la sogs bdag me da gnyis/ /phra rags bstan bya'i gtso bor gang mdzad pa/ /de ni nang rig nyid du legs par grub/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ rig gnas spyir bshad pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// lnge //rig gnas dang pos don gnyer rjes 'dzin te/ /bstan pa gnas phyir dkon cog gsum gyi rten/ /bzheng bar 'dod pa'i 'byor ldan lhag bsam can/ /rgyal bas bstan 'dzin nyid du lung bstan cing / /gzhi ni tshangs pa'i bsod nams skyed byed de/ /sngar med gnas su rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mchog /bzhugs pa'i mchod rten rtsig par byed pa dang / /dge 'dun kun ra longs spyod dang bcas byed/ /dge 'dun bye ba legs par bsdum pa dang / /byams sogs tshad med bzhi po bsgom pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs dang po gnyis podo na sanyer la/ /bzo rig shes pas 'dod don sgrub pa tsam/ /smra mkhas grags pa can gyis mi 'grub cing / /chu chen brgal bar 'dod pa'i gru gzings dang / /gzhan phyogs 'joms/ pa'i 'khrul 'khor mtshon cha dang / /rang phyogs bsrung ba'i mkhar rdzong go cha dang / /gos bzang rgyan mchog bza' btung rol mo sogs/ /dgos dgu mtha' dag 'di la rag las phyir/ /des na

ra༅༅/ /sgo gsum bzo la mi slob dang / /khyad par mdo rgyud chos mthun gtsor bzung nas/ /dge 'dun sde dang rten gsum 'gog byed pa/ /'di dag gcer bus grub mthas bslus par zad/ /rgyal bas 'dul ba lung gi gnas mal gzhir/ /gtsug lag khang dang de dbus dri gtsang khang / /sgo khang khyams kyi thog 'bugs thog brtsegs dang / /gnas khang so sor ri mo khri tshul sogs/ /rgya cheragasungs shing mdo sngags phal cher dang / /khyad par shā ri'i bus zhus mdo dang ni/ /sdom 'byang dus 'khor sogs las sku gzugs dang / /mchod rten phyag tshad legs par gsungs pa bzhin/ /drang srong e gu'i bu yis byas pa yi/ /sku gzugs rnams kyi mtshan nyid ston pa dang / /dri med 'grel pa sogs las mchod rten dang / /sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad par grags pa yi/ /blos slongs mtshan nyid gzhan yang bzo yi gnad/ /ston pa'i rgya bod gzhung la bslab par bya/ /lus ngag gtso bor byed dang mi byed las/ /lus ngag yid kyi bzo zhes gsum du dbye/ /lus bzo mchog ni sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /sku la longs sku rang sor brgyad pa ni/ /nyi shu tsa lngar dus kyi 'khor lor gsungs/ /sprul sku rang sor brgya dang brgyad pa 'am/ /bcu gcig pa ru rig pas thob pa bzhin/ /gzhung lugs gzhan du 'byung ltar lag len byed/ /mi lus phal pa srid du gya bzhi dang / /zheng du go drug chu zheng mi mnyam gsungs/ /gzhan yang sprul sku la ni zhi khro dang / /rgyan dang phyag mtshan sogs kyi ma nyid do/ /gsung gi rten ni tshangs pa'i

yi ge so/gas/ /yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhir mdo las gsungs/ /larngo wartu la dang d+ngha ri dang / /na ga ra dang kha che'i yi ge sogs/ /rgya gar nyid kyi yig rigs du ma dang / /bod dang rgya nag bru zha'i yi ge sogs/ /thugs kyi rten ni mchod rten zhes bya ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la rnam kun yongs rdzogs te/ khri1ka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa 'o/ /rang sangs rgyas la char khebs med pa dang / /nyan thos 'bras bu bzhi la 'bras bu'i grangs/ /so so'i gdugs kyi rim pa bya ba dang / /so skye la ni byi bo zhes bya ba/ /gdugs med bum pa'i steng du bre ldan te/ /tshad ni dus 'khor dri med 'grel pa gnyis/ /so sor 'byung dang blos slongs phyag tshad sogs/ /kho bos gzhung lugs gzhan dang khyad par du/ /rten gsum bzheng tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad/ /lus bzo phal pa khang khyim/ gru gzings dang / kheng rta la sogs 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs kyang / /dus 'bor rnam bshad kun tu rgyas par bshad/ /ngag bzo rgyal ba mchod pa'i bstod dbyangs dang / /gdug pa 'dul ba'i gad rgyangs nga ro drag /sna tshogs rol mo'i cha byad mtha' yas so/ /yid bzotho sa dang bsam dang sgom pa'o/ /thos bsam bya ba'i yul ni mtha' yas te/ /brtag pa brgyad dang rig gnas bco brgyad dang / /skar rtsis dbyangs 'char nag rtsis gso dpyad sogs/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi ste/ /de dag bstan don zhi gnas lhag mthong sogs/ /yid babo'i mchog gyur thar lam khyad par du/ /de phyir gnas 'dir rig gnas mtha' dag 'dus/ /de

ra༅༅/ /dag phal cher bshad zin chad par 'gyur/ /brtag pa brgyad ni rin chen sa gzhi gos/ /ljon shing rta glang pho mo brtag pa 'o/ /phyi ma gnyis ni rgyud sde kun na gsal/ /sa gzhi brtag thabs dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad / /gzhan rnams 'khral med bong du ma byon zhing / /rta dbyangs la sogs bod kyis sbyar rnams la/ /rang bzo'i skyon mthong phyir na 'dir ma bshad/ khyas kyi rnam gzhag zur du bshad las shes/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos zlos/ bzo rig bshad pa ste le'u gnyes pa'o// lto //'gro kun lus nad sna tshogs kyis gzir phyir/ /gso dpyad don du mi gnyer srid mtha' tsam/ /de phyir rig gnas gnyis pa 'di nyid ni/ /don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i mchog tu grub/ /thub pa'i dbang pos rgya gar lho phyogs su/ /tshangase pas zhus ngor tshe yi rig byed kyi/ /sman rgyud 'bum phrag gsungs par mkhasatsho la grags/ /gzhan yang rgyud sde spyi dang dus 'khor lo/ /sman gzhi'i lung dang gser 'od sogs su'ang gsungs/ /sgra gcan 'khor los tshangs pa'i dpral bar snad/ /de yi rkyen gyis tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye rgu'i bdag la bshad cing de yis kyang / /tha skar bu gnyis brgya byin la sogs pa/ /lha yi drang srong rnams la brgyud nas ni/ /ston pa bzhugs dus rgyal po pad+ma yi/ /snying po zhes bya'i yul ljongs rdo 'jog tu/ /mi yi drang srong rgyun shes bu las ni/ /gzugs can snying po'i zur bu tha chung po/ /'tsho byed gzhon nus bsos zhes cher grags pa/ /sman pa'i

yo+olaporelanamang dbang bskur cing / /thub pa snyun gso'i sman pa'i rgyal po byung / /de las brgyud pa gsal bar ma mthong yang / /lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed shes rab can/ /pha ma'i bran mdzad pha khol ma khol dang / /de gnyis ngag bcag lha chen bsgrubs pa yis/ /pha gol ma gol zhes kyang mtshan du grags/ /phyi rol rig byed mkhas pa'i mthar son pas/ /mngal skyes sus kyang ma thub rig smra'i mchog /rdzus skyes 'phags pa lhas btul ston pa dang / /bstan la dad pa'i mchog gyur snyan ngag pa/ /phyi mo'i dbu ma par nges dpa' bo yis/ /phyi nang gzhung lugs zla med du ma brtsams/ /khyad par yan lag brgyad pa chen po sogs/ /sman dpyad mkhas pa dga' byed bzhi tsam mdzad/ /de yi nang nas yan lag brgyad pa yi/ /snying po bsdus pa zhes bya 'di mdzad nas/ /kha che zla dga' la bshad de yis kyang / /bla zer zhes bya'i rgya che 'grel pa mdzad/ /de nas legs brgyud lo chen skyes bu mchog /rin chen bzang pos bsgyur bshad gtan la phab/ /mkhas pa du mar spel nas bod yul du/ /rgya cher 'phel las bod kyi shing rta che/ /g.yu thog sogs kyis rgyud bzhi'i grags pa spel/ /gzhan yang rgya nag la sogs yul gzhan nas/ /'thon pa'i sman dpyad du ma'ang yod mod kri/ /gzhung gi mthar thug yan lag brgyad pa 'o/ /'di yi gzhung tshad dgu stong bzhi brgya lhag /brjod bya yan lag brgyad yin rjod tshul ni/ /gnas drug le 'u brgya dang nyi shu 'o/ /brgyad ni lus spyi gso dang byis pa gso/ /gdon gso lus kyi stod gso mtshon mis

༄4〉༅/ /gso/ /dug gso rgas pa gso dang ro rtsa gso/ /kun la gso ba'i yan lag ces sbyar brgyad/ /gnas drug mdo gnas lus gnas nad gzhi'i gnas/ /gso gnas cho ga grub gnas phyi ma'i gnas/ /drug po rim bzhin le 'u sum cu dang / /drug dang bcu drug nyer gnyis drug dang ni/ /bzhi bcu'o mdo gnas dang por gso ba'i dpyad/ /spyir bstan phyir na rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya/ /lnga pa yan gyis de nyid 'chad pa'i phyir/ /bshad pa'i rgyud yin yan lag dang po ston / /tha mas yan lag phyi ma bdun 'chad phyir/ /phyi ma'i rgyud de rgyud gsum nyid du'ang gnas/ /'di dag la brten bod kyi rgyud bzhi la'ang / khya rgyud bshad rgyud man ngag rgyud dang ni/ /phyi ma'i rgyud ces bya bar grags pa yin/ /gso bya'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhes/ /gzhan du grags pa rlung mkhris bad kun dang / /'dus pa bzhi la brgya rtsa re rer ni/ /phye bar gsal zhing bsdu na bzhi por 'dus//༄ /gzhung 'dir gso bya'i sgo nas brgyad nyid dang / /nad gzhi'i sgo nas bcu drug nyid du'ang gsal/ /gzhan du bkres 'du'i nad ces gnyis su'ang bsdus/ /der ni sman yang rnam pa bzhir bsdu sa te/ /dus rung thun tshod rung dang zhag bdun pa/ /'tsho ba'i bar du bcad pa zhes bya 'o/ /rgyud du rtsa rlung thig le'i nad gsum ste/ khya chad rlung log dwangs ma nyams pa 'o/ /der ni gso thabs gtso bor rnal 'byor te/ /phal pa 'byor ldan phyi rol sman gyis dang / /kun spangs lus gnas sman gyis gso bar gsungs/ /'dir ni sman dang nad pa nad g.yog dang / /sman pa rnams

la yon rten bzhi bzhir bstan/ /tha ma gnyis po gso ba por mtshungs pas/ /gso ba'i brjod bya gsum du bsdus pa yin/ /gso dpyad byung tshul rnam thar rgyas pa dang / /spyi yi rnam gzhag lag len gces bsdusarnams gzhanadubasha/dephyirngo 'dir ni de tsam mo/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ gso ba rag pa bshad pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// lnge //gsum pas tshig la 'khral pa sel ba'i phyir/ /de la log par smra ba tshar gcod byed / /sgra rig de bzhin gshegs pas gsu ngas pa ni/ /nges tshig so so yang dag rig pa yi/ /yi ge dbye dang bsnan dang bsgyur ba dang / /tshig gi rnam dbye sogs kyi rnam 'gyur ro/ /khyardo par rnga bo che yi mdo las ni/ /byings dang ming dang kun bshad nye sgyur dang / /kṛta dang de phan gyis bsdus grub pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung gsal bar gsungs/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'jig rten dbang phyag bis/ /dus kyi 'bor lo'i dbyangs gsal la brten pa'i/ /yi ge'i bsdu ba mdzad pa'i sgra yi mdo/ /yod par dbyangs 'char mdor bsdus thog mar gsal/ /tshangs pa rtag par zhi bas byas pa'ang yod/ /brgya byin gyis byas in+d+ra bya ka s+dza/ /de la drang srong phur bus legs sbyangs pas/ rgan tu mkhas pa'i nga rgyal mchog tu gyur/ /nga rgyal brgya byin gyis bcom zhum nas ni/ /lha phran blo gsal mang la 'chad 'phro bzhig /da dung rang nyid sgra la sbyong bar zhus/ /nyan 'chad ṅgi/nyis ka gyis 'es bkas bskul bas/ /dus bzang brgyad la ga'an la mi ston

ra༅༅/ /par/ /rang nyid slob pa'i sbyor la bco+on pas na/ /nyan po gzhan gyis dus bzang bsrung dgos shar/ /de bzhin bram ze pā ṇi ni yis kyang / /rang ming ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po sbyar/ /de la tsan+d+ra go mis bsdus pa yi / /gzhung la tsan+d+ra par grags chos 'bangs kyis/ /byas pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas bod du 'gyur/ /dbang phyug go chas gzhon nu gdong drug bsgrubs/ /grub nas tshar 'khog bstan pas tshig don rtogs/ /cha bsags ka lā pa yi mdo zhes bya / /rang sde'i mkhas pa bgrod dka' seng ge yis/ /sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dur sing zhes bya dang / /gzhan sde jo bo drag 'byor gyis sbyar ba'i/ /slob phan zhes bya'i 'grel pa'ang bod du byon/ /snga ma'i byings mdo yi ge'i rma do 'grel bcas/ /phyi ma'i byings mdo u ṇa 'grel par bcas/ /byings dang kun bshad dpung gnyen si sogs rdzi /bya ba rgyas pa la sogs mang po dang / /snga ma'i sub mtha' rin chen 'byung gnas sogs/ /sgra yi yan lag sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung / /snyan ngag me long mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ yi/na tu dga' ba'i zlos gar la sogs pa/ khang dpang yab sras rnams kyis bsgyar cing bshad/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod dang / /zlos gar rnams la rig gnas chung ngu 'am/ /tha snyad rig pa'i gnas lngar grags pa rnams/ /chos rje sa paṇa yan la ma dar zhing / /thar lo yan la sgra mdo 'gyur ba med/ /sgra rig brjod bya spros te bshad na ni/ /sgra yi yan lag thun mong gsum dang ni/ /thun mong min pa gsum zhes bya ba las/ /dang

po ming dang tshig dang yi ge 'o/ /mngon par yi ge du ma 'dus pa las/ /don gyi ngo bo tsam ston ming yin te/ /de 'dus khyad par ston pa tshig yin la/ /yi ge gnyis po de yi bsgrub gzhi byed/ /dngos smra'i lugs la'ang rig pas dpyad bzod ne+e / /yi ge'i cha shas skad cig re re ste/ /gzhan rnams rgyun yin ldan min 'du byed do/ /'di la mkhas rlom kha cig 'di skad du/ /kha yig gcig nyid rgya skad nam mkha' dang / /bod skad smra ba'i bu sa/ri mi ra ge na phyir/ /ming la yi ge 'dus pas ma khyab la/ /kha yig srog tu a yig ma zhugs na/ /brjod du mi rung tshul la rmongs par zad/ /'dir ni yi ge re res don ston te/ /a i u rnams lha re'i ming yin phyir/ /'dir yang ming tshig 'gal te tshig yin na/ /si sogs ti sogs gang rung mtha' can yin/ /ming ngam rtags ni de 'jug gzhi yin phyir/ /yi ge'i ngo bo skad kyi gdangs yin te/ /thung mtha' skyes bu dar ma'i mig 'dzum tshad/ /gcig yun de yin ring po gnyis yun dang / /gsum yun la sogs shin tu ring po 'o/ /gzugs ni la: d+ngha ri la sogs te/ /byed las ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /nges tshig ak+ṣa ra dang bya ñja dang / /war+ṇa zhes pa gzhan du mi 'gyur dang / /ming tshig gsal dang don rnams rjod byed do/ /dbye bsdu sgra pas dbyangs yig bcu bzhi dang / /gsal byed so gsum dbyangs gsal min pa bzhir/ /dbye zhing bsdu na dbyangs gsal gnyis misna gsum/ /ring thung shin tu ring po zhes pa gsum/ /dbyangs la 'byed cing lo yig ring po med/ /'tshams sbyor yi ge thung

ra༅༅/ /ngu med pas na/ /de lnga las gzhan dbyangs la gsum gsum dbye/ /re re'ang mtho dma' bar pa gsum gsum dang / /re re'ang sna ldan sna med gnyis gnyis dbye/ /dus kyi 'bor lor rang byung yi ge lnga/ /a i ṛ u lo zhes bya ba yin/ /de yi ring po yon tan 'phel ba rnams/ /lnga lnga ya ṇar bsgyur ba ha sogs lnga/ /ring thung phye bas dbyangs yig sum cu ste/ /a yig thig le can dang tshig drag can/ /gnyis bsnan dbyangs yig so gnyis zhes kyang sagad / /gsal byed sde pa lnga dang ba sde ste/ /sum cur byas pa mang zhing ha sde dang / /r+bha sde zhes pa'ang bsnan pas bzhi bcur gsungs/ /sngags gzhan dbyangs gsal bcu drug so bzhi ste/ /dbyangs la ring thung sbyar bas bcu drug dang / /gsal byed la sogs drug bsnan bzhi bcu po/ /phrag gnyis dpe byad brgyad cur byas pa'ang gsungs/ /rgyu ni rjod 'dod rlung dang gnas rnams dang / /byed pa lce rkan las skyes phal cher te/ /rnga sgra'i gdangs sogs gzhan las skyes pa'ang yod / /yi ge'i gtso bo 'bru gsum rlung gdangs ni/ /byed pa lce rkan gnas la mi bltos so/ /klog tshul dbyangs gsal so so dag las bslab/ /ming la thog ma'i ming dang rjes grub ming / /'di gnyis rim bzhin dngos ming btags ming yin /mtshan nyid rgyu mtshan med pa'i 'dod rgyal dang / /'dra'abrel rgyur byas phyi nas sbyar ba zhes/ /zer ba rnams la sangs rgyas zhes pa'i sgra/ /dngos ming min par thal ba'i gnod pa yod/ /des na rgyu mtshan med dam yod kyang rung / /dang

por sbyar bas de la 'khral med dang / /'dra 'brel rgyur byas gzhan la'ang 'jug rung yin/ /tshig gi khyad par snyan ngag sdeb sbyor te/ /dang po bcad lhug spel ma gsum du bshad/ /tshigs bcad rkang bzhi pa ste de la yang / /yi ge babakar zhing mnyam pa bṛt+ta dang / kyai/ mo bgrang zhing mi mnyam dzā ti 'o/ /de gnyis sdeb sbyor ming yin dang po la/ /yi ge nyer drug man chad tshigs bcad dang / /rkang pas bcad pa'i yi ge bgrang mod kyang / /nyer bdun yan la rgyun chags zhes byar bshad/ /bṛt+ta mnyam dang phyed mnyam mi mnyam gsum/ /dzā ti 'phags pa ro langs phyi mo mnyam/ /snyan ngag tshigs bcad la yang grol mdzod 'dus/ /rim bzhin rkang pa lakhrig dang tshigs bcad gcig /tshigs bcad du mas don gcig ston pa 'o/ /le zhus bcings pa snyan ngag chen po dang / /ma bcings snyan ngag chung ngu'i tshigs bcad yin/ /rkang po med pa'i tshig rgyun lhug pa ste/ /brjod dang gtam zhes bya ba gnyis su dbye/ /spel ma'am gcam bu zlos garabastan bcos yin/ /de gsum legs sbyar la sogs skad bzhir dbye/ /rgya gar lho dang shar pa'i snyan ngag la/ /be dar+bha ba dang go ḍa ba zhes bya/ /sbyar bar ba dang mnyam nyid la sogs bcu/ /dang po'i rgyan yin bzlog pa gnyis pa'i rgyan/ /thun mong don rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga dang /sgra rgyan zung ldan bya dka' bya sla dang / /gab tshig bzhi ste dang po bar ma chod/ /bar chod zung ldan che dang lugs lngog dang / /bya dka' ba glang gcin dang phyed 'khor dang / /kun 'khor kun tu bzang po thes byar grags/ /bya sla dbyangs

༄༄༄/ /gnas yi ge ma nges gsum/ /gab tshig kun tshogs bslu med sogs bcu drug /mngon brjod du ma'i don la ming gnyig nyid/ /'jug pa dag phyags sa dang 'od zer dang / /phyugs sogs bcu la go sgra nyid 'jug dang / /don gcig nyid la du ma'i ming 'jug pa/ /nyi ma nyid la rta ljang tsha zer can/ /nam mkha'i nor bu pad+ma'i gnyen sogs so/ /thun mong min pa rang bzhin rkyen rnam 'gyur/ /rang bzhin byings dang ming yin byings la yang / /byings mdo le 'u dgu nas bshad rnams la/ /glegs bam nas byung zhes zer 'grel pa yi/ /zur nas rnyed rnams mdo yi byings su grags/ /byings mthar san sogs drug po khyin nas kyang / /byings su gnas rnams rkyen gyis bcos pa'i byings/ /ming ni lugs 'dir rtags su grags pa ste/ /byings la rkyen byin rnamadabye ma byin pa'i/ /bar skabs sgra yi yan lag ming ngam rtags/ /dbye na pho mo ma ning so so ba/ /gsum dang thun mong ba ste ming bzhi zer/ /rkyen la mtshan nyid rang bzhin rnam 'gyur du/ /sgrub par byed pa'i sgra yi yan lag zer/ /dbye na bdun te byings la kṛta kyi tshun/ /sbyar bas byings ni rtags su sgrub pa'i rkyen/ /byings la ti sogs sbyar ba tshig tu sgrub/ /byings la san sbyar byings nyid byings su sgrub/ /rtags la mo rtags sbyar ba rtags cid rtags/ /rtags la de phan rkyen sbyar ming nyid ming / /rtags la yin sogs sbyar ba rtags nyid byings/ /rtags la si sogs sbyar ba rtags tshig tu/ /sgrub par byed pas rkyen gyi sde tshan bdun/ /rnam 'gyur rang bzhin

rkyen dang 'brel ba 'am/ /yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba'i bsgyur dbye ste/ /yan lag so so ba'i dang phrid pa las/ /gyur pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba gnyis su bsdu/ /dang po sbyar ba :'i dang ā ga ma/ /sbyar min rjes 'brel zhes grags mi gnas te/ /rjes 'brel tsam dang brjod don ngo bo'i don/ /dang po khyings rkyen rtags dang ā ga ma/ /mi zad pa dang tshig gi rjes 'brel lo/ /ā ga ma ni glo bur ba zhes bya/ /des na dus gnas gar yod mi shes par/ /thol byung dkrus min dgos ldan rtags kyi don/ /phrad gyur spyi dang byings rkyen phrad pa dang / /tshig gnyis phan tshun phrad las gyur pa yi/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i dbye ba mtha' yas phyir/ /legs sbyar gzhung dang kho bos sbyar ba yi/ /spyi don nyid du gsal phyir blang bar mdzod/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ sgra rig pa bshad pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// lto //bzhi pas don la 'khral rnams tshar gcod phyir/ /lta ba ngan pa mtha' dag 'joms par nus/ /gtan tshigs rig pa rgyal bas gsungs pa ni/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa sngon po tsam/ shes kyi sngon po 'o zhes ma yin zhes/ /gsungs pas mngon sum rtog bral dadrong mngon bstan/ /gzugs la gsal snang shes pa gnyis yin te/ /mig dang yid do zhes pas yid mngon bstan/ /'dis ni chos la gsal snang yod pa tsam/ /yid mngon yin par smra ba rnams kyang bkag /dmigs myong so sor bshad pas rang rig dang / /bdag med gsal snang gsungs pa rnal 'byor te/ /mngon sum bzhi ga ston

ra༅༅/ /pas gsal bar gsungs/ /gang zhig 'dus byas yin pa de mi rtag /du ba las ni mer shes dper mdzad pas/ /rang bden 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs de bzhin du/ /tshad mas ma dmigs pa de med ces dang / /gang zag tsam gyis gang zag tshod mi bzung / /bes pas mi dmigs pa gnyis gsal bar bstan/ /de bzhin dgra bcom chos skyob me waṃ ga /kun mkhyen gnyis pas rtsoX sgrub snga dus mdzad/ /des bskyangs 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes bzung ba/ /rig smra'i gtso bo phyogs kyi glang po yis/ /gzhung mang mdzad las btus nas tshad ma'i mdo/ /mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis dang gzhan sel dang / /dpe dang rtag chad le 'u drug ldan mdzad/ /'grel byed tshad mar ma gyur 'gas kyang bshad/ /rgyal bas lung bstan chos grags nyi ma yis / /mdo yi pad mo rnam par rgyas byed pa'i/ /sde bdun tsha zer phyogs bcur spros par gyur/ /de yang gtso bor rgyal ba'i bstan bcos sri /mchod brjod bshad pas ston dang bstan pa la/ shes nas dad pa rgyas byed le 'u gcig /mngon sum grangs nges 'bras bur bcas la gcig /gzhan sel dpe dang bcas pa bsdus pa yis/ /gto tshigs gtsor ston rang don rjes dpag dang / /rtag chod shugs ston gzhan don rjes dpag gis/ /mdo yi brjod bya mtha' dag rnam par 'grel/ /mngon rjes le 'u gsum po rang gi lugs/ /'bring dang bsdus pa rnam nges rag thigs te/ kho ba lus dang 'dra ba gsum zhes grags/ /'grel dang tshul gsum sgrub ngag ltar snang dang / /rang blo lkog

gyur 'gog la 'phros nas ni/ /'brel brtag gtan tshigs thigs pa rtsod rig dang / /rgyud gzhan grub la 'phros pa yan lag zer/ /rnam 'grel le 'u dang po rnam nges dang / — /'brelabartag rnamasalanyidakyisarnamabashademadzad le'udang 'grel rjes dpag bstan bcos ni/ /'chad rgyur gsungs pas le 'u dang por grub/ /bram zes mthong ba blos bslad man chad la/ /'grel bshad ma byas phyir na de man chad/ /rang 'grel min zhes zer mod lha rgyan gyis/ /le 'u gzhan gsam nyid las ma bshad phyir/ /dang po'i smad la 'grel pa med par 'gyur/ sgodzis rang 'grel nyid la bshad phyir yang / /rgyan gyi rjes 'brang rgyal ba can dang ni/ /ya mā ri dang nyi ma sbas pa 'o/ /rgyal rnga gsum pas rnam nges rig thigs k+shi /zlo cher 'grel byas zhi 'tshos de nyid bsdus/ ka ma la yis de 'grel tshad chen byas/ /gzhan yang bram ze che dang spyo na shrī/ /dul lha tsan+d+ra go mi je tā ri/ /dge bsrungs sogs kyi gzhung phran mang po yod/ /snga dar dus su sde bdun phyi ma 'ga'/ /phyi dar rma rngog sa paṇa sogs kyis bsgyur/ /brjod bya gsum gyi gzhal bya mngon gyur ni/ /tshur mthong dbang byas phya rol gzugs sogs lnga/ shes pa'i steng gi myong cha tsam du zad/ /'phags la bdag med gnas lugs mngon gyur nyid/ lta/na mkhyen la ni shes bya'i rnyed pa yang / /mngon gyur yin zhes mkhas rnams smra mod kyi/ /chos kyi grags pas bsam mi khyab par gsungs/ ka bum gang zag sogs kyang tshur mthong la/ /mngon gyur yin zhes bod na grags mod kyang / /de dag gzugs

ra༅༅/ /mthong tsam 'a/ gang zag sogs/ /mngon sum mthong zhes byis la grags mod zhi /ldan min 'du byed dbang pos mthong mi srid/ /des na rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i/ /dngos po rig pas dpyad bzod bden grub ni/ /mngon gyur nyid du dngos smra gsum ga mthun/ /rgyun dang rags pa yan lag can kun la/ /rang sde kun gyis bden 'dzin bzlog phyir ro/ /gzhal bya 'di yi 'jal byed mngon sum bzhi/ /lkog gyur dbang po gzugs can mi rtag sogs / /rnam pa bcu drug bdag gcig de byung 'brel/ /nus pa sa bon spang gnyen la sogs rte/ /dngos stobs gtan tshigs nyid kyis sgrub dgos phyir/ /sgrab byed gtan tshigs de ni rnam gsum ste/ /'bras bu rang bzhin ma dmigs zhes bya 'o / /'bras rtags mthun dpe du ldan tshang mang du/ /me du'i rgyu 'bras nges byed phrugs gsum ches/ /der nges la khar du ba mngon sum mthong / /phyogs der rmo la shes 'dod zhugs pa na/ /sngar gyi khyab 'brel dran pa'i rtags sems kyis/ /bsgrub bya nges pa'i rjes dpag skyed pas na/ /rgyu 'bras nges pa'i lung rtogs 'bras bu ni/ /mngon sum grub pas rang rgyu gsal bar rtogs/ /rgyu yi khyad par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags rdzi /dbang shes rkyen gsum la sogs sgrub par nus/ /tshogs pa gcig la rag lus 'brel shes na/ /du bas bud shing 'gyur ba rtogs pa bzhin/ /gzugs sogs ro la sogs pas rtogs pa ni/ /rgyu yi nus pa rjes su dpog pa 'o/ /rang bzhin sgra sogs 'dus byas skad cig mar/ /byas dang dngos

yod rtags kyis sgrub pa ste/ /rig byed sgra sogs rtag par smra ba la/ /byas par 'dod phyir ma byas par thal zhes/ /mi 'dod thal bar 'phangs nas rtag phyir gri/ /khas blangs ngan pa rtags su bkod nas ni/ /rtag la rkyen gyis byas pa mi srid phyir / /byas na 'jig rgyu gzhan la ltos med spyo/ /rig pa bstan pas lan gyis ma bzlog nas/ /the tshom skyes tshe gang byas mi rtag ste/ /bum pa ji bzhin sgra yang byas zhe 'am/ /ldog khyab mi mthun sbyor ba bkod pa na/ /gdul bya mi rtag lam la 'god par nus/ /'di la bltos ngag dbye ba gnyis su gsungs/ /ma dmigs pa la mi snang ma dmigs dang / /snang rung ma dmigs gnyis te dang po ni/ /med par ma nges rtags dang mngon sum gyis/ /yod par mi 'grub shin tu skog gyur don / /de ltar gyur bas yod nges mi 'jug ste/ /de yi mngon rjes tshad mas ma grub phyir/ /'dis ni gzhan rgyud chags ldang khyad par sogs/ /kha tshon gcod rnams glen chen nyid du bstan/ /gnyis pa phung po las gzhan bdag med de/ /de 'dra snang rung tshad mas ma dmigs phyir/ /'di ni phung po dag pa dmigs pas na/ /de mi dmigs pa'ang mngon sum nyid kyis 'grub/ /'di la 'brel zla ma dmigs pa dang ni/ /'gal zla dmigs pa'i dbye ba du ma yod/ khen lkog dge sdig las 'bras phra mo dang / /bde 'gro ngan 'gro'i gnas dang 'gro ba dang / /de dag bde sdug tshe tshad lus tshad sogs/ /'jal byed dpyad gsum gyis dag lung nyid la/ /brten pa'i yi da ches rjes dpag ces bya 'o/ /dpyad pa gsum ni mngon gyur ston

ra༅༅/ /rnams la/ /mngon sum gyis dang lkog gyur ston pa la/ /dngos stobs rjes dpag shin lkog ston rnams la/ /rang tshig snga phyi 'gal bas mi gnod pa'o/ /de dag zhib tu 'dir bshad tshig mang zhing / /rgyas par rig pa'i gzhung du bshad zin phyir/ /de dag nyid las rgya cher rtogs par bya/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ tshad ma rig pa bshad pa ste le'u lnga pa'o// 7 //nang rig nges 'byung mchog dang byang chub sems/ /rnam grol gsum gyi lam mchog ston pa ste/ /grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus zhes pa'i/ /lus rnams grol zhes bya bar gnas pa ste/ /nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs nyon sgrib las/ /grol ba nyan rang gnyis kyi myang 'das so / /mi shes 'dam du bying ba shes sgrib las/ /thar pa phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /bla med 'bras bu lus sgrib phra mo las/ /rnam par grol ba mthar thug sangs rgyas so/ /rjod byed sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /sngags la'ang bslab gsum ston rnams sde snod gsum/ /yin phyir sde snod zur pa min zhe na/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud ni/ /mdo sde chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /snod dang rgyud sde sum khri sum stong gi /rtsa bar gsungs pas snod dang rtsa ba'i khyad/ /phye phyir rigs pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces/ /bzhi par rgya bod mkhas rnams bzhed par 'thad/ /gsu/ma ni 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa ste/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims sems dang shes rab kyi /bslab gsum bstan bya'i gtso bore mdzad pa

sno / /'dul pa bzhi dang rnam 'byed phran tshegs dang / /dam pazhesabya 'dul lung sde bzhi yin/ /dang po gnyis la glegs bam bzhi bzhi ste/ /phyi ma gnyis la gnyis gnyis tha ma la/ /zhu ba 'dul byed gtam dang gling gzhi dang / /sil bu la sogs 'dul phran du ma bzhugs/ /mdo sde theg chung dran pa nyer gzhag dang / /mdo mang phran tshegs mang por 'dul lung gi /brjod bya thor bu khyad par ba rnams la/ /gleng gzhi yi rang dang bcas zur bkol yin/ /theg chen shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde ni/ /phal chen dkon brtsegs sprin chen rnga bo che/ /myang 'das tshe sogs 'khor lo tha ma dang / /bar pa sher phyin 'khor dang bcas pa 'o/ /mngon pa theg chung sde bdun du grags te/ /theg chen stong phrag brgya pa dga' ldan na/ /bzhugs shing gzhan rnams lan gsum brlag ces grags/ /rgyud sde gdul bya dman 'bring chen po dang / /chen po'i chen po rnams la rim bzhin du/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rnal 'byor bla med gsungs/ /'di dag gzhung tshad brjod bya la sogs pa/ /gsang sngags spyi dang mdo phyogs brjod tshul rnams/ /mang bas 'jigs shing gzhan du bshad pa'i phyir/ /'dir ni mdo tsam bsdus mod gzhan du rtogs/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ nang rig bshad pa sī le'u drag pa'o// lto //de ltar lnga rig nyer mkho bsngas pa 'dis/ /lde mig byas te rig gnas mtha' dag gi /bang mdzod mthong nas bsam 'phel nor mchog gis/ /'gro kun blo mun sel ba'i dpal thob shog /ces stag tshang gi

༄༄༄/ /dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gser 'phyang zhes bya ba me mo bya'i sa ga'i dkar phyogs kyi dzol ba dang po la chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba'o// lto /shes byar srid kun mang thos gser sgong du/ /rnam dgrod drod kyis smin pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /'jig rten mig gcig stag tshang lo tsā ba/ /nges pa don ldan ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gang gi phyi nang grub mtha'i dbye ba dang / /sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa'i tshogs/ khun gyi gnas lugs mtsho la byad ltar du/ /mthong nus glegs bam 'di kos chos rnams shes/ /rmongs zhen mun pa'i khung pur bag phab nas/ /phyogs lhung lce gnyis rkyong min blo gros bya/ /gtsug lag nam mkha'i pha mtha' gzhal 'dod pa'i/ /gzur gnas blo ldan kun dga' skyed pa'i yul/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i legs bshad yid bzhin nor/ /lam kha'i rdo ba lta bur dor byas nas/ /deng dus cher rlom ngag sgros mching bu la/ /rin thang gzhal ba'i tshul der mchi ma dku/ /'on te blang dor shes pa srid pa'i phyir/ /dpyod ldan mang por phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /tshad med chos sbyin spel 'bras tshe rabs/ kun/ /gsal myur zab pa'i shes rab 'thob par shog /ces 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rig gnas kun shes dang grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi bar blo gsal mang por phan 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas blangs te dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du brkos pa'i tshe za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa
ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o// //sarba maṅga lam̐// //

ra༅༅//bibhāk+ṣa〉wakāshānasdonā rbirgyasbrunā4tanirār+yapābyukanāmashās+t+robidzahār//ra༅༅/ /rig gnas kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kya rnam par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs//

ra༅༅/ /na mo martsi gho ṣa ya/lha mi'i ston mchog zla med thub dbang dang / /bstan 'dzin rig gnas kun shes mkhas rnams dang / /bla ma lhag pa'i lhar bcas gus gas nas/ /rig gnas kun shes rnam bshad 'dir baṅgi+o bya/ /'dir mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo'i gtso bo ni rig pa'i gnas lnga zhes bya ste/rgyal tshab dam pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar ltod rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de 0na byed/ /ces chos tshol gyi skabs su rig pa'i gnas lnga po 'di don gnyisamathar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su nges par btsal dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang sgra rig pas ni tshig la dang /gto tshigs rig pas ni don la

ra༅༅/ /log par rtog pa tshar ltod dgos shing /bzo rig pas ni 'dod dgu spyi dang /gso ba rig pas ni khyad par nad med don du gyer ba rjes su 'dzin pa dang /nang rig pas ni bdag nyid de kho na nyid dang lam ga zus kun shes nas nyams su blangs dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di bshad pa la sbyor dngos mjug go/dang po la mchod par brjod/ bshad par dam bca'/masmo par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/rjod byed bar gyi zung ldan bar ma chod kyi sgra rgyan du byas la/ brjod bya rgyu tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs/ngo bo don gnyis mthar son te rang don thogs med kyi mkhyen pa dang dmigs med kyi thugs rje/gzhan don 'gro ba'i ma rig pa kun bcom pa'i 'phrin las rnams nyi ma'i gzugs su bkod pas don rgyan gyi gtso bo yang tshang ngo / /gnyis pa ni/rtsom pa mthar phyin zhing gzhan la phan pa'i ched du ston pa la gus pas btud nas/gzhung rtsom par zhe nas khas blangs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/'phags pa'i mchog smo rang gi dgra bcom pas kyang rang lam de tsam gyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub mi srid pas/don gnyis mthar phyin 'dod na 'di la mi 'bad pa'i thabs med ces nan gyis bskul ba'o/ /dngos gzhi la spyir bstan/so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dgos pa'i sgo nas mdor bstan/brjod bya'i sgo nas rgyas par stod/thun mong dang de min gyi rgyu mas bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/don gnyer sogs te// go rim 'dir bstan pa'i rig gnas dang po gnyis kyis don gyer khyad par rjes su tshon la/bar pa gnyis

kyis tshig dang don la log par smra ba tshar gcod cing / phyi rol pa dang thun mong min pa'i srol lam lhag par ston pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi sgos chos yin pas nang rig ste/ de la yang gdul bya thun mong ba la mdo phyogs sde snod gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa la sngags phyogs rgyud sde bzhi rnams ni 'dir bshad par bya ba'i brjod bya mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lnga po re re'ang brjod bya'ilus bsdus na gsum gsum nyid du gnas pa'i bzo ni/ spyir yid kyis rtogs nas lus dbang la 'jug par khyad med kyang / yid dang 'brel ba'i lus kyi g.yo ba dang ngag gi brjod pa gtso bor gyur pas lus ngag gi bzo gnyis dang / ma 'brel bar yid kyi bsam pa tsam gyi dbang du byas pa yid babo'o/ /gso rig la gso bya nad dang nad pa/ gso thabs sman dang dpyad/ gso ba po nad g.yog dang sman pa'o/ /yan lag brgyad par sman dang nad pa/ nad g.yog dang sman pa ste bzhi la skyon bzhi bzhi spangs pa'i yon tan bzhi bzhi ldan pa ste/ bzhir bshad mod nad g.yog dang sman pa gnyis ka gso ba por 'dir bsdus so/ /sgra la dpang los/ rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur rnams/ /brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'og nas ston no/ /tshad ma la/ brjod bya/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag ltar snang bcas pa bdag rig byed/ /sgrub pa dang sna sun 'byin dag /ltar snang bcas pa ga'an rtogs byed/ /ces mngon sum dang rjes dpas yang das dang ltar snang / sgrub ngaris dang thal 'gyur ya nga dag dang lta ra sna nga ste rtog ge'i

༄༄༄/ /tshig don brgyad du grags shing / rang don dang gzhan don gnyis su'ang 'dus la/ zhib mo rnam 'thag gi phyogs sngar/ rtog ge'i tshig don bcu drug tu yang gsungs mod rdzi gnas gsum gzhal bya gtan 'bebs su rgya cher gsungs pa ltar byas so/ /nang rig ni theg pa gsum du grags shing / grags pa ltar don la'ang grub la/ de yang brjod bya'i dbang du byas na nyan thos kyi/ rang sangs rgyas kyi/ byang sems kyi theg pa rnams te phyi ma la theg chen zhes brjod do/ /rjod byed kyi dbang du byas na theg pa thun mong ba 'dul lung sde bzhi lta bu dang / thun mong min pa la mdo phyogs shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dang / sngags phyogs rgyud sde rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /gsum pa la rig gnas thun mong ba'i dang / thun mong min pa'i rgyu ma no/ /dang po la dngos dang / rtsod spang ngo / /dang po ni/ rig gnas dang po bzhi la thun mong ba zhes nges par brjod dgos te/ bzhi po'i brjod bya gsum thams cad kyang nang par ma zad phyi rol pa la'ang tshang bar yod pa'i phyir/ des na mkhas pa rnams la ni de ltar du grags so/ /gnyis pa la rtsod pa spyir spang pa dang / bzhi ba'i gzhung la spang pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhas rlorme kha cig na re/ gal te phyi rol pa'i rig gnas bzhi po ston pa'i brjod bya sogs/ zhe na / phye ba'i gzhung la skyon can 'ba' zhig gis ma khyab ste/ gzhon nu gti mas bshad pa'i sgra ka lā pa dang / de'i 'grel pa mu stegs kyi mkhas pa jo bo drag 'byor gyis sbyar ba'i slob phan la skyon can gyi gtan tshigs ma grub pa'i phyir te/ sgra rig

ston pa 'i legs bshad du grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te/ rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyed kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod/ /ces pa ltar/ rang rang gi gzhung lugs la mkhas pa gong ma gong ma'i rig pas 'og ma la cung zad gnod pa tsam gyis thun mong ba zhes bya bar mi rigs na ni/ rang sde bye mdo sems tsam ste dngos smra sde gsum po nang pa sangs rgyas par gcig pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rig gnas bzhi pa ston pa'i gzhung / sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa ni/ bod kyi rje btsun gong ma rnams kyang gtan tshigs rig pa yin byu/ nang rig ma yin pas sgra tshad la chos 'brel du mi bzhed de/ 'o skol gyi ston pas phyi ba'i drang srong ring 'phur skyes dang lhag spyod la bsam gtan gzugs med kyi man ngag gsan pa bzhin no/ /zhes bzhed la/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis kyang chos 'byung du rig gnas thun mong bar bgrangs so/ /phyis chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs ni/ mngon 'du'i phyir dang yang yang dang / /zil gnon rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi pa tshang bas mngon par bzhed cing / dpang lo yab sras kyis lung gi mngon pa dang / rig pa'i mngon pa zhes gnyis su bya ba'i phyi ma'i mtshan gzhir mdzad pas bstan 'dzin chen po btsong kha pa/sa kyang / byang phyogs 'di na tshad ma'i gzhung lugs la/ /sbyangs dang ma sbyang du ma mgrin gcig tu/ /mdo dang sde bdun kun na byang chub tu/ /bgrod pa'i so skabs rim pa yod mi na zer /'jam pa 'i dbyangs kyis phyogs kyi glang po la/ /dngos su 'di rtsoms

ra༅༅/ /'di ni ma 'ongs dus/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig tu 'gyur ro zhes/ /gsung gi snang ba stsal ba'ang tshad mar 'dzin/ /'di ni mi rigs smra ba'i phul byung du/ /mthong nas tshul der legs par dpyad pa na/ /zhes sogs kyi'agal 'du 'dzin mod lgi /de ni sgra rig la'ang 'di ltar mtshungs te/ byang phyogs 'di na sgra yi gzhung lugs la/ /sbyangs dang ma sbyangs du ma mgrin gcig tu/ /ka lā tsan+d+ra kun na byang chub tu/ /bgrod pa'i go skabs rim pa yod min zhes/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis tsan+d+ra go mi la/ /dngos su 'di rtsoms 'di ni ma 'ongs dus/ /'gro ba kun gyi mig tu 'gyur ro zhes/ /gsung gi snang ba stsal ba'ang tshad mar 'dzin/ /'di yang mi rigs smra ba'i phul byung du/ /'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ni slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis sgra mdo tsan+d+ra pa brtsam/sa zin pa na/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgra kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba rjod byed tshigs bcad du byas shing brjod bya mchog tu gyur pa zhig mdzad nas mkhas pa'i grwa 'grim du byung bas/ rang gi bstan bcos mi legs par gzigs nas thugs phyung ste khron par bskyur ba na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis khyod rang gi 'di ma 'ongs pa na 'gro phan che bas khron pa nas thon cig ces dngos su bka' stsal nas bton pas chus cung zad kyang ma nyams par thon zhing khron pa de la tsan+d+ra khron pa zhes grags nas chu 'thungs tshad blo༄ sdo bar gyur to zhes gsal bar grags so/ /mngon par 'jog pa'i chos bzhi'i yang yang dang zil gnon tshad du chug kyang / chos nyid mngon sum du byed tshul dang / lam

mngon par rtogs tshul ma tshang ste/ tshogs sbyor sogs lam gyi rnam gzhag cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir dang / bdag med kyi gzhi gtan 'bebs cung zad yod kyang / mchod brjod kyi 'phros don tsam yin pas/ bstan bya'i gtso bo ma yin zhing de yang mngon du byed thabs kyi bsgom rim mngon pa lta bu cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang nang pa la rig gnas bzhi pa ston pa'i gzhung med par 'gyur ba dang / gsung rab spyi'i don gyi dgongs 'grel yin pa tsam gyis nang rig tu 'jog na sgra rig skyon du 'jug pa dang / mdo'i mchod brjod kyi dngos bstan nang rig dang mthun pa tsam gyis der 'jog na/ sman yan lag brgyad pa'i mchod brjod du/ 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs pa yi nad/ /rgyun du 'brel pas lus kun khyab gyur pa / /'dod dang khro ba gti mug sel mdzad pa'i/ /sman pa sngon med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / tsan+d+ra par/ grub pa kun mkhyen kun la phan/ /thams cad mkhyen la phyag 'tshal nas/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ /sgra yi mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zhes dang / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas su/ /nang gi mtshan mo bshes bral gyi/ /nang gi thub pa nyi ma ni/ /snang ba mchog gi bdag nyid can/ /rgyal ba nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod kyi mchong brdzod ni/ nge das las kyang nang si sanyen por lin tu gsal ba rnams/ chos grags lta bus rgyas par bzhed na/ nang ris dang yin tu mthun pa 'byung mod/ nge das nang ris tu 'angod na ha cang thal lo des na dngos/ bstan dang de ya nga

ra༅༅/ /bstan bya'i gtso bo'i sgo nas thun mong rig gnas su gzung dgos te/ gzhal bya'i gnas gsum dang rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad po dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bor nges pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab ste/ drang don dang nges don gyi mdo dang / mdophyo gas sde snod sasum dang sngags phyogs la rgyud sde bzhir 'byed pa sogs kyang dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bos 'byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thun mong min pa'i rgyu ma ni/ thun mong pa la bstan bya'i gtso bor med pa'i 'bor ba'i rtse mo srid rtse las nges par 'byung ba'i gsum pa sogs bstan bya'i gtso bor rtsal 'don gang du mdzad pa'i gsung rab de ni nang rig nyid du rgyu mtshan du mas legs par grub bo zhes blo'i nor can rnams kyis rtogs par bya'o/ /le'u dang po cung zad bshad pa'o// 7 //so sor bshad pa la lnga las/ dang po bzo rig bshad pa la/ bzo rig la gus pas 'jug dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'jug bya bzo rig gi rang bzhin/ 'dir ma spros pa'i rgyu ma bstan pa'o/ /dang po la sgrub pa nyams len gyi 'khor lo dang bsod nams mnyam/ 'dod rgu mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas mchog tu bstan/ des na bzo rig la mi gus pa gcer bu'i grub mtha' yi/na pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rig gnas dang po sogs te/ sngon gyi chos rgyal bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po sogs dang / mnyan yod kyi khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang / ko'u sham bhi'i khyim bdag gdangs can la sogs pa shin tu mang po dang / phyis kyi chos rgyal mya ngan med dang / bod kyi chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum la

sogs pa/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dang bdag rkyen mdzad pa'i rgyal po dang khyim bdag ni/ bstan 'dzin gyi paṇa grub las kyang grangs mang ba 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las lung bstan pa rnams ni/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang kun sa' ra ba go+os bzhengs nas zhabs tog mdzad pa'i cha nas lung bstan pa yin gli rgyal po de dag mkhas pa dang grub pa'i cha nas ma yin la/kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / /mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /glo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang / /yul ngan tsha na sbyin pa ni/ /rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun/ /zhes pa'i dang po dang / bzhi yis tshangs pa'i bsod nams yin/ /zhes pa'i dang po gnyis/ dge 'dun bye ba bsdum pa dang /nyams len gyi gtso bo byams sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dang bsod nams mnyam par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bstan pa'i bdag rkyen chen po de dag dgyes pa skyed cing rjes su tshon pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni rig gnas 'di i do/ /de phyir dang po gnyis podo na gnyer la/ /zhes sogs smras so/ /gnyis pa ni/ chu chen sogs te/phyi'i rgya mtsho nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu len pa'i gru gzings chen po dang / gzhan yang chu bo bzhi dang bod kyi gtsang po sogs brgal ba'i gru chung gi bar dang /gzhan phyogs 'joms pa la/ thang rdzong bzhig pa'i khro'i 'khrul 'khor te rgyogs su grags pa dang / de bzhin du/ chu rdzong 'joms pa gru'i/ ri rdzong 'joms pa me'i/ ral gri 'khor ba gri gug girtse mo 'byed pa rlung girtsig pa 'jig pa gur gyi/ go cha 'jig pa lcags mda'i 'khrul 'khor

༄༄༄/ /rnams dang / rang phyogs bsrung ba la pho brang bsrung ba ral gri'i 'khral 'khor/ rgyal rigs 'thab pa shing rta'i tshad/ de bzhin du bde bar spyod pa'i 'khral 'khor la/ ltad mo la 'gro ba'i don du khang bzang gi mtshan nyid / dpyid kyi dgazha stoni gyi don du khyogs kyi mtshan nyid/ ldum ra bcu ba'i don du chu gyen du 'aspron pa'i 'bral 'khor rnams dus 'khor du gsungs la/ gzhan yang bza' btung rgyasna gos sogs kyi nyer mkho'i dgos dgu thams cad rig gnas 'di la ma brten par mi 'grub pa'o/ gsum pa ni/ des na/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /ts+tsha yi tshad kyang ji tsam mi nges pas/ /ngang pas chu la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar mdzod/ /ces jo bo chen pos gsungs pa dang / gzhi gcig tu yun ma ring / gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi'i rtsom pa ma byed ces sogs ni/ rang sems kho na 'dul ba rtsal du 'don pa'i las dang po pa la dgongs mod 64 gcer bu kun dga' ra ba sogs/ khyeg pa sdig pa'i rgyu ru sma/ /zhes srog chags phra mo la 'phral du gnod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas phugs kyi phan yon ma mthong bar zad de/ /de lta na/ lus kyi dka' thub bgyis pa yis/ mdud pa 'jig pa gcer bu 'tshal/ /zhes zas gcod pa sogs kyi dka' thub kyang byar mi rung ste/ lus kyi srin bu'i rigs brgyad khri bzhi stong la gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lung de gnyis kyi 'phro las rim pa bzhin/ thams cad mkhyen pa khyod kyis ni/ /de nyid bsod nams rgyu zhes gsungs/ /zhes

dang / khyod ni sems kyi dka' thub kyis/ /mdud pa 'jig par bzhed pa lags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gzhan gyi lus sogs la 'phral du gnod pa cung zad srid kyang rang gzhan gyi phan pa'i rgyu dang / rje khyed par bstan pa'i rgyun dang sems can la phan pa 'byung na de gnyis kyi spang blang ma log par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ bzo rig gi khungs btsal ba dang / de'i dbye ba rgya cher bstan pa dang / de rig gnas kun gyi lus su bstan pa(ོsmu+o/ /dang po ni/ bzo rig ston pas gsungs shing bstan 'dzin gyis bkral nas phyag len du mdzad par shes nas gus pa bskyed par bya'o zhes pa ni/ rgyal bas/ 'dul ba lung gi gnas mal gzhir/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad phyed dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thams cad la yid sngon du 'gro yang / des kun nas bslangs pa'i lus gtso bor byed pas lus bzo ste/ gar thig dbyangs gsum du grags pa'i dang po gnyis lta bu'o/ /ngag gtso bor byed pas ngag bzo ste/ gsum pa lta bu'o/ /lus ngag gtso bor mi byed par yid nyid kyis 'grub pas yid bzo ste/ bsam byung gi rig shes khyad par can lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ lus bzo la gtso phal gnyis kyi dang po la ska gsung thugs kyi rten no/ /dang po ni/ sku la zhes sogs te/ longs sku dang sprul sku'o/ /dang po ni/ dbu ska'i rtse mo nas gsang gnas kyi bar la zhal lnga/ de nas sting pa'i bar la zhal lnga sde zhal bcu po re re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum khro ste bsdoms pas brgya nyer lnga'o/ /'ji sna

ra༅༅/ /'pho rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis po'i sa bon zad par spangs pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid la/ kun tu 'od dang rdo rje'i 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis su phye ba'i thun mong ma yin pa bem chos kyi sgri ba pa yin pas / stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dri mar gsungs pas phar phyin theg pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir de'i longs sku la ni sor tshad 'di tsam dang mi ldan pas mdo phyogs su dang / rgyud sde 'gar yang / rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med/ /ces gsungs pa nyid/ zhal re la rang sor bcu gnyis mar grags pas rang sor brgya dang brgyad du longs sprul khyad med du byas nas de gnyis kyi khyad par rgyan yod med kyis 'jog par grags la/ dus 'khor du zhal bcu par bshad pa zhabs mthil gyi dkrus bsnan nas bgrangs pa'o zhes de phyogs kyi mkhas rlom dag zer mod/ zhabs mthil ni zhal bcu po la mi the bar rang sor bcu bzhir gsal bar gsungs pa ma mthong bar zad do/ /des na brgya dang bcu gnyis sam brgya dang brgyad pa ni/ dus 'khor lugs kyi sprul sku'i phyag tshad rags par byed dgos so/ /byang sems gzhir byas la yang / phyag rdor dang zla bzang gnyis longs sprul du gsal bar gsungs shing / mi thal pa'i lus kyi srid tshad la sor brgyad cu gya bzhi las med pas des na phar phyin pa'i longs sku la sor brgya dang bcu gnyis par byas nas de'i bar gyi sor brgyad po/ sa bcu gnyis kyis

bgos pas sor gnyisare dang nas phyed dang rgesum re lhag tsam re la 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes kyang don gyis thob bo/ /'o na dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ rgyal po zla bzang gi spangs rtogs 'chad pa na/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la/ stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu 'gags zin nas gnyis pa 'gog par bshad pa dang / 'dir phrag bcu gnyis po phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dri mar bshad pa 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ der dbugs 'byung ba dang 'jug pa sum stong drug brgyas dman pa zhes gsungs pas 'pho rlang mngon gyur ba la dgongs shing / byang sems kyang phar phyin theg pa'i sa bcu pa'i byang sems yin pa la dgongs so/ /de la ni/ sa dang po rab dga' thob ma thag tu 'pho rlung mngon gyur ba stong brgyad brgya phrag gcig 'gags pa nas chos kyi sprin thob ma thag bcu 'gags/ sa de nyid mthar phyin phyin gyi bar la phrag gnyis 'gags nas phar phyin theg pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob mod rdzi da dung 'pho ba'i bag chags bem chos phra mo stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis lus pa kun tu 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis kyis spong zhing bcu gnyis pa'i spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa na mthar thug gi longs sku 'thob bo/ lta/na tu 'od la sogs pa bcu gcig sngags kyi byang 'phags kyi sar byed dgos mod kyang de la ni yun ring mi 'gor bas lus tshad che chung sogs gzhag par dka' yang / zhib tu sbyor na sor bcu gsum pa nas nyer lnga'i bar gyi bcu gsum po la bcu gnyis kyis bgos pas rtogs mod kyi 'di dag lag len du byed pa'ang dka' bas 'ib

ra༅༅/ /par ma bshad do/ /de ltar na phar phyin theg pa'i longs sprul la'ang sor bzhi'i khyad du bya'o/ /dus 'khor lugs kyi sprul sku'i phyag tshad rags par bshad pa de yang ston pa shwakya thub sogs mdo phyogs kyi mchog gi sprul sku'i dbang du byas zhi sngags kyi longs sprul la ni khyad par mi byed de/ rgyud du gsungs pa'i tshad nyid dkyil 'bor gtso bo'i phyag tshad du bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs chu lon mar grags pa ni/ rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo ji'i sku dri bzang kha dog legs pos byugs nas ras gtsang gsher ba bkab ste blangs pas byin rlabs kyis phyag g.yas g.yon sogs thad kur byon pa zhig la dper byas nas bris pa ste/ sku'i zheng shin tu rgyas shing mags pa thung pa shin tu brjid pa zhig 'byung ste phyag tshad sbyar du med do/ /spyir sprul sku la babyo'i dang skye ba'i dang mchog gi sprul sku gsum gsungs pa'i dang po ni dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i don du dri za'i cha byad du sprul pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni zhabor los sgyur rgyal du dang gzhan yang rgyal blon dang skyes pa bud med khye'u dang bu mo dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i rnam par sprul pa ste/ gang la gang 'dul lo/ /snga ma'ang 'di nyid yin mod kyang de 'phrin las khyad par ba yin pas/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /zhes zur du mdzad do/ /gsum pa la thun mong ba byang chub chen po brnyes tshul dang / mya ngan 'das tshul sogs ston par mdzad pa tshodzi'i rgyal po dang / thun mong min pa rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang brten pa mtha' dag ste/ 'di dag longs

skur 'dod pa'i mkhas rlom shin tu mang mod kyi/ gang la gang 'dul gyi mdog dbyibs shin tu tha dad pa spyir sprul sku'i mtshan nyid du rang rang gis khas blangs pa brjod pa dang / dkyil 'khor rere zhing sprul bshad mdzad pa ma go bar/ spal sku 'o/ rab byung gi rnam pa can gyis khyab par bzung bas nongs so/ /brten pa lha rnams sprul sku yin du chug kyang rten gzhal yas khang ni bem po'i rnam par snang bas sprul skur mi rung ngo zhe na/ khyed rang gis gzengs dang zam pa la sogs pa skyethe 'i sprul sku'i mtshan gzhir 'dod pa'ang mtshungs so/ /de dag ni bem por snang ba tsam yin gyi ngo bo ni sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes kyi cha shas yin no zhe na 'dir yang de bzhirno no/ /de ltar na mchog gi sprul sku thun mong ba ni bde gshegs brgyad mi 'brags pa la sogs pa shin tu zhi ba'i nyams ldan no/ /thun mong ma yin pa la/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lta bu shin tu zhi bas spyan dkrus phra zhing ring ba sogs kyi nyams ldan dang / mi bskyod rdo rje lta bu khro chags gnyis ma'i nyams tshang ba zhig ma khro dang / gshin rje gshed skor lta bu sbom zhing thung ba srin po dang gnod sbyin gyi cha byad/ mi sdug pa'i ltas bco brgyad tshang bas shin tu khros pa dbu sgra ma gtogs pa'i bzhengs pa'i spangs la'ang zhal bzhi las med pa dang / 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa zhes gsungs pa'i bstan don gur gyi mgon po lta bu dbu che zhing mjing pa nub pas/ zhal gsum gyi dpangs las med pas lhag par khros pa'o/ /ska de dag gi phyag mtshan gyi gtso bo rdo rje dang dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni dus 'khor la sogs

ra༅༅/ /pa'i rgyud sde du mar 'byung ba'i nang nas/ bshad rgyud rtse mo sogs nas 'byung ba la phyi dril dang / dus 'khor dang sam pu ṭi sogs nas 'byung ba nang dril zhes bya ste/ de dag la gsang sngags phyi nang du kun la grags shing rgyud nas kyang gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na drang don rtags kyi rdor dril yin na phyi dril yin pas khyab bo zhes zer ba ni mkhas rlom dregs pa'i nga ro sgrogs par zad do/ /'di dag thams cad kyi phyag tshad sogs dang gzhan yang kha ṭaṃ ga la sogs pa'i lag cha dang / rgyan drug sogs kyi bshad pa ni/ kho bos rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho dang / kye rdor mchod 'phreng sogs su bshad par blta'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rten ni/ yi ge'i i na la/ de la yang yi shi'i ngo bo ni/ skad kyi gdangs te/ dbyangs dang gsal byed do/ /'dir bzo rig gi gnas su gzhag par bya ba ni/ yi ge'i gzugs yin la/ de yang mdo rgya che rol pa las yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhir bshad de/ 'di skad du byang chub sems dpa' yi ge'i grwa zhugs te/ yi ge pa kun gyi bshes gnyen gyi drung du byon pa na/ des byang chub sems dpa'i dpal dang gzi brjid ma bzod de kha bub tu 'gyel lo/ /de dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu yan lag bzang po zhes bya bas bslangs te/ yab zas gtsang la sogs pa skye bo mang po'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' la rgyas par bstod cing mchod nas mi snang bar gyur te/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' tsan+dan sprul gyi snying po las byas pa'i yi ge'i glegs shing gyis byugs pa gser gyi yang mig lis

btags/ mtha' nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa thogs te/slob dpon kun gyi tsos gnyen la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ma/lan pos bdag la yi ge gang slob/ tshangs pa'i yi ge'am/ 9lho+oge'am/pad+ma'isnyingatshoyige'am //de bzhin du sbyar te/ aṅga'i/baṅga'i/ma ga dha'i/ bkra shis pa'i/sor mo'i/shā ka na'i/ ya ba na'i/ pa ga le'i/pa ru sha'i/ 'gro lding ba'i/ki ra ta'i/lho phyogs pa'i/ drag shul can zhigrangs skyuspyi'u tshugs pa'i/rjes su mthun pa'i/ bru sha'i/ kha che'i/ rgya'i/ bu na'i/ hu na'i/ 'bring rgyas su bri ba'i/ rgyal gyi/lha'i/klu'i/ gnod sbyin gyi/dri za'i/ mi 'am ci'i/ lto wo chen i/lha ma yin gyi/ nam mkha' lding gi ri dwags 'khor lo'i/ bya rog sgra gcan gyi/ sa bu'i/ bar snang gi ba lang spyod kyi/ sgra mi snyan gyi/ lus 'phags tsho/ 'degs pa'i/ bzhag pa'i/ bsnan pa'i/ rgya mtsho'i/rngo rje'i/ spring yig dang len gyi/ rnam thar gyi/ rings med kyi / bstan bcos skor ba'i/rtsis skor ba'i/ 'degs pa skor ba'i/ bzhag pa skor ba'i/rkang pas bris pa'i/tshig lan gnyis su gdab pa mtshams sritshig gi mtshams bcur brgyud pa'i bar sibla thabs su bsnan pa'i/sgra thams cad kun tu bsdus pa'i/ rig pa dang mthun pa'i/ rnam par 'dres pa'i/ drang srong gis dka' thub spyad pa'i/ ldeng ba'i/ sa blta ba'i/ nam mkha' blta ba'i/ sman thar/sa cad kyi rgyu mthun pa 'i/ snyi nga po thams cad kun tu bsngas

ra༅༅/ /pa'i/ 'byung po thams cad kyi sgra bsdus pa'i yi ge ste/ kye slob dpon/ yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag gi nang nas bdag la gang bslab ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon nga rgyal dang dregs pa dang rgyags pa med par byas te ngo mtshar nas bzhin gyi 'dzum byang ste/ sems can dag pa ngo mtshar che/ /bstan bcos kun la bslabs gyur kyang / /'jig rten 'jig rten rjes bsnyeg phyir/ /yi ge'i grwar ni byon par gyur/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad du mas bstod do / /de yang re re nas bgrangs na re ༄ bdun snang bas re bzhi zhes pa ma dag pa'am/ yang na sa bla dang bar snang gcig tu snang zhing / 'degs bzhag bsnan gsum gcig tu byas sam snyam mo/ /mdo 'dir/ ṛ '-i bzhi bor ba'i dbyangs bcu gnyis dang / gsal byed ka sde sogs sde pa lnga dang / mthar gnas bzhi dang dro ba bzhi dang k+ṣa yig ste so bzhi po rnams byis pa khri phrag gcig dang lhan cig brjod pa'i tshe/ mi rtag bdag med la sogs pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs/ gsal gyi grangs dang mnyam pa byung bas byis pa sum khri nyis stong byang chub tu smin par mdzad ces gsungs so/ /bod kyi yi ge ma bgrangs pa ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das rjes thon mis lha sa'i chos rgyal gyi dus su / kha che'i yi ge la dpe byas nas gsar du brtsams pas yin la hor gyi yig gsar du grags pa yang 'phags pa rin po ches gsar du mdzad pa'o/ /larngo dang wartu la la sogs pa'i gzugs ni mthong ba brgyud pas shes dgos shing rags pa'i rnam pa tsam sgra'i spyi don du bshad zin to/ /chos sku'am

thugs kyi rten ni mchod rten du grags pa ste/ de yang bstan pa 'di'i mchod rten gyi gtso bo ni shāka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa ste/ de rnams gang du bzhengs pa'i gnas dang dus dang ming dang bang rim gyi sgo nas dbyibs kyi khyad par ni/ kho bos snga mo'i dus su byas pa'i bstod pa 'dir gsal te/ na mo martsi nā thā ya/ phun tshogs dge legs gzi 'od stong 'bar zhing / /ma lus 'phro ba'i nyer 'tsho phan bde'i gzhi/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i dbus na lham me ba/ /bde gshegs mchod rten lhun por gus phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa bltams tshe ser skya'i grong khyer du/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi glo 'bur dang bcas pa/ /bang rim bzhi ldan sgo mang kyis spas pa'i/ /bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma ga d+ngha yi byang chub shing drung du/ /bdud sde bcom nas mngon par sangs rgyas tshe/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi ldan pa'i/ /byang chub chen po'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal 'oju+o/ /wa ra ṇa sir chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs gru bzhi glo 'bur dang bcas pa/ /bang rim bzhi ldan sgo mang gis dben pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yum la chos bstan nas/ /slar yang babazlo tshe gsal ldan du sbyangs pa/ /chos 'khor lta bu gdang bus rab mjos pa 'i / /lha la sa babs pa 'i ma chod rten phyas 'tshal lo ma nyan du yod rnga riri mu stegs/ pham/ byas/ tshe /che/sas sbyangs zlum/ po bang rir/ ba'i pa ni/ /pad+ma'i drwa bas mngomyo par spras pa yi/ /cho 'phrul chen po'i mchong rten phyas 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po'i

ra༅༅/ /khab tu dge 'dun dbyen bzlums tshe/ /legs sbyangs byang chen lta bu zur bcad pas/ /zur brgyad logs brgyad kun nas cha mnyam pa'i/ /dbyen bzlums byams dngos mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /yangs pa can da sku mo'i 'du byed ni/ /zla ba gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs zlum po bang rim gsum ldan pa/ /byin brlabs rnam rgyal mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa mchog grong du mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe/ /legs sbyangs bang rim gyis dben mgur chu yan/ /rab brjid seng khri'i dbus na lham me ba/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mchod rten phyag 'tshal lo/ lta/na kyang pad gdan seng khri ming dge bcu/ /mgur chu bushā pa bre dang bcu gsum gdugs/ /char khebs tog sogs mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pa'i/ /lha mi'i bsod nams rten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i mchod rten brgyad la bstod pa gnas dang dus dang dbyebs kyi khyad par du byas pa 'di yang dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis sbyar ro/ /zhes te / dus de dang de'i tshe gnas de dang de'i grong khyer pa rnams kyis dga' spro khyad par can gyis bzhengs shing so so'i dus ston bzang po yang gnas de rnams su yod par gsungs so/ /'di ni gtsug tor dri med kyi 'brel bar 'byang ba bzhin te / phyag tshad cha chen dang cha phran gyi nges pa'ang dpal 'byor rgya mtshor gsal lo/ /dus 'khor las gsungs pa ni/ phyi ri rab kyi dbyibs dang / nang skyes bu'i lus tshad/ gzhan de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyil krung du bzhugs pa'ikhu skyil krung gi

cha bang rim du don gyis thob cing / bum pa ni skyes bu dang ri rab kyi lus dngos/ lte ba nas mgrin pa'i bar te dpung pa'i thad du je rgyas su song ba snying ga'i thad du pad+ma'i 'phreng ba phyir la 'bur du rde+od pas bskor ba/ bre mgul mgrin pa'i g.yos dang bre gdong ni byad bzhin gyi dpangs tshad phyi la 'phyar ba dang bcas pa/ phyogs kyi gsum cha'i glo 'bur can te 'og gi bang rim la song / bre'i steng du gdugs ni sgra mtshams yan chad zhal gang gi tshad can char khebs sogs don gyis thob pa'o /de ltar na lugs 'di sor bzhag la mchod rten brgyad kyi mtshan nyid so sor med do/ /lugs gnyis ka la yang seng khri ni ma bshad pas ci mdzes so/ /de ltar na rdzogs sangs rgyas la sogs so/ /rang sangs rgyas la sogs ni rgyas par bshad na mang la/ mdor bsdus/ rtogs sla zhing dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba mchod pa dang gdug pa 'dul ba'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur gar gyi rnam gzhag la/ mig gi lta stangs/ lag pa'i phyag rgya/ rkang pa'i stangs stabs la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa rnams kyang lus bzor gco bor bsdu ste/ rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba la gtso bor bslab bo/ /lus bzo phal pa ni/ khang khyim khyad par can khang pa brtsegs pa khang mig lnga brgya pa la sogs pa dang / gru gzings sogs kyang rgyas par bshang mod kyi/ bong na meng pa'i gru sazings ngang phong rta sogs ni rtogs par dala'o/ /sa'an yang bza' btung khyang pa/ra can gyi sa5ོ༈ོ sta rgyan sos khyad pa ra can gyi bzo tshem la sogs pa'ang shes par bya zhing / gos dra
