ra༅༅/ /ba dang drub pa dang 'gru ba dang 'chag pa dang kha sgyur ba sogs ni 'dul ba'i gos gzhi na'ang gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ngag bzo ni/ rgyal ba mchod pa'i bstod dbyangs sogs ni gtso bo ste/ rgod bag med par dad pas bya dgos par/ bstod phyag dang rgyun chags gsum pa sogs kyi dbyangs kyi pe ro bya bar mdo lung dang rgyud sder rgyas par gsungs so/ /des na skad gang ngas che zhing snyan pa 'byung ba'i thabs kyi sman dang dpyad dang spyod lam bsten cing zlog phyogs su nges la/ 'gyur dang khugs dang 'degs dang 'jog sgom dang phra ba ste drug lngan la sogs pa'i gdangs kyi rnam 'gyur du ma la byang bar byas nas bod snga ma la grags spro/'i mdo lugs kyi dbyangs dang / lo chen lo chungari gis spel ba'i yi ge'i dbyangs dang / chos skyong zhi drag gi bstod bskul la sogs pa yang mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun las legs par bsla ba dgos la/ sna tshogs rol mo'i cha byad/ rnga bo che dang rnga pa ṭa ha dang / rdza rnga dang zom rnga dang gling bu dang pi waṃ dang rgyud mang la sogs pa dang / dung dang zangs dung rags dung la sogs pa mtha' yas pa rnams kyi gzugs bzo ba la mkhas pa ni lus bzo yin la/ 'dir rol mo'i skad gdangs 'don pa la mkhas pa ni ngag babyo'o/ /yid kyi bzo ni thos bsam sogis mtha' yas so/ /de la brtas pa brgyad ni/ sa gzhi dang / rin po che dang / ljon shing dang / gos dang / glang po che dang / rta dang / skyes pa dang / bud med brtag pa ste/ dang po ni phyi nang gis dpyad rgyas pa dpal 'byor rgya mtshor bshad

drung gzhanarnams kyi gzhung lugs khungs thub bod du ma byon la/ mi dpyad rta dbyad sogs 'ga' re snang ba ni yid ches kyi gnas su ma mthong bas ma bris so/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor pho mo'i dpyad du ma ni rgyud sde rnams su 'byung bas de dag gi rnam bshad du gsal lo/ /rig gnas bco barbad ni/ bram ze rnams kyi las/ gsang sngags dang rgyud kyi rig pa/ cho ga zhib mo'i rig pa/ gtan tshigs kyi rig pa nas/ gnas 'dug gi rig pa'i bar bco brgyad 'dul ba lung las gsungs so / /skar rtsis ni/ rgya gar nas 'byung ba lngarā sdus dang sgra gcan gdong mjug dang / lo 'pho zla 'pho dang nyi zla gza' 'dzin dang / gza' lnga'i rtsis dang / dus sbyor gyi rtsis/ dang / khyad par yul drug gi dus sbyor sogs te kho bos gzhan du rgyu mtshan dang bcas te bshad do/ /dbyangs 'char ni gtso bor dus 'khor dbyangs 'char gyi mdor bsdus las gsungs la/ de dang cha mthun zhing phal cher dgag par bya ba ni dbang phyug chen pos bshad pa'i rgyud globo lo tsā bas bsgyur ba la kun dga' zla ba'i ṭī ka dang bcas pa deng sang grags che ste de la brten pa'i dus sbyor sogs kyi rnam gzhag zur na gsal lo/ /nag rtsis ni/ rgya nag nas 'byung ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pas bdag gi rigs brtag pa la shin tu nye bar mkho yang bod kyi pha jo blan pos mang du bslad pa sa rnam dag zur na bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yid bzotho sa bsam bya yul du ma 'dus pa'i rig gnas med pa de'i phyir bzo'i rig gnas 'dir rig gnas mtha' ngas 'dus pas ris gnas kun gyi lu/sa

ra༅༅/ /yin pa'i phyir zas 'tshol ba'i rig gnas zhes brnyas par mi bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag phal cher sogs te brjod zin to/ /rig gnas ngang po cung zad bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// 7 //gsum pa gso rig la/ gso rig gi dgos pa/ de'i byung khungs/ de'i rang bzhin/ de'i kha 'phangs so/ /dang po ni/ rig gnas gnyis pa gso ba rig pa ni don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs kyi mchog tu grub ste/ 'gro kun sogs de'i phyir te/ 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad/ rjes su 'brel bas lus kun khyab gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i zag bcas las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyi lus ni 'byung bzhi 'dus pa las 'byung la/ 'byung bzhi ni tsha grang mi mthun pas de la brten pa'i nad rlung mkhris bad yin cha snyoms na nad med byed mod kyang tsha grang cha snyoms su zas dang spyod lam du mas mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'byung lus rags pa yang sku rgyab bstun pa sogs su gdul bya thun mong ba mtha' dag la snang zhing gzugs khams kyi lha chen tshangs pa la sgra gcan gyi 'khor los dgral bar snad pa'i zug rngus brgyal bar phyi rol pa kun la thun mong du grags shing grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la rgyal bas gsungs tshul / tshangs pa nas brgyud tshul/ rgya gar du dar tshul/ bod du byon tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ thub pa'i dbang po sogs te/ rgyud sde spyir yang lus kyi chags tshul dang de'i khams 'khrugs pas nad skyed tshul dang de la phan pa'i phyi nang gi sman dang

dpyad la sogs pa gsungasaparnamarme 9/ma 'bras la sogs pa'i man ngag du mar bsnarme sheng / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang ler/ dang por mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni sngags pa rnams kyis dngos grub rgyu ru yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /zhes sogs bsrung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan khyad pa racan gsungs nas/ bsrung thabs kyi gca bo rnal 'byor gyi rlung sbyor/ bsrung thabs phal pa sman dang bcud len/ sman la yang kun spangs kyi rang gi lus la yod pa'i sman/ mi bskyod pa ni cung zad dro bas kha nad zhi bar byed de/ so yi zug rngu nyid la yang / /zhes sogs du ma dang / 'byor ldan gyi phyi'i sman/ rlung 'joms lan tshwa skyur po dag tu rab tu 'gyur te mngar dang bska ba dag ni mkhris pa'i dgra/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la / bcud len yang / sman 'bring mchog gsum dang chen po'i chen po ro chen gyi sbyor ba sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /de bzhin du 'dul ba lung sman gyi gzhi las/ sman rnam pa bzhi'i bsten tshul sogs dang gser 'od dam pa'i mdo sde sogs su yang gsungs te de dang der blta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol pa la grags pa/ lha min stobs ldan gyis/ ri rab kyis srubs shing / klu'i rgyal po gnyis kyis srubs thag byas nas phyi'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pas dug dang bdud rtsidang zla nyi la sogs pa byang ba'i dug dbang phyug gis 'grungs pas mgrin sngon du song ba sogs kyi tshe/ tshangs pas bdud rtsi sgos su khyer bas/ sgra gcan gyis 'khor lo bsnun pa dpral/ bar phog pa sa shin tu snad nas yun ring du brgyal/ de las bsos dran pa rnyed nas

ra༅༅/ /phan pa'i thabs bsams pas/ sngon ston pas sman gyi rgyud thos pa rnams brjed bsos te rang gi nad kyang bcos shing / skye rgu'i bdag po zhes pa tshangs pa gnyis pa zhig la rgya cher bstan/ des tha skar gyi bu gnyis zhes pa sngon gyi rgyal po skya bsring gi bu lngar grags pa'i 'thab brtan chos kyi bu/ 'jigs sde rlung gi bu/ srid sgrub dbang po'i bu/ rigs med dang lhar bcas gnyis skar ma tha skar gyi bu yin pa'i nang nas tha ma gnyis la bshad/ de gnyis kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la brgyud pa nas bzung ste/ kho bos byas pa'i gso dpyad spyi don du bkod pa bzhin lha'i khrong srong du ma la brgyud do/ /gsum pa ni/ ston pa bzhugs tshe sogs te/ 'dul ba gos bzhi'i gleng gzhir rgyas par 'gyur ba bzhin du / thub pa snyun gso'i sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nus bso shes grags te/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la btsun mo'i bu ma skyes dgra/ zur bu che ba/ yangs pa can gyi a smra skyong ma dang 'grogs pa las byung ba/ gzhon nu 'jigs med ces pa la/ rgyal po'i khab nyid kyi tshong dpon gyi chung ma zhig dang 'grogs pa las 'di byung nas rang gi phu bo gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis 'di bsos pas gzhon nus bsos zhes bya'i/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu zhes pa ni ming gi zur nyams la/ gzhon nu gso zhes pa'ang rnam dbye nyams so/ /rgyun shes gyi bu nas 'di las brgyud pa'ang rigs na'ang ma mthong la/ ma bzhin 'jug sogs nas mi'i drang srong brgyud tshul rgyas pa'ang spyi don du gsal zhing / khyad par lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed

sogs te/ mkhas mchog dpa' tsho / dbu ma 'a ngasalo sa rang rgyud pa dang / sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs thal 'gyur bar gyes kyang / 'phags pa klu sgrub dang ār+ya de wa ni phyogs su ma lhung bas gzhung phyi tsho dbu ma pa zhes bod na gsal bar grags pa'i nang du gzhug dgos par nges te/ 'dis mdzad pa'i don dam byang chub sems kyi bsgom rim khyad par ༅ rin r+sā sgron me zhes bya ba la bltas pas lta ba'i mthar thug dang ldan par gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di dang 'dul byed 'phags pa lha' rnam thar dang 'dis gzhung lugs dang 'phrimyo/ las mdzad tshul yang sman gyi spyi don na gsal lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ dpa' bo yab sras de nas brgyud pa ring thung gnyis su legs par brgyud pa skyes mchog rin chen bzang po nas brgyud de sman gyi rgyad bzhi byung tshul gyi bar yang snga ma bzhin te 'dir ldab nas ma bris so/ /gsum pa la yang /mdzad pa po sangs rgyas byang sems/ lha mi'i drang srong sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rgya gar rgya nagahor dang ge sar bod la sogs pa'i gso dpyad kyi snam gzhag du ma yod par grags kyang / gzhung gi mthar thug pa mkhas rmongs kun la mthun snang du grub pa/ khungs nas brgyud/ mkhas pas bshad/ lo chen gyis bsgyur/ mkhas grub la grags pa ni/gso dpyad yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsngas pa 'ji/'o/ /'ji'i gzhung tshang/ brjong bya yan lag brgyad/ brngod tshul gnas drugale' brgya rnyi shu/rtsa rgyud tshod rgyud/phyi ma'i rgyud nge rgyud gsum du bsdu tshul sogs sna gzhung sis shin tu gsal lo/ //'on/ kyang 'ji/

ra༅༅/ /nyams su len pa po'i gang zag gi bsam sbyoradang / blang bya le'u so so'i brjod bya bsdus te bstan na 'di lta ste/ spyir 'jig rten pa'i tshe dang bsod nams sogs don du gnyer bas kyang / rang rgi 'tsho ba'i lhag ma gang byung bla ma dkon ci+og gi phyogs su gtong bar 'dod pa'i sbyin pa dang / mi dge bcu spong gi nang nas sna re sna gnyis ya na chad ji tsam nus pa spong ba sogs dang / 'dul pa dang mdo sde nas 'byung ba'i ya rabs kyi spyod pa'i ngang nas bya bar gsungs te / gzhung 'di'i mdo gnas le'u gnyis pa nyin re spyod pa'i le'u las/ sems can thams cad bde 'dod phyir/ khyam pa kun la 'jug par 'dod/ /bde ba chos med par ma yin/ /de bas chos la brtson par bya/ /mos pas dge ba'i bzhes gnyen bsten/ jig shos ring du spang bar bya/ /'tshe dang rgyu dang 'dod log spyod/ /phra ma ngag rtsab rdzun tshig dang / /ma 'brel smra dang gnod sems dang / /bsnab sems lta ba phyin ci log /de ltar sdig pa'i las rnams bcu/ /lus ngag yid kyis spang bar bya/ /phongs pa nad pa mya ngan gzir/ /ci nus par ni phan gdags phyir/ /'bu sgron grog sbur dag la yang / /rang dang 'dra bar blta bar bya/ /lha dang dge slong bram ze dang / /sman rnga/ rgan rgyal 'gron 'ongs mchod/ /slong la rgyab kyis phyogs mi bya/ /brnyas par mi bya tshar mi 'kho+od/ khes sogs sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa dang khyad par/ gnod par byed brtson dgra gzhan la'ang / /phan gdags pa ni gtso bor bya/ /zhes sogs bdag pas gzhan gces dang / /'byor rgud

la yang yid gcig bya/ /rgyu la phrag dog 'bras bu min/ /zhes sogs brtan zhing bsran tshugs pa dang / rgyu nas bcos kyi 'bras bu grub zin la bzod par bya ba sogs bsam sbyor khyad par can du ma dang spridapagadamoglalabal k+ṣe/de gdang bar mi bya 'o/ /zhes sogs 'phral gyi kun spyod 'dul ba ltar zhib pa mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang chos dang mi mthun pa'i gnas dang grogs dang bza' btung thams cad spang zhing / mdor na 'jig rten mdzangs pa'i kun spyod mtha' dag ni dam pa'i chos dang mthun pas de la bslab par gsungs te/ blo lngan sbyor ba thams cad la/ /'jig rten nyid ni slob dpon yin/ /de bas 'jig rten pa yi don/ /rtogs par bya ba de nyid bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ 'jig rten tshul lugs gang dang gang / /de dang de la chos rjes 'jug /de yi phyir na chos pas kyang / /'jis rten stobs ldan lta bur snang / /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad nas/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang mthun mod kri/ ding sang ni 'jig rten ya rabs kyi chos lugs byas na tshe 'di mi 'grub par byas nas rgyal rigs ngan pa'i gzhung dang chom rkun gyi gzhung lugs tshad mar byed pas ya rabs kyi spyod tshul nub pa 'i phyir na de spyod par 'angod pas gzhung lusas 'ji lta bu chos gtso bor ston pa la bslab cing / khyad pa ra sman pa'i bsam sbyor gyi gtso bo sa'an phan gyi bya ba nying lhur blangs nas nyams su blangs na/ mthar thus sangs rgyas 'a/ nye

༄༄༄/ /bar ma zad 'phral gyi blun po la grags pa'i sman bsod sogs kyang bde blag tu 'byung bar nges so/ /de skad du yang / le'u de'i mjug tu/ snying rjes brlan zhing gtong dang ldan/ /lus dang ngag yid dul ba dang / /gzhan gyi don la rang don sems/ /de dag dam pa'i spyod mthar thug /ces dang / de ltar spyod pa mdor bsdus pas/ /gang zhig kun tu sbyong byed pa/ /tshe dang nad med dbang phyug dang / /grags pa 'jig rten rtag thob 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /khyad paradu/ rang gzhan gyi tshe bsring bar 'dod pa'i kun slong gis/ chos dang 'byor pa sgrub cing sman dpyad kyi gzhung 'di la nan to du bya bar gsungs te/ mgo'i bshad par dam bca' las/ tshe ni ring bar 'dod pa yis/ /chos dang nor dang bde bsgrub/ /tshe yi rig byed lung bshad pa/ /rab tu gus par bya bar gyis/ /tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye rgu'i bdag la bshad pa yin/ /de yis tha skar des brgya byin/ /des rgyun shes sogs drang srong la'o/ /de yis me bzhin 'jug la sogs/ /de rnams kyis kyang so sor byas/ khren tu 'thor ba de rnams las/ /rab gces phal cher btus pa ni/ tshen tu bsdus min rgyas min par/ /yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po labya/ /zhes sogs so/ /brjod bya yan lag brgyad ni / lus dang byis pa gdon lus stod/ /mtshon dang mche ba gos ro tsa/ /gso dpyad gang la gnas gyur pa/ /yan lag brgyad ces de la brjod/ khes so/ /le'u so so'i brjod bya ni/ mdo gnas le'u dang po tshe ring ba'i le'us ni/ brjod bya

yan lag brgyad/ nad gsumagyi ngobo / sman dang smanapa/ nad pa dang nad g.yog rnams chos bzhi ldan sogs kyi sman dpyad spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / le'u brgya nyi shu'i mtshan rnams bstan no/ /gnyis pa nyin re'i spyod pa'i le'us ni/ zhag gcig gi khrus dang gtsang sbra sgo gsum gyi kun spyod bstan no/ /gsum pa dus su spyad pa'i le'us ni/ lo gcig gi dus drug dang bzhi la sogs pa'i tshe nad ldang tshul dang zas spyod so sor bsten tshul lo/ /de bzhin du nad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i dpyad kyis ne+e / dus de rnams su nad gsar du mi gsog pa'i sman dang dpyad dang / gal te bsags na/ dgun bsags pa dbyed dang / dbyed bsags pa dbyar sel tshul sogs so/ /lngapa chu snod sogs kyi bye brag shes pas ni/ chu dang 'o ma bu ram shing / /tilamar chang gi sde tshan rim/ /zhes de rnams kyi sde tshan ston no/ drug pa kha zas kyi tshul bstan pas ni/ gra ma can dang / gang du chags pa dang / g.yos su byas pa dang / sha dang tshod ma dang / 'bras bu dang / tshwa rnams kyi sde tshan rgyas pa'o/ /bdun pa kha zas srung bas ni/ rang gis bslabs sam/ sman pa mkhas pa rang gi drung du bzhag nas zas spyod gnod par 'gyur ba bsrung zhing phan pa bsten tshul lo/ /brgyad pa la zas tshod bzung gi le'us ni/ de'i tshul rgyas par ro / /dgu pa sman sags kyi bye brag shes par bya bas ni/ sman gyi ro nus sogs rgya cher ro/ /bcu pa ro tha dad shes par bya bas ni/ ro drug gi sde tshan no/ /bcu gcig pa nad lasags pa'i tshul shes pas ni/ nad dang / lus zungs dang / dri

ra༅༅/ /ma'i dbye ba'o/ /bcu gnyis pa nad kyibye brag shes pas ni/ nad rnams lus kyi gnas so sor ldang tshul dang / yang lci dang 'phel zad dang / de dag la brten pa'i dbye ba sogs so/ /bcu gsum pa nad gso thabs kyis ni/ nad gsum dang ldan 'dus gso tshul lo/ /bcu bzhi pa gso thabs rnam pa gnyis pas ni/ lus brtas shing rgyas pa dang / nyams smad cing bsnyung bar byed tshul lo/ /bco lnga pa sbyang pa la sogs pa'i sde tshan sna tshogs 'dus pas ni / skyag sman/ 'khra sman/ 'tsho byed/ lung sel gyi sde la sogs te nad sna tshogs sel ba ston no/ /bcu drug pa snum gyi cho gas ni/ rlung nad gtso bor gyur pa la snam par byed pa'i thabs so/ /bcu bdun pa dug gi cho gas ni/ dug sna tshogs༄ na/ /bco brjod pa 'khu skyags cho gas ni/ de gnyis rgyas pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ bcu dgu pa mas gtang tshogs dang / nyi dgu pa sna nas gtang ba'i dang / nyer gcug pa dud pa gtang ba'i dang / nyer gnyis pa mkhur ba dgang ba'i/ nyer gsum pa mig tu thigs pa blug pa'e/ nyer bzhi pa mig brtas par byed pa'i/ nyer lnga pa gtar dang dpyad sgo nyer drug pa gtar dpyad sgo nyer bdun pa gtar ga gdab pa'i/ nyer brgyad pa zug rngu dbyung ba'i/ nyer dgu ba gtar ga gdab pa'i las sgo sum cu pa thal sman rnon po dang me btsa' gdab pa'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u rnams kyis ni rang ming gi cho ga rgyas par gsungs te tshul rgyas par ma spros so/ /mdo gnas le'u sum cu'o/ /gnas gnyis pa lus gnas le'u drug ni/ lus kyi

rum du zhugs pa'i dang / de'i nad kyi bye brag gi dang / lus kyis yan lag gi bye brag gi dang / lus kyi gnad kyi bye brag gi dang / lus kyi 'gyur ba'i bye brag dang / lus kyi pho ha'ibyebragarnamasakyile'uste ge rimabazhinakhu khrag gi skyon yon nyal po bya tshul/ mngal chags nas bskyed tshul/ btsa' khar ji ltar bya tshul sogs rgyas pa dang / mngal ma'i zas spyod kri shāsko ngan pas nad skyed tshul sman dang bcas pa sogs dang / lus la yan lag drug dang / rus pa dang chigs sum brgya drug cu sogs yod tshul dang / brla gnyis dang lag ngar gnyis la gnad bcu gcig re dang / lto ba la gsum dang brang la dgu dang / rgyab la bcu bzhi dang / nam tshod yan chad la so bdun te gnad brgya dang bdun dang gzhan yang gnad ming can 'ga' rnams la gtar me sogs byas na skyon skyed tshul dang / sman pa 'gugs pa'i pho nya ba mchog dman dang de yi rgyan gos dri tshig sogs la brtag pa dang / sman pa dang nad pa gnyis ma'i rmi lam brtag pa rnams rgya cher gsungs so/ /gnas gsum pa nad gzhi'i le'u bcu drug ni/ rlung sogs spyi'i/ rims nad zhi khrag mkhris lud pa'i/ dbugs mi bde ba dang skyigs bu'i/ glo gcod chen po'i/ chang nad zhi gzhang 'brum zhi tshad pas 'bra ba dang pho ba'i/ gzhin 'gags pa bsri ba'i/ chan rnyi za gu'i/ khong 'bras dang rgyu rlugs dang skran gyi/ rmu rdzing sa skya rbab dang 'or nad kyi mdze dang sha bkra dang za gu dang srin bu'i nad kyi/ rlung nad kyi/ dreg nad kyitsho nad gzhi'i le'e mas te/ rang rang si ming sis

ra༅༅/ /bstan pa'i nad de rnams kyi rgyu dang rkyen dang rnam 'gyur sogs so/ /gnas bzhi pa nad gso ba'i gnas la/ nad gzhi gnyis pa rims gso ba nas brtsams te nyi shu rtsa gnyis gsungs so/ /de yang 'di ltar rims nad dang / khrag mkhris dang / lud pa dang / dbugs mi bde ba dang / gcong chen gso ba ste lnga/ rlon nad ces pa skom dad dang / chang nad dang / gzhang 'byum dang / tshad nad dang / pho nad gso ba ste lnga/ gcin nad gnyis zhes pa bsri ba dang rnyi ba/ khong 'bras dang / skran dang rmu rdzing gso ba ste lnga/ skya rbab dang / 'or nad dang / me dbal dang / ma/dze dang / sha bkra dang / rlung nad dang / snodreg nad gso ba ste bdun rnams so/ /'di dag las btus shing phyi ma'i le'u sogs nas kha bkangs te/ lag len gces bsdus zhes bya ba le'u bcu pa zhig kyang kho bos zur na byas par gsal lo/ /gnas lnga pa cho ga grub pa'i gnas le'u drug ni/ skyug sman gyi/ bkru sman gyi/ de gnyis nges par grub pa'i cho ga re re/ mas gtang gi de nges par grub pa'i cho ga rnams te/ 'di la dpe 'ga' rer nyes par grub pa zhes 'byang ba ni/ da ltar yang yul ska da ma dag pa 'ga' rer/ nges pa can du 'dug zer rgyu la nyes pa can du 'dug ces zer ba bzhin du sgra nyams pa yin gyi / nyes par grub pa bcos pa'i le'u zhes tshig snon mi dgos so/ /yang kha cig sman gyis rmi grub kyang / dpyad chen 'dis nad med grub pas na cho ga grub pa'o/ /zhes zer ba yang don ma yin te/ skyag sman bkru sman mas gtang ste cho ga

gsum dang / de gsum bogs 'don lta bu'i sgo nas nges par grub pa gsum ste le'u drug yin no/ /gnas drug pa phyi ma'i gnas le'u bzhi bcu pas/byis pa gso ba la gsum/ gdon gso ba la bzhi/lus kyi stod gso ba la bcu zhe/ la bcu/ dug la bzhi/ rgas pa dang ro tsa gso ba la le'u re re rnams so/ /de yang dang po gsum ni/ byis pa nyar spyod kyi/ de'i nad sri de'i gdon gyi le'u'o/ /de nas bzhi ni/ khong tsho gdon dmigs shes par bya ba dang / de gso ba / smyo byed kyi dang / brjed byed kyi gdon gso ba rnams so/ /bcu bdun po yang /lus stod kyi gtso bo mig gso ba la dgu dang / gzhan la brgyad do/ /dgu ni mig mchu zhes pa yas lcibs mas lcibs su grags pa dang / rdzi ma dang /grwa zur rnams la nad dmigs shes par bya ba dang / de gso ba'i le'u ste gnyis gnyis/mig tsos dang / rab rib dang / mthong nyams te gsum gso ba gsum ste dga'o/ /gzhan la/ rna ba dang / sna dang / kha dang /mgo bo ste/ bzhi la nad dmigs shes par bya ba dang de gso ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad do/ /rma la/ rma spyi dang /lkol gyi rma dang / chag grugs dang / ma bar rdol ba rnams gso ba ste bzhi/ 'bras sogs dang / phra mo'i nad dang /gsang ba'i nad rnams la nad dmigs shes par bya ba dang / de dang de gso ba gnyis gnyis te drag rnams so/ /drag la/ dug nad spyi/ sprul rdzi srin bu'i/byi ba'i dag rnams gso ba'o/ /rgas pa gso ba ni bcud len gyi le'u'o/ /ro tsa gso ba ni/ bud med sa bon

ra༅༅/ /gso ba'i le'u ste bzhi bcu pa'o/ /'di'i mjug tu/ rgyun shes bus sbyar ba'i nad sna tshogs gso ba'i mdo yang bzhugs so/ /le'u'i ma 'di dag ni le'u dang po'i mjug tshigs bcad du rnga5ོda pas le'u dang po 'di la brjod bya kun 'dus pas rtsa ba'i rgyud ces bya ste/ cher rje zhig po la sogs pa bod kyi mkhas pas zur du ṭī ka yang byas so/ /le'u 'dir gso dpyad kyi brjod bya mtha' dag don bzhi dang bzhi po re re yang bzhi bzhi tshang dgos par bstan te/ gso ba dag tu bstan pa ni/ /sman pa sman dang nad g.yog dang / /nad pa yan lag rnam bzhi ste/ /re re'ang rnam pa bzhi bzhi yin/ /sman pa mkhas stegs gzhung don shes/ /las rnams mthong zhing gtsang ba yin/ /sman ni cho ga mang po dang / / yon tan mang ldan phun tshogs 'phrod/ /nad g.yog rjes brtse gtsang sbra can/ /sgrin zhing blo dang ldan pa yin/ /nad pa phyug cing bsgo ba nyan/ shes par nus shing snying stobs ldan/ /zhes/ so/ /mkhas stegs ni/ mkhas pa brgyud pa'i man ngag can no/ /de ma go bar mkhas bston zhes pa 'chos/ pa'ang yod mod snga ma 'chun che'o/ /gzhung gzhan 'dul ba'i gzhung du nad la bkres skom dang / 'du ba'i nad ces pa gnyis su bsdus zhes sogs kyang go sla'o/ /dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyad du zhes pa'ang de bzhin te/ 'dir rgyas par 'chad pa skabs min pas sbyor drug gi gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho sogs su blta'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ spyir rgya gar rgya nag bod sogs gso dpyad spyi 'byung tshul/ khyad par mkhas mchog dpa' bo'i rnam thar

rgyas pa/ de 'dul byed 'phags pa lha'i rnam thar dang bcas pa/ de nas lo chen la rim gyis brgyud tshul/bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi dbye bsdu/sman dpyad spyi'i rnam gzhas rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzhung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gcig dang / lag len gces bsdus reg pas nad sel zhes pa le'u bcu pa kun la mkho ba gcig ste sman dpyad kyi yi ge gnyis tsam gzhan du bshad zin pas gzhung 'dir ni de tsam la bsdu'o zhes pa'o/ /le'u gnyis pa'i bshad pa'o// 7/ //rig gnas gsum pa sgra rig la yang dgos pa dang /byung tshul dang / rang bzhin dang / kha 'phangs so/ /dang po ni/tshig gi bsgrub gzhi byings kyi 'jog tshul dang / des sgrub byed kyi skyen la las kyi don la byed pa dang /byed pa'i don la las sbyor ba sogs dang / de tshig tu sgrub pa'i rnam dbye sbyin mi dgos pa dang / dgos kyang gang dran gyis chog par 'dod pa sogs sgra don gnyis kyi nanganas dang po la log par smra ba thams cad ni rig gnas 'di mi shes na sel thabs med pas shin tu dgos pa che'o/ /gnyis pa la yang / rgyal bas gsungs tshul/ rgyal sras kyis mdzad tshul/ rgya gar du byon tshul/bod du 'gyur tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sgra rig pa ni/phyi rol pa'i drang srong sogs kyis byas pa yin gyi dzol ba'i gsung rab las mi 'byung ngo snyam na/ spyir chos dang don dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa ste bzhi'i gsum pa 'chad par mdzad pa 'i tsha/ yul ljongs kyi skad rig dang / nges tshig mtha' dag la smob dgos tshul dang / smad rigs spyi

ra༅༅/ /dang khyad par so: ta la yi ge dbri ba dang bsnan pa dang bsgyur ba dang / tshig thams cad ka lā pa ltar na se sogs ti sogs dang / tsan+d+ra pa'i brda las sub dang ting gi mtha' can gyi rnam dbye gang rung can du gsal bar gsungs la/ khyad par 'khor lo tha ma'i mdor gtogs pa bde gshegs snying po rgya cher ston pa rnga bo che chen po'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la sangs rgyas rtag pa dang bdag la sogs pa med pas de dag ni phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas pa'o zhes smra bar 'gyur yang de lta ma yin te / de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung las rgyas par 'byung tshul gsungs shing / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la skad kyi byings la sogs pa med pas de dag phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas so zhes smra bar 'gyur yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la byings la sogs pa yod par gsungs te/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston yang don la thar pa'am myang 'das ni rtag brtan zer zug yin pas skye'ajig med pa'i dpe khang bzang zhig kyang de'i nam mkha' mi 'jig pa dang gzhan yang / de dper byas na ṣi dhu zhes bya ba'i skad kyi byings kyi de na ni k+ta zhes bya ba'i rkyen gyis de grub pa zhes bya ba'i rang bzhin du 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa'i bstan bcos rnams las/ nā mā khyu ta u pa sarga kṛta ta da dhi ha zhes bya ba la sogs pas bsdus pa'i grub pa'i tshig de la grub pa zhes bya'o/ /grub pa'i cho ga de'i grub pa gang yin pa de ni yang mi mngon pa med do zhes/ byings rkyen gyis bsgyur yang byings kyi rang

bzhin mi 'gyur ba ni thar pa'i dper gsungs shing / sgrub tshul de dag ston pa'i gzhung ni/ nā ma zhes pa ming le dang / ā khya ta kun bshad/ krita ces pa krita kyi le'u ste/ sgra'i lus gzhung tshan gsum du bsdus shing / de dag gi rnam 'gyur dang nyer mkho ni/ u pa sarga nyer bsgyar dang tad dhi ta de phan la sogs/ pas bsdus pa'i gzhung ngo / /de yang ṣi dhu bstan bcos la ste bkra shis la'ang ngo zhes pa'i byings las la k+ta'o zhes k+ta'i rkyen byin/ byings kyi dang po'i di'i sa dang / d+ngha da ru bsgyur ba'i cho ga dang / rkyen gyi ka skyonan tan 'gog pa'i rjes 'brel dang / te d+ngha ru bsgyur ba'i cho ga yod pa rnams byas pas/ sid+dhi zhes sa ma sid dhi zhes pa grub pa/ grub pa la 'jug pa'i grub pa'i tshig ste/ brda sprod pa ci dgar klog pa dag gis ṣi d+ngha zhes sogs su 'don srid kyang / thob thang bzhin du byed na ma 'ongs pa'i chos ma 'ongs na'ang mi 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad kyi byings ni mkhas shing khong du chud pa'o zhes gsungs te/ bu d+ngha khong du chud pa'am rtogs pa la'o zhes pa'i byings las sgrub ces gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs/ dus zhabor dbyangs 'char gyi mdor bsdus kyi thog mar gsal te/ der/ dbyangs dag gi dang po a yig yin pa de ni a sogs lnga ste/ a i ṛ u la zhes pa rang byung gis bshad pa'o/ /a i u ṇa/ ṛ h+la ka ces pa ni so sor bsdus pa gzung phyir ro/ /e a tsa zhes pa klag pa las mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ste/ i yig dang u yig dag li yon tan gyis

ra༅༅/ /so/ /ṛ kya'i a ṇa las ra la dag go zhes pa'i mdo'i phyir ṛ lo dag ni ma ning du mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis kyang yon tan dang ldan pas i yig la sogs pa rnams dang khyad par med do/ /zhes sogs nas/ de dag kyang nam mkha' la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi dbang gis grangs bzhin du 'jam dpal gyis rang gi bde sprod pa las bris zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ tshangs pa rtag gzhi pas byas pa'i sgra mdo dang / de las brgya byin gyis bsdus pa dang / de la phur bus sbyangs tshul sogs ni gzhung gis gsal te lha yul du byung tshul lo/ /de dag la brten nas rgya gar du bram ze pā ṇi nis byas tshul sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ snga ma tsan+d+ra pa'i rnam dbye'i bshad pa sub mtha'/ rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs pa sgra rig dngos kyi rgya gzhung gong du brjod pa dang ma brjod pa yang bstan 'gyur dka/ ra chag na gsal ba rnams dang / sgra rig pa'i yan lag tu gtogs pa'i sdeb sbyor sogs/ shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang de'i gcung blo brtan dang / dpang blo gros brtan pa dang / sras lo chen byang rtse dang / de'i bu chen lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pos slob phan gyi 'gyur bcos shing phran mang po yang bsgrur/ de'i slob ma lo tsā ba shes rab dpal dang / de dpon slob gnyis ka la gtugs pa bdag gi bla ma sems dpa' chen po thugs rje dpal bzang pos tsan+d+ra pa'i 'grel pa dharma dā sa dang / u ṇa'i 'grel pa sogs bsgyur cing bshad pas/ spyir 31sa rje sa paṇa yan la tha snyad kyi rig gnas ma dar zhing de nas thar lo nyi ma rgyal

mtshan yan la dar yang bod skad du ma bsgyur mod 6 sgra rig dngos ni dpang lo yab sras kyis bsgyur cing bshad nas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas rigaganas 'di la shin tu bka' drin che'o/ /gsum pa la thun mongadang / de min gyi yan lag gnyis las/ dang po la/ yi ge dang / ming dang / tshig gsum ste/ sgra'i spyi don na gsal zhing rgyas la 'dir bsdus shing gsal lo/ /thun mong min pa ni/ dpang los rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur rnams/ /brda sprod gzhung gi brjod bya yin / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang bzhin dang / rkyen dang / rnam 'gyur gsum du sdud par rgya gar gyi gzhung rnams na dngos su mi gsal yang nges par don gyis thob pas shin tu legs so/ /de la dang po rang bzhin ni/ rkyen gyis zlas drangs pa'i tshe/ byings dang / ming ngam rtags gnyis rka'ang rang bzhin du bya dgos te/ rkyen gyi dbang gis rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su bsgrub par bya ba'i gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang byings ni/ sgra mdo rnams su sgrub tshul rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis gnyis gsungs te/ ka lā par ming gis dang kun bshad kyis dang / tsan+d+ra par sub mtha' can dang ting mtha' can gyis sgrub tshul lo/ /sgrub tshul dang po'i dbang du byas nas brjod bya'i don cung zad ston yang gsal por mi ston pa lha sku'i rus tshugs lta bu ste/ rkyen gyi nang nas gtso bor kṛta rkyen ster ba'i gzhir gyur pa ste de byin nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston yang bya byed sogs kyi sgo nas gsal bar mi ston pa lha sku tshon gyis spras kyang rgyan dang spyan dbye ma sbyar ba lta bu ste/ ming ngam rtags

ra༅ ༅/ /zhes pa si sogs kyi rnam dbyesgyu sbyar ba'i gzhi yin pas 'di la'ang rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /de la rnam dbye sbyar nas tshig tu rdzogs par grub pa ni/ de dag kyang legs par sbyar ba'i lha ska lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas/ bya ba rtogs byed ni byings so zhes dang / rkyen pha rol lo/ /zhes pas/ dus dang don gyi bya ba rtogs shing ston par byed pa'i gzhi'o/ /rtogs byed dngos ni/ ti sogs rnam dbye ste/ sde tshan bcu yodi pa'i/ brta mā na sogs brgyad kyis dus dang / sde tshan gnyis pa sap+ta yī bar gsum pa sap+ta shrīs don rtogs par byed pas de dag byin pa nyid kyis bar du skyen gzhan sbyin pa la mi ltos par tshig nyid du gsal par 'grub pa'o/ /byings la dbye na/ glegs bam nas 'byung ba'i dang / mdo las 'byung ba'i dang / ming gi dang / de las gzhan pa'i byings te bzhi zhes gsung yang phyi ma gnyis la rkyen gyis bcos pa'i byings zhes gcig tu byas nas gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ byings mdo le'u dgu nas 'byung ba spyo yod pa la'o zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mañju mdo'i byings so zhes sogs byings mdo na med pa 'grel pa rnams kyi zur nas rnyed pa 'ga' re la zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ kun bshad rkang pa gnyis pa'i mgor bshad pa'i san dang yin dang / kā mya dang / a yi dang / i na kā ri ta dang / ya sgra dang / ā+o ya rnams byings la byin nas kyang da dung byings nyid du gnas pa ste/ de dag gi mthar de rnams byings so zhes bshad pas so/ /de yang kā ri ta'i phyed byings las kyang rgyu la'o zhes pa dang

san ni/ byings nyid la ster bas de gnyis la byings las gyur pa'i byings dang / gzhan rnams ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa la yin no zhes ming la ster zhing kā ri ta'i phyed/ byings don la i na te kā ri ta'o zhes pa ni ming byings su sgrub pas na ming las gyur pa'i byings te gnyis ka rkyen gyis bcos pa'o/ /rang bzhin gnyis pa ming ni/ byings dang rnam dbye bor ba'i don dang ldan pa rtags so/ /zhes pas/ byings dang po gnyis gang rung la kṛta rkyen byin nas byings yin pa yang bor/ san sogs ma byin pas rkyen gyis bcos pa'i byings kyang ma yin/ rnam dbye gnyis po ma byin pas tshig tu yang ma grub pa zhig yin la/ de la ming rkang dang por dngos su bstan pa/ i ta u ta asni'o/ /ā+oṃ ta lū ta bud med jo+od pa dag na dī'o/ /ā shra d+dha'o/ /zhes/ a i thung ngu'i mtha' ༅ asni'i rtags dang / ring po'i mtha' ༅ bud med brjod na na dī'i rtags dang / ā yig ring po'i mtha' can shrad+dha'i rtags zhes pa gsum dang / a yig thung ngu'i mtha' can dang / 2ta mtha'i rtags zhes pa rngams bshad kyang / pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum/ de la'ang rtags gsum so so ba dang / thun mong ba gnyis/ dang po la skyes pa kho natsho rtags sogs gsum/ de re re la dbyangs mtha' can dang gsal byed mtha' can gnyis / gnyis pa la rtags gnyis thun mong ba dang / gsum thun mong ba gnyis/ dang po la skyes pa'i rtags can gyi rtags gnyis pa sogs gsum/ gnyis pa la skyes pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gsum pa sogs gsum ste rgyas par si sogs kyi bya ba

ra༅༅/ /rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung las 'byung ba spyi don du yang rags pa bris pa bzhin no/ /rkyen ni/ rang bzhin rnam 'gyur du sgrub par byed pa'i sgra'i yan lag yin la/ dbye na rnam dbye yang rkyen du bsdus nas/ byings rtags su dang / byings tshig tu dang / byings byings su dang / rtags rtags su dang / ming ming du dang / rtags byings su dang / rtags tshig tu sgrub par byed pa'i rkyen te bdun no/ /mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin/ kṛta dang / ti sogs dang / san dang / mo rtags dang / de phan dang / yin sogs dang / si sogs rnams yin no/ /dang po ni/ kṛta le rkang pa drug dang / de'i cha shas u ṇa rkang pa gsum mo/ /de dag kyang brjod bya ngo bo dang las dang byed pa po la 'jug pa sogs te rgyas par gzhung du gsal lo/ /gnyis pa/ la ti sogs dngos dang / de dang 'brel ba gnyis te/ dang po la brta mā na sogs sde bcu'i don ston byed ni/ 'dod pa dang smon pa dang nus pa'i don la pañca t+pā dang / sgrub pa sogs la sap+ta sī dang / bye brag tu bya ba yang dag par sdud pa rnams la pañca sī'i dbus ma'i gcig tshig hi nyid 'jug dgag pa'i mā byings kyi sngon du sbyor ba la a bya tā nī dang / mām sbyor ba la de dang byasta nī yang 'jug go /gzhan rnams ni dus la 'jug ste / brta mā na ni spyir da ltar ba/ tisma zhes sogs sma dang sbyar na 'das pa/ byasta nī ni kha sang / abya ta nī ni sngon ma/ ba ro3ṣ+ṭha ni lkog gyur/ shwa sta nī ni nang par/ ā shi ṣa ni smon pa/ bha bi ṣ+ṭhan+ti ni 'byung 'gyur/ kṛ pasti ni bya ba shor ba'am

rjes 'brel lo/ /dang po la bzhi/ dbyangs dang / gsal byed dang / gsal byed srog yig can dang / dbyangs gsal sanyis ka rjes 'brel lo/ /dang po la dgu dang / gnyis pa la brgyad dang / gsum pa la nyi/ ṭu/ ḍū/ tā dang / bzhi pa ni ir rjes/ 'brel lo/ /gnyis pa rkyen gyi rjes 'brel la/ kṛta dang / mo rtags dang / de phan dang / si sogs dang / san sogs dang / ti sogs dang de dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po la dbyangs ni/ ṛ dang / ki pa kyi i lta bu'o/ /gsal byed ni ka sogs bcu bzhi tsam mo/ /mo rtags la/ pa dang nga'o/ /de phan la/ ta/ ṭa/ ḍa/ ṇa rnams so/ /si sogs la/ i/ nga / ṭa/ dza/ pa/ sha rnams so/ /san sogs la/ na/ in/ i/ kā ri ta 'i na rnams so/ /ti sogs la/ di si 'i i dang / a ṭa 'i ṭa dang / thal gyi la rnams so/ /de dang 'brel ba la/ a/ tsa/ ṇa/ na rnams so/ /rtags kyi rjes 'brel ni ta'o/ /ā ga mi ni u dang ṭa'o/ /tshig gi rjes 'brel yang ta'o/ /brjod don gyi rjes 'brel ni/ a/ i u/ in/ skrun rnams so/ /ngo bo'i don gyi rjes 'brel ni/ tsan+d+ra par/ rang gi ngo bo la i ki shī pa rnams so/ /des ni 'dis zlas drangs pa'i rjes 'brel tsam po thams cad la khyad par gyi don gyi rjes 'brel zhes bya'o/ /ā ga ma nī/ ngo bo gong du bshad pa ltar te/ rtags kyi don du dgos pa khyad par pa yod kyang gar yod dang nam 'ong gi gnas dus ma nges pas sgra'i yi be rnam pa gzhin dang gzhin du sbyar byed ngo/ /gnyis pa phrad pa'i rnam

ra༅༅/ /'gyur la/ spyir dang / byings rkyen dang /tshig phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni/ 'tshams sbyor rkang pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i bstan don rnams so/ /gnyis pa yang byings dang rkyen spyir phrad pas ni/ byings kyi yon to/ i e dang / u a dang / ṛ ar dang / lo al du 'gyur ba rnams te/ de ltar sgyur nus kyi skyen ni gtso bor kṛta rkyen gyi nang nas ka nga rjes tshol la yon to bkag pas de gnyis rjes 'brel du med pa'i rkyen rnams so/ /bye brag tu phrad pas ni/ gtso bor kun bshad kyi dbang du byas nas/ byings kyi lus 'gyur ni/ rkang pa bdun pa yan gyis bstan pa rnams so/ /rkyen gyi lus 'gyur ni/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstan pa rnams so/ /byings dang kṛta rkyen phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ni/ kṛta rkang dang por bstan pa rnams byings dang / drug pa'i smad nas bstan pa rnams rkyen gyi lus 'gyur gtso che'o/ /de bzhin du rtags dang rnam dbye phrad pa la yang / rnam dbye la brten pa'i rtags kyi dang / rtags la brten pa'i rnam dbye'i dang / gnyis la brten pa'i gnyis ma'i lus 'gyur rgyas pa ming rkang dang po bzhis rgyas par bstan pa rnams so/ /rtags dang rtags phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ni mo rtags la brten pa rnams so/ /ming dang ming phrad pa ni/ de phan gyi rjen la brten pa rnams so/ /tshig phan tshun phrad pa'i rnam 'gyur ni/ sde pa'i dang po tshig mtha' rnams dbyangs dang sgra ldan rnams la gsum pa rnams so/ /zhes 'tshams sbyor bzhi pas bstan pa kun dang / tshig mthar eta ata las pha roska gyi a yig

pa ni rtokha dka' ba'i gzhal bya'i gtso bo rtogs pa'i thabs yin mod kyang rgyal bas ma gsungs sam snyam pa bzlog phyir du gsungs tshul gsal bar bstan no/ /mngon sum bzhi ga dang / rjes dpag thams cad kyi rten gto tshigs gsum ka mdo las bstan tshul ni gzhung 'di'i rtsa ba nyid kyis shin tu gsal lo/ /de yang mngon sum bzhi'i ya gyal gyi yid mngon ni/ dbang shes kyi bdag rkyen las dngos su skyes pa nyid du mdos kyang bstan pas/ skye mched drug pa chos kyi gsal snang yod pa tsam la yid mngon du byas na/ rang rig dang rnal 'byor mngon sum yang der 'gyur zhing / yid dang mngon sum gyi gzhi mthun yin pa tsam gyis der byas na dbang mngon yang der thal te/ lus ngag yid gsum du phye ba'i yid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas nas brgyud de/ mngon pa sde bdun gyi nang tshan bstan bcos rab tu byed pa mdzad pa po'i dgra bcom dbyig sogs dang dus dang mkhas mthongs sogs mnyam zhing / ched du brjod pa'i tshoms mdzad pa po'i dgra bcom chos skyob dang / des paṇa chen me wi ga dang / des mkhas mchog dbyig gnyemyo la brgyud par tshad ma ba rnams la grags so/ /tshad ma'i rig pa'i gtso bo rnams ni mdzod 'grel na shin tu gsal zhing / des ni/ kha che'i mkhas pa dge 'dun bzang po'am 'dus pabazang po la gsan la/ des ni/ 'od srungs nyer 'khor kun dga' sha gos can/ /nyer sbas ji ji nag po legs mthong blo/ /zhes bstan pa gtad rabs bdun du grags pa'i tha ma phyir mi 'ongs blos mi 'bebs la gsan pa nas

ra༅༅/ /brgyud kyang rung ngo / /kun mkhyen gnyis pas ni tshad ma'i bstan bcos rtsod sgrub tu grags pa mdzad kyang gzhon nu blo gros ma smin pa'i dus mdzad pas/ bshad pa 'ga' zhig snying po med par dgongs so zhes kun btus su dgag pa yang 'ga' re mdzad do/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa la ni rang las mkhas pa'i slob ma bzhir grags te/ phar phyin dang / tshad ma dang / 'dul ba dang / mngon pa rnams rang las mkhas pa ni rim bzhin/ 'phags pa grol sde dang / phyogs glang dang / yon tan 'od dang / blo brtan rnams so/ /'dir phyogs kyi glang po ni/ rang sde gnas ma bu pa'i nang du rab tu byung ste brjod du med pa'i bdag la dgag pa'i rnam pa cung zad byas pas ma mthun nas rgya gar lho phyogs su kun mkhyen gnyis pa'i zhabs pad legs par bsten/ sems tsam rnam rdzun gyi grub mtha' la legs par sbyang / brgyad stong don bsdu rtsa 'grel la sogs pa theg chen gyi bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams/ khyad par gtan tshigs rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi thog mar gyur te/ tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu ba mang du mdzad/ phyis rgya gar byang phyogs ri bo 'bigs byed kyi phyogs glang phug par de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshad ma mdo rtsom par bzhed nas/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshad ma bsgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun las/ /btus nas sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad thod le kor gyis phug pa'i sgo gong du bris pas/ mu

stegs kun gyi byin pa rengs/ sa g.yos pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung ba mu stegs kyis ma bzod pas/ ston pa thub rgyal nag pos lan gnyis lan gsum du bsubs pas/ rtsod par nus na lus dngos su ston/ mi nus na thod le kor gyi ri mo bsubs par nus kyang blo gros kyi ri mo bslab par mi nus so zhes bris pas lus dngos su bstan nas/ brtsad pas rig pas lan du mar tshar bcad kyang rdzu 'phrul dang g.yo sgyu sna tshogs kyis 'pham pa'i ngos len ma byung zhing 'dul bar ma nus pas thugs phyung nas/ thod le kor nam mkhar 'phangs nas 'di sa la lhung ba na byang chub kyi sems gtong zhes dam bcas pas yun ring du sa la ma lhung / bltas pas bar snang na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs mngon sam du bzhugs nas / bu/ dman pa'i sems ma skyed cig rdzogs byang gi bar du kho bos rjes su bzung ngo / /bstan bcos de yang legs par rtsoms shig 'gro ba kun gyi mig tu 'gyur ro zhes snang ba byin te/ rnam nges kyi 'gor/ gang la 'phams pa nyid rjes bzung ba de ni dpal ldan dri med blo mnga' ste/ /zhes so/ bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams tshul gzhung du gsal la/ dgongs pa ma rnyed bzhin du brtsams pa'i 'grel byed 'ga' yang 'byung zhing khyad par dngos slob slob dpon dbang phyug sdes bshad srolam nyams tsam mdzad pa'i drung du/ phyi rol mu stegs kyi bram ze'i rigs la sgra tshad byang zhing / khyad par rtog be'i gsang tshig la mkhas par sbyangs pa tshis nang pa'i bstan pa la/ zhugs te/ mdo sngags du ma 'i lus rig dang man ngag gi sgo nas

ra༅༅/ /'khor lo bde mchog gis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas kun btus tshar gsum gsan pas bshad srol rngams phyogs glang gi dgongs pa min par rtogs te/ slob dpon gyis kyang de lta na kho bo phyogs sngar byas pa'i bstan bcos rtsoms shig ces gnang ba thob nas tshad ma sde bdun mdzad/ ji ltar mdzad tshul ni gzhung gis shin tu gsal lo/ /tshad ma'i gzhung 'grel phal cher la bam grangs sogs kyi gzhung tshad ma mdzad kyang / le'u dang po'i rang 'grel la stong phrag phyed dang bzhi pa zhes gsal bar grags so/ /'di slob dpon rgyan mkhan po rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ni/ rjes dpag shin tu dka' bas 'grel pa byas pa yin gyi/ le'u'i go rim ni mdo dang bstun dgos pas mchod brjod kyi 'grel pa tshad ma grub pa ni le'u dang por byas nas de rjes mngon sum dang / de rjes rang don dang gzhan gyi rjes dpag rim pa bzhin yin pas lha shwaka ni le'u'i go rim tsam la yang 'bral zhes zer yang / rang 'grel nyid kyi thog mar/ don dang don min pa rnam par 'byed pa ni rjes su dpag pa la rag las zhes gsung la don bstan pa skyon med dang / don min skyon can rnam par 'byed pa ste so sor shes pa dang / de ston pa'i bsnyan bcos rtsom pa yang rjes dpag la rag las zhes pas rjes dpag bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyur bstan pa'i phyir le'u dang por rig pas lha shwaka gi bzhed pa nyid du rgya dpe bod dpe kun la grags pa ni legs pa yin la/ rang 'grel 'di la bram ze chen po shad dkar nan+das mthong ba blos

slad dman la 'grel bshad ma mdzad pas/ de man chad rang 'grel min zer mkhan rgya gar du yang byung mod/ de lta na de min gyi le'u dang po la 'grel pa 'thad ldan med par 'gyur la/ tshodzi blos kyang 'grel rdzus la 'grel bshad byas par 'gyur ro / /gsum pa ni/ rgyan gyi rjes 'brang sogs tshad ma'i gzhung che chung gong du brjod zin rnams dang bcas pa gzhung phran du ma bstan 'gyur dkar chag tu gsal ba mang po yod pa rnams las/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rig thigs dang gtan tshigs thigs pa la sogs pa'i sde bdun phyi ma 'ga' zhig dul lha sogs kyi 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'gyur yod kyang / mdo dang rnam 'grel rnam nges 'grel chen dang bcas pa ni phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba rma dge blo sogs kyis thog mar bslar cing phal cher ni rngog lo chen pos gsar 'gyur dang 'gyur bcos du ma mdzad nas 'chad nyan gyis rgyas par gtan la bab mod/ rnam 'grel ni rnam nges la ltos te bshad srol ma nub tsam du gnas pa las/ dus phyis chos rje sa paṇa gyis rtsal sdu bton nas bsgrur bshad gtan la phab/ 'phags pas gsang phur rnam 'grel gyi tshad rgyags sbyar/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sku mched kyis kyang rtsal du bton pas shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa yi na no/ /rang bzhin la/ gzhal bya mngon gyur/ lkog gyur/ shin tu lkog gyur gsum gyi dang po la/ gzhil bya dang / de 'jal byed ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po 'i/ gzhung nge dag bi brjod bya ci/ gong du ba'ad pa ltar/ rtos be'i tshig ngon brgyad dang / de bsdu na rang gi gzhal bya rtogs pa'i thabs dang / rtogs

ra༅༅/ /nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs zhes pa gnyis su'ang 'du zhing / gzhung gzhan du rtog gi tshig don bcu drug tu'ang grags mod sgo gtan la dbab bya gzhal bya'i gnas gsum du 'du ste/ de rnams kyi 'jal byed tshad ma dang ston byed thal rang gi ngag kyang gzhal bya gsum du 'dus shing gzhal bya bshad pa na 'jal byed dang ston byed kyang don gyis 'phangs yod pas 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de la gzhal bya mngon gyur ni/ tshur mthong gi dbang du byas phyi rol gzhan rig mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i tshul gyis myong stobs kyis sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i skye mched lnga dang / rang rig tshad mas myong zhing rig pa'i sgo nas sgro 'dogs gcod nus pa shes pa'i steng gi myong bya tsam du zad pas rnam shes tshogs drug gi skye mched dang / chos kyi skye mched kyi phyogs gcig sems byung rnams kyi myong rig rgi cha'o/ /des na don dam rig pas dpyad bzod du grub pa yang de dag tu zad de/ lha dbang blos rang rig mngon sum gyi skabs su gtso bo 'gog pa'i tshe/ gzugs dang bde ba la sogs pa bzhin du don dam du grub pa zhig gam/ chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa bzhin du kun rdzob tu grub pa zhig yin zhes dpyad pa'i phyir ro / /des na mdzod du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /zhes pa dang gcig pas/ 'di bye smra'i bden gnyis dang / dngos po la bden grub kyis khyab pa mdo sde pa'i lugs su rlung ltar grags shing thams cad

the tshom med par khas len pa ni/ mdo sde pa la skur pa shen tu chen po yin te/ gzhan du yang bshad zen no/ /'phags pa la ni/ bden bzhi mi rtag bcu drug sogs bdag med kyi gnas lugs gzhal bya mngon gyur yin par thams cad 'dod mod / 'on kyang rtog ge'i dbang phyug gi bzhed pa ni/ med dgag mngon sum la dngos su mi snang bas dgag byas stong pa'i dgag gzhi rang tshan dngos su rtogs pas de'i steng gi med dgag shugs la rtogs pas na/ gcig dmigs nyams su myong ba las/ /'di ni dmigs so zhes bya ba'am/ /ma dmigs so zhes rtogs can spyon /blo ni gnyis su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis rtogs bya'i gco bo med dgag ni shugs la rtogs pas rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi phyogs chos mngon sum gyis grub pa dang 'dir yang 'dra bar bzhed de/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pas/ /'dus byas spyod yul can chags ni/ /rgyu yin de yi gcod byed ni/ /bdag med mthong ba 'gal ba yin/ /zhes spang bya'i rgyu bdag 'dzin ni 'dus byas phung po'i spyod yul can yin la/ de dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ni dmigs yul gcig la dmigs nas rnam pa 'dzin stangs 'gal bar skye dgos pas bdag gis stong pa'i phung po dag pa ba la dngos su dmigs pas de yi steng gi bdag med ni yul gyi gtso bo yin kyang shugs la rtogs pa don smra'i lugs dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi gzhan dbang dngos su rtogs pas de'i steng gi gnyis stong med dgag tu gyur pa'i 'gyur med yongs grub shugs la rtogs pa ni

ra༅༅/ /rnam rig pa'i lugs su bzhed par mngon no/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzigs pa las log pa ni thams cad du med pa go bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes rnam nges su gsungs pa'i don du byas nas shes bya ji snyed dbang po gzugs can lnga dang ldan min 'du byed dang 'dus ma byas gsum la sogs pa'ang mngon gyur yin no zhes bod kyi mkhas 5ri pa mgrin gcig tu smra mod sri dpal chos kyi grags pas ni/ shes bya ji lta ba bdag med gnas lugs ni/ yul dngos stobs rig pas 'grub cing de la goms na gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug pa 'byang ba yang dngos stobs kyis grub pas ji lta ba mkhyen tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / ji snyed pa'i mkhyen tshul ni / spyir/ 'di yis srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa / /nged la 'gar yang nyer mkho med/ /ces dang / gal te ring mthong tshad yin rno/ /tshur shog bya rgod bsten par gyis/ /zhes grol pa don gnyer la mi mkho ba dang / mkho yang / rnal 'byor rtogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang / rgyud gzhan grub pa'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi don thams cad thugs su chud pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste shes pa dang brngod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'grel par tha mal pa gnyid du song pas rang gi rtsa na gnas pa'i gnyid ma log pa'i gang zag gi rgyud tshod mi shes pa dper byas nas bshad do/ /mdzo+od 'grel dgu par ni/ mes nags thams cad rim gyis bsregs nas mthar ma lus

na / mes nags thams cad bsregs zhes pa ltar/ rgyun gyis rim gyis mkhyen pa la thams cad mkhyen zhes bzhag par gsungs pa sogs bshad tshul mang pas bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas la lkog gyur du song ba ni mi sride la / shugs la rtogs pa yod par skabs 'di rnams su khas blang ngo / /ka bum sogs ni gzhung gis shin tu gsal lo/ /gal te zlog phyir ro zhes pa ma grub ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ gal te dngos rnams de nyid du med na/ /tha snyad du yang mo gsham bu ji bzhin/ /'di dag med pa nyid 'gyur de yi phyir/ /'di dag rang bzhin gyis ni yod pa yin/ /zhes pa phyogs snga'i gzhung yin la/ rang bzhin gyi dngos por smra ba thams cad/ yod na rang bzhin gyis yod pa dang / bden par med na gtan med du 'dod pa kho na yin gyi/ don dam par ma grub kyang tha snyad yod pa'i rnam gzhag ni dbu ma pa las gzhan gyis 'jog mi shes so zhes pa 'di bod snga phyi la rlung ltar grags pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ grags pa ni bden mod/ shin tu mi rigs te / mu stegs grangs can pa yang / /yon tan rnams kyi rang bzhin mchog /snang ba'i lam du 'gyur ma yin/ /snang ba'i lam du gang gyur pa/ /de ni sgyu ma bzhin du gsob/ /ces rang bzhin gtso bo dang bdag shes rig ni rtag dngos rib pas dpyod pa yin kyang tha mal pa la mi sngang / da ltar sngang ba'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'di ni rang stong gsog gsob rdzun pa slu chos yin no zhes zer zhing / rnam 'gyur med par khas mi len la/ bdag shes rig si tsha ba bde gshegs snying po la bos

ra༅༅/ /nas gzhan 'di dang mthun par kun rdzob rang stong du smra ba bod na'ang yod cing / gnyis stong li shes rig bden grub don dam bden pa dang / snang ba thams cad rab rib can gyi sgra shad ltar sems tsam rnam rdzun pas kyang 'dod la/ snang ba med par mi 'dod par/ /rnam rig de bzhin min rnam pa/ /skye 'gyur rab rib la sogs bzhin/ /zhes gnyis snang gi bag chags las skye bar 'dod pa'i phyir dang / 'jug pa nyid du/ bum sogs 'di dag de nyid du med kyang / /'jig rten rab tu grags par yod ji bzhin/ /zhes bum pa bden grub ma yin par dngos smra rang gis khas blangs pa dper bkod pa'i phyir dang / rang sde dma' shos mthar thug gnas ma bu pas kyang / gal te khyod bum dngos por ma grub pa'i / /ngo bos gzugs sogs las brjod med 'dod ltar/ /bdag gang phung po las brjod med gyur na/ /rang gi ngo bos yod par rtogs mi bya/ /zhes bum pa blo chos btags yod du 'dod pa ltar bdag kyang de bzhin 'dod par gyis shig ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhal bya mngon gyur 'di'i 'jal byed mngon sum ni mngon sum bzhi ste/ dbang po'i dang / yid kyi dang / rang rig dang / rnal 'byor mngon sum mo/ /gnyis pa lkog gyur ni/ dbang po gzugs can rnams dang / bden bzhi'i mi rtag pa dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / bdag gi bas stong pa dang / bdag med pa sogs rnam pa bcu drug po rnams dang / des mtshon pa'i gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med dang / bdag lakhog dang de

du mi rung nas ma dmigs pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni sogs te/gzhan rgyud kyi skyon yon khyad par ba kha wo+o kod pa ni/ mdo dang bstan bcos spyi dang / khyad par rgyud gzhan grub par yang yang yang bkag ste/ 9lca ngago las de kun nas slong ba'i shes rig yod par nges kyis dad snang sogs kyi khyad par la ni 'khrul par lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa snang rung ma dmigs pa gzhung du gsungs pa ni/snang rung bum pas dben pa'i gzhir bum pa med de / de snang rung tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs kyi phyogs chos dang khyab pa nges byed rnam 'grel du yang skabs 'gar gsungs la/ rnam nges/ rig thigs/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/rtsod rig rnams su ni 'di kho na la rtsal du bton ba ltar gsungs te/ 'dir rgyas par bris na/ gang zag thun mong ba mang pos mi go bas gzhung de rnams dang kho bos byas pa'i de dag gi rnam bshad na gsal lo/ /rtags 'di rgya cher bshad pa'i gtso bo'i dgos pa ni/ mu stegs kun gyis phung po las don gzhan du rang skya thub pa'i gang zag gi bdag 'dod pas de snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyis 'gog pa'i ched kho na ste/ rgyal ba byams pas kyang / gang zag brtags par yod nyid du/ /brjod bya rdzas yod ma yin no/ /mi dmigs phyin ci log pa dang / /kun nas wo+o mongs nyon mongs rgyu/ /zhes sogs rgyas par dang mdzod 'grel dgu par shin tu yang rgyas par ro/ /'di yi phyogs chos kyang mngon sum gyis 'grub ste/ phang po dag pa ba dngos su dmigs pa'i

ra༅༅/ /mngon sum gyi byed pas bdag snang rung ma dmigs pa grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags 'di la rtsa ba'i dbye ba 'brel zla ma dmigs pa dang / 'gal zla dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po la rang bzhin dang / khyab byed dang / rgyu dang / dngos 'bras ma dmigs pa de bzhi dang / gnyis pa la yang rang bzhin 'gal dmigs sogs kyi dbye ba rgyas par rig pa'i gzhung las tsha reg grang reg sogs la sbyar nas gsungs pa rnams/ bdag 'dzin dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs la legs par sbyar nas shes par bya ba'i ched de/ kha cig rma sogs phyir na skyon/ /zad min zhes zer 'di ldog la/ /the tshom za ba de phyir 'khral/ /rtag nyid phyir ram thabs med phyir/ /yang na thabs ni mi shes phyir/ /skyon rnams mi zad pa nyid ces/ /bya bar yongs su rtog drang na/ /rgyu yod phyir na rgyu yi ni/ /gnyen po goms pas zad phyir dang / /rgyu yi rang bzhin shes pa yis/ /ldo shes pa yang grub pa yin/ /zhes dang / lung dang rig pas rnam dpyod pa/ /sdug bsngal nyid kyi khyad par gyis/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de mi rtag /la sogs rang bzhin rtog par mdzad/ /gang phyir de ltar rgyu gnas na/ /'bras log gzigs pa med phyir ro/ /de rgyu gzhom phyir de yi ni/ /mi mthun phyogs la rtog par mdzad/ /rgyu yi ngo bo rtogs pa'i phyir/ /de min mthun phyogos kyang nges 'gyur/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams go ba la shin tu phan pas/ rig pas gzhung la ma sbyangs par bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab skyed par 'dod

mkhas mi mkhas sogs kyi khyad par yod sgo 'bras bu'i rnam grol khyad par meng do zhes gsungs shing / phyis kyi mkhas pas/ gsang sngags ma bsnan na/ phar phyin theg pa rkyang pa la sangs rgyas med de/ phar phyin theg par gsungs pa'i spang bya mthar thug rgyun mtha'i gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra mo de spong bar mi nus pas sngags lam snon la/ de yang lam 'og ma'i dod thub phar phyin theg pa la yod pas sngags kyi mthong lam nas son zhing / bsnan pas thob pa'i rnam grol ni phar phyin theg par bshad pa'i sangs rgyas las lhag rgyu med do zhes bya ba ni legs bshad du grags mod/ lam 'og ma dang phar phyin theg pa'i spang bya gzhan la yang mtshungs shing phar phyin theg pa'i ring lam la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzan dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor med la/ lam gzhan rnams yod pa'i khyad par mi 'thad pa wang / de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyode mchog spyod pa rnams/ /zhes sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' mchog gnyis ka sngags la 'jug par gsungs pa sogs dang / rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba bskab pa'i ched du dbang / /zhes sogs dang / khyad par mtshan brjod rdzi grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /zhes grol ba dang thar pa dang lus rnam grol zhes bya bar gnas pa'i tha ma ni sngags kyi rnam grol du shin tu gas/la te/ dus 'khor du/ dezlo na gtso bos gang zhig 'pho med lhan skyes lus kyi bde ba dag ni sngags kyi theg par bstan/ ces phar phyin theg pa la rtogs bya'i stong nyid rdzogs par smom pa yod kyang / yul can 'gyur med bde

ra༅༅/ /ba dang bral ba des/ na zhes sbyar nas gsal bar gsungs nyung / gtso bor lus la gnad du bsnun pa yod med kyis mdo sngags dang rgyud sde gong 'og gi khyad par 'jog par grags shing grub pa'i phyir/ mtshan brjod pas / nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs shing / /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems can ni phar phyin theg pa'i gdul bya yin la/ sgrib pa de gnyis las grol ba zhig gis da dung / bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /zhes pas phar phyin theg pa'i sgos kyi mthar thug gi rnam grol las lhag pa'i 'bras bu'am spangs pa'i myang 'das shin tu gsal bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dngos dang / rtsod spang ngo / /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi rjod byed ni bsda na gnyis te/ sangs rgyas gzhan dang thun mong ba mdo phyogs sde snod gsum dang / shākya thub kyi thun mong min pa sngags phyogs rgyud sde bzhi'o/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ kha cig gzungs sngags yod med la byed mod/ de ltar na 'dul ba sman sgya gzhi sogs du ma rgyud du 'gyur ro/ /kha cig dkyil 'khor yod med la byed pa ni/ sman bla'i mdo yang rgyud du 'gyur la/ rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /zhes gnas brtan phyag mchod kyang rgyud kyi cho gar 'gyur ro / /des na sngags dang dkyil 'khor khyad med du yod kyang / sgrub pa po la chos smra ba nges zhes dang / rig pa 'dzin pa des zhes sogs kyis 'byed ces mkhas pa dag gsung ba'ang khas blangs du rung tsam mo/ /sdom gsum rab dbyer/ mdo

gyi nyams su blang bde bar go rim snolanas sbyar te gsungs so/ /rnam 'byed la pha ma'i rnam 'byed gnyis ka la ltung ba sde lnga lngar phye nas phal cher gling gzhi dang bcas te gsungs so/ /phran tshegs la yang ltung ba sde lnga'i ma tshang kha skong mang du gsungs shing / lung dam pa la ni/ zhu ba dang / 'dul byed dang / gling gzhi dang / gtam gyi gzhi dang / sil bu dang / bram ze'i bu mos zhus pa sogs gzhung phran bcu tsam gsungs so/ /mdo sde'i sde snod kyi theg chung ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag snga 'gyur po ti gsum lhag dang / phyi 'gyur yang de tsam mo/ /gzhan yang theg chung gi mdo mang phran tshegs mang po ni sogs so/ /mdo mang theg chen sogs 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po sogs sher phyin dang / brjod bya gcig pa du ma bzhugs so/ /mngon pa'i sde snod theg chung ni/ ye shes la 'jug ka t+ya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyeg shes kyis/ /chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mo+o gal bus/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas/ /zhes pa rnams mdo sde pa ni dgra bcom pa de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos su 'dod la/ bye smra ni/ chad du brngod pa'i tshoms bzhin du dgra bcom pa de dag gis bsdus pa tsam yin gyis mdo yin no zhes smra'o/ /theg chen mngon pa'i sde snod stong phrag brgya pa zhig dga' ldan na bzhugs shing gzhan 'dzam bu gling na bzhugs pa rnams la ni/ garje'i sgra la brtags nas mu stegs kyi dmag dang / yul dbus kyi

ra༅༅/ /rgyal po'i skyes kyi gos la snying ga na rkang rjes lta bu'i ri mo yod pa la brtags nas mtha' 'khob kyi ༄la po'i dmag gis bcom pa dang / mu stegs kyi spang po la khras chu gtor bas khros nas nyi ma bsgrubs te gtsug lag khang thams cad bsregs pa ste dgra lan gsum byung bas brlag par grags so/ /gnyis pa rgyud sde ni/ sde lnga dang bdun du 'byed pa sogs du ma yod kyang / grags che ḍi/ pathun seng du gru) pa ni/rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /rnal 'byor mchog ni sems can mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la'o/ /zhes gdul bya la dman pa dang / 'bring dang / chen po dang / chen po'i chen po ste bzhir nges pa de dag 'dul byed kyi rgyud la'ang bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med bzhi'o/ /bla med la yang pha ma gnyis su nges par phyis kyi mkhas pas bsgrubs shing / de dang mi mthun pa dag gis kyang legs so byas mod 7 bla med kyi dbang la gsum dang / de'i lam yang rigs gsum dang / 'bras bu yang gsum du 'byed bzhin du rjod byed la gsum du mi 'byed pa mi rigs la/ pha ma gnyis ka gar+sā/ med yin pas de gnyis las don gzhan pa'i gnyis med kyi rgyud med pas dus kyi 'khor lor yang ma rgyud nyid do zhes bsgrags shing rjes 'brang shin tu mang pos kyang rjes su brjod pa la ni/ dbang bzhi pa de dang po gnyis su 'dus pas zur du gzhag rgyu med do zhes sogs brjod pa la gzur gnas blo ldan byed na lan med do/ /gsum pa ni/ 'di dag gzhung tshad sogs te/ gzhan

rgyud sde kun shes sogs su rgya cher bshad pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ste/ /de yi gzhi ni rig pa'i gnas lnga yin/ /de dag rgya cher so sor brjod zin kyang / /byung tshul rang bzhin mdor bsdus 'dod rnams la / /phan gdags bya phyir rtsa 'grel mdo tsam byas/ /'di yis mig phye rgyas bshad gzugs rnams la/ ngo mtshar ltad mo'i dga' ston cher myongs nas/ /kun mkhyen lam la 'gro kun 'jug par lge+og /ces rig gnas/ kun shes nas bdag med grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi rngam par btsad pa nyung gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba/ gtsang stag tshang gi dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ gser 'phyang zhes bya ba me mo bya'i sa ga zla ba'i snga tshes nyi shu gcig la/ lo chen chos kyi rgyal po a ti sha'i zla mchod dang / phyi tshes nyi shu sngon gyi 'brom chos kyi rgyal po'i bla mchod la sbyar ba dge'o// /shes byar srid kun mang thos gser sgong du/ /rnam dpyod drod kyis smin pa tshangs pa'i spun/ /'jig rten mig gcig stag tshang lo tsā ba/ /nges pa don ldan ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gang gi phyi nang grub mtha'i dbye ba dang / /sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gnas lugs mtsho la byad ltar du/ /mthong nus glegs bam 'di kos chos rnams shes/ /rmongs zhen mun pa'i khung bur bag phab nas/ /phyogs lhung lce gnyis rkyong min blo gros bya/ /gtsug lag nam mkha'i pha mtha' ga'al 'angod pa'i/ /gzur sams blo ldar kun ngasa' skyed pa 'i yu' /sngon byon ma khas pa 'i le gas

ra༅༅/ /bshad yid bzhin nor/ /lam kha'i rdo ba lta bur dor byas nas/ /deng dusacher rlom ngag sgros mching bu la/ /rin thang gzhal ba'i tshul der mchi ma dku/ /'on te blang dor shes pa srid pa'i phyir/ /dpyod ldan mang por phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /tshad med chos sbyin spel 'bras tshe rabs kun/ /gsal myur zab pa'i shes rab 'thob par shog /ces 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rig gnas kun shes dang grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi par blo gsal mang por phan 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas blangs te dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du brkos pa'i tshe zla hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o// //sarba maṅga lam̐// //
༄༄༄/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//

ra༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba sid+dhin+ta dzhai ye nabun+ta sā d+ngha ga nā ma shāsta/ bod skad du/ grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrab pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcorme/ 'phagasapangag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul med smra ba'i gtso/ /grub mtha' kun gsung thub dbang la btud nas/ /grub mtha' rgya masta'i pha rol mthar son te/ /grub mchog mtha' bral bsgrub phyir 'di bshad bya/ /sna tshogs lta ba'i dbye ba rnam mang yang / /lta ba smra ba rang ba/zhan sde par 'dus/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang srid rtse'i gnyen po dang / /mtha' gnyis spong dang thar pa 'gog bden du/ /'dod dang mi 'dod lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ /de gnyis 'byed pa'i khyad par byed chos yin/ /phan bde mtha' dag rgyal ba'i 'phrin la sa dang / /rtags sprul rang rgyud mu stegs dbye ba dang / /phyogs 'dzin nyes

ra༅༅/ /pa kun gyi 'byung khungs phyir/ /snang zhugs tshul gyis gzhan sde'ang smad mi rung / /rang gzhan grub mtha'i dbye ba rnam mang yang / /lhan skyes 'khral pa'i 'dzin stangs sgrub 'gog phyir/ /mtha' la zhen dang mtha' bral smra bar 'dus/ glu sgrub lugs las gzhan dang de nyid do/ /dang po'ang rtog dang rtog med 'dzin stangs phyir/ /phyi rol pa dang rang sde gnyis su 'dus/ /dang po nye ring dbye bzlo chad rtag gnyis/ /gnyis pa phyi nang dbye bas don sems gnyis/ /de dag 'khral pa'i 'dzin stangs bden zhen gyis/ /bsgru bas nas kun brtags cha/thar lta'i g.yang du lhung / /'khral med rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i yul/ /mtha' bral mchag de klu sgrub lugs las rtogs/ /yul can de ni mdo rgyud gzhan du sbas / /r+shanyis med dus kyi 'khor lor gsal bar gsungs/ /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bawormi las lta ba spyir brtag pa ste le'u dang rte+o'o/ // //phyi rol grub mtha' smra ba mang gsungs kyang / /chad smra gcig dang rtag smra sde bzhir 'dus/ /kun kyang bdag dang rtag dngos 'tshe ba smra/ /thub pa'i lugs la snang smras byed par mthun/ /chad smra tshu rol mdzes pa rgyang 'phen pa/ /med sma lha yi bla ma phur bu pa/ /ngo bo nyid smra rang bzhin rgyur smra zer/ /phur bu 'jug stobs 'jig rten mig rjes 'brang / /'dod yon chags pas snying la rab gdungs nas/ /'byung bzhi'i bdag dang lus sems rdzas gcig dang / /'gro ba gsum dngarge zhan grags gtan tshigs sgrub/ /skye ba snga phyi las 'bras dkon cog gsum/ /ma

mthong dngos po rjes dpag tshad ma 'gog /lnga pas ba'i pa bsgrubs nas de dang ni/ /sgrab pa bzhi yis dgag pa'i dang po sgrub/ /de yis lhag ma mtha' dag 'grub par 'dod/ /ma mthong tsam gyis med pa mi 'grub cing / /rjes dpag med dang gtan tshigs yod pa 'gal/ /'byung sems mthong myong so sor snang bzhin du/ /gcug tu 'dod na mngon sum 'gog par 'gyur/ /rgyun ldan sems la rang rgyu sngon song dang / /rang 'bras bskyed nges da lta'i sems kyis mtshon/ /chags sogs goms gsal nyer len des phyir yang / /mi gsal 'gro ba grangs can phyugs dang mtshungs/ /rtag smra grangs can pa dang dbang phyug pa/ /khyab 'jug pa dang gnyer bu pa zhes bya/ /grangs can yon tan gsum pa ser skya pa/ /sum cu pa dang gtso bo pa zhes grags/ /dbye na mngon gsal pa dang rnam 'gyur smra/ /lha med pa dang lhar bcas zhes kyang bya/ /ser skya chu klung la sogs ston par 'dzin/ /tshad ma gsum gyis shes bya nyer lnga 'jal/ /dbang ngo 'i 'jug pa mngon sum tshad ma ste/ /'brel pa bdun gyi rang don rjes dpag dang / /rnam ldan gsal 'ongs gzhan don rjes dpag nyid/ /dbang phyug nag po'i rgyad dang drug cu pa/ /mtshan nyid lnga bcu la sogs yid ches/ khungs/ shes bya gtso bdag gnyis 'dus tha ma bdag /za po rtag cing yon tan byed min shes/ gtso bo'i blor gnas ser skyas kyang mi mthong / /gzhan kun gtso bo yon tan bem po tshul/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang rnam 'gyur 'bras bus bsdus/ /thog ma dang po yon tan gsum mnyazlo pa/ /byed pa

༄༄༄/ /rtag gtsig khyab cing mi gsal ba/ /de yi dngos 'bras blo'am chen po ni/ khel ltar gsal dwangs yul shes gzugs brnyan 'char/ /gzugs 'dres mngon gyur yul shes lkog gyur nyid/ /de las byung ba'i nga rgyal gsum yin te/ /rmongs dang 'dod chags g.yo ba'i rang bzhin phyir/ /rdul dang rnam 'gyur 'byung ba las gyur gsum/ /dang pos sgra sogs de tsam lnga bskye da cing / /de lngas mkha' sogs 'byang ba lnga skyed byed/ /gnyis pas dbang po bcu gcig skyed byed cing / /gsum pas gnyis po'i thun mong bdag rkyen byed/ /rgyu dang rang bzhin kho na thog ma ste/ /'bras bu rnam 'gyur kho na bcu drug nyid/ /gnyis yin chen po so bdun gnyis min (rdog /thog mtha' bden grub gzhan kun rdzun pa slu / /sngar yod gsal ba'am 'gyur ba skye ba'i don/ /rang bzhin ngang du zhi ba 'jig par smra/ /bdag gis rnam 'gyur rdzun par mthong ba na/ /skyengs te rang bzhin ngang du bsdus pas thar/ /de las gzhan pa'i thar lam med pas na/ /spyod lam brtul zhugs la sogs gtsor mi byed/ /rgyu ma log par 'bras bu zlog pa 'gal/ /gsum phyir gcig min myong phyir bem po min/ /reg phyir rtag min rtag la thar mi srid/ /phal cher blos btags 'ga' zhig 'thad par rung / /dbang phyug phyugs bdag zhi ba ye srid pa/ /mig mi bzang ba zhug pa pa zhes grags/ /drang srong rkang mig gzegs zan ston par 'dzin/ /zhi ba'i rgyud dang gzegs zin bstan bcos 'chang / /dbye ba rig pa can pa bye brag pa/ /gsal byed pa dang rna ba ma

phug pa/ /dbang phyug kun mkhyen te se ri steng gnas/ /yang dang phra dang dbang gyur bdag por gyur/ /gar yang phyin dang mchod 'os 'dod dgur ldan/ /dga' mgur gnas te yon tan brgyad zhen zhes snodabacud mtha' dag 'dod pas khyab par ni/ /sdod 'jug sogs dang rgyu bdun 'tshol bas 'grub/ /de nyid gzugs min rnam gsum gnas na gnas/ /mdud pa bcu brtas lam drug de nyid lnga/ /thig le zhi ba 'khrig pa chos su smra/ /mngon rjes nyer 'jal sgra byung tshad ma bzhis/ /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi bye brag /'du ba zhes bya tshig gi don drug 'jal/ /rdzas ni 'byung bzhi mkha' dus phyogs bdag yid/ /'byung bzhi'i rdul phran kun tu song min tshad/ /de dang mkha' sogs mtha' dag rtag pa'i rdzas/ /'byung bzhi'i rigs pa mi rtag kun rdzas yod/ /bdag ni gson lus la brten bem po khyab/ /yon tan bcu gsum bdun lngas nyi shu lnga/ /las ni 'degs 'jog brkyang bskum 'gro ba lnga/ /spyi ni cha med khyab dang nyi tshe ba/ /kha dog dbyibs yig gis stong sgra blo'i rgyu/ /gsal kun rjes 'gro thar lug tha dad 'dod/ /bye brag dkar sogs gsal ba so so ba/ /'du ba spyi gsal rdzas yod rten brten pa/ /khyad par khyad par can rnams sgrel byed gzhan/ /bdag bsgom dbang phyug dbang bskur thar lam yin / /don drug shes pas thar pa bye brag pa/ /tshig don bcu drug shes thar rig pa can/ /de bzhin mngon sum bem po rtog par 'dod/ /rdul phran brgyud dang dbang phyug nyid kyis bskyed/ /rtag pas 'bras skyed rkyen la mi ltos phyir/ /rtag tu'am

༄༄༄/ /yang na nam yang skyed mi 'gyur/ /'dod la ltos na nus med mi rtag nyid/ /cha med kun khyab 'gal sogs gnod pa mang / /khyab 'jug srid med bu pa grong 'joms pa/ /rgyal dpogs gzhon nu ma len sogs rjes 'brang / /rtogs phan yal ga lo ldan gsang mig 'chad/ /dbye ba tshangs pa pa dang spyod pa pa/ /brda sprod rig byed mtha' pa gsang ba pa/ /spyod pa las gzhan thar dang kun mkhyen 'dod/ /khyab 'jug lha chen nor lha gtum mo'i bu/ /sgo ldan grong na bud med mang pos bskor/ /dngos po kun gyi mchog kun de yin la/ /bram ze'i lus kyis las byed rnam smin za/ /lha rdzas ngo bo zhi dang zhi min gnyis/ /dang po bsgoms pas thar pa thob par 'gyur/ /gnyis pas khyab 'jug 'jug pa bcu byed de / /nya dang rus sbal phag rgod mi'i seng ge /mi thung dga' byed ra ma nag po dang / /sangs rgyas rigs ldan bcu yis rim bzhin du/ /rig byed bton dang 'jig rten bteg pa dang / /'jig rten bsnan dang gser can bsad pa dang / /stobs ldan bslus dang rgyal rigs med byas dang / /srin po btul dang sems can don byas dang / /sdig pa sbyangs dang dus log rtogs pa 'o/ /de ltar 'jig rten sna tshogs de yis byas/ /rtag chad lta ba gnyis ka de yis bstan/ /tshangs pa pa ni tshangs pa skye gnas gsum/ /ming bdun ldan pa lus kyi cha shes las/ /mchod sbyin snyan tshig nges rjod srid bsrung ste/ /rig byed bzhi dang mi rigs bzhi byung ba/ /rta yi mchod sbyin gtsang mas sgrub ces smra/ /spyod pa pa 'am rgyal dpogs pa

rnams ni/ /blo bdag shes rig rtag pa'i bdag 'dod cing / /nyes rnams skyes bu la brten rtag pas na/ /nyes zad kun mkhyen med pas bden ngag med/ /yul khras kyis dag srid g.yul srog bsrungs 'dag /mngon rdzas nyer 'jal sgra byung don go dang / /dngos med ces bya tshad ma drug 'dod cing / /don go drug dang dngos med bzhir yang 'byed/ /de yi bye brag tsa ra ka pa ni/ /rigs dang ma dmigs srirdo pa zhes grags dang / /snyam sems la sogs tshad mas zhan yang 'dod/ shes bya mngon gyur blo ni l+log gyur yin/ /brda sprod pa ni sgra yi tshangs pa smra/ /cha med dngos kun rang bzhin rtag pa'i e/ /sna tshogs de yi rnam 'gyur sgrar snang bas/ /dngos dbang sgra 'jug sbyin sreg gnyis kyis 'grub/ /phal cher tshad ma rig byed gcig pur 'dod/ /bṛ tra ha ri mngon rjes gnyis kyang smra/ /rig byed mtha' ba shes rig skyes bu gang / /drang srong chen po nyi ma'i mdog ces pa/ /sa 'og mun pa'i dkyil 'khor 'og na gnas/ /sna tshogs 'di dag de yi sgyu ma'i gzugs/ /bcings thar la sogs kun gyi byed po yin/ /de zhes mkhas pa de char thim pas grol/ /gsang mtha' pa ni gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi /rtag gcig cha med shes rig bdag bden 'dod/ /tshangs dang khyab 'jug skyon las ma grol bar/ /rang gi gzhung 'a/sa/ ra/nga du ba'id nga sa/ bsal// /phal/ cher rtas gcis cha me/nga brkyas pas khegs/ /nyes zad skyes bu brtags ling dpyang pas 'grub/ /gcer bu 'dzer/ re/da zad byeng thal ba pa/ /rgyal/ ba phyosas ra/la'i sos/ can kun tu rgyu /rgyal༈ ba lhang

ra༅༅/ /'dzin khyu mchog ldong ris dang / /snod kyi rje dang 'phel ba sogs rjes 'brang / /srog ni lus ched rdzas rtag rnam grangs gzhan/ /mngon rjes lung gis dus gsum rdzas drug dang / /tshig dgu srog ldan drug rnams 'jal ba bzhin/ /sdom dang brtul zhugs ye shes lnga lnga dang / /spyod pa bcu gsum las zad thabs ni lam/ /srid gsum steng na dpag tshad zhe lnga'i tshad/ /dkar zhing dri zhim yid 'ong thar pa 'bras/ /'gro lnga yod pa'i lus lnga gzhi 'bras nyid / /mngon sum spyi 'jal rtog med bye brag rtogs/ /tshul gsum 'bral phyir gzhan du mi 'thad pa'i/ /tshul gcig nyid las lkog gyur shes pa ni/ /rjes dpag yin te yid ches tshig ni lung / /srog bdag mkha' phyogs sdig dang bsod nams rdzas / /srog dang srog min bcings thar 'dzade (nga spangs/ /zag pa sdod+mo pa tshig gi don dgu 'o/ /'byung bzhi ljon pa 'bras bu'i srog ldan drug /gzhan du srog gi sde tshan dgur yang bshad/ /spyod lam skad tshol mi 'dor nyer gnas sdom/ /mi 'tshe bden smra tshangs spyod byin pa len/ /yongs bzung thams cad gtong ba brtul zhugs lnga/ /blo gros thos mtshams dpyod dang mo'i ye shes/ /spyod pa sdom dang brtul zhugs sgo gsum gsang / /dpyal ba dud 'gro lha mi thar pa'i 'gro/ /kham zas 'od yid rdzus skyes mtha' yi lus/ /kun mkhyen med dang shing sogs sems ldan du/ /sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs mang du 'god par byed/ /lus bzhin che chung 'gyur na de mi rtag /rdzas dang rnam grangs gcig dang tha dad brtag /tshul gcig

mi lad gto tshigs thams cad 'khrul/ /las zad don med thar pa gzugs su 'gal/ /rā ma ṇa yi rjes wang stag gzig dang / /bod na gshen rab rjes 'brang bon la sogs/ /gnyis min mang yang gsaradublosabatagasaji'i / /rko nas grub pa'i grub mtha' smra ba min/ /bdag ni phung po las gzhan ma dmigs phyir/ /gcig na mtshan nyid 'gal bas bdag med grub/ /rim dang cig car don byed nus stong phyir/ /rtag dngos mi srid 'tsha la chos mi srid/ /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las gang zag gi bdag gtso bor dgag pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //sangs rgyas pa la lnga pa med gsangs phyir/ /rang sde bye brag smra ba mdo sde pa/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa dbu ma pa dang bzhi/ /don sems ngo bo nyid med gsum du'ang 'du/ /gnyis gnyis theg dman pa dang theg chen phyir/ /gnyis pa theg chen par sdud gzhung lugs 'khral/ /don sma gnyis sha'i 'dod pa mthun pa ni/ /longs sku rtag bzhugs byang sems bde bar 'gro/ /bdag mchog 'dod dang smo rang 'tshang rgya bas/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang 'gal sogs mtha' yas phyir/ /theg chen spong zhing sgrab gnyis bdag merdo gnyis/ cen gzhi nyon yid gnas gyur sa bcu dang / /sku gsum ye shes lnga sogs/ mi 'dod cing / /thams cad yod smra phal chen gnas brtan pa/ /mang bkar ba bzhi gyes pa bco brgyad 'dod/ /mang bkar nang wo gnas ma bu la sogs/ /snge pa lnga yis brngod med bdag 'dod cing / /bye smra'i nang 'a gzhan kun bdag med 'dod/ /dpe ston sde pa slob dpon

ra༅༅/ /dge srungs dang / /btsun pa dpal len la sogs mdo sde pa/ khun kyang phung sogs dbye ba skye 'gro zas/ /rdul phran cha med rags pa cha bcas rdzun/ /sems dang sems byung 'dus byas skye tshul dang / /bden bzhi lam lnga nyan rang byang sems dang / /phyin drug sangs rgyas dge 'dun nyi shu dang / /bsam gtan la sogs yon tan phal cher dang / /sangs rgyas sa na sdug bden yod pa dang / /lhag med gsum ga rig pa rgyun chad dang / /zag bcas zag med bden gnyis 'jog tshul mthun/ /zag rnams kun tu rgyas 'gyur cig shos phyir/ /lam bden las gzhan 'dus byas mtha' dag dang / /de dang 'dus ma byas kun go rim bzhin/ /gzhig dang gsal bas rang blo mi 'dor 'dor/ /yang na don dam don byed nus mi nus/ /don dam kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid phyir/ /'di gnyis don gcig chu dang bum sogs kyis/ /dam pa'i don du don byed mi nus te/ /de ni rang 'dzin 'khral med skyed byed pa'i/ /don chos rang gi mtshan nyid la 'dod na / /de dag brda sogs nang gi yan lag la/ /bltos pa'i blo chos kun rdzob dngos po'i phyir/ /des na dngos po tsam la don dam gyis/ /khyab pa mdo sde'i lugs su smra ba ni/ /mdo s+thā pa la skur pa 'debs pa ste/ /bye smra las kyang chos bdag rgya che'i phyir/ /don dam bden pa rig pas dpyad bzod rdzi /bden par mi 'dod dngos smra med phyir ro/ /ldan min 'du byed blos btags dngos por ni/ /'dod pas bye brag smra las lhag pa'ang 'gal/ /de phyir don smra gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ /

mngon pa sde bdun bka' ru 'dod mi 'dod/ /lung gi dam chos 'du byed gzugs phung dang / /rdul phran bskor ba bar bcas bar med dang / /rig byed min gzugs sgrub dang 'gog pa dang / dbang po tshad ma gzung 'dzin rgyu 'bras kun/ /das mnyam 'dod dang mi 'dod don snang 'di/ /phyi don nyid dang shes pa'i rnam pa dang / /dbyebs dang dus gsum shes bya gzhi lnga dang / /ldan min 'du byed rdzas yod btags yod dang / /'dus ma byas rnams dngos po dngos med dang / /de bzhin snyed dang rang rig mi 'dod 'dod/ /bya byed ldan 'brel don gzhan don gcig dang / /lus shes bsam gtan yan lag mi rung rung / /'phags pa'i spangs rtogs nyams dang mi nyams so/ /lus sems sa bon can du mi 'dod 'dod/ /rags la rdzas brgyad 'dus pas khyab ma khyab/ /sems byung mtha' dag rdzas gzhan grub ma grub/ /rten 'brel phung po tshogs dang kha yar ba/ /'di dag spyan ras gzigs dang legs ldan 'byed/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pas ji ltar gsungs pa rnams/ /'khrul med legs par rtogs nas bstan pas na/ /rgya bod gzhan gyis gzhan du bshad rnams 'khrul/ /brjod med bdag ni mdzod 'grel dgu par bkag /theg chen bstan par dam pa kun gyis bsgrabs/ /bye smra'i rtog btags mdo sde pa yis bkag de yi rang 'dod tshal 'byor dpyod pas 'gog /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las bzung ba'i chos bdag gtso bor dgag pa ste de'u gsum pa'o// //theg pa chen po mdo tshodang sngags kyis bsngas/ /gnyis ma'ang dbu

ra༅༅/ /sems gnyis su mkhas la grags/ /ci phyir rnam rig ngo bo nyid med rdzi /tshul gnyis shing rta'i srog 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan/ /thogs med klu sgrub gnyis kyis byams 'jam dbyangs/ /brtan nas dgongs pa nges 'grel mdo dang ni/ /blo gros mi zad mdo bzhin legs bkral ba/ /de dag las gzhan theg chen shing rta che/ /yod pa min par mkhas la grub phyir ro/ kher phyin mdo la 'chad tshul bzhi byang ba/ 'ang rta'i srol 'byed bzhi zhes zer ba ni/ /theg chen spyi yi shing rta'i srol 'byed min/ /de phyir nyan thos sde gnyis mi 'dod pa'i/ /theg chen gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag kun/ /phal cher shing rta'i mchog gnyis bzhed tshul mthun/ ༄/gzhan dbang yongs grub bden par snga mas bsgrubs/ /phyi mas de yang rig tshul du mas bkag /rang rig tha snyad tsam du 'di mi bzhed/ /mtshan nyid gsum dang kun gzhi'ang mi bzhed cing / /phyi'i don tha snyad tsam du 'di bzhed par/ /'di na 'ga' zhig gsal por sgrogs pa ni/ /byang chub sems 'grel gzhung dang 'gal bar mthong / /tshul gnyis rjes 'brang nang tshan so so la/ /tshogs brgyad rang rig 'dod tshul sna tshogs yod/ /theg chen gnyis kyi khyad par gtso bo ni/ /gzhi la ngo bo nyid med la sogs dang / /lam la skye med chos la bzod pa dang / /'bras bu mthar thug theg pa gcig pa rnams/ /drang don nges don nyid du bzhed pas na/ /'khor lo bar mtha'i drang nges khyad par yin/ /rnam rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan sku mched gnyis/ /ngo bo nyid dang khyad par btags pa

dang / /gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan bden pa'i kun brtags te/ /rtog dang rtog med lhan skyes la snang ba'i/ /chos bdag 'di gnyis 'gog la so sor brtson/ /ming gi snga rol ming can blo med phyir/ /dorno de ming 'dibadag cid du 'gal dang / /don gcig nyid la mang po'i ming ldan pas/ /don de bdag nyid mang por 'gal ba dang / /don gcig nyid la ming gcig ma nges pa sa/ /don gnyis gcig tu 'dres par 'gal bas na/ /rtog la ming don gcig tu snang ba shādi/ /snang bzhin ma grub bdag med grub par 'gyur/ /rdzas gzhan snang ba'ang bdag 'di'i rtsa ba can/ /yin zhing spang bya'i rtog pa bzhi dang lnga/ /bcu dang khyad par byang sems rnam rtog bcu/ /'dir rtog nyid la brten phyir 'di bkag pas/ shes sgrib mtha' dag 'joms par nus so zhes/ /gnyen gyis theg bsdus sogs su gsal bar gsungs/ /cig car sbyar tshe so so'i phyogs blta na/ /cha bcas 'gyur zhing shar la blta ba'i ngos/ /gang yin gzhan la'ang blta na rags mi 'gyur/ /des na phyi don mi 'grub rtsod spong dang / /bcas pa gcung gis nyi shu pa las bshad/ /gzhan yang mi rtog ye shes dor med dang / /ris drug dgra gnyen snang ba 'gyur phyir dang / /sad dang rmi lam don byed mtshungs phyir dang / /gsal myong lhan cig dmigs pa nges phyir dang / /don la gnas 'dod rdul phran mi snang zhing / /blo la snang ba'i rags pa don gnas la/ /med par don smra rang yang 'dod pas na/ /don la skyes 'dra'ang 'grub pa mi srid phyir/ /don snang mtha' dag chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin/ /

rī༅༅/ /de phyir phyi don rig pa'i dgag byar bzhed/ /tshul 'di lang gshegs dgongs pa nges 'grel sogs/ /zab yangs mdo sde mang las gsal bar gsungs/ /rdul phran cha bcas zla grags bzhed zer la/ /ri rab rdul du thal ba'i gnod pa 'bab/ /rnam rig smra la 'dod tshul gnyis yin te/ /gzugs snang mtha' dag sems su bden pas na/ /phung khams skye mched ji snyed gsungs pa kun/ /sems kyi chos su bden par 'dod pa dang / /skra shad sogs bzhin med pa gsal snang phyir/ khel gong dag 'dra'i rang rig rang gsal nyid/ /bden par 'dod pa'i rnam bden rnam rdzun no/ /gnyis ka bag chags brtan dang mi brtan phyir/ /'phral dang gtan gyi 'khral rgyu'i khyad par 'byed/ /rnam bden la yang gzung cha 'dzin cha yi/ shes pa gnyis su bden dang rnam pa'i grangs/ /ji snyed shes pa'i grangs kyang 'dod pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs shes pa gcig nyid du/ /smra ba gsum du mkhas la grags shing grub/ /gsum ga la yang thun mong gnod pa ni / /bden na gcig tu bden las ma 'das shing / /phyogs char snang 'di rdul dang mtshungs pas khegs/ /dang po gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan thal ba dang / /gnyis pa ris mthun rnam shes gcig nges dang / gsum pa gcig dang du ma 'gal bas bkag /rnam rdzun pa yi gnyis stong rig pa de/ /yul med phyir na shes pa'i mtshan nyid med/ /bden pa de nyid rdzun par snang ba dang / /'brel pa med phyir rdzun snang 'byung mi rigs/ /med kyang 'byung na rgyal la'ang 'byung bar nges/ /'brel pa
