yod na rdzun snang dngos por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sa na gnyis snang yod med kyis/ /rnam rdzun dri bcas dri med gnyis zhes grags/ /'di dag rtog ngor phyi rol don yang yod/ /don la gzhan rig sems dang sems byung med/ /bya byed mtha' das rtog ngo tsam du bzhed/ /de phyir 'bras rtogs gsum pa'ang 'di ye lugs/ /yin par kho bo'i rnam dpyod kho nas( rig /sems tsam pa la kun gzhi bzhed mi bzhed/ /gnyis su gangs can 'di na grags mod sgo /sku mched gnyis kyis gsal bar bshad pa las/ /rjes 'brang la las/ gsal por ma brjod kyang / /'gos pa'i lung rig sus kyang ma brjod phyir/ /kun gzhi mi 'dod sems tsam tshad ldan dka'/ khen tu brtan pa'i rig rgyun med mi rung / /chos kun bden gnyis ma nyid gsum du bsdu/ /ma grub btags pa'i 'kho+o bdag la sogs dang / /rtog la gakhrig snang rtog med gnyis snang sogs/ /mtshan nyid yongs chad rnam grangs kun brtags yin/ /'khral gzhi sems dang sems byung 'khral ldan dang / /'khral bral ma dag dag pa'i gzhan dbang yin/ /ngag de phyin ci ma log yongs grub kyang / /'khrul gzhi 'khrul bas sto ngas pa'i stong nyid ni/ /'gyur med yongs grub ces bya 'dus ma byas/ rā/ di nyid rnam dag dmi gas par kurno kyang 'dod/ /rnam snyun yongs grub dang po'ang der 'dod pas/ /me nyam gzhag stsang bcas zhes byar grags pa yin/ /kun brtags gang yin kun je+o ba bden pa dang / /yongs grub don dam bden par gnyis ka mthun/ /rnam bden ga'an dbang gnyis kyang kun rdzob

ra༅༅/ /dang / /rnam rju na dag pa gzhan dbang don dam 'dod/ /mu stegs byed kyis rgyun dang rags pa rnams/ /cha med gcig tu bden par 'dod pa de/ /bye smras bkag nas rgyun can phra rab rnams/ /dam pa'i don du grub par nan gyis bsgrubs/ /de yis bya byed ldan 'brel bden 'dod pa/ /mdo sde pas bkag 'brel po sogs bden bsgrabs/ /de yis rnam pa gtod byed phyi rol na/ /yod par 'dod pa rnam bden smra bas bkag /de yis shes pa'i bya byed bden grub tu/ /smras pa rnam rdzun 'dod pas bkag na yang / /'khral dang bya byed mtha' dag 'jog pa ni/ /gzhi rten bden grub med par ma shes phyir/ /dngos por smra ba (shes byar mkhas rnams gsung / /de yis bdag med stong nyid gang smras kyang / /rang gi ngo bos stong tshul med pas na/ /gzhan stong nyi lha'i stong nyid khom nar zad/ /khyad par shes pa skad cig cha med de/ /dus gzhan gnyis dang phrad dam ma phrad brtag /ma phrad da lta bar yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /phrad na dus gsum skad cig nyid du 'gyur/ /grub mtha' kun shes pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos las 'dzin pa'i chos bdag gtso bor dgag pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //grub mtha' mtha' dag rang rang blo ngo na/ /mtha' gnyis bkag nas dbu ma smra bar rlom/ /khyad par rnam rdzun gnyis med lta ba 'di/ /dbu mar mdo dang tshad ldan gzhung las bshad/ /bye brag klu sgrub lugs mchog 'chad pa la'ang / /sangs rgyas bskyangs dang legs ldan 'byed gnyis kyis/ /thal 'gyur tsam dang rang rgyud sgrub byed phyir/ /thal

mkhyen ye shes chos kun 'jal ba dang / shes bya byed la tshad ma min pa 'ako/ /rdzas yod bdag smra gnas ma bur nges dang / /rnam shes bdag smra'i dbu sems yod pa 'gal/ /de ltar 'gal bsnye+o'irgyu/ /rnamastodamedaparngo 'jig rten nyid las zhes/ /yang yang smras kyang rtog ger goms pa'i mthus/ /'thad pa bcug nas dpyad cing bsgrubs pas so/ /klu sgrub lugs mchog dbu ma chen po ni/ /zla bas legs bkral nyi mas bsgyur pa'i srol/ /sras bzhi las 'ongs rtog ges ma bslad pa/ /gangs can mtha' bral rtser gshegs 'ga' yis gzigs/ /bod yul rtog ge'i brda yis gang ba'i mthus/ /tha snya/da smra brjod cung zad mi bde bas/ /mkhas rlom kun gyi blo gras ra bar ni/ /ma shong khron pa'i rus sbal ji bzhin no/ /de phyir klu sgrub yab sras sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /zla grags zhi ba lha yi gzhung mchog kun/ /ma dpyad cung zad dpyad dang legs par dpyad/ /gnas skabs gsum la sbyor bar kho bos rtogs/ /tha snyad ma dpyad 'jig rten lhan skyes ngor/ /don dam cung zad yod pa'i rigs shes ngor/ /spros bral legs par stod pa'i brngod med ngor/ /'di gsum legs par shes de dbu ma che/ /gang phyir gsum po 'di las rim bzhin du/ /bsod nams min pa dang por bzlog pa dang / /bar du bdag tu lta ba gnyis bzlog cing / /tha mar lta ba'i spros kun bzlog phyir ro/ /de yang dang por lhan skyes 'khrul pa'i ngor/ /byed po sto+od po snyag tu 'dzin pa ni/ /rtog gis ma bslad rang dgar zhugs pa na/ /rang

ra༅༅/ /bzhin med pa'i las las 'bras bu 'byang / /rtag dang mi rtag dpyad mthar rgyun ngang ni/ /chud mi za sogs gzhan 'dod kun bkas nas/ /zhig dang yang zhig de'i yang zhig dngos sogs/ /bye brag smra ba'i thob pa'i dga' ston ltar/ /smras kyang thug med dang po 'grub mi srid/ /rdo phyir skad cig cha sogs dpyad mi rung / /phyi nang gar yod 'gro 'ong gang byed sogs/ /'jig rten rang dgar dpyod dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /gnyis par bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi 'dzin stangs yul/ /rig pa 'i mchog gis btsal nas mi rnyed pa'i/ /skye med bden stong bslu med yul gyi mchog /de 'jal tshad mar tha snya da tsam du grub/ /des na bden stong don dam bden pa dang / /de yod tha snyad bden par 'thad mod rdzi /de nyid legs par dpyad mthar 'dod pa dang / /rnam grangs don dam du 'dod gnyis ka 'khral/ /gsum par med dgag tsam du bzung na yang / /gzung 'dzin yul dang yul can ma 'gags phyir/ /gnyis snang spros pa gcod par mi nus pas/ /dbyings rig chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du /rig bya rig byed cung zad mi dmigs par/ /snam mkha' mthong zhes brjod ltar spros kun zhi/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed yod na byang chub ni/ /min par klu sgrab zhabs kyis gsungs phyir ro/ /rig shes rjes dpag bden stong rnam ldan du/ /skyes shing de la nges shes cher 'dren pa/ /bsam byung yin gyi bsgom blo ga la yin/ /de phyir de ni mnyam bzhag sngon du 'gro/ /nges shes 'dis drangs ci yang mi 'ardzon dang / /hwa shang lta ba mtshungs pa'i skabs med

pas / /gnyis pa sngon du ma btang rtsom 'jog dang / /gsum par med dgag nan 'dzin gnyis ka 'khrul/ /de phyir rang lugs gzhi lam 'bras bu kun/ /cung zad dpyad ngor yin phyir lugs 'di la rnamadapyodamedacesasmralarmengarnamadapyod pa / /rnam par grol sogs gsungs dang 'gal ba yod/ /de phyir bden sanyis thabs shes sku gnyis rnams/ /zung 'jug gzhi lam 'bras bur grub pas na/ /klu sgrub zhabs kyi gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin/ /cung zad dpyad ngor bdag gis 'dir brjod bya/ /bden gnyis dbye gzhi shes bya tsam du gsungs/ /dbye ngo kun rdzob bden dang don dam bden/ /mtshan nyid 'khrul ngor rnyed dang reg ngor rnyed/ /sngo dang zla gnyis 'jig rten bden rdzun phyir/ /ma dpyad yang log dbu ma rang lugs min/ /ma dpyad yul ngos bya ba byed pa yang / /'jig rten kun rdzob dpyad na 'di mi srid/ /rang rgyud pa yis 'di tsam dpyad nas smras/ /brtag pa ma byas zhes pa tshig tsam las/ /don dam yul dang yul can dngos rnam grangs/ /ngo bo dbyer med mtshan nyid tha dad yin/ /de rtogs dgos pa thabs dang thabs byung rig /rtog gis brtags bzhin mtha' dag mi 'dod kyang / /ma brtags nyams dgar phung khams skye mched dang / /phyi don kun gzhi ma nyid gsum la sogs/ /sgya ma'i snang ba tsam du lugs 'di bzhed/ /de phyer dngos smras don dam gang 'dod pa/ /'di yis tha snyad tsam du 'dod ces pa'ang / /mi 'thad dngos por smra bas gang bzhag pa/ /kun kyang rang grags 'gal 'du'i rang bzhin phyir/ /cung zad

ra༅༅/ /dpyad ngor ma dag las snang 'di/ /rab rib can gyi sgra shad dang mtshungs pas/ /dag pa'i ye shes yul med zhir zhugs nyid/ /yul gzhan 'jal dang gzhan la ston pa sogs/ /gdul bya'i dge dang sngon gyi smon lam las/ /'byung tshul rtog shes bsam mi khyab par gsungs/ /de phyir kun rdzob nges byed 'bral shes tsam/ /don dam nges byed gcig dang du bral dang / /rdo rje gzegs ma yod med skye 'gog dang / /mu bzhi skye 'gog rten 'brel gto tshigs rnams / /ngo bo rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis ka dang / /snang tsam la dpyod chos kyi bdag med sgrub/༄/dang po'i nang 'dus rnam bdun rig pa yis/ /gang zag bdag 'gog rig pa'i rgyal po ste/ /rtag gcig rang dbang ༅ tsam lhan skyes la/ /snang mod 'thad pa bcug pa kun brtags yin/ /bden pa'i gcig dang du mas dben pa'i phyir/ /chos kun bden par med de gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /chos can ma brtags snang tsam kho na ste / /phyogs chos cha bcas phyir dang gtsig med phyir/ /bden na gnyis por nges pa med pa 'grub/ /brtags pa 'gog na rdul dang skad cig sogs/ /cha med 'dod la phyogs cha dus chas dgag /des brtsams bem rig mtha' dag bden gcig khegs/ /chos nyid nam mkha' sogs la'ang rten cha tsam/ /dngos med kun la tha snyad tsam du yang / /ngo bo med pas bden 'dzin chung ba'i phyir/ /gzhung du dngos po rnams la bden grub bkag /stong nyid bden med sgrub la'ang cha bcas dang / /rten 'brel sogs kyi gtan tshigs ma bkod par/ /dgag

bya bden med kho nas bsnya par mdzad/ /gzugs brnyan bsto med tsam du ma grub kyang / /byad bzhin nyid du mi bden dpe la grub/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka gnyis min skye bral phyir/ /bden pa'i skye med dang tsho rtags sgrub ni/ /nu ban la pa meng/ pa dang / /myu gu' skye dang mdog dbyebs mi rnyed dang / /mngon gsal yin na rgyu 'bras gcig min dang / /mthong dang 'gal zhing 'jig rten dang 'gal dang / /bya byed mtha' dag gcig tu 'gyur phyir ro/ /gnyis pa'i rtags sgrub rgyu min kun sbyar 'gyur/ /nas dang sa lu'i sa bon gnyis ka yang / /sa lu'i mya gu las gzhan mtshungs phyir ro/ /dus mnyam min la gzhan pa'i tshul mi srid/ /rgyu 'bras dus mnyam rig pas khegs phyir dang / /dus mnyam 'bras bu yod med brtags pas khegs/ /'di la 'phros nas yod med ska gog gsungs/ /yo| la ci bya med la rgyus nus med/ /gnyis yin nges legs gnyis min mi srid do/ /gzhan skye 'jig rten tshad mas grub ce na/ /'dzin stangs 'khral pas tshad mar mi 'thad cing / /kho bo sazhan du 'jig rten yang mi 'dordo/ /ma brtags 'khral ngor 'bras tsha rgyu gnas pas/ /las 'gags yun ring lon las 'bras 'byang 'thad/ /'dir 'gros kun gzhi'i bag chags bden grub dang / /rgozhan dbang yod dang phyi don med tshul bkag /gnyis skye de gnyis khegs pa'i shugs la khergermi/ /rgyu med ha cang thal zhing mthong dang 'gal/ /der 'dzin 'khrul par mngosna sum 'khral pas 'grub/ /de lngar rdo rje gzegs ma rgyas par gsungs/ /mu ba'i rgyu gcig nyid

ra༅༅/ /las 'bras gcig dang / /ldog dang gcig las du ma de las ldog /rang rgyud pa yis gnyis pa bzhi pa dang / /gzhan las skye dang med pa skye ba rnams/ /tha snyad tsam du ma dpyad 'dod na yang / /'di las lhag pa'i dgrod tshul gzhan med pas/ /'dir grub bden grub nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ khun kyang tha snyad tsam du'ang 'dir mi 'dod/ /rig pa'i rgyal po rten cing 'brel 'byung ni/ /phrad bltos tsam las mi 'byung chos med la/ /bden par grub na bltos pa mi srid phyir/ /lta ngan drwa ba mtha' dag 'di yis gcod/ /ngar 'dzin lhan skyes 'dzin stangs kyis bzung pa'i/ /bden grub bdag de 'dogs gzhi'i phung po dang / /gcig dang tha dad rten dang brten pa dang / /ldan pa lnga ru klu sgrub zhabs kyis dpyad / /zla bas dbyibs dang tshogs pa gnyis bsnan nas/ khreng rta dang mtshungs dpyad na mi rnyed kyang / /rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyid las 'dir/ /rang gi yan lag brten nas 'dogs zhes gsungs/ /phal cher gzhan gyis brtags rnams thal bas 'gog /ma brtags gtan tshigs bgod pas rang gzhan la/ /rig shes rjes dpag skyed la 'gal ba med/ /rtog gis btags pa'i rang rgyud mi srid phyir/ /rang rgyud tsam yang mi 'dod ces smra ba/ /thal 'gyur la yang ci yi phyir mi mtshungs/ /phung sogs bden bzhi kun byang mtshan nyid kun/ /ngo bos grub par gsungs rnams drang don tsam/ /gzhan kun mngon pa'i mdo bzhin 'dir bzhed de/ /'jig rten ngor byas ston pas gsungs phyir ro/ /lam gyi thob bya mngon

mtho nges legs te/ /de gnyis sgrub thabs dad dang shes rab ni/ /'gro ba bzhi yis chos las mi 'da' dang / /sgo gsum spyod pa 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'o/ /nges legs rang gzhan dbang byas dman mchog gnyis/ /mngon mthor bcas pa skyes bu gsum gyis sgrub/ /yid ches dad pas dge sdig blang dor dang / /nges 'byung bsam pas bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog dang / /byang chub sems kyis phyin drug spyod pa rnams/ /de gsum lam du mar me mdzad dpal bzhed/ /dman las 'bring po dbye bas theg gsum ste/ /theg pa bzhi dang grub mtha' lnga ba bkag /kun kyang stong nyid lta bas ma zin na/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul la 'khral pa'i phyir/ /las su 'gyur mod zab mo'i snod dkon pas/ /'bras kyi phyir du ko ṭa 'debs pa ltar/ /drang phyir gsungs te zab mo'i phyogs re nas/ /rim gyis zhugs pas bde blag grol 'gyur phyir/ /rgyal dang sems can gnyis shar /sa bya yi/ /rang lta la chags gzhan la 'khrag mi bya/ /'on kyang nges legs lam kun 'dir bltos phyir/ /lam gyi gtso bo mtha' bral shes rab yin/ /mnyam gzhag dngos kyi 'jog tshul khyad med kyang / /sbyor 'jug dbye bas lam lnga sa bcur 'gyur/ /'bras bu mngon mtho lha mi'i bsdo ba dang / /nges legs byang chub gsum gyi rnam bzhag dang / /sangs rgyas sa yi sku gsum 'phrin las kun/ /phal cher theg chen mngon pa'i mdo bzhin bzhed/ /dngos kun blos btags ming kyang btags yong phyir/ /tha snyad du yang rtos shes btags kun spong / /dpyad ngor bslu med

ra༅༅/ /myang 'das kho na'i phyir/ /'dus byas bslu chos tshad grub med pa dang / /bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar nges pa'i phyir/ /des bskyed chags sogs nyon sgrib kho na dang / /theg gsum chos nyid gzigs tshul gcig pa'i phyir/ /mthong lam skad cig du ma med pa dang / /rang ngor shes bya'i snang ba nub pa'i phyir/ /'phrin las bsam yas gzhan snang rnam rol rnams/ /lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin khyad chos gtso/ /sgrub byed rgyas par dbu ma che gzhung ltos / /legs ldan shar gsum byams chos dbu ma kun/ /rang rgyud yin phyir cha mthun tsam du zad/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla rtsa 'grel rnams/ /thal 'gyur gzhung du mkhas mang bzhed mod rdzi /'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye ba tsam/ /spangs pa rnam grol nyid la tshang ba dang / /gang zag bdag med la yang chos nyid tsam/ /mkhas la grags shing lesas par grub phyir dang / /rang gzhung mang dang gong 'og 'gal 'gyur phyir/ /ma nges rigs can drang phyir gsungs pa ste/ /dngos bstan lam gyis srid rtsa mi chod pas/ /'phags lam dngos min yan lag khyad par can/ khathags bzhi'i mngon rtogs spang gnyen rags pa kun/ khren tu gsal phyir lhag par gus 'jug bya/ /'di dag 'bor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan nyid / /dbu ma'i gzhung las ji ltar bshad bzhin te/ /tha mar gzhi yi zag med shes pa nyid/ /bde gshegs snying po sngar las je gsal gyur/ /la lar shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang / /gzhan du rang bzhin lhan skyes 'od gsal dang / /theg

bya ba'i bstan bcos las/ phra ba'i bdag gnyis bkag nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //gang gi drin las phyi nang grub pa'i mtha'/ /rgya mtsho'i pha rol son pa'i ded dpon du/ /legs par bskan mdzad 'jam mgon bla ma la / /snying nas gus pa chen pos phyag bgyid do/ /rang gzhan lta ba'i mtsho chen lta 'dod cing / /rnam grol dbang gi rgyal po len 'dod na/ /ded dpon 'dir brten rnam dpyod gru chen la/ /dran pa'i zag lhan bco+on bsla dar tshugs shig /mkhas rlom phal cher khron pa'i rus sbal te/ /gzhan dag gang gā'i chu tsam sgrol nus kyang / /mtha' yas chu gter mthar son srid mtha' tsam/ /de phyir su zhig 'dir gus skye mi 'gyur/ /'on kyang byis blos zab mor dpyad pa'i phyir/ /ye shes spyan ldan dag gis gzigs pa na/ /nongs pa gang mchis nongs rgyu ma rig bcas/ /ye shes me yis slar yang gzhom du gsol/ /'dir 'bad dge ba gangs ri ltar dkar des/ /lhan skyes kun brtags dngos 'dzin gdon chen pos/ /yan skreng gzir ba'i ma bon 'gro ba 'di/ /myur du zhi zhing bde bas 'tsho lagyur cig /ces grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po 'di ni/ yul byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs su bstan rtsis yongs grags ltar narnyi brgya pa brgyad pa'i steng dang 'thad ldan ltar na lnga pa'i sked kyi dus su byung ba/ gtsang stag tshang gi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos nyi ma zhes bya ba chu mo lug gi lo mgo can gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa'i

ra༅༅/ /nyin/ dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du grub par bgyis pa'o// //ra༅༅/ /grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo martsi shrī ye/ grub mtha' kun shes nas mtha' bral grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge legs gser gyi gzhi las 'thon / /sku bzhi'i bang rim mngon par mtho/ /'phrin las gzi 'od mu mtha' med/ /thub dbang lhun por gus phyag 'tshal/ /skal bzang blo mun mthar byed cing / /legs bshad pad mo'i tshal skyong ba/ /mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od 6/chog gi mchog khajam mgon bla ma'i nyin byed rgyal/ /gang gi drin las bdag blo'i dpal/ /sprin bral nyi ma ltar gsal bas/ /thub bstan pa da tshal rgyas phyir du/ /legs bshad gzi 'od 'di spro 'o/ /'dir phan bde mtha' dag gi gter chen po rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang the tshom gyi rab rib dang ldan pa dag gi rmongs pa drungs nas phyung ste/ yang dag pa'i lam dri ma med pa la 'god par 'dod nas bstan bcos 'di brtsams so/ /de yang mtshan gyi don ni rgya gar skad du zhes sogs te/ 'phags yul du sbyar ba dngos ma yin yang rjes su mthun pas/ de ltar smos pa tshad ma rig pa'i gter la sogs pa bzhin no/ /gzhung gi don la/ bshad pa la 'grug pa ni/ grub pa zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gcig

ste / rkang pa gnyis kyis mchod par brjod pa dang gnyis kyis bshad par dam bcas so/ /de la grub pa ni sa'i ming ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mtshan nyid gang zag bslab pa dang / — /phung pogrubabartagasadangani ngesapa'i:gdangathobapa yis / /gnas pa dang ni sa nyid do/ /zhes mdor bstan dang / grub pa dag kyang ma grub dang / /grub pa dag tu yang 'dod do/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la/ phyogs gzhan nas kyang / grub pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang mchog gi rnam gzhag gsungs pa las ches mchog tu gshegs pas na grub pa'i mthar phyin te rang don mthar phyin pa'o/ /rang gis rtogs pa gzhan la smra ba ni drang srong ser skya dang rkang mig la sogs pa yang yin mod kyi brjod bya'i don la 'khral pa dang bcas pa yin la / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kho na 'khrul med du gsung pa yin pas smra ba rnams kyi gakho+o bo dang / 'chad par 'gyur ba'i grub mtha' thams cad kyang rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung bas na/ grub mtha' kun gsung trī po thub pa'i dbang po la bstan bcos rtsom pa'i thog mar spyi bos 'dud pa ni/ dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun zhing skabs kyi bya ba mthar phyin pa'i ched du bsod nams khyad par can sgrub pa ste/ lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ snying nas dad dam ji ltar dga' ba dang / /the tshom gyis sam gzhin gyi ngor yang rung / /gang zhig thub dbang la ni phyag byed pa/ /des ni lha yi bde sogs phun sum 'thob/ /ces dang sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i bsod nams ga'al du med pa sogs mang du gsungs te yi se mang du ngosne+osas

ra༅༅/ /pas mi spro'o/ /dam bca'i rgyu ma ni/ spyir rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa ni dam pas bsngags pa'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir dang / rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang / ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par bya'o/ /de la mkhas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs dang / byang chub sems dpas bslab par bya ba'i rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad kyi nang na/ grangs can dang bye brag pa'i bstan bcos kyang yod pa'i phyir dang / jo bo chen pos/ ngang pas chu la 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dwang du blang bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi 'dod pa yang dag pa'i lta ba tshol na yang / dbu ma'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi phyogs snga ma shes na de ji ltar 'gog tshul mi shes shing de lta na rang gi lta ba lhan skyes 'gog par mi nus te/ lta ba dang grub mtha' thams cad ni lhan cig skyes pa'i blo dang bstun nas bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bshad pa nye bar dgod pa la/ bdag lta'i 'dzin stangs spyir dgag pa dang / so sor dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang gzhan gyi khyad par bzhed/ gzhan la snang zhugs spang / blang dor bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa dang 'dzin stangs sogs kyis phye ba'i sna tshogs pa'i lta ba dang grub mtha'i dbye ba ni rnam pa shin tu mang ste/ slob dpon sman pa'i zhabs kyis/ lta ba lnga brgya bdun cu bshad pa

'dod cing / gtan 'jig mi srid pa'i rtag dngos su khas mi len pas mu stegs dang khyad par che'o/ /srid rtse'i gnyen po ni mu stegs la med de/ bdag med bden pa'i rnam pa can gyi lam las rgyab kyis phyogs shing gonganasagazhanamedapas zhi rags kyi rnam pa yang med pa'i phyir te/ mkhas mchog dpa' bos/ khyod kyi bstan la mi phyogs pa'i/ /skye bo gti mug gis ldongs pa/ /srid rtse'i bar du song nas kyang / /sdug bsngal yang 'byung srid pa sgrub/ /khyod kyi bstan pa'i rjes 'brang ba / /bsam gtan dngos gzhi ma thob kyang / /bdud kyi mig ras rtsa bzhin du/ /srid pa rnams ni 'dor bar byed/ khres gsungs pa ltar ro/ /spyod pa'i skyon ni mtha' gnyis su lhung ba ste/ rnyed bkur la chags pas/ ngan pa dang nyung dus mi tshim par bzang po dang mang po 'dod zhen gyis sgrub cing spyod pa dang / rang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang ldan/ bdag med kyi lta bas dngos 'dzin rags pa las grol ba zhig gis/ sgrub pa'i tshe chos la gnod pa'i 'bad rtsol mi dgos/ spyod pa'i tshe chags zhen dang mngon zhen drag po mi skye na bzang zhing mang ba spyod pa la yang bag 'khums mi dgos kyang / de ltar byed pas lus sems gdung ba gnyis ni/ rim pa bzhin rgyang 'phen pa dang gcer bu pa la gtso bor yod la/ sangs rgyas bcom lngan 'das kyis ni/ gos dang zas dang gnas mal dang sman te gnas bzhi po mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba la bslab par nan gyis gsungs pas so/ /'bras bu thar pa yang / bshes spring du/ sa chu me rlung nyi zla bral thob ma/cidzod ces/

ra༅༅/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rgyang 'phen ni/ 'byung bzhi sems dang bcas pa dang / de dang bral ba gnyis 'bor 'das su 'dod pas/ thar pa dang 'byung bzhi'i gzhi mthun 'dod la/ ne tsos nyi mar btol nas ni/ /thar bar mchis par bshad ces grag /ces sogs nyi zla thar par 'dod pa dang / gcer bu pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings na thar pa gdugs bkan pa lta bur 'dod pa sogs kyis thob bya'i thar pa la rmongs pas thob byed lam la yang rmongs la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni/ thar pa'am mya ngan las 'das pa 'gog bden du bzhed pas so/ /de dag ni 'thad mod kyi/ dkon cog gsum las gzhan la skyabs su 'gro ba phyi rol mu stegs kyi 'jog byed du kha cig 'dod pa yang 'thad do zhe na/ de lta na bod kyi gshen rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams der 'gyur la/ 'dod mi nus te/ bdag med kyi rnam bzhag rgyas par khas len la/ bdag med dang phyag rgya bzhi 'dod pa'i mu stegs ni mi srid pas 'di ni blos btags gnyis min du rigs so/ /gzhan la sdang zhugs spang ba ni/ lta ba smra ba phal cher rang lta la mchog tu bzung nas gzhan la snang smras kyi ser ba 'bebs la/ khyad par dbu ma chen po par khas 'che ba dag gis/ shing rta chen po dag la yang gshe na/ phyi rol pa la lta ci smos / rang gi rjes 'jug dag gis kyang rang lugs la gus shing 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pas mi chog go /gzhan phyogs la snang smras ma byas na bstan pa ma bzung bar 'dod pa dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bzhed pa ma yin te/ 'jig rten

na phugs kyi phan pa dang 'phral gyi bde ba mtha' dag ni rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kho na yin te/ 'bras bu de ni rgyu dbe ba med par mi 'byung la/ dge blo phra mo tsam yang sangs rgyas kyi mthu las 'byung dgos pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar pa' mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig bar snang ston pa ltar/ de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /zhes sogs mdo dang sngags las mang du gsangs pa'i phyir/ mu stegs kyi sgras brjod rigs la dbye na/ ming brtags pa dang / der spru la pa dang / rang rgyud pa'i mu stegs te dbye ba gsum yod pa'i phyir te/ lang kur gshegs pa las/ ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /de srid 'jig rten rgyang 'phen yin/ /zhes rnam rtog ma zad kyi bar la rgyang 'phen gyi sgras gdags par gsungs shing / bden smra'i mdo las/ yid bzhin nor dang 'ching bu phrad gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshul du nam yang 'byung ba med/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen mu stegs can/ /zhing gcig tu ni nam yang 'byung bamed/ /mu stegs can sgo 'di kun bsam gtan dang / /mngon shes dbang sgyur thabs mkhas yin shes gyis/ shes rab thabs kyi spyod pas blo ldan rnams/ /rnam par 'phrul pa sna tsho+ogs ston par byed/ zhes dang rab tu 'i ba rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul gyi mdo las kyang / seng be chen po'i mdun du ri dwags phra mo mi gnas pa ba'in du/ de ba'in gshegs pa'i mdun du mu stegs gnas par mi nus mod zhi sems can smin par bya ba'i don du de bzhin

༄༄༄/ /gshegs pa nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa ni ma gtogs so/ /zhes zab mo'i la ma la dngos su bkrir mi rung ba dag rim gyis gzhug pa'i phyir du/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems mang pos de'i ston par sprul nas reg pa'i sgo du ma ston par gsungs la/ de dag gi gdul bya mang po rang rgyud pa yin pa la dgongs nas ni/ chos 'di las phyi rol tu gyur ba la dge sbyong gi tshul dang 'phags pa'i lam med do zhes dang / kun tu rgyu klan ka tshol ba'i bsam pas 'ongs pa de dag la dkar po'i chos gcig tsam yang ngas ma mthong ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyogs tshodzan ni nyes pa kun gyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir te/ zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /ces sogs dang / yid kyi nyes pa rang bzhin gdug pa ste / /zhes sogs dang / rang gi lta la chags dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi lta la 'khrag gang rtog pa nyid/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs shing / sde dang ris su chad pa'i 'khrag long gis 'jig rten mtha' dag rgud par 'gyur ba mngon sum gyis mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na sdang zhugs tshul gyis rang sde ston pa gcig gi bstan me+e la tshangs pa'i spyod pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag lta spyod kyi cha phra mo re tsam mi mthun pa bh+rūṃ mtshan du byas nas phan tshun smod pa lta zhog ston pa dang bstan pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i gzhan sde'ang smad du mi rung bas gnas 'di la gzab par bya'o/ /blang dor bsdus te bstan pa la/ mdor bstan ni/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i dbye ba rnam pa mang yang blang bya dang dor bya'i tshul gyis bsdu na gnyis

su 'dus te/ rtag chad gang rung gi mtha' sogs su 'dus pa'i phyir te/ rgyu mtshan ni blo lhan skyes 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs sgrub par byed pa dang / 'gog par byed pa gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /ma gzhi ni/ kla sgrub zhabs kyi lugs las gzhan pa rang gzhan gyi sde pa dngos por smra ba rnams dang / dpal mgon 'phags pa'i lugs de nyid do/ /de yang rtog dpyode dang ldan par rlom pa thams cad kyang / rang rang gi blotho ga ma med pa nas rjes su zhugs snang 'phral gyi 'khral rgyus ma bslad pa 'di la gang snang ba thams cad ni snang ba ltar don la grub pas yul bden pa dang blo tshad mar bzung nas lta ba dang grub mtha' 'jog pa sha stag yin la/ lhan skyes kyi rig rgyun 'dzin stangs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba yul gyi r+shanas tshul dang blo'i snang tshul shin tu ma/thun pa zhig skye bo thams cad kyi rgyud la thog ma med pa nas rang chas su gnas pa ni/ glo bur dri mas sprin dang rnyog pas bsgribs nas mngon du ma gyur cing / gsung rab phal cher las gsungs kyang sbas la/ cha dang zur gyis cung zad smos pa rnams la ni/ blo gros sna zhing gsal bar khas 'che ba dag gis sgro 'dogs dang skur 'debs kyi lta ba du ma'i 'khrul gzhir gyur te rnam pa sna tshogs su smra bar byed do/ /rgyas par bshad pa ni/ lhan skyes 'khral ma 'khral gnyis kyi dang po 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs dbang du btsugs nas grub mtha' 'jog pa'ang phyi sogs 'dus te/ rtog pa 'khrul pa'i 'dzin stangs rtag pa dang gcig pu dang cha med du 'dzin pa 'dis ji ltar bzung ba ltar grub par rlom nas phyi rol pa'i

ra༅༅/ /grub mtha' dang / rtog med lhan skyes 'khral pa'i 'dzin stangs kyis ji ltar bzung ba la 'phral gyi gnod pa ma mthong bas rgyu byas nas rang sde'i grub mtha' bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /dang po phyi rol pa la grub mtha' sma ba shen tu mang yang / mtho ris dang thar pa gnyis sha'am gang rung re re mi 'jo+od pa'i chad smra dang / 'dod kyang rgya byed pa po rtag dngos dang cha med sogs khas len pa'i rtag smra gnyis su 'dus te/ nye ba mngon sum la snang tshod las gzhan pa thed par 'dzin pa dang / ring ba gtan tshigs ltar snang la brten pa'i lkog gyur blos btags la bden par 'dzin pa'i dbye bas so/ /gnyis pa rang sde la sde pa bco brgyad sems tsam rnam bden rdzun sogs mang yang phyi don smra ba dang sems tsam pa gnyis su 'dus te/ mngon sum gzhan rig phyi rol rgyang chad du 'dzin pa 'di la gnod pa can gyi tshad ma ma mthong nas ji ltar snang ba ltar don dam du grub pa 'dod pa dang / de las blo mchog tu gyur pas de la gnod pa mthong yang / kha nang ltas myong rig tsam du snang ba 'di la gnod pa gang yang ma mthong zhing 'khor lo tha ma phal cher gyis de ston par mthong nas snang ba shes rig tsam du 'dod pa'i dbye bas so/ /de ltar lhan skyes 'khral ba dbang du btsugs nas grub mtha' 'jog pa po phyi nang de dag ni / 'khrul pa la 'khrul pa bsnan nas rtag chad gang rung gi mthar sogs su lhung ste lhan skyes 'khrul ba'i 'dzin stangs lung rig ltar snang la brten bden zhen gyis 'bad pas bsgrudros nas lhan skyes kyi sa bon drung po lung rig gi brlan dang drod kyis

brtags kyi zhen yul de lhan skye ngar 'dzin gyi rten nam yul du mi 'dod na skyon de yod par gsungs pa'am/ lung rig ltar snang gis brtan par byas pa'i kun brtags kyi bdag de/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi rten da dgos na/ bskal pa rang pori sdod 'gror skyes pa sogs la lhan skyes mi srid par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa la dgongs pa'o/ /grub mtha' kun shes las le'u dang po rgya cher bshad pa'o// //bdag lta'i 'dzin stangs so sor dgag pa la/ gangashā ga gi bdag dgag pa dang / chos kyi bdag dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ phyi rol pa'i 'dod pa spyir bstan/ so sor bshad/ zhar byung gzhan yang dgag pa dang thun mong du dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi rol sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ spyir sems can gyi rigs ni shes bya'i gnas tshul dang 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi ngang tshul la rtog dpyod gang yang mi 'jug par tshe 'di'i bde sdug gi blang dor tsam don du gnyer ba ni ngan song gi 'gro ba gsum dang lha mi phal che ba yin la/ de dag 'bum phrag tsam gyi nang na de dag la rtog cing grub mtha' la zhugs pa ni re re tsam du zad do/ /de dag kyang 'og ma 'og ma ni ches mang la/ gong ma gong ma ni ches nyung ste/ jo bo chen pos/ ding sang rgya gar na mu stegs kyi grub mtha' la mkhas pa brgya brgya'i tshe cha bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' shes pa re re/ de brgya brgya na mdo sde pa re re/ de brgya brgya na sems tsam rnam bden pa re re/ de brgya brgya na rnam rdzun pa re re/ de brgya brgya na dbu ma rang rgyud pa re re/ de brgya brgya na zla ba grags pa'i lugs shes pa re re tsam las med

ra༅༅/ /ces gsungs nga ltar ro/ /de ltar na phyi rol rgyang 'phen gyi grub mtha' shes pa yang sems can gyi rigs ni shin tu nyung bar snang ste/ mir skyes pa tsam yang shin tu dkon pas so/ /de la phyi rol pa 'i nges tshig ni / bstan pa 'di dang ston pa 'di las phyi rol tu phyogs te/ 'jig rten pa'i shes rab kyis shes bya'i don la dpyod par byed pa yin lugs kyi mya nganalas 'das pa dang rjes su mthun nga 'i lam med pa'o/ /'on kyang de la cung zad nye bar gyur pas thar pa'i mu dang stegs la gnas pas mu stegs zhes bya bas na 'jig rten phal pa las ni ches mchog tu gyur te/ shes bya'i gnas lugs spyod pa la sogs pas so/ /mtshan nyid ni/ (sto sgom spyod 'bras bzhi'i sgo nas sangs rgyas pa'i ldog mthar gnas pa'i grub mtha' smra ba po'o/ kho ba'i dbye ba ni/ bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rig pa'i ral gris/ de 'dra'i mu stegs rang rgyud la/ /bsam gtan pa dang rtog ge gnyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi mngon shes lnga ldan te/ ji skad du/ drang srong chen po lnga mngon shes/ /mkha' la ring du 'gro ba yang / /gang du 'chi ba yod min pa'i/ /go 'phang der ni 'gro ba med/ /ces bshad pa ltar ro/ /de yang ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo dang rtog ge 'bar ba sogs nas/ bsam gtan pa blo dman 'bring mchog gsum gyis bskal pa sum cu dang drug cu dang dgu bcu rjes su dran par bshad la/ de 'dra ba rnams ni 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas byung zhing / rtog ge pa yang spyir de dang 'dra

'bab pa dang / /sranazlumatsher ma gzang ring rno me rdeng / /rma bya'i mjug bkra la sogs dngos rnams kun/ /rgyu yod ma yin ngo bo nyid las byung / /zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin don gcig pas chad smra sogs ming gi rnam grangs brgyad do/ /ston pa ni/ spyir rengs byed kyi bu lhag spyod la sogs pa snyoms 'jug pa drug bram ze tshangs pa'i tshe'am rgyus rgyal la sogs pa rjes sgrog pa drug khyad par rtog ge pa drug ni/ 'od srungs rdzogs byed dang / yang dag rgyal ba can dang / mi pham skya'i lwa ba can dang / ka ti'i bu nog can dang / gnag lhas kyi bu kun tu rgyu dang / gnyen gyi bu gcer bu pa ste ston pa drug tu grags pa ste/ 'di dag so so'i 'dod pa ni/ 'dul ba lung gi mchog zung dang 'od srungs chen po sogs kyis dris pa na gsal lo/ /yongs su grags shing sngon du bstan bcos byed pa po ni/ drang srong lha'i bla ma phur bu pa sum cu rtsa mi/sum du lha min las g.yul rgyal du re nas skye ba snga phyi dang dge sdig med par ston pa'i bstan bcos byas shing / de nas rim gyis 'phel te mi yul du babs pa las btus pas drang srong 'jig rten mig gis brtsams pa'i rtsa ba la/ slob dpon chos grags dang dus mnyam du byung ba'i drang srong 'jug stobs kyis 'grel ba byas nas 'phel lo 3sa/ dbu ma spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las bshad do/ kho bar de gnyis go rim ldog pa ni tshig sbyor bde ba'i ched de/ zhi ba lha dang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ /zhes sogs bzhin no/ /de ltar ston pa de dag sga rjes su 'brang ngo / /grub mtha'i dngos

ra༅༅/ /kyi rgyu ni/ ji tsam dbang po'i spyod yul ba/ /skyes bu'ang de tsam kho nar zad/ /bzang mo mang thos gang smra ba/ /de dag spyang ki'i rjes dang mtshungs/ /zhes rang gi bu mo la bgrod par 'dod nas smras pa lta bu 'dod yon sogs so/ /dam bca' ni/ bsgrub pa bzhi dang dgag pa lnga ste/ 'byung ba rgyu dus na mi gsal ba'i bdag dang / 'bras bu kun lus sems rdzas gnyig tu mngon du gyur pa gsal ba'i bdag dang / mi gsal ba 'byung bzhi'i 'gro ba gsal ba mi dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba ste 'gro ba gsum yin gyi lha dang dpyal sogs med par 'dod pas 'gro ba gsum du bsgrub pa dang / rang nyid rjes dpag mi 'dod pas gtan tshigs med kyang gzhan la grags pa'i gtan tshigs kyi 'god tshul/ bum pa chos can / lus sems rdzas gcig pa'i bu dang bum pa gang rung gi zla dang bcas pa yin te/ āt+pa la min pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rtsig pa bzhin zhes sogs sgrub par byed la/ spyir rgyu med dang / gal te rgyu yod na'ang / skye ba yongs su len pa na/ /'byung rngub dbang po blo dag ni/ /rang gi rigs la ltos med par/ /luganyid 'ba' zhig dag las skye/ /zhes pa ltar skye ba snga ma dang / gang gang 'chi sems de dang de/ /skye ba gzhan du rjes 'gro med/ /'chi sems yin pa'i phyir na dper/ /nyes bral 'chi kha'i rig pa bzhin/ /zhes skye ba phyi ma 'gog pa dang / ji ltar tsher ma la sogs rdzi /rno ba nyid sogs rgyu med de/ /glo bur ba nyid yin pa ltar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal sogs rgyu med/ /ces las 'bras 'gog pa

dang / blo ni lus la brten pa'i phyir/ /goms pas grub pa med/ ces thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas med la/ de med par des gsungs pa'i chos dang dge 'dun med ces dkon mchog gsum 'gog pa dang / ji tsam dbang po'i spyod yal ba / /zhes sogs kyis tshad ma mngon sum gcig pu las med pas mtho ris dang dpyal ba sogs ma mthong ba'i dngos po 'gog pa dang / rjes dpag ni tshad ma ma yin te/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dngos po 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir dang / lha sbyin sh+lau ba las sdab sangs dpog pa sogs gtan tshigs thams cad 'khrul ba'i phyir zhes rjes dpag tshad ma 'gog par byed do/ /de dag las kyang dgag pa lnga pa des bzhi pa ma mthong ba'i dngos po b.lag pa de bsgabs nas de dang ni/ gong gi 'byang bzhim bdag la sogs pa bsgrub pa bzhi yis dgag pa lnga'i dang po skye ba snga phyi med pa de sgrub cing de grub pa yis dam bca' lhag ma mtha' dag grub par 'dod pa rnams ni 'dod pa mdor bsdus te brjod pa/ rnam 'gril le'u gnyis pa'i phyogs snga/ dngos sa yod pa dang med kyang 'gog byed kyi rig pa rnams dang sbyar bas gsal lo/ /de dgag pa ni/ lnga pas bzhi pa sgrub pa'i bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis ka mi 'thad de/ kun gyis thams cad du ma mthong ba'i dngos po mi srid cing 'ga' zhig gis 'gadro zhig tu ma mthong so/gas nas 'gal ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang tshad ma gtan med du 'gyur te/ rjes dpag mi 'dod la mngon sum yang 'gog par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ 'byung ba dang sems gnyis gzhan rig gis mthong mi mthong dang / rang reg

ra༅༅/ /gis myong mi myong so sor snang bzhin du gcig tu 'dod pa'i phyir na'o/ /spyir rgyun dang ldan pa'i sems chos can/ rang rgya snga ma sngon du song ba dang rang 'bras phyi ma skyed par nges te/ sems yin pa'i phyir/ dpe da lta tshe 'di'i sems kyis mtshon no/ /de bzhin du brda la ma byang ba'i byis pa chung ngu chos can/ chags sogs skye ba snga ma rnams su goms par gsal lto/ bslab mi dgos par chags yul la 'jug pa'i phyir/ rig pa bem po'i nyer len las mi skye ste / bem rig nyer len so sor nges pa'i phyir ro/ /yang zhes pa tshig gcig pu 'dis don gzhan yang ston pa ste/ de ltar skye ba snga phyi grub tu chug kyang / thams cad mkhyen pa mi grub bo zhe na/ dngos po'i gshis la zhugs pa'i thabs shes khyad par gyi blo chos can/ goms rkyen khyad par can dang ma bral bar yun ring du goms na gsal snang khyad par can 'byung ste/ rten brtan cing goms rkyen dang nyer len rigs mi mthun la mi ltos par nges pa'i sems kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ dper na / chags sogs goms pa las je gsal du mthong ba bzhin te/ 'dod 'jigs mya ngan gyis brlams dang / /rkun po rmi sogs kyis bslad pa/ /mdun na gnas pa ji bzhin du/ /yang dag min pa'ang mthong b.ra'agyur/ /zhes sogs so/ /mi gsal ba'i 'gro ba khas len pa ni rtog ge pa mtha' dag gi gtsug rgyan du mi 'thad do/ /de 'dra khas len pa ni grangs can pa dang de las kyang blun pa'i phyugs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ khu sogs rtse na glang chen brgya/ /sngon tshe ma mthong yod do

zhes / /de skad grangs can phyugs las gzhan/ /ngo tshar bcas pa su brjod stsol/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ dbye ba mdor bstan ni/ mu stegs rtag smra ni sde bzhi ste/grangs can sogs kyi phyir ro/ /'di bzhi yang dug /pha༅ba dang / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug shas che ba dang rim bzhin sbyar la/ skro bshad ni 'og tu so sor 'chad do/ /mtshan nyid so sor brjod pa la bzhi las/ grangs can la 'dod pa brjod pa la yang / rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ ston pa / grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni/shes bya grangs su bcad pa la nan to du byed pas dang / rdul mun snying stobs kyi yon tan cha mkho pa rang bzhin dang mi mkho pa rnam 'gyur du 'dod pas dang / drang srong ser skya'i bu brgyud yin zhing de'i rjes su 'grangs pas dang / gzhung lugs sum cu pa zhes bya ba mchog tu 'dzin cing bdag gi rnam grangs sum cu 'dod pas dang / da ltar gyi snang ba 'di thams cad gtso bos byas shing de'i rang bzhin du gnas par smra ba rnams kyis grangs can pa sogs so / /gdung la lar grangs can pa dang ser skya ba tha dad du byas pa'ang snang ste/slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/grangs can sgra rnams yon smo med/ /ser skya pa rnams stongs pa'i tshul/ /zhes dang / grub chen sman zhabs pas/ bdag gi rnam grangs sum cu las/ dus las byung ba dang 'dod rgyal dang gnam gyis bskos pa dang gyi na bzhi ni grangs can gyi 'dod pa yin no/ /rnal 'byor dang tshad ma dang / dag pa dang ma dag pa bzhi ni ser skya'i 'dod pa yin no/ /thes dang /'od lngan

ra༅༅/ /las kyang / gang dag grangs can dang ser skya la sogs pa'i bstan bcos de kho na nyid yin pa'i blos 'don pa de dag la ni yul zhabor gyi bsod snyoms dug tu 'gyur ro zhes bshad mod/ ser skya'i mnga' zhabs spyi dang drung skor lta bur mngon no/ /dbye na/ mngon gsal smra ba lha med pa dang / rnam 'gyur smra ba lhar bcas zhes kyang bya ba gnyis so/ /don ni/ 'o ma zho'i rang bzhin du gnas pa rkyen gyis mngon par gsal pa rang bzhin nam/ gtso bo'i rgyu tsam las byung ba yin gyi blo sngon du gtong ba'i lha gzhan med pa dang / de gnyis rang bzhin gcig kyang rnam 'gyur tha dad du song ba ni gtso bor ma zad lha chen dbang phyug gis blo sngon du btang nas kyang byas zhes sma la 'dis ni shes bya tshig gi don drug kyang 'dod do/ /'on kyang dbang phyug par ni mi 'gyur te/ gco bo bden zhen gyis 'dod pas so/ /ston pa ni/ sngon tshe lo dpag med kyi dus su drang srong ser skya zhes bya bas bsti gnas su bsgoms pas mras stegs kyis thar pa thob par rlom nas rang gis mthong ba'i de nyid gzhan la ston par 'dod nas grangs can gyi bstan bcos byas shing / phyis rnal 'byor dpyod pa dbang phyug lhar 'dzin pa'i drang srong chu klung gis kyang dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud sum cu pa dang drug cu pa sogs byas pas na ser skya sogs so/ /grub mtha' mdor bstan ni/ 'jal byed tshad ma gsum gyis gzhal bya'i shes bya nyer lnga 'jal bar 'dod do/ /rgyas bshad la/ 'jal byed gsum las mngon sum tshad ma ni dbang po'i 'jug pa la 'dod de/ de yang rna ba dang pags

gsum cha mnyam pa byed pa po yin la rtag pa dang gcig pu dang kun la khyab cing 'on kyang rgyu brgyad kyis mi gsal te/ khyab tshul ni til la til mar bzhin dang / rgyu brgyad ni/ ha cang nye phyir ring phyir dang / /cha phra'i phyir dang bsgribaso sbyer dang wa/zil gnon phyir dang 'dres phyir dang / /dbang po nyams phyir yid med phyir/ /zhes bshad do/ /rnam 'gyur 'bras bu bsdus pa'i gtso bo ni nyer gsum ste/ rgyu'i gtso bo de'i dngos 'bras mang la blo'am chen po ste blo zhes kyang zer/ chen po zhes kyang zer skabs la lar nang gi byed pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /de ni me long ngos gnyis pa lta bu shel ltar gsal zhing dwangs pa yul rnam 'gyur gyi tshogs dang shes pa bdag gi gzugs brnyan gnyis ka phyi nang nas 'char bas gzugs brnyan gnyis 'dres pa ni gzhal bya mngon gyur gyi mtshan gzhi dang / gzugs brnyan gtod pa po'i yul shes gnyis ni lkog gyur gyi mtshan gzhi ste de gnyis nyid du nges pa ste/ mang la blo zhes 'dogs kyang sems med pa'i bems por 'dod de/ sems pa ni rgyun la 'jig mi srid pa'i bdag gcig pu yin gyi skye 'jig srid pa rnams sems med du 'dod do/ /chen po'am blo lda la sogs te/ yul gdung sim bar mar myong ba'i sdug bde btang snyoms gsum po de rdul las gyur pa dang / rnam 'gyur las gyur pa dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i nga rgyal gsum yin pa'i phyir te/ rim bzhin rmongs pa dang 'dod chags dang g.yo ba shas che ba'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ nga rgyal de gsum gyis dngos ngang brgyung pa'i 'bras bu skyed tshul ni/ ngang po rdul/ 'a/sa/ gyur nga li nga rgya'༈

ra༅༅/ /gyis sgra sogs zhes te sla'o/ /de skad du yang dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud las/ rang bzhin las chen de las nga rgyal yin/ /de las tshogs ni rnam pa bcu drug go /bcu drug pa ni de dag rnams las kyang / /lnga po rnams las 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /zhes bshad do/ /de ltar yul shes gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan blo la shar ba ni shes pas yul za zhing spyod pa'i don te/ blo la shar ba'i don ni skyes bus shes par byed do/ /zhes so/ /de ltar shes bya thams cad yul shes gnyis su bsdus pa'i yul las gzhan pa ni shes pa yin pa la bsams nas/ mig sogs yul gyis bsdas pa rnams chos can/ gzhan gyi don byed de/ 'dus shing bsags pa'i phyir/ mal cha dang stan la sogs pa bzhin no/ /zhes pas bdag sgrub par byed de/ bdag la chos can gyi don dang rtags kyi don gnyis ka ma tshang bas so/ /gnyis pasna / rgyu dang rang bzhin ming gi rnam grangs dang 'bras bu dang rnam 'gyur ming gi rnam grangs su byas pa'i mu bzhi las thog ma ni gco bo dang / bdun ni blo dang nga rgyal dang de tsam lnga'o/ /bcu drug ni lhag ma rnams so/ /de skad du yang / rtsa ba byed yin bya ba min/ /chen po sogs bdun bya dang byed/ /bcu drug po ni bya ba nyid/ /skyes bu bya min byed pa'ang min/ /zhes so/ /bden gnyis su bsdu ba ni/ thog sogs te/ drang srong ser skyas/ yon to rnams kyi rang bzhin mchog /snang ba'i lam du 'gyur ma yin/ /snang ba'i lam du gang gyur de/ /sgya ma lta bur shin tu gsog zhes bshad de/ kun rdzob rang stong sgra bshad

snang ba lta bu dang / don dam gzhan stong 'od gsal bden grub ces zer ba dang rjes su mthun te de yang sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i gzhung lugs dang shin tu nye'o/ /rnam 'gyur 'di dag la sim gdung bar mar snang ba'i rtags kyis de skyed pa'i gtso bo rang bzhin nam yon tan gsum ldan dbog par 'dod de/ ji ska da du/ rangs dang mgu dang kun dga' dang / /bde zhing zhi ba'i sems nyid dag /res 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag snying stobs yon tan no/ /mi dga' yongs sa gdung ba dang / /mya ngan 'dod dang mi bzod dag /gang du snang ba'i gtan tshigs kun/ /de dag rdul gyi gtan tshigs 'dod/ /rmongs dang de bzhin gti mug dang / /bag med gnyid dang g.yel ba dang / /lan 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /sdo dag mun pa'i yon tan 'dod/ /ces so/ /'bras bu thar pa ni/ bdag shes rig gis sogs te/ gtso bo skyengs te rnam 'gyur rnams rang gi rang bzhin ngang du bsdus nas bdag gcig pu zla med du gyur pa thar pa thob par 'dod do/ /thar lam ni/ de nyid nyer lnga legs par shes pa de la sogs te/ de nyid nyi shu lnga shes na/ /ral pa'am byi boco da pan sogs/ /cha lugs gang gis gnas gyur kyang / /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces so/ /de dgag pa ni/ thar pa thob pa'i tshe skyed byed gtso bo ma log bzhin du skyed 'bras rnam 'gyur rnams 'gag pa mi 'thad de/ rgyu sogs 'gal ba'i phyir/ gtso bo ni gcig tu bden pa min par tha'4/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum yin pa'i phyir/ blo bde chos can/ bem po ma yin par thal/ myong

ra༅༅/ /ba'i ngobo ra skyes pa'i phyir/ bdag chos can/ rtag pa ma yin par thal/ shes rig yin pa'i phyir/ khyod la bcings bzhin pa las grol ba'i thar pa mi srid par thal/ rtag pa'i phyir de ltar na grangs can gyi grub mtha' phal cher ni don la med bzhin du blos btags pas rjes 'jug slu bar byed pa yin la/ rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su 'dod pa'i kun rdzob thams cad rdzun pa slu chos su 'dod pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ni 'thad par yang rung zhing / dngos po'i gnas lugs la blo kha cung zad kyang ma phyogs pa'i blun dad tsam sgom pa las ni gnas lugs mthong ba la nye ru song bas mtha' gcig tu sdang smra mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbang phyug pa dgag pa la yang gnyis las/ 'dod pa rngod pa la/ rnam grangs/ ston pa / dbye ba/ grub mtha' dngos so/ dang po ni/ ming gi rnam grangs dbang phyug pa zhes sogs drug ste/ dang po gsum lha chen gyi ming gi mngon rjod yin la de lhar 'odzin pas de dang de'i ming ngo / /ye nas srid pa zhes pa ni/ snod bcud gdod ma nas 'dis byas zhes smra bas so/ /tha ma gnyis ni/ mig btsums nas rnal 'byor sgom pa dang / zhug pa'i sgro gos su rgyu+on pas so/ /ston pa ni/ lha chen kyis u ma'i srung ma la drang srong mdzes pa brtul zhugs grub pa zhig bzhag pa na/ de la u ma chags nas mdun du 'dug ste chags tshul du ma bstan pas/ des mig rang gi rkang pa la phab ste brtul zhugs bsrungs pas dbang phyug mnyes nas gzhung lugs rtsom pa por dbang bskur ba dang / gzhan gyis bor ba'i gzegs ma za zhing

brtul zhugs spyad pas dbang phyug grub ste sa/zhung mang du tshims pas/ de gnyis la ming de ltar du grags pas so/ /bstan brla ni/ dbang phyug i kyis stod pa'i zhi ba'i rgyud dang dbang phyug nag tsho rgyud dang / gzegs zan rnya bstan bcos mang po rnams la 'chad wo du byed do/ /dbye ba na bzhi ste/rigs sogs so/ /grub mtha' la gzhi lam 'bras gsum las/ dang po la/ lha dang / tshad ma dang / gzhal bya'o/ /dang po ni/ lha chen dbang phyug ni shes bya kun mkhyen pa/ gnas gangs te se'i ri'i steng na 'byor pas brgyan pa'i stan la 'dug cing / u ma dang khyu mchog la sogs pa'i 'khor gyi tsho+ogs stong gis bskor ba mtsho ma dros pa nas 'ongs pa'i dgra bcom pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig gnas zhes/lha las phul byung gi 'grel patsho slob dpon shes rab go chas bshad do/ /lha chen de'i yon tan ni dbang phyug brgyad ldan te/ dbu ma spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las/lag pa dag dang rkang pa dag /mig dang bzhin dang lus rnams kyis/ /mang po byed cing 'jig byed pas/ /des na phra bar brjod pa yin/ /nam mkha' rlung dang sa dang ni/ /chu dang me dag gnas byed cing / /sdud pa dang ni rgyas byed pas/ /des na yang bar brjod pa yin/ /'byung po kun la dbang byed cing / /gnas pa dang ni rgyu ba dag /gang dang gang 'dod de byed pas/ /des na bdag por gyur pa yin/ /bdag la rag lus rang dbang can/ /'ga' yang 'jig pa yod ma yin/ /thams cad dbang du gyur pas na/ /des na dbang du gyur pa yin/ /yul dang

ra༅༅/ /bza' ba bca' ba dang / /gzhan yang yid kyis gang bsams pa/ /yid kyi rjes 'gro mi sdod pas/ /des na gar yang phyin zhes bya/ /'jig rten gsum na mchog gyur cing / /gnas pa dag dang rgyu ba dang / /'byung po kun gyis brjed pas na/ /des na mchod par bya ba yin/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa gsum/ /de dag gang la gnas gyur pa/ /mig 'byed tsam gyis byed gyur pas/ /des na 'dod dgur ldan zhes bya/ /thar pa'am yang na lha yi lus/ /gang du bdag nyid 'dod gyur pa/ /thams cad 'dod pas thob 'gyur pa/ /des na dga' mgur gnas zhes bya/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ /des snod sogs ni/ snod bcud 'di chos can/ dbang phyug gis blo sngon du btang nas byas te/ sngod cing 'jug pa'i phyir dang / sogs pa dbyibs dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / don byed nus pa'i phyir zhes dang / ser sna can la longs spyod dang gtong phod can dbul po dang dge ba can sdag bsngal dang sdig pa can bde ba dang ldan pa rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu 'chol pas grub ste/ yon tan nor ldan tshe thung dang / /ngan par spyod rnams tshe ring dang / /gtong ldan dbul bo mthong bas na/ /dbang phyug gis byas gsal ba yin/ /zhes soges bshad do/ /gzhung gzhan nas ni dbang phyug de nyid gzugs can min pa dang rnam pa gsum gyi srid pa khyab pa'i gnas na gnas pa dang mdud pa sogs tshan pa gsum ni khyim bcu gnyis dang / yul gzugs la 'jug pa'i lam mig ces sogs yid kyi bar drug dang / sa sogs 'byung ba'i de nyid lnga

dang / gzhan yang sngags dang / 'dod pa dang / bdag dang / zhi ba'i de nyid de bzhi dang thig le zhi ba chos su smra bar gsungs la/ dbang phyug sgra bsgrags kyi rgyud las/ dbang phyug nus/ ma mnyam sbyor bas/ /med du byung ba'i bde ba skye/ /nus can tshul gyis bsgoms pa yis/ /yang dag tu na dngos po med/ /nus can ma yin stong nyid lta/ /sgro 'dogs thams cad rnam 'joms pa'o/ /zhes dang / dbang phyug 'khrig pa grub pa las/ /dbu ma'i ye sheg skye bar 'dod/ /bam pa can gyi rlung gis ni/ /bskal ba'i bar du 'chi med sgrub/ /ces pa ltar 'khrig pa chos su smra zhing / rlung gi rnal 'byor ma nga po yang bshad do/ /yang gzhung gzhan nas/ lha chen 'di ri rab kyi byang shar thod pa dgu brtsegs kyi pho brang na/ zlob 'jug dang dga' byed dbang phyug la sogs pa pho dang / dbu ma dang drug ldan ma la sogs pa mi'i 'khor nyi shu rtsa re re dang / gzhan yang gnod sbyin dang rims kyi bdag mo la sogs pa du mas bskor nas gnas pa dang / khyab 'jug gis ser skyar spal nas rgyal po drug can gyi bu drug khri bsad nas dpyal bar shor/ de dag gi tsha bo bha gī ra tha zhes bya bas tshangs pa bsgrubs nas/ lha'i chu bo gaṅgā mi yul du phab pa/ lha chen 'di'i ral pa bkram pas lo stong gi bar du bgor/ des dbang phyugasnya da la gsol ba btab ste ral pa btsir ba'i thigs pa gakhog te se'i steng du babs pa mtshor gyur pa las gaṅgā sogs chu klung bdun byung / gaṅgā lha chen gyi bsnyi gnas shig tu babs pa na lha chen khros te 'thungs/ yang gsol ba btab pas slar skyags

ra༅༅/ /pas 'og tu song bas dug can gyi bu rnams kyi sdig pa bkrus nas tshe 'phos nas mtho ris su skyes pa sogs kyi rnam thar yod pas/ lha 'di ni lus dang rdzu 'phrul shin tu che'o zhes smra'o/ /'dis 'jig rten sprul tshul ni / 'jig rten 'di zhig nas nam mkha' stongs par gyur pa'i tshe/ 'dis snod bcud byed 'dod kyi blo skyes pa na/ bar snang gi rdul phran rtag pa snang mi rung du gnas pa rnams phan tshun phrad de se gol gtogs pa'i bar la 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor grub cing / me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gser gyi sgo nga zhig byung ba brtol ba'i nang nas tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa pad+ma'i mngal na gnas pa zhig byung ba des 'jig rten thams cad byas pas na dbang phyug gis byas zer ro/ /tshad ma ni bzhi las mngon sum ni/ rig pa can pa rnam med kyi sgo nas khyad par yon tan 'dzin pa'i rtog par 'dod la/ de tshad ma dang des drangs pa'i khyad par can rdzas 'dzin pa'i blo ni 'bras bur 'dod do/ /bye brag pa ni/ mngon sum shes pa ma yin gyi dbang don phrad pa'i 'brel pa tsam du zad la/ de tshad ma dang de las don nges pa 'bras bur 'dod do/ /rjes dpag gi rang don la yang / rig pa can pa/ sprin 'dus pa las char 'bab pa dang / mdar chu grub pa las phur char bab par dang / du ba las me yod par dbog pa gsum snga ma can dang lhag ma can dang spyir mthong ba'i rjes dpag ces zer la/ bye brag pa ni/ rig byed rgyas pa 'don pa las rgyang ring po shes par dang / zla ba shar ba las rgya mtsho 'phel bar dang / ston ma'i chu dwangs pa las skar

ma ri byi mo 'char bar dbog pa lta bu rnams rtags yang dag dang / khyab 'brel med pa dang / chos rtags tha mi dad pa dang / khyab 'brel the tshom za ba gsum ltar snaje ste/ ma grubapadang med pa dang the tshom can zhes smra'o/ /gzhan don rjes dpag ni / sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan no/ /nyer 'jal ni/ ba lang ci 'dra zhes 'dri na ba men 'dra'o zhes pas ba lang rtogs pa lta bu'o/ /sgra byung tshad ma ni/ dbang phyug ni thams cad mkhyen te/ thams cad kyi byed pa po yin pa'i phyir/ dper na rdza mkhan gyis rdza la dgos pa thams cad shes pa bzhin no zhes bsgrubs nas/ dbang phyug gi lung thams cad der 'dod do/ /gzhal bya ni/ tshad ma de bzhis/ rdzas dang yon tan dang las dang spyi dang bye brag dang / 'du sogs so/ /de ltar shes bya tshig gi don drug ste/ rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /byebrag 'du ba drug yin no/ /zhes so/ /drug ga bden grub tu 'dod de/ zhi ba 'tshos tshad ma'i de kho na nyide bsdus par/ rdzas la sogs pa'i don drug ni/ /dam pa'i don du yod pa'i phyir / /zhes so/ de ltar drug las rdzas ni dgu ste/ 'byung ba bzhi dang nam mkha' dang dus dang phyogs dang bdag dang yi da rnams so/ /de dag rtag mi rtag tu baji na/ 'byung sogs tshad du grags pa 'jig rten stongs pa'i tshe snang mi rung du gnas pa de dang sogs rdzas yin la 'byung bzhi'i rdul gyis brtsams pa'i rags pa ni mi rtag pa'i rdzas so/ /drug po kun kyang rdzas yod bden grub tu bshad zin to/ /rnom mkha' ni sgra'i yon tan rtag rdzas thams cad du khyab pa'o/ /dus ni/ 'byang

ra༅༅/ /ba rnams kyang dus kyis 'byin/ /skye rgu rnams sdud dus kyis byed/ /dus kyis gnyid log sad byed phyir/ /dus ni shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /zhes sogs dus can gyi dngos po rnams las rdzas tha dad pa bya ba kun gyi byed pa po'o/ /phyogs kyang shar sogs te de bzhin no/ /bdag ni lus dang dbang po dang blo sogs las rdzas tha dad dang thams cad la khyab kyang gson lus kho na la gnas pa'o/ /yid ni blorto ga bcas rtag dngos so/ /des na bdag sogs so/ /yon tan ni nyi shu lnga ste/ de yang bdag gi yid kyi yon tan bcu gsum ste/ dbang shes lnga'i blo lnga dang bde sdug dang chags sdang dang chos chos min dang 'dus byas pa dang 'bad pa'i shugs rnams so/ /dus phyogs kyi yon tan bdun te/ grangs dang bongs tshod so so ba dang phrad pa dang bye ba dang gzhan dang gzhan ma yin pa rnams so/ /'byung bzhi dang nam mkha'i yon tan lnga ste dri ro gzugs reg sgra rnams so/ /las ni 'degs sogs lnga/ spyi ni ngo bo cha med rtag rdzas yod pa nyid dang ba glang nyed lta bu khyab dang nyi tshe ba gnyis rka'ang kha sogs so/ gsal ba yod sar 'gro ba dpe thar ra'i lugs dang / gsal ba yod med kun tu rjes su 'gro ba dpe lug ku'i lugs tha dad 'dod do/ /bye brag ni dkar po dang nag po sogs so/ /'du ba rne / spyi dang gsal ba rdzas dang yon tan rten dang brten pa/ khyad par dang khyad par can rnams sbrel byed kyi 'brel pa 'brel po las don gzhan te/ de yang 'byor pa'i/ ldan pa'i/ 'phrod 'du'i/ 'du ba'i ldan pa'i/ ldan pa'i 'phrod 'du'i 'brel

rnams 'chad cing nyan no/ /dbye ba tshangs sogs lnga las dpyod pa ba ni thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'dod pas de las gzhan sogs so/ /grub mtha' ni/ kun kyang khyab 'jug ltar 'dzin cing / de'i khyad chos ni/ lha chen khyab 'jug ces /gra ba lha'i drang srong chen po nor lha sred med ces bya ba dang lha mo gtum mo'i bu yin cing / rgya mtsho'i nang na sgo ldan zhes bya ba'i grong na rang gi chung ma dpal mo la sogs pa bud med khri drug stong la sogs pa mang pos bskor te gnas pa/ nye dbang dang gos ser can la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dngos sogs yin par khas len te/ des/ nyi ma'i nang na nga khyab 'jug /skar nang 'od ldan zla ba ste/ /rlung nang nga ni 'od zer can/ /snang ba'i nang na nyi ma yin/ /rig byed nang na snyan tshig dang / /lha nang nga ni brgya byin yin/ /zhes pa nas/ ri yi nang na ri rab dang / /nga ni yi ge'i nang na a/ /zhes smras pa'i phyir ro/ /de bram ze sogs te/ nga ni bram ze'i lus gnas nas/ /za bar byed cing sbyin par byed/ /nga ni sbyin byed za ba po/ /nga ni zas dang skye dgu'i bdag /ces kyang smras pas so/ /dbye ba lha tshogs te/ chos sku dang gzungs sku'i rnam pa'o/ /dang po sogs te/ gang gi khyab 'jug yon tan rnams/ /rtag tu bsgoms pas bde thob 'gyur/ /zhes dang / skal ldan nor lha 'di ni thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs/ /'gro ba thams cad lhar 'dren thar pa sbyin par byed/ /nor lha stobs bzang 'chi med la sogs ngo bor gnas/ /skye dgu thar par bkod nas

ra༅༅/ /'khor pa stongs par byed/ /ces bshad de/ 'dis kyang 'khor ba zad mtha' can du 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ma zhi bas khyab sogs te/ nya sogs bcu ru sprul pa yis rim pa bzhin du/ sngon dus kyi dbang gis rig byed bzhi rgya mtsho'i nang du nub pa ston pa dang / rus sbal gyi gzugs kyis 'jig rten bteg nas rgyun du gnas pa dang / phag rgod kyi gzugs kyis tshangs/ pa'i 'jig rten man chad mnan pa dang / mi'i seng ge'i gzugs kyis lha min gyi dbang po 'gro ba skyong gser can bsad pa dang mi'u thung du sprul nas lha min stobs ldan gom pa gsum gyis blang zhes bslus pa dang / dza mā da asne'i bu dga' byed du sprul nas rgyal bu srid sgrub la sogs pa bsad nas rgyal rigs med par byas pa dang / rgyal po shing rta bcu pa'i bu rā ma ṇar sprul nas rame sga chung ma srin po lang ka mgrin bcus phrogs pas/ spre'u ha nu man+dha la grogs bcol te srin po btul ba dang / nag pas rtsod pa'i dus su sems can gye don byas pa dang / sangs rgyas staka thub tu sprul nas sngon rgyal rig bsad pa'i sdig pa sbyangs pa dang / rigs ldan bram ze'i bu kur ki rtse zhes bya ba ma 'ongs pa na 'byung bas sems can mang po btul ba'i mthar dus log pa rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang dang po gsum la sgro gdags gzhi 'thad ldan med kyang gtam rgyud rnying pa rdzun ma la brten pa dang / gzhan rnams ngo mtshar che che rnams khyab 'jug gis sprul bar sgro 'dogs pa'o/ /rgyu mtshan de ltar nas byas shing rtag sogs bstan te/ ji skad du/ lus ni rnying po spangs nas

su / /lus gzhan gsar pa len byed pa'i/ /bdag ni mtshon gyis mi chod cing / /mes kyang mi 'tshig chus mi 'drul/ /zhes dang / sems rtag dngos la bdag dam pa nor lha'i bu zhes sgro btags pa'i sgyer dang 'thab dka' rlag par byed pa'i dus su/ gang gis mi ni bsad pa dang / /gang zhig gsod par byed pa dang / /de dag gnyis ka mi dmigs te/ /bsad dang gsod po yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs chad lta smras pa'i phyir ro/ /so sor brjod pa la lnga las tshangs pa ba ni/ lha chen tshangs pa de skye gnas gsum par smra ste/ sngar bshad pa ltar dbang phyug yis blos sprul pa'i sgo nga dang / yang na khyab 'jug gi lta ba'i pad+ma dang / yang na des dang por chu'i dkyil 'khor sprul zhing der sa bon bcug pa gser gyi sgo ngar gyur pa las skyed par 'dod pas so/ /de ming bdun dang ldan pa yin te/ bskal pa bdun la rim pa bzhin du/ rang byung / tshangs pa/ skye dgu'i bdag po/ pad+ma'i skye gnas can/ gdong bzhi pa/ mes po/ pad+ma'i snying po can rnams so/ /des 'jig rten gyi ma brgyad bskyed de/ nyi ma'i/ sbyin byed ma'i/ ma'i/ klu'i/ mkha' lding gi ma sogs so/ /de brgyad las rim pa bzhin du lha dang lha min mi snye5 sogs pa rang rang ngo / /de'i lus kyi cha shas snying dang kha/ dpung pa/ brla/ rkang ma/thil/ bzhi 'a/sa mchod sbyin so/gas/ ris byed bzhi dang bram ze rgyal risas rje rigs dam/ngas risas/ mi/ rigs bzhi byung ba de 'dra'i lha chen de spu dkar po/ sha stag yod pa'i rta gtsang ma 'i ma chod so gas so / /yang lugs gzhan

ra༅༅/ /las/ tshangs pa'i kha las skye dgu'i bdag po gsal ba zhes bya ba skyes/ des mchod sbyin zhig byed pa na tshangs pa spyan 'dren pa la rang gi bu mo btang bas tshangs pa chags te khu ba byung ba blugs gzar gyis blangs te mer blugs nas drang srong ngan spong dang e gi ra skyes so/ /lhag ma dur ba'i nang du lus pa las drang srong a ti byung zhing / des snyan ngag gi ri dang srid srung si ri la rigabyed re re byas pa ni snyan tshig dang srid srung / mchod sbyin dang nges brjod gnyis drang srong gzhan gnyis kyis byas te tshangs pa'i bus byas pa la tshangs pas byas zhes kyang 'byung / yang de dag gis kha ton du bton pa tsam yin gyis mi dran pa sogs kyi gtan tshigs las rig byed skyes bus ma byas par 'dod pa yang yod de / gang ltar yang rig byed rnams ni sgra don so sor nges pas sgra nges sbyor dang bcas/ brjod bya la tshad ma skyed pas shes gsal dang bcas/ ā li kā lis brgyan pas yi ge rnam dbye dang bcas/ gzhan yang / rig byed las ni gang mi 'byung / /rig byed las ni gang ma smras/ /thams cad med par shes bya ste/ /rig byed 'dra ba'i thos pa med/ /ces sogs bsngags pa brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dpyod pa pa'am rgyal dpogs pa rnams ni/ grangs can ltar blo bdag 'gal bar mi 'dod kyi blo bdag gcig dang / dbang phyug pa ltar bem por mi 'dod kyi shes rig sogs 'dod cing / chags sogs nyes sogs nas bden pa'i ngag med par 'dod la/ 'jug ngogs bzhi'i yul gyi khrus kyis sdig pa 'dag cing srid sde

dang g.yul dang srog rnams 'bad pas bsrungs namide'angag par 'dod do 'ejal byed tshad ma ni mngon sogs so/ /drug ni mngon sum skad cig gnyis pa phan chad rtog pa dang 'bras bur 'dod pas dang por don la lta ba'i rtog med ni mngon sum mo / /du ba las me dpog pa lta bu 'brel pa mngon sum du shes pa dang lhas byin 'gro bar mthong bas nyi ma yang 'gro bar nges/ pa lta bu 'brel pa spyir mthong ba gnyis ni rjes dpag dang / ba men gyis ba lang dran pa lta bu dang / rig byed kyi tshig las skog gyur shes pa lta bu dang / lhas byin ma shi bzhin du khang nang na med par mthong bas phyi na yod par go ba lta bu dang / chos 'ga' zhig gzhi 'ga' zhig la ma mthong bas der med par rtogs pa rnams ni nyer 'jal sogs so/ don go drug ne+e / tshad ma drug po de rnams kyis drangs pa drug ste/ me tsha bar dang / nyi ma song bar dang / ba glang ba men 'dra bar dang / sgras don rtogs par dang / sgra don 'brel par dang / bum pa med par rtogs pa rnams las rim pa bzhin/ sreg par dang / 'gro bar dang / zho rgal rung bar/ sgra don 'brel par dang / de rtag pa yin par dang / sa phyogs dag pa bar go ba rnams so/ /dngos med bzhi ni/ sngon med pa dang / zhi gnas med pa dang / phan tshun med pa dang / shin tu med pa snge / 'o ma la zho dang zho la 'o ma dang / rta la ba glang dang ri bong la rwa med par rtogs pa rnams so/ /dpyod pa pa de'i sogs ni/ me'i rtags kyis du ba 'grub pas du ba me'i 'bras bur rig pa dang / chags bral ma dmigs pas med par nges pa

ra༅༅/ /dang / stong yod sar brgya yod par nges pa srid pa dang / rgyu mtshan yang dag ma mthong bar gtam rgyud rnying pa las shing sdong la mi ma yin gnas so zhes grags pa dang / sring mo'i yid la ming po sleb pa snyam byed pa na de ltar sleb pa snyam sems sogs so/ /de dag gi 'dod pa thun mong du yul shes bya thams cad rnam med mngon gyur yin la/ blo ni rang rig med pa dang skog gyur rtags kyis 'a/sngal bar 'dod cing / 'jal byed ni skyes bu dang tshad ma ni dbang po dang don rtogs ni 'bras bu'o zhes dang / blo tshad mar 'dod pa dag kyang khyad par dang khyad par can gyi blo tshad 'bras su 'dod do/ /gsum pa brda sprod pa ni/ rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'de 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur pa sgra yi tshangs pa zhes bya ba rigs pas dpyad bzod zhig yod do zhes smra bar byed la/ de yang phyogs dang dus kyi cha med pa dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin skye 'jig dang bral bas rtag pa'i dngos po yi ge e zhes bya ba'o/ /rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'di sgra'i tshangs pa de'i rngam 'gyur yin pas shes bya thams cad sgrar snang bas khyab pa'i phyir sgra thams cad dngos dbang gis 'jug par 'dod do/ /de skad du zhi 'tshos/ skye 'jig med par yang dag gnas/ /sgra yi rang bzhin tshangs pa mchog /gang de yongs su gyur pa ni/ /dngos po'i 'gro 'dir rab shes bya/ /zhes dang / ji ltar nam mkha' dag pa la/ /rab rib kyis bslad skye bo yis/ /rab rib sna tshogs dag dang ni/ /ldan pa nyid du mngon par rlom/ /da ltar 'chi med 'gyur med pa'i/ /tshangs pa 'di ni ma rig pas/ /

rnyoka tho ba ste/ /tha dad ngo bor rnam par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /da sgrub pa'i thabs ni phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gnyis kyis sgrub ste/ phyi ni/ re re la yang grong gi mi/ /byol song drug cu drug cu sbyin/ /zhes sogs dang / bram ze la ni bram ze bsad/ /rgyal rags la ni rgyal rigs te/ /ma rungs pa la rje rigs dang / /dka' thub pa la dmangs rigs so/ /zhes so/ /nang ni/ go tam me ni bud med de/ /de yi nyer gnas thab khung yin/ /der skyed bu ni du ba ste/ /de yi nang zhugs sol dro yin/ /de lta ba yi me 'di la/ /skyes bu lhayi sa bon sre ga /sbyin sreg de las skyes bu byung / /de skyes 'tsho bar gyur pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar nang gi sbyin sreg la brten pa'i bde stong ni thar par 'dod do/ /gang gis bag chags bcas sems kyis/ rā/ ngan 'das pa thob byed pa'i/ /dga' ba'i lta ba gcig pu las/ /lta ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes dang / bze ba gang de tshangs nyid de/ /bde ba de ni thar pa yin/ /zhes so/ /brda sprod pa phal cher ni gnam sa 'bar bar snang ba lta ba mngon sam rnams 'khral zhing / rjes dpag tshad mar la las byas pa yang / de las rig pa bzang ba gzhan gyis brtags na tshad min du 'gro bas tshad ma ni sogs/ de'i ston pa bri sogs te/ rig byed mi slu ba yang mngon rjes mi sla ba las theb dgo~X pas so/ /snas so/ /bzhi pa rig byed sogs te/ skyes bu drang srong chen po nyi ma'i mdog /mun pa las 'das gyur pa de rig na/ /'chi ba las 'angs 'gyur te bdag gis rtogs/ /skye med gnas 'gro ba la

ra༅༅/ /lam gzhan med/ /ces dang / dngos po ma lus 'jig na yang / shes pa nus ldan 'jig pa med/ /ba skya rnams kyi ba bzhin du/ /de ni skye ldan rgyu ru grag /ces dang / srid pa sna tshogs de las skyes/ /dar gyi srin bu'i skud pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa de yi char thim pas/ /yang srid len par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs dang / steng phyogs de'i mgo dang 'og phyogs de'i rkang pa sogs su bshad cing / 'jig rten 'jig pa'i tshe des za bar 'dod pa dus 'bor du bkag go /lnga pa rig byed gsang ba'i mtha' smra ba pa ni sogs te/ sa dang me chu la sogs pa/ /de shes rtag pa'i 'jug pa 'di/ /de bdag can nyid bdag nyid ces/ /gzhan dag kyang ni rjod par byed/ /gzung 'odzin mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ /'di ni cung zad yod min te/ /de phyir 'di dag thams cad ni/ /rnam shes 'gyur bar yang dag snang / /zhes sogs bshad la/ phal cher snga ma dang thun mong ngo / /de dgag pa ni/ tshangs sogs te/ lha chen thig le mchog ma la/ /chags pa skyes pas gdong bzhi byung / /zhes dang / skye dgazhi bdag po rang nyid rdzi /bu mo dang ni 'khrig ces thos/ /zhes dang / khyab 'jug mi'u thung gzugs sprul nas/ /g.yo thabs kyis ni stobs ldan bslus/ /zhes dang / rgan pos khyab 'jug mda' yis bsnun/ /zhes dang / khyab 'jug gis ni gnyen 'dun dag /le lan gyis ni gcigs par gyur/ khes dang / khyab 'jug dpung drag dbyug tho mtshon cha thogs par brtson/ /zhes sogs rtsa 'grel dang / a mar ko dzi'i 'grel par

gto༄gopa'osazlo+o/ /'dodapa phal cher ni rtag pa'i dngos po dang snyab/ pu cha med kyi gzhi mkhyen bkag pas khegs te/ skyon gyi gtso borto sa pa la ji ltar snang ba'i rtag dngosarnye sa ḍās palasagyur pas so/ /nyes zad skyes bu rne / rtag nyid phyir ram thabs med phyir/ /zhes sogs dang /mchongs dang chu yi drod bzhin du/ /rang bzhin las 'das min zhe na/ /zhes sogs 'gog pa'i rig pas brtags dgos so/ /bzhi pa gcer bu pa dgag pa la/'dod gabarngod pa la / rnam grangs/ ston pa/ grub mtha'o/ /dang po ni/ gos med pas dang /ngo tsha med pas dang / dka' thub kyi las zad par byed pas dang /lus thal mdog tu yod pas dang / drang srong rgyal ba dam pa'i rjes su tsong bas dang / gos gzhan med pas phyogs dang nam mkha'i gos can yin pas dang /phyogs kun tu 'gro bas de dang de'o/ /ston pa ni/ drang srong rgyal ba dam pa lhar 'dzin cing khyu mchog dang ldong rigs sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rjes su 'brang bar byed do/ /grub mtha' la mdor bstan ni/ /ger bu lus kyi tshad bzhin du/ /srog ni zhum dang rgyas par smra/ /zhes srog ni lus kyi tshad bzhin du che chung du 'dod/ rdzas sam rang bzhin dang rnam grangs sam rnam 'gyur rim pa bzhin du rtag pa dang gzhan mi rtag pa de gnyis kyang gcig tu smra'o/ /'jal byad mngon sum sogs gsum gyis gzhal bya/ dus gsum dang rdzas drug dang /tshig gi don dgu dang srog sogs ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gzhi'o/ /sngom pa dang brtul zhugs dang ye shes rnams lnga lnga

ra༅༅/ /dang / spyo da pa bcu gsum dang las zad par bre+od pa'i dka' thub kyi thabs sna tshogs ni lam mo/ /kha pa rgya spos me tog mdog /ba zho ba mo mu tig mdog /gdugs bkan bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar pa yin par rgyalacibs bshad/ /ces pa ltar srid sogs ni 'bras bu'o/ /'gro ba lnga dang yod pa'i lus lnga ni gzhi dang 'bras bu gnyis ka nyid yin par 'dod do/ /rgyas bshad la/ gzhi ni/ mngon sum gnyis te spyi 'jal ba ni rtog med dang / bye brag 9〉jal ba ni rtog pa'o/ /lhas byin bu las sngo bsangs su dpog pa lta bu la tshul gsum yod kyang yid brtan du mi rung bas tshul gsum ni 'khral/ ba'i phyir na gzhan du mi 'thad pa zhes pa'i tshul gcig nyid la sogs te/ dngos po dngos med gnyis ka ni yod pa yin te/ dmigs pa'i phyir zhes pa la/ shes bya thams cad chos can du yod pas mthun dpe med pa'i phyir rjes su 'gro ldog med zlo/ phyogs chos kyang gzhan du mi 'thad pa nyid du 'dus pas so/ /zhes so/ /ston pa tshad ldan gyi ngag lta bu yid sogs so/ /rdzas ni drug ste/ srog dang bdag dang nam mkha' dang phyogs dang sdig pa dang bsod nams rnams so/ /tshig gi don ni dgu ste/ srog dang srog min gnyis/ bcings pa dang thar pa gnyis 'gro r+sha(nga gnyis/ spangs pa dang zag pa dang sdom pa rnams so/ /srog ldan drug ni/ sa chu me rlung gi 'byung ba bzhi dang ljon pa dang 'bras bu'i srog ldan rnams so/ /gzhung gzhan du sogs te/ dang po lnga/ srin bu/ grog ma/ bung ba/ mi sogs rnams te/ lnga po lus

dbang snyag pu dang / srin bu sogs bzhi/snga ma snga ma'i steng du lce/ rna ba/ sna/ mig ste mdor na ngabang po gcig ldan nas lnga ldan gyi bar rnams so/ /srog dang bdag ni tha dad du bgrangs pa i ma gakho+os gcig tu ges la/ / dge sdig gi las te/gzhung gzhan du batrod nams dang de min zhes kyang 'byung ngo / /bcings pa ni/lo ma can dang gtsang sbra can dang dbyig gu gsum la sogs pa lta ngan sum brgya re gsum rnams so/ /gzhung gzhan du 'gro 'ong gi tshab tu las dang nges par rga ba zhes 'byung ste/phyis myong 'gyur dang / ming dang rus dang tsha rnams ni las dang / de zad pa'i thabs su dka' thub byas pas lus zad pa ni nges par rga ba'o/ /thar pa ni stod zin to/ /lam la sdom pa lnga ni/spyodi lam gyi dang skad kyi dang tshol ba'i dang mi 'dor ba'i dang / nyer gnas kyi sdom pa'o/ /brtul zhugs lnga ni/ mi 'tsha ba dang bden par smra ba dang tshangs par spyod pa dang byin pa len pa dang / yongs su bzung ba thams cad gtong ba'i brtul zhugs rnams so / /ye shes lnga ni/blo gros kyi dang /thos pa'i dang / mtshams kyi dang / spyod pa'i dang / tsho ye shes so/ /bon gyi phywa gshen ni 'di las khyung ngo / /spyod pa bcu gsum ni sdom pa lnga dang / brtul zhugs lnga dang sgo gsum gyi gsang ba gsum rngams so/ /'gro ba lnga sna/ stsol ba dang dung 'gro dang lha da/nga mi dang thar pa'i 'gro ba'o/ /yong pa'i lus lnga ni/ kham zas kyi 'ong/ kyi yid kyi rdzus skyes kyi mtha'i lus te lnga'o// /rim bzhin mi dang dud 'gro/ gzugs gzugs

ra༅༄/ /med/ bar do/ thar pa ste 'gro ba lnga pa yang de'o/ /'di dag dus 'khor nas gsungs pa ste/ gzhung gzhan na mi gsal lo/ /kun mkhyen sogs ni/ ser skya dang gzegs zan sogs kyang chags bral dang kun mkhyen min te/ kun 'dzin yongs 'dzin gnyis dang ldan zhing skar ma'i bstan bcos ma brtsams pa'i phyir/ ldog khyab ni rang gi ston pa khyu mchog dang ldong ris sogs la tshang bar 'dod pas kun mkhyen gtan med du 'dod pa ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang dge sbyong go'u ta ma ni kun mkhyen ma yin te/ lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi lung ma bstan pa'i phyir dang / 'khor ba'i mtha' mi shes pa'i phyir dang / lhung bzed bkrus pa bzhin du log pa'i phyir dang / lhas byin gnas nas phyung ba dang sgya ma mkhan bzang po'i bsnyen bkur bzhag pas zhe sdang dang 'khon 'dzin yod cing / lnga sde'i bsnyen bkur 'gog pa ma shes pas rmongs pa dang / seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa sogs kyis las ma zad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ kheng ni sems ldan yin te / shun pa bzhus na 'chi ba dang dus su se bas rga ba yod la/ dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir zhes spyir bkod nas/ bye brag tu/ 'khri shing dang / chu shing dang / ma du lung ga dang / skyu ru ra dang / 'o ma can gye shing rnams la rim pa bzhin mig rna ba sna lce lus dbang rnams yod de/ shing gzhan gyi gseb tu 'jug shes pa dang / 'brug sgra grag pa na 'bras bu 'byung ba dang / khyi ro rul pa'i dri la brten nas 'bras bu 'byung ba dang / 'o mas bcus pa na ro mngar ba dang / reg pa na lo ma

'khums pa'i phyir ro/ 'ang mya ngan med la yid dbang yod de/ bud med lang tsho bab pa rkang gdub dang ldan pas bsnun na ngo tsha ba bzhin du 'bras bu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes mang du smra'o/ /de dgag pa ni/ srog gam bdag de mi rtag par 'gyur te/ lus sogs kyi phyir na'o/ /rdzas sogs brtag pa byas na mi 'thad de/ gcig na 'o ma 'grung 'dod pas rnga mo 'thung bar thal ba sogs kyi phyir/ gto sogs te/ tshul gsum ma tshang ba'i tshul gcig pa gto tshigs su mi 'thad pa'i phyir / las tsam zad pa'i thabs la 'bad pa den med de/ rtsa ba nyon mongs ma zad pa'i phyir/ thar pa gzugs su 'gal te/ spang bya gnyen pos zad pa'i 'gog par mi rung bas so/ /dgag pa rgyas pa ni/ dbu tshad kyi gzhung lugs rnams las shes par bya la/ mdor bsdus ni de tsam gyis mtshon no/ /gsum pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs sngar rgya cher 'byung ba/ rgya gar nub phyogs ma kha'i yul du byung ba lha rā ma ṇa'i rjes 'brang sog po'am kla klo stag gzig pa zhes grags pa nang pa dang phyi pa gnyis ka ma yin par lta spyod bar ma do sna tshogs byed pa ni gzhung lugs gzhan gyi phyogs sngar mi gsal zhing / dus 'khor du bkod pa ni/ spyi don chen mo bstan pa'i rgya mtshor bris zin pas 'dir mi spro la/ bod na yang rdol bon gshen rab mi bo tshes grags pa'i rjes/ 'brang bon theg pa rim pa dgu ste/ rgyu'i bon bzhi/ 'bras bu'i bon ba'i/ theg pa bla na med pa'i bon no/ /dang po bzhi ni/ phyu gshen/ snang gshen/ 'dur gshen/ 'phrul gshen te/ mo/ ma/ dang lha bon po

ra༅༅/ /dang / gzhin chog pa dang / mthu gtad byed pa'i bon no/ /'bras bu bzhi ni/ dge bsnyen dang / gtsang ma gtsug phud dang / drang srong dang / a dkar ba rnams te lta spyod gtso bor byed pa'o/ /dgu pa ni rdzogs rim pa rdzogs chen pa dang mthun pa ste/ dang po bzhi bod kyi lha 'dres bstan/ bar pa bzhi 'dul mdzod phar phyin rnams 'dra min du bsgyur/ tha ma ni rgya nag hwa shang gi lugs kyi lhag ma lus pa ste/ 'di'i lhad 'dres pa ni lta ba mtho mtho mor byas nas spyod pa khyad du gsod pa gzhan yang mang ngo / /gsang sngags rnying ma ni/ bstan pa snga dar la/ bla med kyi rgya dpe la ma brten pa'i 'gyur mi byed par bkas bcad pas/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang bi ma la mi tra dang / lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa na la sogs pas/ gsang 'dus sogs thugs la bzhugs pa rnams don longs su mdzad nas le'u'i go rim sogs rnam gzhag gzhan dang gzhan du mdzad de snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa rnams/ phyis yi ge cung zad 'phyugs pa'i steng du gang zag gzu lum dang rang bzo che ba 'ga' zhig gis rgyud sde shin tu mang por spel zhing bslad pa tsam ma gtogs/ bstan pa snga dar gyi sngags bla med don 'gyur du bzhugs pa/ mkhas shing grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' du mas thugs nyams su bzhes pa'o/ /gang zag gis bslad pa ni/ bod kyi rtog ge dang dbu ma sogs la'ang shin tu mang ste/ rgya gar gyi gzhung las 'byung ba dang shin tu mi mthun pa'i mdo sems dbu ma'i grub mtha' du ma yod do/ de ltar de dag la sogs pa nang pa

dang phyi ba gnyis ka ma yin pa'i grub mtha' mang yang / 'dir bsdu bar bya ba'i grub mtha' ma yin te/ gdong sogs kyi phyir te/ shes rab can du rlom pa dag gis gsar sogs kyi phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar na gang zag gi bdag med grub ste / mu stegs kyis btags pa'i bdag ni 'dogs gzhi phung po las rdzas gzhan du tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir dang / phung po dang gcig na rtag gcig dang mi rtag du ma mtshan nyid 'gal bas so/ /dbang phyag la sogs pa'i rtag dngos mi srid de / rims sogs kyi phyir/ mu stegs dngos dang rjes mthun zhe sdang rang dgar btang nas mthu gtad sogs la mchog tu 'dzin pa dag ni chos can/ khyod la rgyal bas bsngags pa'i chos mi srid de/ rang dzhar+shan la 'phral phugs su 'tshe bar byed pas so/ /khyad par 'phags bstod las/ tshodzi'i rgyal rigs 'khrungs khyod kyis/ /gang zhig bden dang mi slu dang / /tshangs pa/ra spyod dang dul ba dang / /brtse ldan dam chos legs par dgongs/ /zhes sogs sazhung lugs rnamapar dag ma dag ni/ thabs snying rje chen po dang / shes/ rab gnas lugs kyi don la zhugs pa'i rig shes khyad par can gtso bor ston mi ston gyis dbye bar bya'o/ /gang zag gi bdag dgag pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //gnyis pa chos kyi bdag dgag pa la / rags pa dgag pa nga nga / phra ba dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ don smra'i 'dod pa bzung ba'i dang / rnam rig pa'i 'dod pa 'dzin pa'i chos bdag dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ rang sde'i rigs bsdu ba dang / theg dman gyi 'dod pa 'asos pa

ra༅༅/ /dngos so/ /dang po ni/ kha cig rang sde gnas ma bu ba dang / bye brag smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa ste lnga'o zhes dang / kha cig bye smra sogs bzhi'i steng du gsang sngags smra ba dang lnga'o zhes zer ba ni mi rigs te/ sangs rgyas pa la grub mtha' smra ba lnga pa med par gsungs pa'i phyir/ dus 'khor kyai rdor sogs su grub mtha' bzhi nyid du gsungs shing / rdo rje snying 'grel du yang de bzhin dang / theg pa yang gsum du gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /zhes theg pa gsum dang grub mtha' bzhi nyid du gnas skabs bltos te nges pa mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rang sde'i grub mtha' smra ba ni bye sogs bzhi nyid du dbye ba nges la/ bsdu na phyi rol don du smra ba dang sems tsam pa dang / ngo bo nyid med par smra ba'i dbu ma pa ste gsum du'ang 'du ste/ bye mdo gnyis ka don smrar 'dus pas so/ /'o na dbu ma rang rgyud pa phal cher tha snyad sems tsam pa yin la / thal 'gyur ba phyi don khas len pas don sems gnyis su'ang 'dus par 'gyur ro zhe na/ thal 'gyur ba'i phyi don tshad grub ni 'gog par 'gyur la/ 'khral ngor ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i 'jig rten sgo bstun gyi don sems yod mtshungs dang / kun rdzob yang log gam slu mi slu sogs ni 'jig rten gzhan ngo'i rnam gzhag yin gli dbu ma rang lugs kyi grub mtha' ma yin no/ /'o na de dag theg pa r+shasum dang ji ltar sbyor zhe na/ kha cig don smra gnyis nyan thos dang / sems tsam

pa rang sangs rgyas dang / dbu ma pa byang sems theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra bar 'dod pa ni/ snga phyi cha mthun dang / bar pa la rnam bden pa'i lta ba dang rang rgyal gyi bdagye 'dzin spongatshulalachosamathunacungazadarmedakyang rnamardzun pa 'dzin pa bden med zhal gyis bzhes pa dang mi mthun no/ /rgya gar gyi a ba dhū tī pa dang gnas brtan byang bzang la sogs pa mdo sde pa theg chen pa yin par 'dod pa ltar/ bod phyi ma 'ga' re yang 'dod pa'i sgo nas gnyis pa mdo sde pa theg chen par sngad pa'i gzhung lugs rnams ni 'khrul te/ bzhi po'i dang po gnyis theg dman pa nyed du nges pa dang tha ma gnyis theg chen pa nyid du nges pa'i phyir/ de ltar na theg dman pa dang theg chen pa gnyis su'ang 'dus so/ /'o na mdo sde pa theg dman pa yisna pa la shes byed ci yod ce na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sras kyi thu bo mkhas mchog legs ldan byed kyis/ de gnyis so sor ma phye bar theg dman pa zhes gcig tu bsdus shing / theg dman mtha' dag sde pa bco brgyad du bsdus la/ mdzod 'grel du/ rtsa ba bkag nas 'grel par rang lugs bzhag pa rnams mdo sde pa'i 'dod pa dang / de slob dpon nyid kyang bzhed par bzhed pa rnams bod kyi mkhas pa kun la grags shing grub la/ de yang phal cher la gzhan dag ni zhes pa las mi 'byang ya nga skabs 'ga' rer dpe ston sde pa na re/ zhis dang / nub phyogs pa na re thes bkod nas mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' bzhig pa'i phyir dang / sde pa bco brgyad po'i nang du ma 'dus pa'i mdo sde pa'i mtshan gzhi mi rnyed pa'i phyir dang / mdo sde dro/'i

ra༅༅/ /bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo ni mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi sku tshe'i stod yin la/ des theg chen pa skur pa btab nas phyis 'gyod pa skyes te ljags spu gris gcod par brtsams pa'i phyir ro/ /phyogs snga ma dag gi sgrub byed / mdo sde pas/ bsam pa snying rje dang sbyor ba gzhan don du phyin drug la bslabs nas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i phyir zhes zer ba ni/ shin tu ma nges te/ bye smras kyang ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dang por sems bskyed tshul dang bar du phyin drug la bslabs tshul gyi skyes rabs du ma dang mthar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'tshang rgya tshul rgyas par 'dul ba'i lung las 'byung ba rnams sgra ji bzhin du khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du theg chen dbu sems gnyis mas theg dman gyi lam dang gang zag gi rnam gzhag du ma rang lugs la khas len pas de dag theg dman pa'i grub mtha' smra bar thal ba la lan med do/ /des na spyir gang zag theg dman pa dang / grub mtha' theg dman pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i brjod bya/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang / /bdag med gnyis kyi nang du ni/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes pa lta bu rnams spyir blo la shong yang / theg chen gyi bsam sbyor khyad par can rang rgyud la skyed mi nus par dman pa'i myang 'das tsam don du gnyer ba yin la/ phyi ma ni byang chub gsum ga'i lam dang 'bras bu thun mong ba khas len kyang / chos kyi bdag med la sogs pa theg chen gyi gsung rab las 'byung ba'i brjod bya khyad par can
