mang po blor ma shong bas/ de rnams ston byed kyi gsung rab bkar khas len mi nus pa la byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa brjod pa dang / de dgag pa'o/ dang po la/ 'dod pa mthun pa dang / mi mthun pa'o/ /dang po la/ theg chen bka' ma yin par 'dod tshul dang / gzhi lam 'bras bu thun mong du 'dod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ don sogs ni/ theg chen gyi gsung rab 'khor lo bar pa chos kyi bdag med rgyas par ston pa rnams dang / tha ma rang bzhin gsum dang rnam shes tshogs/ brgyad dang sgrib pa gnyis la sogs pa dang / rdul phran dang stong gsum skad cig dang bskal pa mi 'gal bar bshad pa lta bu rnams ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' ma yin no zhes spong bar byed do/ 'dus byas mi rtag zag bcas sdug bsngal / chos kun bdag med/ myang 'das zhi bar gsungs pa'i phyag rgya bzhi dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ rim pa bzhin longs sku 'jig mi srid par rtag tu bzhugs pa'i phyir dang / bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems zhes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur / /zhes sogs/ byang sems bde bar 'gro ba'i phyir dang / bdag med mchog gi bdag thob nas/ /bdag nyid chen po'i bdag thob 'gyur/ /zhes sogs bdag mchog grub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ nyan rang lhag med du zhugs tshar ba pad+ma'i stabs su skye ba blangs nas slar yang lam basmoms te 'tshang rgya dgos pas so/ /gzhan yang / rtog ge 'bar bar bkod pa/ thun mong sga 'dul ba la mi snang / mngo sde la mi 'jug chos nyid dang 'gal ba'i sgo nas sde snong gsum du ma

ra༅༅/ /'dus pa'i phyir dang / mu stegs la grags pa'i zas gcod pa dang 'jug ngogs kyi khras dang / sngags bzlas pas sdig pa 'dag pa sogs phyi rol pa'i lam bstan pa'i phyir dang / rgyang 'phen 'dod pa'i las 'bras med pa sogs kyi chad lta bstan pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la sde pa bco brgyad las med par bshad zlo der ma 'dus pa'i phyir dang / mngon sum dang 'jig rten gyi grags pa dang 'gal ba mang du bshad pa'i phyir dang / bden bzhi mi rtag sogs kyis de kho na nyid kyi go mi chod par bshad la/ de lta na de kho na nyid med par 'gyur ba'am/ yang na lhas bstan pa'i de kho na nyid du grags pa/ grog ma bsad nas gser skud la rgyus pa sogs de kho na nyid dul ba'i phyir zhes sogs skyon mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ zhes zer la/ shes sgrib dang chos kyi bdag med khas mi len pas sgrib sogs/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad mi 'dod pas kun sogs/ sangs rgyas la las dang sdug bsngal gyi lhag ma yod pa'i sgo nas skyon kun zad du mi 'dod pas gnas gyur dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod khas mi len pas de nas 'byung ba'i rab dga' la sogs pa 'i sa bcu dang / 'og min gyi longs sku mi 'dod pas sku gsum dang me long lta bu la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga dang bzhi la sogs pa mi 'dod cing / khas mi len pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ 'dod pa po'i gang zag gi dbye ba dang / des thun mong du 'dod tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde pa gcig dang gnyis dang gsum du'ang bshad mod kyi

grags che ba ni rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi ste/ thams cad yod par smra ba dang / dge 'dun phal chen pa dang / gnas brtan pa dang / mang pos bkur ba rnams so/ /de dag las gyes pa'i nyan thos sde pa ni bco brgyad du 'dod de/ 'di ltar/ slob dpon dul ba lhas/ sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lor sdom du bsdus pa ni/ 'od srungs sa ston chos srungs sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye dang gzhi kun pa/ /thams cad yod par smra ba bdun/ khar dang nub dang gangs rir gamyos / /'dus byas rtag par smra ba dang / /'jig rten 'das smra phal chen lnga/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ /gtsug las khang chen gnas brtan gsum/ /sa sgrogs ri dang srung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu pa'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnams gsum yin/ /zhes pa rnams so/ /de la rtsa ba'i sde pa gcig tu bshad pa ni/ slob dpon stak+ṣa 'od kyis thams cad yod smra la gzhi thams cad yod smra zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan du/ skad rigs bzhi las legs sbyar gyi skad du gsung rab 'don pa'i phyir dang / sngon 'di gcig pu las med pa las phyis gzhan rnams gyis par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis su bshad pa la/ rtog ge 'bar bar bshad tshul gnyis te/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu drug na chos rgyal mya ngan meng kyi dus su/ grong khyer me tos sis rgyas par/ dbe 'dun 'khrug long la brten nas phal chen pa ngang gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyis la/ de'i dang po la brgyad de/ phal chen pa ngang / tha snyad gcis pa ngang / 'jig rten las 'angs

ra༅༅/ /par smra ba dang / mang thos pa dang / rtag par sma ba dang / mchod rten pa dang / shar gyi ri pa dang / nub kyi ri pa'o/ /phyi ma la bcu ste/ gangs ri pa dang / thams cad yod smra dang / gnas ma'i bu pa dang / chos mchog pa dang / bzang po'i lam pa dang / kun gyis bkurab dang / marngo ston pa dang / chos sbas pa dang / char bzang 'bebs dang / bla ma pa'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang so bdun na/ grong khyer pa ṭa li pu trar rgyal po dga' bo dang bang chen gyi dus su bdud sdig can bzang po zhes bya bas dge slong gi cha byad du sprul nas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pas dge 'dun bye ste/ rtsa ba'i sde pa phal chen pa dang gnas brtan pa gnyis su gyes nas/ lo drug cu rtsa gsum du ma bzlums par lo brgya phrag gnyis pa 'das nas gnas brtan gnas ma'i bus bstan pa bsdus pa na rim gyis gyis te/ phal chen pa la ma gcig dang bu gnyis te/ tha snyad gcig pa dang ba lang gnas pa'o/ /ba la nga gnas pa la ma gcig dang bu gsum ste/ mang thos rtag smra/ mchod rten pa'o/ /de ltar na phal chen sde pa drug go /gnas brtan pa la ma gcig dang bu gsum ste/ gangs ri pa dang thams cad yod smra dang / gnas ma bu pa'o/ /thams cad yod smra la yang ma gcig dang bu gnyis te/ rnam par phye ste smra ba dang / bla ma pa'o/ /de'i dang po la yang ma gcig dang bu bzhi ste/ mang ston pa dang / chos sbas pa dang / gos dmar ba dang / 'od srungs pa'o/ /de ltar thams cad yod par smra ba la yang sde pa bdun

no / /gnas brtan gnas ma bu pa la/ dang por ri chen po pa dang mang bkur pa gnyis su gyes/ dang po la chos mchog pa dang / lam bzang pa gnyis su gyes/ mang bkur pa la ma dang bu grong khyer drug paganyisasugyisangasaganasarmedabapa bzhi'o/ /de ltar na gnas brtan pa bcu gnyis te sde pa bco brgyad du gyis so/ khya ba'i sde pa gsum du 'dod tshul ni/ gnyis po de'i steng du rnam par phye ste smra ba dang gsum mo/ /'di'i lugs kyi phal chen pa brgyad de/ phal chen pa dang shar rmo pa dang nub ri pa dang rgyal po'i ri pa dang / gangs ri pa dang mchod rten pa dang don grub pa dang ba lang gnas pa'o/ /gnas brtan pa drug ste/ thams cad yod smra dang / mdo sde pa dang / sngar gyi gnas ma bu pa bzhi'o/ /rnam par phye ste smra ba bzhi ste / sa ston pa dang / 'od srungs pa dang / chos sbas pa dang gos dmar ba'o/ /'o na sde pa de dag gi ming 'dir bshad pa dang gzhan du yang 'byung ba rnams so sor bgrangs na bco brgyad las mang bar 'byung ba rnams ci zhe na/ rnam grangs pa yin te/ 'di ltar/ 'od srungs pa la char bzang 'bebs/ sa ston pa la dpe ston/ chos srungs pa la chos sbas/ mang thos pa la mang ston/ gos dmar ba la bla ma pa'am 'pho bar smra ba/ rnam par phye ste smra ba la rgyur smra ba dang mo run ta pa'o/ /bye brag gzhan rnams la rnam grangs ma mthong la/ mang bkur ba'i spyi ming gi rnam grangs la a ban+ta ka pa dang ku ru kul+le'i ri pa zhes bshad do/ rtswa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i sgra bshad ni/ dus rnams kun tu yo da gsungs phyir/ /gnyis phyir yul

ra༅༅/ /yod phyir 'bras phyir/ /de yod smra ba'i phyir thams cad/ /yod par smra par 'dod de dag /ces sogs dus gsum da ltar ba bzhin du rdzas yod du smra bas dang / gyes pa'i tshe dge 'dun phal che ba phyogs gcig tu gnas pas dang / gnas brtan 'phags pa'i rigs yin pas dang / slob dpon skye bo mang pos bkur bsti byas pa'i lugs 'dzin pas so/ /grub mtha' ni shas che ba'i dbang du byas na/ rim pa bzhin dus gsum rdzas su yod/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma dang gang zag gi bdag med de/ chos 'khor lam dang mthong lam skad cig bco lnga dang chos phung ming yin/ bskal pa grangs/ med gsum gyis 'tshang rgya/ dbang shes lam du mi rung / lha la 'da' lam skye/ bar srid yod / 'dus ma byas gsum du 'dod pa rnams dang / bdag phung tha dad/ bden pa cig car mthong / dbang shes lam du rung / chos 'khor chig yin/ chos mchog las kyang nyams srid/ 'phags lam nyams mi srid/ dbang pos yul mi 'dzin / bar srid med pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas legs sbyar mi gsung / bskal pa grangs med bcu yin/ sum cu man las gang rung gis 'tshang rgya/ 'gog snyoms la sems yod/ log shes dang mi shes pa med pa rnams dang / brjod du med pa'i bdag yod/ shes bya thams cad brjod du yod pa dang med pa gnyis su sdud/ 'dus byas rgyun brtan pa rnams 'jig byed don gzhan gyis 'jig dbang shes lam du mi rung / mthong lam skad cig bcu gnyis yin pa sogs so/ /de dag

gi nang la yang / dus gsum rdzas yod du 'dod tshul bzhi la sogs pa lta bu mi 'dra ba du ma yod de/ rtog ge 'bar bar nga sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo la sogs par blta bar bya zhing / de dag las sa ste+on pa dang 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba gnyis rang gi 'dod pa sogs ni mdo sde pa dang mthun no/ /gzhan yang thams cad yod smra ni gsung rab legs par sbyar ba sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i skad du 'don/ mkhan po rgyal rigs las rab tu byung zhing bslab pa la gus pa'i mchog sgra gcan 'dzin las brgyud/ snam sbyar snam phran dgu yan nyer lnga man la/ rtags 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ ming dpal dang / bzang po dang / snying po'i mtha' can te/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / ye shes snying po dang / tshodzi shrī la sogs pa'o/ /phal chen pa ni/ skad pra kri ta rang bzhin gyi skad de/ 'od gsal gyi lha dang mthun pa/ 'od ldan nas 'bring du 'don pa zhes bshad de zur chag ces kyang grags so/ /mkhan po bram ze'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sbyangs pa'i duyon tan la gnas pa'i mchog 'od srungs chen po/ snam phran bdun yan chad nyer gsum man chad/ rtags dpal be'u/ ming ye shes dang sbas pa'i mtha' can te/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / a bha yā ka ra gusta sogs so/ /gnas brtan pa ni/ skad pi sha tsi sha za'i skad/ mkhan po spyig ma mkhan las rab tu byung ba/ mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i mchog ka t+yā ya na/ snam phran lnga nas nyer gcig gi bar la rtags dung yod pa/ ming 'byung gnas dang / go cha sde/ rin chen 'byung gnas dang / dad

ra༅༅// /byedagocha sogs so/ /mang bkur ba ni/ a ba/shi ta yi dwags kyi skad/mkhan po 'dreg mkhan las rab tu byung ba 'dul pa 'dzin pa'i mchog nye ba 'khor/snam sbyar gnas brtan pa dang mthun/ming 'bangs dang sde'i mtha' can te/ dkon mchog 'phangs dang /grol ba'i sde dang /mchog gi sde dang /dul ba'i sde la sogs pa'o/ /phyi ma gnyis kyi skad la/'od ldan du rim bzhin zur chag dang tha mal pa zhes bshad do/ /ming la mkhan tsho meng gi mtha' can yang chung ste/bod kyi sad mi bdun la/mkhan r+ṣa byang chub sems dpa'i ma' gyi mtha' rak+ṣi ta zhes sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /ming brje ba yang da ltar gyi cho ga la yin sgosngon chog dang tshur shog sogs la med do/ /gzhan yang sde pa so so la byin len byed tshul dang nub lhag gcod tshul sogs bcas rkyang gi 'jog mtshams mi mthun pa ni yod par nges la/bod dgaphal 'a sde pa chang 'thung ba la mi tshangs spyod kyi tshab ma'i rtsa ljang du byed do zhes rlung ltar du grags pa ni/'dul ba la mi mkhas pa'i gas 'chol yin te/'dod pas bar du mi gcod par 'dod pa ni sdig lta 'a po yin pas 'dul bar gakhos pa'i lta ba mi mthun pa yin la/de lta na sde pa tha dad kyis las kya kha skong mi rung bar 'gyur na/bri ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du/sde pa bzhi ma'i dge slong bsnyen rdzogs kyi kha skong la 'du bar stod pa sogs dang 'gal lo/ /sdopa bzhi po de dag las kyang thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa ni mchog tu gyur te/kun gyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rig

pa ni/ 'jig rten na ya rabs dag sgra'i mtshan nyid la brtson par byas nas legs sbyar gyi tha snyad du brjod la/ de las 'jig rten gyi chos lugs bzang po rnams 'byung bas gzhi dang 'dra ba bzhin du/ sde pa 'dis kyang le/gas sbyar gyi skad du 'don pas ya rabs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lung ni sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas rgyal po'i khab tu sde snod gsum bsdus shing / lo brgya dang bcu na/ yangs pa can du 'phags pa thams cad 'dod la sogs pa nas sgur po dang zhi ldan la thug pa dgra bcom pa bdun brgyas/ hu lu hu lu la sogs pa'i rung ba min pa'i gzhi bcu bsal nas bsdu ba gnyis pa mdzad cing / de rjes chos rgyal mya ngan med 'das nas/ tha mal pa dang zur chag dang 'bring du 'don pa'i skad la mngon par zhen pa'i dbang gis lung tshig mi 'dra ba dang / de la brten nas 'don yang cung zad mi 'dra bar song ste/ gyes pa bco brgyad du gyur gyi bar du sde pa 'di gcig pu yin par lung phran tshegs las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ zhes mkhas mchog stadzi 'od kyis bshad do/ /de ltar tha dad du gyes pa'i rtsod pa cung zad kyis bstan pa sna tshogs su gyur pa ni/ ston pas sngon bram ze'i 'khor phye ba'i las kyi lhag ma yin pa dang / thams cad kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nang du 'du bar ni / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi sbyin bdag rgyal po kri kri'i rmi lam bcu'i tha ma/ mi bco brgyad kyis ras yug gcig la brtsad pas re res kyang ras yug re re thob cing / thun mong gi ras yug gcig ngu yang thun mong du lus par mthong

ra༅༅/ /ba/ stodzi khub kyi bstan pa bco brgyad du gyes kyangarnam grol thun mong du thob pa'i ltas su lung bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /sde pa mang po de dag kyang bsdu na bdag smra dang bdag med smra ba gnyis su 'du ste/ gzhung gzhan du mang pos bkur ba'i nang tshan du grags shing rtog ge 'bar bar gnas sogs nas kun dang mdo sde pa yang bdag med 'dod pa'i phyir mdo sde pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ sde pa'i nang nas dpe ston sde pa dang gang zag gi nang nas phyi rol don grub mdzad pa po slob dpon dge 'dun srungs dang / mdzod kyi tshor ba bde ba bsgrub pa'i phyogs sngar byung ba btsun pa sogs so/ /gnas ma bu sogs lngas brjod med kyi bdag 'dod pa'i khungs ni/ rtog ge 'bar bar/ de rnamasalas sngar bstan pa'i dge 'dun phal chen pa la sogs pa brgyad dang / phyis bstan pa'i gnas brtan pa dang / thams cad yod smra dang / mang ston pa dang / chos mchog pa dang / 'od srungs pa rnams ni/ chos thams cad bdag med par smra ba yin la/ lhag ma gnas ma bu pa la sogs pa sde pa lnga ni gang zag tu smra ba yin te/ gang zag ni phung po las de nyid gzhan du brjod du med pa/ rnam shes drug gis shes par bya ba/ 'khor bar gyur pa yongs su gsal bar bya ba yin no zhes zer ro/ /zhes so/ /lnga ni/ gnas ma bu pa dang / bzang po'i lam pa dang / ku ru kul+le ba dang / chos sbas pa dang / bla ma pa'am 'pho bar smra ba'o/ /gang zag de phung po dang gcig tha dad rtag mi rtag sogs su brjod du med kyang rang rkya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dod de/ 'jug pa

las / kha cig de nyid gzhan nyid rtag mi rtag /la sogs brjod med gang zag rdzas yod 'dod/ zhes sogs gsungs shing / gal te khyod bum dngos por ma grub pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyis rig ngor brjod med yin na bden grub ma yin par thal ba bum sogs kyis dpes bsgrubs pas/ rang sde'i grub mtha' smra ba dma' shos kyi mthar thug bdag smra 'dis kyang bum sogs kyi tshogs pa bden grub ma yin par khas blangs bzhin du/ spyir dngos smra yin na dngos po la bden grub kyis khyab pa dang / khyad par mdo sde pas/ dngos po la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pas khyab par smra'o zhes bod na mang po mgrin gcig tu smra ba ni/ gzhung lugs rgya chen po la ma sbyangs par ma zad/ bum pa dang bum gzugs gnyis blo ma 'khrul ba'i ngor grub tshul la rtog ge sgo bstun gyi blo kha yang ma phyogs bzhin du lung rig gi dbang phyug tu khas len par zad do/ /des na bdag smra 'dis gang zag rdzas yod bden grub dang / bum pa brtags yod brdzun par khas blangs pa'i nang 'gas ma rig pa ni grub mtha'i skyon yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ dogs pa chung ba spyir bshad/ che ba bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar bye mdo'i grub mtha' smra ba kun kyang 'og gi mthun zhes pa re re zhing sbyar te/ phung po'i dbye ba lnga dang sogs pa khams dang skye mched kyi dbye ba bco brgyad dang / bcu gnyis dang / der sna sgo nga las skyes sogs so/ /sems can skye gnas ba'i dag tu/ /tshes sgo nga dang mngal ngang drod g.yer dang rdzus/ skyes/ te skye sanas/ bzhi dngari der ni dkyi la so gas 'gro ba lnga / /

ra༅༅/ /zhes ngan song gsum dang lha mi gnyis te 'gro ba lnga/ kham dang reg pa dang sems pa dang rnam par shes pa'i zas te zas bzhi dang / phyogs kyi cha yod na gzugs can gyi chung mthar mi 'gyur bas rdul phran chung mtha' la phyogs cha med cing / rdzun zhes pa'i tshig shugs kyis 'di bden grub dang / de ma brtsams pa'i rags pa dbyibs ldan thams cad phyogs kyi cha dang bcas shing / blos cha gzhan bsal du rung bas rdzun pa kun rdzob pa yin pa dang / spyir sems dang sems byung gi mtshan nyid yul gyi ngobo dang khyad par tsam 'dzin pa dang / gzugs can gyi 'byung gyur 'byung ba las dang / shes rig gi rdzas mtshungs ldan lngas mtshungs su dang / ldan min gyi dngos po gnas skabs can gyi gzugs sems las skye ba ste 'dus byas kyi skye tshul dang / yul blang dor bden pa bzhi'i mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid kyi gtso bo dang / yul can la tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam ste lam lnga dang / gang zag nyan thos skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag ya brgyad kyi grangs dang spangs rtogs phal cher dang / rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu dang / tshogs na spyod pa dang / byang sems kyi dang por thugs bskyed tshul dang / bar du tshogs bsags tshul tha mar 'tshang rgya tshul/ de yang srid pa tha ma pa rgyal bu don grub kyi dus su yang bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi tshogs rdzogs kyang so skye tshogs lam pa 'ching ba kun ldan yin pa dang / kun la thams cad snying rje yis/ /sbyin par byed pas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /zhes sogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs tshul dang / 'og

min du sangs rgyas pa sogs mi 'dod par byang chub kyi shing drung du srod la bdud dpung bye ba phrag so bdun btul nas/ tho rangs sbyor lam stan gcig pa nas zad mi skye shes pa'i bar gyi spangs rtogasathams cad bde|bzhi mirtagasogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam kho nas thob cing / de'i sngon du ring 'phur skyes dang lhag spyod las 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan gyi man ngag blangs nas ci yang med man las 'dod chags dang bral zin pa'i chags bral sngon song gi sangs rgyas yin pa dang / de bzhin du dge 'dun nyi shu'i spangs rtogs kyi 'jog tshul dang spangs rtogs las nyams tshul phran tshegs 'ga' zhig ma gtogs thob tshul phal cher dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi dang tshad med bzhi la sogs pa'i yon tan phal cher dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa na sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po dang zag bcas las kyi lhag ma mang po la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yod pa dang / nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ste lhag med kyi myang 'das gsum ga gzugs zhig tshor ba bsil bar gyur/ /'dus shes 'gags shing 'du byed zhi/ /rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /de 'dra 'di ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ zhes bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du rig pa rgyun chad pa dang / gzhi'i shes bya'i gco bo zag bcas sogs thun par 'dod do/ tha'i dag li rgyu mtshan ni/ mdzod kyi rtsabs ji ltar bshad pa bzhin du 'grel pas kyang bsgrubs nas dgag pa ma mdzad par byetsho mdo thun mong du 'al gyis ba'es pas so/ /de das so so'i mtshan nyid

ra༅༅/ /dang lung gi shes byed la sogs pa mdzod kyi ṭī kur bshad zin cing / 'dir bris na yi ge mang bar 'gyur bas der bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ zag bcas zag med dang / bden gnyis 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po la / kha cig sde pa 'di gnyis zag bcas zag med kyi 'jog tshul mimathun te/ mdzod nas bshad pa nibye smra dang / mngon pa kun btus las/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel ma 'brel la der bshad pa ni mdo sde pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir / de yang mngon pa kun btus phyi don khas len gyi sems tsam pa'i gzhung yin la/ don smra gnyis kyi nang nas kyang mdo sde pa dang sgo bstan pa yin pa'i phyir te/ 'byung ba gcig las gyur pa'i 'dus pa sogs mdo sde pa'i lugs bshad pa'i phyir ro zhes gsung mod sgo mi 'thad de/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang / /bdag med gnyis kyi nang du yang / /theg chen mtha' dag 'dir zad do/ /zhes theg chen gyi brjod bya mtha' dag gco+o bor bshad pa'i phyir dang / phyi don tshad grub khas len pa'i sem sa tsam pa shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir dngan mdo sde pa mi 'dod pa'i rig byed min pa'i gzugs bshad pas byasmra'i gzhung du yang thal ba'i phyir dang / spyir gzhung de'i brjod bya 'ga' zhig sde pa de dang mthun pa byung bas/ gzhung de na bshad tshad sde pa de'i lugs su byed na ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na mngon pa kun las btus ni/ byams chos bar pa gsum po ji bzhin du/ legs par dpyad na gnyis stong gi gzhan dbang las gzhan pa'i

bden grub kyi chos mi bzhed kyang / ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i 'khral ngor mdo'i dngos bstan gyi rnam gzhag phal cher zhal gyis bzhes pa sems tsam pa'i mchog gyur rnam rdzun pa'i gzhung du de'i ṭī ka la sogs pa mang por bzhed zin to/ /des na chags bcas bi+o blo gang gis chos de'i rang bzhin shes nas de la josmigs nas zag pa nyon mongs rnams dmigs pa dang mtshungs lda na gang lung gi sgo nas rgyas shing / gnas dang thob par 'gyur ba'i chos ni zag bcas kyi dang / cig thu+os rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i chos ni zag med kyi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir na/ ma gzhi ni lam sogs so/ /'dus ma byas kyi mtshan gzhi la/ mdzod du/ nam mkha' dang btags 'gog btags min gyi 'gog pa ste gsum bye smra'i lugs dang / mdo sde pa de'i steng du de bzhin nyid dang bzhi'o zhes bod na grags pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mngon pa kun btus la brten na ni brgyad kyang bshad la/ khungs su mi rung zhing / 'phags pa lha'i ye shes snying po kun las btus dang / dze tā ri'i gzhung rnam 'byed dang / dus 'khor dang / zhal lung sogs su/ mdo sde pa'i skabs su/ nam mkha' mo gsham bu dang mtshungs/ /'gog pa gnyis kyang de bzhin te/ /zhes 'dus ma byas kyi ngo bo mi mthun pa ma gtogs mtshan gzhi zur pa ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / bdag med yan gar ba shes bya zur par 'dod na/ de rtogs pa'i mngon sum gyis de yul du byed dgos pa las/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pa/ /'dus byas spyod yul can chags ni/ /rgyu yin de yi gnod byed ni/ /bdag med

ra༅༅/ /mthong ba 'gal ba yin/ /zhes bdag gis stong pa'i phung po dag pa ba yul du byed par bshad pa'i phyir dang / med dgag dngos su snang ba'i mngon sum 'dod na/ rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi phyogs chos la dngos rtogs kyi mngon sum khas len dgos pa las/ gcig dmigs nyams su myong ba las/ /zhes sogs shugs rtogs nan gyis bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ rang lugs gzhag pa dang / gzhan lugs dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni / mdzod du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /zhes pa dang / rnam 'grel du/ don dam don byed nus pa gang / /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin / /gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa ste/ /de dag rang spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /ces pa 'di gnyis don gcig ste/ chos gang la gzhig byed kyis gzhig pa dang / sel byed kyi blos cha gzhan bsal bas rang 'dzin gyi blodo na mthun mi 'dor ba dang 'dor ba gnyis sam/ yang na don dam par don byedanus pa dang mi nus pa'i chos gnyis po rim bzhin don dam bden pa dang kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid rnam grangs pa yin pa'i phyir dang / mtshan gzhi yang / mdzod bzhin du/ rnam 'grel gyi lha dbang blo'i/ chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa bzhin du kun rdzob tu yod pa yin nam/ gzugs dang bde ba la sogs pa bzhin du don dam par yod pa yin/ zhes gtso bo 'gog pa'i skabs su gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bum pa dang chu dang

gad pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de dag ni spyi mtshan gyis don byed gtan mi nus pa dang /rtog pa la yul de dag gi don spyi tsam las rang mtshan mi snang bar bstan pa yin no zhe na/ 'o na mig dang gzugoge+o 'god pa mi rigs par 'gyur te / ri bong rwa sogs blo bzhin no/ /zhes 'god rigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du bum pa dang / 'degs 'jog sogs kyi las dang / grangs dang dus la sogs pa dper bkod pa la'ang rnam bcad med de/ bum gzugs 'dzin pa'i rtog pa la'ang don spyi tsam las mi snang ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang mdo sde pa de ldan sogs nas 'gal zhing mi 'thad de/ ldan min 'du byed rang mtshan dang bden grub tu 'dod pas so/ /des na spyi mtshan dngos med du bsgrubs shing spyi dngos po ba bkag pa rne / dngos po dag pa ba zhes lan mang por gsungs pas rang mtshan gyi dngos po la dgongs la/don byed nus pa gang yin pa/ /zhes pa ni/don dam zhes sbyar dgos par gong 'og bsgrigs pas gsal te/ spyir yang gzhung gang yin gyi gong 'og mtha' dag bsgribs nas bshad dgos kyi rang rang gi thad so'i dngos bstan sor bzhag na nang 'gal mang du 'byung ngo / /'o na/ gal te thams cad nus med na/ /zhes don dam par don byed nus pa'i dngos po shes bya la mi srid do zhes dbu ma pas smras pa'i lan/ du/ sa bon sogs ni myug sogs la/ /nus mthong / 'es sa myug sogs don dam du grub par bshad pa ma yin rnam 'e na/ de sna mtha' gcod pa'i sle ra du nge ltar lan btab pa na/ dbu ma pas/ de 'dra kun rdzob tha snyang pa'i

༄༄༄/ /rnam gzhag yin no zhes smras pa na/ ci ste de ltar 'gyur zhes/ kho bo cag kyang mngon sum la dngos su snang ba'i slo nas mi 'grub pa'i bya byed dang rgyu 'bras la sogs pa rgyan la ltos nas bzhag pa'i shes bya thams cad kun rdzob tha snyad par 'dod pas 'dod mthun no zhes dang / de dag 'jal ba'i tshad ma dpyad zhugs thob gsum tshang ba thams cad tha snyad pa'i tshad ma kho na yin gyi/ don dam pa'i tshad ma ni rdul phran dpa skad cig ma'i yul can dang blo yang skad cig ma'i 'phreng ba kho na yin te/ dngos po rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par gnas na ni rtag dngos nyid du 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyan mkhan pos 'a/na mang du gsungs la/ yul stengs nas rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i skad cig ma ni/ skad cig nyid phyir bya gang las/ /zhes bya byed dang smra brjod thams cad las grol bas/ don dam bden pa tha snyad pa'i shes brjod las 'das pa ni grub mtha' smra ba'i nang bzhi ga mthun no/ /de ltar na don smra'i gtso bo gnyis ka yang / yul stengs nas don la grub pa ni skad cig ma dang rdul phran cha med kho nar zad mod kyi/ rtog ngor tshogs pa dang rgyun tu snang ba'i dngos po gcig tu rlom pa la rgyu 'bras dang bya byed dang blang dor dang dgag sgrub thams cad byed cing / de dag kyang kun rdzob rdzun pa'i dngos por khas len pas/ rtag dngos smra ba rnams las khyad zhugs pa gnas lugs gang zag gi bdag med mthong bas nyan rang gi byang chub thob par gzhung lugs phal mo che las mgrin gcig tu gsungs shing / gsung rab yongs rdzogs la

dang 'das rme 'ongaso kyang ngo bo da ltar ba ltar yod pa dang / don dang de ni zad phyir ro/ /zhes da lta med pa dang / thogs med rig byed min pa'i gzugs yod med rnams snga phyi go rim bzhin te/ tshig 'di dag dus 'khor rtsa rgyud yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ don smra gnyis bden gnyis mi mthun par 'dod pa bkag nas mthun pa de'i phyir don smra gnyis kyis grub mtha' mi mthun pa'i khyad par mdzod rtsa 'grel sogs su gsal bar 'byung ba na 'di dag ste/ mngon sogs te/ snga mas 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo las dngos su gsungs pa ched du brjod pa'i tsho+oms bzhin du dgra bcom so sos bsngas pa tsam yin pas bka' yin zhes zer la/ phyi mas de ltar ma yin gyi/ /ye shes la 'jug ka t+ya'i bus/ /rab tu byed pa dbyig shes kyis/ /chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mo gal bus/ /rnam shes tshogs ni lha skyid kyis/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus po ches/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang bos byas/ /zhes pa' dgra bcom de dag so sos rang dbang du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos yin no zhes 'dod pas so/ /lung sogs chos kyi phung po ni 'du byed phung po dang gzugs kyi phung por 'dod de/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dag /gang dag thub pas gsungs de dag /tshig gam ming yin de dag kyang / /gzugs sam 'du byed dag tu 'dus/ /zhes/ tshig dag sgra rang mtshan rnga ba'i yul dang / ming spyi ldan min 'du byed yid rtog bcas kyi yul yin pas snga phyi ldog ste sbyor ro/ /chos phung li grangs ri/ 'jir brkyang khri tshes ba'ad

ra༅༅/ /kyang / mdo sngags gzhan du stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zhes pa sha stag 'byung zhing / tshad kyang / shā ri'i bus mdzad pa'i bstan bcos la drug stong yod pa'i sdurdzo+o ku'i grangs de tsam rigs par 'dod pa dang / phung khams sogs kyi gtam gyi sde tshan rdzogs pa re re dang / 'dod chags sogs la spyod pa brgyad khri sogs te/ spyod pa de 'dra re re'i gnyen po rdzogs par ston pa ste/ phyi ma 'di dbyig gnyen rang lugs su grags pa rnams ni theg pa thun mong ba ste / theg chen thun mong min pa ltar na glang po che rab brtan gyis theg tshad kyi snag tshas chos phung gcig las 'dri bar mi/ nus so zhes bshad do/ /rtsom byed rdul phran sogs te/ 'di ni bod na gsal bar grags mod kyi/ khungs ni/ ru phyi rol don grub las/ phan tshun bdag nyid ma reg par/ /cha shas med par rnam gnas te/ /de phyir sa yi dkyil 'khor sogs/ /bsags pa dag ni 'byung ba yin/ /zhes dang / tha dad phyogs nas mang po dag /'ga' la kun nas skor tsam du/ /gnas par zad kyi rdul de ni/ /cha shas bcas pa'i bdag nyid min/ /zhes dang / gnas brtan btsun pas/ rdul phra rab rnams ma 'byar ba bar med pas reg par 'du shes so zhes pa tsam du zad la/ rig pa ni/ snga mas reg na cha gcig gis reg gam bdag nyid kun gyis reg dang po ltar na reg ma reg gi cha tha dad byung bas cha bcas su 'gyur ba dang / phyi ma ltar na/ rdul phran mang po bsdoms kyang gcig las ma byung bas rags pa mi rtsom par 'gyur ba'i phyir ma reg pa'i bar bcas su 'dod

par bshad/ /ces sogs shes byed du 'dren no/ /'di ni mi 'thad de/ mngon pa kun las btus dang / sa sde dang / phung po lnga'i rab byed dang / dbu ma phung po lnga pa sogs las/ rig byed min pa'i gzugs gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / khyad par yang dag par blangs pa las byung ba so thar gyi sdom pa ni gzugs phung gi nang du bsdus pa'i phyir dang / rig pa ya nga / so thar gzugs can ma yin na/ len pa'i tshe lus ngag gi rig byed la bltos pa dang / srung ba'i tshe yid kyi mi dge ba gsum po ngo skal gyi spang byar mi 'jog par gzugs can bdun nyid la 'jog pa dang / gtong ba'i tshe yang 'chal tshul gzugs can nges par dgos shing khyad par lus brjes pas gtong ba rnams mi 'thad de/ byang sems dang gsang sngags bzhin no zhes pa la mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis kyang lan mi 'debs shing / de nyid kyang gzugs can du bzhed par gsal te/ 'chal pa'i tshul khrims mi dbe'i gzugs/ /de spong tshul khrims rnam gnyis so/ /zhes 'chal tshul dang de spong byed rig byed dang de ma yin gnyis so zhes gsal bar bris nas/ dgag pa dngos dang sngar bshad dran lam du 'phen pa tsam yang ma mdzad pas so/ /des na mdo sde pa la'ang rig min 'gog pas ma khyab ste/ mdo sde pa mkhas shes kyis mi 'gog pa'i phyir/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /'on kyang sgrab byed rgyas pa rnams ni mi mdzad pas bye smra dang khyad che'o/ /des na/ gzugs kyi ma nyid/ mig shes kyis blta bya zhes bris nas/ gzugs can la rten yod kyis khyab par 'dod pa dag gis

ra༅༅/ /'di'i brgal brtag byed pa ni bstan pa nyams pa'i skyon yin no/ /yang dbang po yul 'dzin bzhin pa ni rten mtshungs dang / da lta mi 'dzin pa ni de mtshungs te/ dang po rten mtshungs kyi dbang po gzugs can tshad mar 'dod pa dang / tshad ma la shes rig gis khyab par 'dod pa dang / gzung 'dzin dang / rgyu 'bras phal cher kun dus mnyam du/ lhan cig 'byung gang phan tshun 'bras/ /'byung bzhin sems kyi rjes 'jug bzhin/ /zhes sogs dang / mtshungs/ ldan rgyu ni sems dag dang / /sems byung rten mtshungs can rnams so/ /zhes 'dod pa dang / rgyu ye dngos po ma gtogs pa'i/ /gzung ba zhes bya gzhan ci'ang med/ /ces dang / phan 'dogs gang yin skyed pa yin/ /zhes rgyu 'bras la bskyed bya skyed byed kyis khyab la/ dus mnyam la ma grub na bskyed bya med pa bzhin du skyed byed kyang med la/ grub na skyed byed grub pa bzhin du bskyed bya yang grub pas mi nus pa dang mi dgos par 'gyur zhes bkag nas skyed byed 'gag pa dang bskyed bya skye ba sung mda'i mtho dman bzhin du 'dod cing / dus tha dad pa ji ltar 'dzin/ /zhe na rig pa shes pa yis/ shes pa'i rnam pa 'jog nus pa'i/ /rgyu nyid la ni gzung bar shes/ /zhes gzung 'dzin rgyu 'bras dus mnyam du mi 'dod par snga phyir 'dod pas / don 'dis rig smra'i mchog tu grags so/ /de bzhin du da lta don du snang ba 'di rnam pas bar du chod na don dngos su ma rtogs par 'gyur bas phyi don dngos yin zhes dang / de 'gags kyang des bzhag pa'i shes pa'i rnam pa yin mod sgo de

das rwabo rdo myong bar gdags te/ bus pa'i gzhes dngos su mi tshon kyang de dang 'dra ba bzung bas/'jig rten rgyu gzugs lon zhes brjod/ khes dang / dbu ma rgyan du/shes pa rnam bcas phyogs la ni/ /dngos su de gnyis tha dad kyang / /de dang 'dra ba myong bas na/ /don myong zhes ni gdags su rung / /zhes bshad do/ /'di la bod snga rabs pa dgaphyi don lgog na mo zhes zer la/phyi rabs pa dag de lta na bskal don dang 'dra bar 'gyur bas/phyi don dngos su snang zhes zer mod zhi bye smra dang khyad par gang gis 'byed pa soms shig des na bstan pa rim gyis je mthor 'gyur bas/ sems tsam rnam bden pa dang 'di gnyis snang ba shes pa yin par mtshungs kyang /gtod byed phyi don yod med kyis 'byed pa yin no/ /lkog na mo dang de bskal don du mthong ba gnyis mas mgo ste/ rang 'dzin la rnam pa gtad ma thag tu 'gags nas gtan med du song ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang rnam pa gtad pa nyid kyis dngos yul du song pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / spyir ring thung sogs dang / khyad par lus kyi thal mo sbyar ba lta bu'i dbyibs ni khog gi bkod pa las don gzhan pa'i rdzas yod du dang / de lta na/ gnyis bzung 'gyur te rdul la med/ /ces bkag nas khog gi bkod pa la btags pa'i batshos yod du 'dod pa dang / dus rngams kun tu yod gsungs phyir/ /gnyis phyir yul yod phyir tsos phyir/ /zhes dus gsum ka da ltar ba bzhin du rdzas yod dang / de bzhin da/ yod na ci phyir ma skyes phyir/ /zhes dang / rang bzhin yang

ra༅༅/ /ni rtag tu yod/ /dari+os po rtag par yang mi 'dod/ /rang bzhin las kyang dngos mi gzhan/ /dbang phyug tha snyad yin par gsal/ /zhes sogs kyis de bkag nas/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi dus blo btags kyi dngos po dang / de gnyis kyi dus can so so rnams da lta 'gags shing ma skyes na med par 'dod pas so/ /bye smra'i sgrub byed ni/ dang po gnyis lung ste/ dge slong dag 'das ma 'ongs kyi gzugs yod de/ med na de gnyis la dmi gas pa'i nyon mongs spong bar mi 'gyur ba las spong ba'i phyir/ zhes dang / rnam par shes pa ni gnyis las skye ste/ mig dang gzugs nas yid dang chos las so/ /zhes pa'i chos la 'das ma 'ongs kyang yod pa'o/ /phyi ma gnyis rig pa ste/ rnam shes yin na yul yod pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / 'das pa'i las las da ltar 'bras bu 'byung bas so/ /zhes pa'o/ /spyir shes bya gzhi lnga ste/ snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi/ 'khor sems byung gi gzhi/ gnas skabs ldan min 'du byed kyi gzhi / bral rdzas 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi'o/ /bye brag tu/ thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / /'du shes med snyoms 'jug dag dang / /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la sogs pa yang / /zhes pa'i ldan min 'du byed rnams gang gi gnas skabs la bzhag pa'i gnas skabs can las don gzhan rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du 'dod pa dang / gzugs sems gnyis dang sems byung tshor 'du gnyis sam sems pa dang gsum rnams rdzas yod yin gli gzhan mtha'

cer lakhos pani bye smayangami'adod mod zhibazhi sne rigs las lnga ltas las/ /khos 'gyur dang po las ma yin/ /zhes gtso bor dgra bawo+o gyi tsos bu las khos pa yod par/dgra ba.o pa la yang rnyed pa dang bkur snis bar chad byed pa yod do zhes sogs la brten nas sgrub pa dang /de mthong chos la bder gnas kyi snyoms khrug khyad par can las khos pa la dgongs sridage slong dga'aphags pa'i shes rab kyis spangs pa gang yin pa de ni legs par spangs pa yin no zhes gsungs pas 'phags lam gyis thob pa'i spangs rtogs mtha' dag nyams pa mi srid do zhes so/ /des na dgra bcom la nyams pa'i chos can sogs kyi dbye ba bshad pa yang yon tan khyad par can gyi dbang du byas la/mngon pa ye shes la khrug pa las/nyon mongs kyi skyechu gsum ma tshang na smo+o mongs mi skye zhing / dgra bcom gyis phra rgyas ma spangs na dgra bcom du mi rung /spangs na rgyu med kyi 'bras bu mi srid pa'i rig pas bsgrubs nas/sol ba'i phung tsho mdo las / mi dge ba'i sems mngon du 'gyur bar bshad pa dgra bcom la sbyar ba ltar snang yang slob pa'i dbang du byas par bsgrubs so/ /lus sogs ni lus la sems kyi sa bon yod par/mdo sde pa'i dbang du byas nas rnam 'grel sogs su gad la/bye smra'i gzhung gang du'ang de mi lngang ngo / /rags sogs ni/'dod na dbang po med pa dang / /sgra med phra rab rdul rdzas brgyad/ /lus dbang ldan la rdzas dgu'o/ /dbang po gzhan ldan rdzas bcu 'o/ /zhes bum pa lta bu'i tshogs

ra༅༅/ /pa'am rags pa yan lag can gcig la/ 'byung ba bzhi dang 'byung 'gyur gzugs dri ro reg bzhi ste rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus su nges par skye ste/ gang rung gcig ma tshang na rang rang gi bya ba byed mi nus pa'i phyir dang / yod par mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir te/ gzugs sogs rang 'dzin gyis rtogs/ 'byung ba bzhi 'dzin sdud smin skyod kyi bya ba bzhis 'grub pas so/ /lus dbang dang ldan na de dang dgu/ mig dbang sogs dang ldan pa la lus dbang yang nges par yod pa sa bcu dang bcu gcig sogs nges par ldan zhing / de yang rigs mi mthun rnams go sa gcig tu dang / rigs mthun rnams tha dad du gnas te/ gzhan du na rags pa rtsom mi nus pas so zhes dang / bya ba tsam gyis mngon gyur mi 'grub pas gang la gang dmigs pa de yod kyis ma dmigs pa de med ces so/ /sems byung sogs ni/ gti mug med pa dang lta ba dang shes bzhin ma yin pa rnams shes rab la btags shing / brjed ngas dang rnam g.yeng dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin nyon mongs can yin pas sems byung gi dbye bar mi bgrang ngo / /des na mdzod kyi rtsa bar bgrangs pa'i sems kyi dang dge ba'i sa mang bcu bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i dang mi dge ba'i sa pa drug dang gnyis/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu ste so brgyad/ dbyig shes kyis/ sdom du mdzad pa/ — rtog dpyod 'gyod gnyis khro chags dang / /nga rgyal the tshom ma nges brgyad/ /ces zhe drug po thams cad sems las kyang rdzas gzhan/ nang phan tshun yang rdzas gzhan gyi rdzas yod du

gzhan du brjod min pa/ /dgos pa med par mi rigs so/ /mas nyid dang ni 'jig rten na/ /mthong phyir bstan bcos sgo nas kyang / /bud shing me bzhin gnyis su ni/ /brjod min mi rung dmigs phyir ro/ /zhes dang / dus 'khoye du yang bkag la/ 'jug par yang / gal te bdag gang dngos por grub gyur na/ /sems ltar grub dngos brjod du med mi rung / /zhes sogs kyis bkag cing / khyad par mdzod 'grel gyi gnas dgu par yul drug dang yid bzhin du mngon sum dang / dbang po gzugs can lnga bzhin du rjes dpag gis kyang mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang / bud shing dang me'i dpes brjod mi rung du yang mi 'grub ste/ rig pas brtags na de gnyis bsreg bya srag byed yin pa'i sgo nas rdzas gzhan du grub pas dpe ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sogs lung dang rig pa du mas brtags yod du bsgrubs te/ de'i 'grel bshad du tshigs bcad kyi tshul/ gyis brjod bde zhing go sla bar kho bos bshad zin to/ /theg chen sogs te/ mdo sde rgyan du/ sngar lung ma bstan lhan cig 'byung / /spod yul ma yin grub pa dang / /yod dang med na yod med dang / /gnyen po dang ni sgra gzhan phyir/ /zhes sogs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin du sgyu sgrub zhabs kyis rin chen 'phreng ba dang /legs ldan gyis rtag ge 'bar ba nga/nga / 'i ba lhas ṅgā+od 'jug tu legs par bsgrabs rte/ mdor na gzhung lugs 'og ma'i nang du rgyas par ma byung bas spyir med par mi 'grub cing / bsdus pa'i tshul gyas ma byung ba yang ma grub/ khyad/ par mngo sde la 'jus/ 'dul ba

ra༅༅/ /la snang / chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba yang / sde snod kyi brjod bya spyi tsam gyi cha nas theg dman gyi sde snod gsum la 'jug pa sogs kyang grub cing / khyad par gyi cha nas theg chen rang gi nyid la 'jug pa sogs dang / spyir zab rgyas blor ma shong ba rtog ge nyid kyi shes rab dang mos pa dang bsod nams zhan pa'i dbang gis yin par gsungs so/ /bye smra'i sogs ni/ gtso bor thob pa ji cha/ sogs pa'i bya byed ldan 'brel don gzhan yin na/ byed po dang 'brel med du 'gyur zhing / 'brel pa gnyis pa yod na de yang don gzhan pas de la yang 'brel pa gzhan dgos pas thug med du 'gyur ba sogs so/ /mdo sde pa de yi sogs te/ 'brel po sogs/ kyi gnas skabs can rdzas yod dang / khyad par rdul phran cha med ni/ drug gis cig car sbyar ba na/ /zhes sogs kyis rgya cher 'gog par 'gyur bas 'dir rgyas par mi brjod do/ /grub mtha' kun shes las gzung ba phyi don bden par grub pa'i chos bdag rig pas dgag pa'i le'u gsum pa rgya cher bshad pa'o// //gnyis pa la/ theg chen spyi'i rnam bzhag bshad/ khyad par sems tsam gyi 'dod pa dgod/ de gzhan dang sprel nas dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ theg chen gyi rigs bsdu/ shing rta gnyis kyi bzhed tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la / gzhung lugs dang / grub mtha' bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir theg pa zhes pa khal dang ldan pa'i glang chen sogs la grags pa ltar khur khyer ba'i don yin la/ de yang che ba dang chung bas mchog dman du bzhag go /de yang 'dis 'gro ba

shān+ti pa dang /dri med sbas pa dang /sher khong sbas pa la sogs pa 'phags yul gyi r+sā slob dpon tshad ldan du ma sems i pa yin pa'i phyir dang /klu sgrub yab sras dang / ye shes zhabs rdong / desnyophalacher dbu ma pa yin 'a phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/gzhan yang / grub mtha' smra ba po dbu sems gnyis ka theg phi pa yin te/ thub bstan spyi dang khyad par theg chen gyi shing rta'i srol wod chen po gasmo su nges pa'i phyir/ rgyu mas ci'i phyir na/rnam rig tsam gyi tshul dang ngo bo nyid med kyi tshul gnyis su 'grel ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling rgyan drug gi gtso tho thogs med kyis rgyal tshab byam/sa pa la brten nas dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdo dang ni 'phags pa klu snaji zhabs kyis 'jam stongs la brten nas blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo bzhin du rang bzhin gsum gtan la phab pa 'i sgo nas bka' tha ma nges don dang / bden pa gnyis gtan la phab pa'i sgo nas bka' bar pa nges don du legs par bkral sogs kyi ra ro/ /gsum pa ni/'o na sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid 'grel pa klu sgrub kyi rig tshogs/sbas don mngon rtogs ston pa byams pa'i mngon to gas rgyan/ gtso bo'i don so gnyis su bsdu ba phyogs glang gi brgyad stong don bsdu/ sgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig tu bsdu ba dpa' tsho 'bum ṭīka r+sā shing rta'i srol wod bzhir grags pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de lngar sher sogs ni ma yin te/ bstan pa spyi dang khyad par theg 'a gyi de kho na nyid mchog tu gyur pa'i srol sngar ma phye ba gsal bar phye ba la shing rnga'i srol wod du

ra༅༅/ /'jog pa gang zhigasgo gsum rnam grangs bcu gcig sogs lta zhogayum don dngos brgyad du phye bas kyang don de mi 'grub pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/mthun pa dang /mi mthun pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sde gnyis theg dman pa dang dbu sems theg chen pa yin pa de'i phyir sogs te/gzhi'i gtso bo bdag gnyis kyis stong pa'i 'gyur med yongs grub bam bde gshegs snying po dang /lam gyi gtso bo bsam pa sems skyed dang sbyor ba phyin drug dang sa bcu'i spangs rtogs dang /'bras bu sku gsum gyi rnam bzhag la sogs pa/klu sgrub kyi mdo btus dang rin chen 'phreng ba dang bstod tsho+ogs gtam tshogs nas 'byung ba dang /thogs med kyi gzhung las 'byung ba snams la mi mthun pa cher med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ phal cher zhes pa ci zhe na/mi mthun pa'ang yod de/'di la/ phal ba dang /gtso bo gnyis las/ dang po ni/gzhan dbang dang / yongs grub bden pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par snga ma thogs med kyis byang sa'i de kho na nyed kyi le'ur rgya cher bsgrubs pa drang nges rnam 'byed na gsal lo/ /phyi ma klu sgrub zhabs kyis de yang spyir/ rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang / /rkyen la bltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes sogs dang / khyad par/ji ltar skad cig mtha' yod pa / /de bzhin thog ma dbus brtag go/zhes sogs rig pa'i tshul du mas bkag go/de bzhin du klu sgrab 'di 'dzin rnam khyad par gsum ldan gyi rang rig ni don dam du lta zhog tha snyad tsam du'ang mi bzhed de/rtsod zlog tu rgyas par bkag pa bzhin

gzhan nyid kyi dang /kun brtags bden par med pas rang gi mtshan nyid kyi dang / gzhan dbang rkyen la lto sa pas rang nyid kyi dang / yongs grub 'dus 'a dra༅ba'agyur gyi dngawa/ spangasapa mi zlog pas de la slar kun nas nyon mongs kyidang / sangs rgyas spangs rtogs mthar thug pas de la slar khyad par du 'gro ba'i skye ba rnams med par skye med kyi chos la bzod pa'o/ /'bras bu mthar thug theg rnga/ gcig tu gsungs pa la yang dgongs gzhi bdun te/shes bya'i chos bdag med du mtshungs pa dang / sgrub byed kyi lam bdag med kyi rnam ldan du mtshungs pa dang / bsnasas pa'i rnam grol bral 'bras su mtshungs pa'i phyir dang / rigs nges ma nges tha dad kyi sgo nas ma nges pa'i nyan thotra slob pa rnams theg chen du 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis sems can la bder gshegs snying po gzigs pas bdag nyid kya dgongs pa rnyed la/ nyan thos sngon theg chen la bslabs pa la bdag nyid sangs rgyas so snyam pa'i bsam pa ste gang zag gnyis la bsam pa gcig thob pa'i phyir dang / de bzhin gshegs pas sprul nas nyan thos kyi byang chub thob tshul ston pa dang / theg chen de theg pa'i mthar thug yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la ni dgos pa yang yod de/smo thos rigs ma nges pa theg chen du drang ba dang /byang sems rigs ma ngas pa theg chen nyid dwa gzung pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag li gzhung ni/thog ma dang ni de nyid gzhan nyid dang / /rang gi mtshan nyid rang dang gzhan du 'gyur/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa dang khyad par las/ /ste ba med pa'i chos la bzod par

ra༅༅/ /gad/ /chos dang bdag med grol ba rnams/ /mtshungs phyir rigs ni tha dad phyir/ /bsam gnyis thob phyir sprus pa'i phyir/ /mthar thug phyir na theg gzhig i/ /kha cig dag ni drang phyir dang / /gzhan dag kun tu gzung ba'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ /ma nges rnams la theg gcig bshad/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ sku mched gnyas kyi mos bdag 'gog tshul rjes wang rnams bden rdzun gyi khyad par/mas i gsum dang bden gnyis 'jog tshul lo/ /dang po la/ mdor bstan/ so sor bshad/ mdo dang sbyar/ zhar byung bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos thams cad rnam par rig pa tsam du smra ba'i gtsug rgyan man gco bo ni sku mched gnyis yin te/ rgya gar du chos mngon pa la gnod pa lan gsum byung bas nub pa na bram ze mo gsal ba'i tshul khrims kyis bu bskyed nas bstan pa 'dzin du 'jug par 'dod de/ rgyal rigs gcig dang 'dus pas gcen thogs med dang / bram ze gcig dang 'dus pas gcung stog gnyen 'khrangs te/ljags la gi haṃ gi yi ge a 'dri ba la sogs pa blo sno ba'i cho ga mang du byas te bskyangs nas/gcen gyis lo bcu gnyis su rgyal tshab dam pa bsgrubs pas grub ste dga' ldan du byon nas chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin la brten te / chos mngorno pa stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa theg 'a gyi shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod mang du gsan nas/ de'i don rgya cher ston pas sde lnga dang / bsdus te ston pa theg pa thun mong ba'i sdom mngon pa kun las btus dang / theg wo thun mong min

pa'i sdom theg bsdus la sogs pa mdzad de/'dzam bu'i gling du byams pa'i lo+o lnga dang ba.a pa dar zhi3 sa par mdzad do/ /stong gis chos mngon pa dar bar lung bstan pa'i yul ljongs kha cher byon nas/kha che 'dus pa bzhe+o gi mngon pa sde bdun dang bye brag stod mdzod la sogs pa legs par bslabs te/kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs gtso bor ston cing rig pa dang 'gal ba rnams bar yang cung zad bkag cing /'grel pas rgyas par bkag nas mdo sde pa'i lags lngog pa'i bstan bcos mdzod rtsa 'grel mdzad de/theg wo la thugs snang bar gnas pa/gnyen gyis 'dul thabs mdzad pas/phyis theg phi la shin tu mos shing mkhas par gyur te/pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la sogs pa rang dga' dang /r+shazhan 'grel gyi bstan bcos rgya cher 0mas shing /'bum sde dgu bsto go dgu thugs la mnga' ba brgyad stong pa la zhal 'don rgyun du mdzad pa sogs kyi rnam thar rgyas pa gzhan du gsal lo/ /sku mched gnyis kyi gzhung de dag tu theg chen gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag yang rgyas par khong mod kyis/bstan bcos kyi dgos pa'i gtso bo ni slob ma'i sems rgyud 'chos pa yin zhing /sems rgyud kyi r+yā pa'i gtso bo yang bdag tu lon pa yin pas/bdag 'dzin gyi gyen po ston pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung si khyad chos yin no/ /de yang tshon stangs kyi shen yul nyag nas 'gog pa las/gang zag ga bdag ni smo thos de gnyis kyis legs par bkag zin nas rtsal du mi 'don zhar byung gi tshul du ston la/chos kyi bdag ni rtog pa

ra༅༅/ /dang rtog med la snang ba gnyis mched gnyis kyis rtsal du bton nas 'gog ste/ 'di ltar rtog pa la bum pa dang bum pa'i ming gcig tu snang ba ni ngo bo nyid du btags pa'i kun brtags dang / bum pa'i mi rtag pa dang de'i ming bden pa'i gcig tu snang ba ni khyad par du btags pa'i kun brtags dang / rtog med la sngon po dang der 'dzin gyi gzung cha 'dzin cha gnyis rgyangs chad rdzas gzhan bden par snang ba'i kun brtags te/ rim pa bzhin rtog sogs bco+on pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ brten gyis rtog pa la dang / gcung gis rtog med la snang ba'i chos bdag 'gog tshul lo/ /dang po la/ dngos dang / des grub pa'i don no/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi bdag med bde blag tu grub par 'gyur te/ rtog pa la sogs 'di snang ba bzhin du bden par ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar/ ming gi snga rol blo med phyir/ /mang ba'i phyir dang ma nges phyir/ /de yi bdag nyid bdag mang dang / /bdag 'dres 'gal bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don/ lto ldir ba lta bu'i don de bum pa zhes pa lta bu'i ming de'i bdag nyid du gcig pa 'gal te/ gcig na brda med pa'i byis pas ming mi shes pa'i snga rol tu lto ldir ba mthong ba'i tshe bum pa'o snyam pa'i ming can gyi blo skye dgos pa las de 'dra skye ba med pa'i phyir / yang ming don gcig pa 'gal ba yin te/ gcig na brgya byin lta bu'i don gcig pu de bdag nyid mang por 'gyur dgos pa'i phyir te/ don brgya byin gcig nyid la mig stong pa dang skabs gsum dbang po sogs mang po'i ming dang ldan pas

so /yamemingadonagacigapa'agal ba yin te gcigashe de+on yul dang yul can gnyis gcig tu 'dres par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ /ming mngon sum zhes pa gnyig pu 'di don rtog bral gyi blo gcig nyid la 'jug par ma nges pa'i sgo nas dbu ma pa dag bum pa sogs kyi yul la mngon sum du grags pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang yul dang dus kyi dbang gis ming gcig nyid don du ma la 'jug pa mang ngo / /gzhan yang / ming dang don dag tha dad min na/ me sgra brjod pa dag gis kha ni cis mi sreg ces sogs mdo rgyud gzhan du rgyas par 'byung ste/ rtog pa la snga phyi gcig dang mang po gcig dang gcig du mar snang ba sogs snang ba ltar grub par bzung bas rang gzhan gyi lta ba ngan pa rnams byung la/ ma grub kyang log sa tha dad las log pa dang du mas 'bras bu gcig dang gcig gis 'bras bu du ma byed pa'i gzhan sel la mkhas pas yang dag pa'i lta ba skye bar 'gyur te rig pa'i gzhung las rtogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtog med la gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan du snang ba'ang rtog pa la snang ba'i ngo bo nyid dang khyad par du brtags pa'i kun brtags kyi bdag 'di'i rtsa ba can yin zhing / mdo sde so so las gsungs pa'i lam gyi spang bya'i rtog pa mngon rtogs rgyan las 'byung ba gzung rtog gnyis dang 'dzin rtog gnyis te bzhi dang / de las phye ba'i dgu bzhi so drug pa phrag gsum ste shes sgrib gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgya rtsa brgyad du grags pa dang / chos dang chos nyid rnam 'byed las/ med pa'i chos dang gang zag rdzas yod du 'dzin pa gnyis/ skye 'jig si 'gyur ba

ra༅༅/ /dang / chos dang chos nyid tha dad don dam du 'dzin pa gnyis/ chos dang gang zag kun brtags tsam yang med par 'dzin pa'i skur 'debs te/ med la 'dzin pa rnam pa lnga/ /zhes pa'i rnam rtog lnga/ dbus mtha' las / yi ge don dang yid byed dang / /mi 'phro ba dang mtshan nyid gnyis/ /ma dag dag dang glo bur dang / /mi dngangs pa dang khengs pa med/ /ces pa yi ge dang don dang yid la byed pa dang / mi 'phro ba dang rang gi mtshan nyid dang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / ma dag dag pa dang / glo bur ba dang / mi dngangs pa dang ma khengs pa rnams la phyin ci log gi rtog pa ste rnam rtog bcu dang / khyad par mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis ni yod dang med pa dang / /sgro 'dogs skur pa'i rtog dang gcig dang du ma dang / /rang dang khyad par rtog dang ming don ji bzhin du/ /mngon par zhen pa'i rtog pa yang dag spang bar bya/ /zhes pa byang sems kyi rnam rtog bcu rnams 'dir bshad pa'i ngo bo nyid dang khyad par du brtags pa'i kun brtags bden par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog nyid la brten pa'i phyir/ 'di sogs gsungs so/ /de yang mdo las/ 'tshol pa bzhi dang yongs shes bzhi dang de'i phan yon rnams rgyas par gsungs pa'i don/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ming dang dngos dag phan tshun du / /glo bur ba ni nyid du btsal/ /'dogs pa rnam pa gnyis po 'dir/ /de tsam nyid du 'tshol ba 'o/ /thams cad dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ /yang dag ye shes rnam pa bzhi/ /sa rnams kun la brtan pa yi/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa yin/ /

zhes ming dang don dang ngo bo dang khyad par 'tshol ba bzhi las/ ming don 'brel med brda'i dbang gis phan tshun glo bur du 'byung ba dang / des na ngo khyad gnyis kyang ming rgyang tsam du btsal zhing bsgoms pas/ chos bdag thams cad dmigs su med pa'i de bzhi yongs su shes pa'i yongs shes kyi ye shes bzhi ni sa thams cad la spangs rtogs don thams cad sgrub par byed ces sogs rgya cher brten pa'i gcen gyi slob ma'i rgyud 'chos tshul lo/ /gnyis pa la/ dngos dang / thun mong gi rig pa gzhan yang bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nyi shu pa las/ drug gis ci car sbyar ba na/ /phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur/ /drug po dag kyang go gcig na/ /gong bu'ang rdul phran tsam du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phyi don dpyad na mi 'grub ste / dbus rdul gcig la phyogs bzhi steng 'og dang drug gi rdul phran cig car du sbyar ba'i tshe dbus rdul de shar sogs so so'i phyogs la lta na/ dbus rdul cha bcas su 'gyur zhing / so sor mi lta'i shar sogs na rags pa rtsom par mi 'gyur ba des na'o/ /'o na/ mdo las/ mig dang gzugs/ rna ba dang sgra sogs skye mched gnyis tshan dang / khyad par gzugs sogs lnga gsungs pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ rang gi sa bon gang las su/ /rnam rig rnam pa gang byung ba/ /de dang de ye skye mched ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su thub pas gsungs/ /gzugs sogs skyed byed yod par ni/ /des 'dul ba yi skye bo la/ /dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ /rdzus rte 'byung ba'i sems can bzhin/ /thes rmi lam bzhin du bag chags las

ra༅༅/ /gnyis snang 'byung ba la dgongs shing / gang zag yod par gsungs pa ltar don smra khyed lta bu drang ba'i don du gsungs zhes so/ /sems snang rkyang pa yin na yul dus nges pa mi 'thad do zhe na'ang / sems can dpyal ba'i srang ma bzhin du rang rang gi las kyi dbang gis 'thad do/ /dmyal srang bye smra yi dwags kyi 'gro bar dang / mdo sde pa 'byung bzhi nyid der snang zhes zer ba la/ dad 'gro mtho ris su 'byung ba ni mi dang rdzogs byed kyi las 'dra bas yin na / themyul ba dang yi dwags 'phen rdzogs kyi las gnyis ka mi 'dra bas miswā yad pa dang / las kyi nus pas 'byung bzhi sems can du snang na sems nyid ci'i phyir mi snang zhes dang / sems nyid yin kyang srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i bya ba byed pa'ang mi 'gal te/ drang srong khros pas so can gyi grong stongs pa dang / 'dre'i yid dbang gis mi'i dran pa nyams par byed pa bzhin/ zhes sogs gsungs te rgyas par der blta'o/ /de ltar phyi don 'gog tshul rtsod sogs bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni / rig pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yang theg bsdus las/ don ni don du grub gyur na/ /ye shes rtog pa med mi 'gyur/ /de med pas na sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob par 'thad pa ma yin no/ /mi rtog ye shes rgyu ba la/ /don kun snang ba med pa'i phyir / /don med khong du chud par bya/ /de med pas na rnam rig med/ /ces bden par yod na 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngor yod dgos pa las/ de'i ngor med pa'i phyir dang / dpyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro

dang / /lha rnams ji ltar rigs rigs su/ /dngos gtseg yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes chu klung du snang ba'i dngos po gcig nyid/las bzang ngan gyi dbang gis/ 'u 'dzi ne la chu dang yi dwags la rnag khrag dang / tsha dpyal la khro chu khol mar mthong ba sogs 'gro ba rigs drug gi snang ba 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa rnams kyang so sor 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / rnam 'grel las/ du ma'i bdag skyon phyir/ /zhes skyes ba lhas byin gyi las gcig nyid dgra dang gnyen gyi mig sngar yid 'ong dang yi da mi 'ong gi snang ba 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / rmi lam sad pa'i gnas skabs dag /don byed pa la khyad med de/ /rmi lam na ni rmis pa bzhin/ /don byed mtshungs pas rang drozhin med/ /sgrus sems 'grel las gsungs pa ltar sang sogs dang / rnam 'grel las/don dang 'dra bar dmigs pa ste/ /gsal bar snang ba myong ba yin/ /zhes dang / nges par blo dang lhan cig tu/ /cig car du ni myong 'gyur ba'i/ /yal ni de las gzhan nyid du/ /rnam gang gis ni 'grub bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang / rnam nges las/ lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir/ /sngo dang de blo gzhan ma yin/ /zhes dang /rig gter las/gsal dang lhan cig dmigs pakā 'grub/ /ces sogs ltar gsal bar myong ba'i phyir dang / lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtags kyis 'grub ste/ da lta 'khrul ngor bsnyon du med pa'i gzung cha 'di chos can/ rang 'dzin shes pa las rdzas gzhan pa'i phyi rol don du med

ra༅༅/ /de/ rang 'dzin shes pa dang lhan cig dmigs pa nges pa'i phyir te/ gcig dmigs byed kyi tshad mas cig shos kyang phan tshun nges par dmigs pa'i phyir/ rgyas par gzhan du bshad zin to/ /gzhan yang / de 'dra las yin 'khrul par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de 'dra ba dang de las byung / /gal te myong ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /don mtshungs can gyi rnam par shes/ /mtshungs pa de ma thag myong 'gyur/ /zhes sogs ltar/ don las skyes pa sogs mi srid de / don sogs na'o/ /rgyu mtshan rgyas pa de rnams kyi phyi na don sogs yin cing snang ba ltar grub pa chos bdag yin pa de'i phyir sogs bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ rig pa de lta bus grub pa'i rnam rig gi tshul 'di ni/ bstan bcog mkhan po dag gis rang dga'i blos sbyar ba ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis lang kur gshegs pa dang dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba dang / mdo sde sa bcu pa la sogs pa zab mo stong pa nyid dang / yangs pa spyod phyogs rgya chen po ston pa'i theg chen gyi mdo sde mang po las gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ lang gshegs las/ phyi rol snang ba yongs med de/ /sems ni sna tshogs can du snang / /zhes dang / gtso bo rdul dang rnam rig dang / /gang zag rgyun dang phung po dang / /dbang phyug rkyen dang byed po rnams/ /sems tsam du ni nges brtags te/ /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol dor mthong log pa yin/ /rig pas rnam par brtags na ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ mtshan

nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag shin tu gsal ba dang / bga' bar pa las ngo bo nyid med par gsungs pa thams cad/ kun brtags mtshan nyid dang / gzhan dbang skye rbe dang yongasagrub don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa ste/ ngo bo nyid med pa gsum la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i drang don dang / de dag bden rdzun phye nas ston pa'i bka' tha ma nges don du rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sa bcu pa las/ kye ༄la ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes dang / sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs pa 'a/ gnas pas srid gsum rnam shes tsam du de kho na nyid mthong bar gsungs pa dang / 'od srungs kyis zhus pa las/ gang dag ral gri mda' chen mtshon 'byin pa'i/ /gnod pa byed pa yod pa ma yin te/ /sems kyi dbang gis ngan song de dag na/ /lus la 'bab mthong de na mtshon cha med/ /ces sogs dang / rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs dang ni/ /lhan cig mkha' la gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin kun gzhi rnam shes kyang / /rnam shes bdun dang lhan cig gnas/ /zhes sogs dang / de bzhin du/ lang gshegs dang dgongs pa nges 'grel las kyang / kun gzhi rnam shes rgya cher gsungs te/ mdor na/ sems tsam gyi gzhi ston pa lang gshegs dang rgyan stug po bkod pa / lam ston pa nges 'grel dang sa bcu pa/ 'bras bu ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo ste/ sems tsam mdo lngar grags pa dang / gzhan yang / snying po rma do bcu la sogs pa 'khor lo tha mar gtogs pa phal cher las sems tsam gyi tshul

ra༅༅/ /gsungs shing / byams mgon gyis kyang / rgyan dang 'byed gnyis su rgyas par gsungs pas/ gzhung lugs 'di ni gnas skabs su mos par bya zhing mkhas par bya ba'i gnas yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ gang dag sems tsam pa ni dngos por smra ba yin pas/ de ni rang sde'i mu stegs par gsungs pas shin tu sdang bar bya ba yin zhing / don dam par ni gzugs bzhin du sems kyang ma grub la/ tha snyad du ni sems bzhin du phyi rol gyi don yang grub pas / rtsom byed rdul phran yod cing / de yang cha med du mas spangs pa na bden grub tu 'gyur bas/tsho gzhi grub la cha bcas kyis khyab pa'i phyir na/ rdul phran cha bcas su tshad mas grub pa ni dpal ldan zla grags bzhed do zhes ding sang zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ 'dod pa de la ni/ phyogs kyi cha dang bcas bzhin du rdul phran yin na ri sogs 'bab pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ bstan/ bshad/ 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ spyir rnam par rig pa'i tshul ni mdo dang sngags las rgya cher gsungs shing / byams pa dang thogs med mched gnyis kyis rgyas par bkral ba yang lugs 'di smra ba la rnam bden rdzun gyi dbye ba ma mdzad par dngos bstan rnam rdzun nyid du gsal bar gsungs mod sgo dus phyis de dag gi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'dod tshul ni rnam bden dang rnam rdzun gnyis yin te/ gzugs can du snang ba mtha' dag snang mkhan gyi sems nyid bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis rgyangs chad kyi don du snang ba tsam yin sgo yin lugs bzung cha'i sems su bden pas na/ 'gog bden

yang spang bya dang bral ba'i sems la 'jog pa sogs/ mdo las phung sogs bden pa ste sems nyid du 'dod pa dang / yang snang ba thams cad zla gnyis dang rab rib can la snang ba'i ska shad sogs bzhin du med bzhin du snang ba'i med pa gsal snang yin pa'i phyir na/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi shes pa shel sogs nyid gcig pu dngos po gzhir byas la bden par 'dod pa gnyis yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / slob dpon phyogs glang yab sras ni gnyis ka bzhed de/ dmigs rtag tu / nang gi shes bya'i ngo bo ni/ /phyi rol ltar snang gang yin pa/ /don yin rnam shes ngo bo'i phyir/ /de rkyen nyid kyang yin phyir ro/ /zhes shes pa'i gzung cha nyid 'dzin mkhan rnam shes kyi dmigs rkyen yin pa dang / yang na/ nus pa'ang yin / zhes/ phyi don dang shes pa gnyis ma'i dmigs rkyen med kyang / rnam shes snga ma'i steng gi phyi ma yul gyi rnam ldan du skyed pa'i nus pa nyid dmigs rkyen yin zhes gsungs la/ rnam 'grel las/ rtog med kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ shes gang ji ltar snang ba de/ /de lta nyid du myong ba yin/ /de ltar sems kyi rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs gcig gi ngo bor 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'dzin pa yi ni nyer len dang / /myong ba sems kyi gzung mtshan nyid/ khes dang / gang phyir shes cha don du ni / /gzhag phyir shes pa yul bcas pa/ /zhes sogs mang po dang / rtog pa'i gzung rnam shes pa yin pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ de dag gi yang de lta'i dngos/ /bkag med gsal bar snang ba nyid/ shes pa'i ngo bo'i don nyid phyir/ /gal te

ra༅༅/ /spyi shes ngobo yi/ /don nyid yin na thal bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'dod phyir skyon yod min/ /zhes sogs dang / rung yul gnas pas mi shes pa/ /rang nyid shes phyir de shes yin/ /zhes sogs rnam bden gyi phyogs dang / de dag 'gog pa na/ sna tshogs snang can don rnams la/ /gal te gcig nyid mi rigs na/ /re zhig gcig bu'i blo de nyid/ /sna tshogs su ni ji ltar snang / /ji lta ji ltar don bsams pa/ /de lta de ltar rnam bral zhes/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis gang gsungs pa/ /de ni dngos stobs 'ongs pa yin/ /zhes pa nas/'jig rten thugs ni 'ba' shig gis/ /phye rol spyod la 'jug par mdzad/ khes pa'i bar rgyas pa dang /'bras rtog gsum pa 'go brtsams pa nas/ galate mtshungs pa de ma thag /rkyen las nges par mi smra na'o/ /zhes pa'i bar du/ skye 'gyur rab rib la sogs bzhin/ /zhes sogs dang / skra sogs shes pa'i tha dad bzhin/ /zhes sogs med pa gsal snang du gsungs pa dang mthun par / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi byang chub sems 'grel las/sems tsam 'chad pa'i skabs su/gzung dang 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /rnam shes gnyis su snang 'gyur te/ /rnam shes las ni logs shig na/ khye rol don ni cung zad med/ khes pas rnam bden dang / des na phyi rol snang ba 'di/ /dngos po'i ngo bor nam yang med/ /rnam shes so sor rnam rig pa/ /gzugs kyi rnam pas snang bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar skye bo sems rmongs pas/ /smyu ma smig sgya dri za yi/ /grong khyer la

sogs mthong ba ltar/ /me+ongs pas gakhrugs la sogs pa mthong / /zhes pas rnam rdzun gsal bar gsungs so/ /de bzhin du/ mkhas pa hwakhishā blos/ shes bya nang gi yin par smra ba la bgokha ba 'di mtshungs pa ma yin te/ 'di ltar de yi sngon po dang ser po la sogs pa phyi dang nang na yod pa ma yin la/ de'i phyir ri bong gi rwa dang 'dra ba yin no/ /zhes pas rnam rdzun dang / yang / rnal 'byor dpyod pa gzhan dag ni/ sngon po dang ser po la sogs pa thams cad med pa min te/ dga' ba la sogs pa bzhin du gsal bar nyams su myong ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /'on kyang sngon po la sogs pa phyi rol gyi ngo bo nyid du yod pa ma yin zhing / shes pa 'dzin par 'dod pa gcig gi cha gnyis par gyur pa yin no/ /zhes pas rnam bden bshad la / dbu ma rgyan du/ ji ltar thog ma med rgyud kyi/ /bag chags smin pas sprul pa yi/ /rnam pa dag ni snang ba yang / /nor bas sgyu ma'i rang bzhin 'dra/ /zhes pas rnam rdzun dang / rgyu dang 'bras bur snang ba kun / shes pa 'ba' zhig kho na ste / /zhes pas rnam bden gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ ding sang rnam bden pas sngon po shes par 'dod ces pa'i grub mtha' la than ltas byas nas/ rnam bden rdzun gyi grub mtha' bod rang rang gi blos sbyar ba'i rang bzos 'jog pa ni/ bstan pa 'ari'i ston pa dang bstan 'dzin tshad mar gyur pa ni mya ngan las 'das/ de dag gi gzhung lugs rnams ni glegs bam bsnams bsngams/ pa nyid du bzhugs/ tshig gi chad lhag bsgug pa la re ba'i chos skad la mchog tu 'dzin pas nongs so/ /de

ra༅༅/ /ltar rnam bden smra ba dang / mdo sde pa gnyis / snang ba 'di shes pa'i gzung byar 'dod pa la khyad par med par ni/ mdo sde pa'i gzhung lugs tshad mar gyur pa phyi rol don grub las/ sems tsam pa'i lhan cig dmigs nges 'gog pa'i skabs su/ sheg pa rnam bcas phyogs la ni/ /da ltar snang ba myong cha nyid/ /de dang tha dad min sgrub na/ /grub pa bsgrub pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snang dang tha dad min sgrub na/ /grub pa bsgrub pa nyid du 'gyur/ /shes pa rnam bcas smra ba dang / /'di la rtsod pa yod ma yin/ /zhes gsal bar bshad do/ /des na bod kyi rtog ge pa rnams kyis mdo sde pa'i yul 'dzin tshul yang / bstan pa 'di la mi gtogs pa'i mdo sde pa'i lugs yin par gsal lo/ /gzhan yang / gzhung der sems tsam pa'i dmigs rkyen 'dod tshul gsum bkag ste/ phyi rol dmigs par mi rung phyir/ /yul ni gzung ba'i char 'dod na/ /zhes rang dus kyi gzung cha dang / 'dra ba'i shes pa snga ma la/ /dmigs par 'dod pa gang yin pa/ /zhes shes pa snga ma'i gzung cha dang / kha cig shes pa mtshungs skyed pa'i/ /nus pa dmigs pa yin par 'dod/ /ces snga ma'i steng gi yul gyi rnam ldan du skyed pa'i nus pa la dmigs rkyen du 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar rnam bden pa ltar na/ 'khrul pa'i blo mi srid de/ zla ba gnyis snang yang shes pa'i gzung cha la ma 'khrul bar 'dod pas so/ /des na 'dis shes pa'i gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan khas blangs so/ /'di la rnam rdzun pas/ phyi rol gyi don zhes bya ba'i ra byed de ba ni

med rdzi phyogs kyi cha dang bcas pa'i snang ba 'di bden par khas blangs pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong ma rtogs so zhes bkag nas/ rang lugs gzhan rig gi shes pa thams cad 'khral par 'dodado 'on gnyis/ltarayangastong 5zha ring thung la sogs mi 'thad do zhe na/ gnyis sogs te/ ska shad dang rmi lam dang zla gnyis sogs 'phral dang sngo 'dzin sogs gtan sogs so/ /rnam bden yang phyi rol don du 〉nga ba'i cha nas 'khral zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyedri las / rnam bden la 'dod pa brjod pa ni/ sems tsam rnam bden pa la'ang bod snga ma dag sgo nga phyed tshal ba dang / gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa dang / sna tshogs gnyis med pa zhes gsum du 'byed padī pa/ bod phyi ma dag gis dgag pa sna tshogs byas pa ni mi rigs te/ de gsum du yod par rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung la grags shing don la grub pa'i phyir te/ 'di ltar/ gang phyir shes cha don du ni/ /gzhag phyir sogs la brten nas/ bram ze chen po shaṃ kur nan das/ gang snang de 'dir rang yin te/ /gzhan gang de ni mi snang nyid/ /ces dang / slob dpon tsan+t+ra ha ris/ rnam pa sgong bshabs lta bur ni/ /smra ba'i sems tsam rnam bden pa/ /bye brag smra dang chos mthun te/ /gzung pa yi ni rnam pa dang / /'dzin pa'i rnam pa tha dad la/ /ces mthong 'dod/ ces dang / 'dis shes pa'i gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan yang 'dod de/ nang du snang ba'ang gzhan yin la/ /phyi ru snang ba'ang de gzhan nyid/ /gsal bar bya dang gsal byed nyid/ /mar me bzhin du de nyid min/ /

go༅༅/ /zhes bshad pas gzung cha sogs dang / dbu ma rgyan du/ci ste rnam pa'i grangs bzhin du/ /rnam par shes pa khas len na/ /zhes bkod nas dgag pa rgyas par mdzad cing /shākya blo'i 'grel bar/ dkar dmar la sogs pa rnam pa'i grangs ji snyed par shes pa'i grangs kyang de snyed du 'dod slo rnam sogs dang / dbu ma rgyan du/gal te sna tshogs de tsog na/ /zhes sogs dang / rnam 'grel du/ re zhig gtsig bu'i blo lda nyid/ /sna rgas su ni ji ltar snang / /zhes sogs rnam bden pa rgya cher bkag pas/rnam sogs smra ba'o/ /de dgag pa la/thun mong ni/ gsum sogs te/ bden par grub na gcig tu bden par grub pa las ma 'das pas snga ma gnyis gzung cha 'dzin cha phyi ma gnyis dang re re'ang du mar bden par 'dod pa khegs shing /gsum ga'ang rags pa phyogs kyi cha dang bcas par snang ba 'di bden par grub na/drug gis cig car sbyar ba na/ /zhes sogs rdul phran 'gog pa dang mtshungs pas khegs so/ /so sor dgag pa ni/'dod pa dang po la gzung tshon rdzas gzhan du thal ba dang /gnyis pa la gang zag gcig gi rgyud la rigs mi mthun gyi shes pa gzugs tshon dang sgra tshon lta bu drug cig car 'byung bar rnam 'grel sogs las bshad kyang / rigs mthun gyi rnam shes ni dus gcig gi tsha gcig nyid du nges te/mdo las/ snga phyi med par sems gnyis 'byung ba ni gnas dang skabs med ces dang / sems ༅ rnams ni rnam par shes pa'i rgyud re re ba'o/ /zhes dang / bstan bcos las/ de dag

rnams la rigs mthun pa'i/ /rnam par shes la nges par 'gyur/ /'di ltar rnam par rtog pa rnams/ /rim gyis 'byung bar yang dag rtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba dang / lugs gsum pa la ni/ 'dzin byed shes pa gcig dang / gzung bya rnam pa du ma rdzas gcig tu bden pa 'gal ba'i rig pas bkag ste/ dbu ma rgyan las/ gal te rnam pa yang dag shes/ /du mar 'gyur ro yang na ni/ /de dag gcig 'gyur 'gal ldan pas/ /gdon mi za bar so sor 'gyur/ /yang dag pa'i rnam pa dang tha dad pa ma yin pas/ rnam pa'i rang gi ngo bo bzhin du rnam par shes pa du mar 'gyur ba'am/ yang na rnam shes gcig bu dang tha mi dad pas/ rnam pa rnams kyang rnam par shes pa'i rang gi ngo bo bzhin du gcig pu nyid du thal bzlog bar dka'o zhes sogs dang / yang sngo ser sogs kyi rnam pa rnams shes pa gcig tu bden na/ baṇig g.yo na thams cad g.yo ba dang / gcig bsgribs na thams cad bsgribs pa la sogs pa yan lag can cha med bakhog 'gog pa'i rig pa dang / 'di mdo sde pa'i rnam pa la yang mtshungs pa dang / gcig nyid du mar bden pa ni gcer bu pa'i lugs yin pa dang / gcig tu bden na blo ma 'khrul pa la sna tshogs su snang ba mi 'thad pa dang / skyon de dag gis 'jigs nas gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam 'dod na/ spyir gzung cha bden grub rdul phran 'gog pa'i rig pas khegs pa dang / sgo nga phyed tshal ba ltar gzhan dus mnyam du 'dod na/ 'dzin pa rgyu med dus 'gyur zhing / de lta na/ res 'ga' bar mi 'thad par thal ba

ra༅༅/ /sogs dang / rnam pa gtan med kyi phyogs la yang dgag pa mang du mdzad nas/ tha snyad du rnam bden bzhed pa lta bu'i rnam gzhag gi sgo nas gzung char snang bzhin pa 'di rnam par byas pa'i brgal brtag kho na 'dzin pas / ding sang / sngon por snang ba 'di sngon po dngos yin gyi sngon po'i rnam pa min la/ sngo 'dzin shes pa'i gzung rnam ni sngo 'dzin shes pa nyid yin no zhes zer ba la ni khungs cung zad kyang med cing / 'dzin rnam yan gar ba chos gsum ldan ni / 'dzin byed kyi ma nyid ma tshang yang rig tsam la 'dzin rnam du ming btags pa rnam rdzun pa'i 'dod pa yin pas/ rnam bden rdzun bsres pa'i grub mtha' rang bzo 'ba' zhig tu snang ngo / /rnam rdzun pa la/ dgag pa dngos dang / dbye ba brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems tsam rnam sogs de chos can/ shes pa dang rig pa'i mtshan nyid med par 'gyur te/ yul don la med pa'i phyir na'o/ /rgyan las/ 'di ltar gang la rnam pa med/ /de la de shes yod ma yin/ /bde ba min la bde sogs dang / /dkar ba'i rnam la mi dkar bzhin/ /zhes dang / sems 'grel las/ rig pos rig bya rig byed na/ /rig bya med pas rig byed med/ khes sogs dang / 'jug pa las/ byed po las dang bya ba gcig min pas/ /de nyid kyis de myong bar rigs ma yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzung ba med na de 'dzin med/ /ces rang gis lan mang du smras pa dang yang 'gas la/ gnyis stong gi shes pa shel gong dag pa 'dra ba la ni dmigs byed med de/ rgyan

las / rnam pa med pa de nyid kyis/ shes de yang ni med par 'gyur/ skodze gong dag pa 'dra ba yis/ shes pa rab tu tshor ba med/ /ces so/ /de 'dra'i myong ba bden par grub pa de nyid rdzun par snang ba 'di dang bdag gcig de byung gi 'brel pa yod dam med/ med na/ de la rdzun snang 'byung mi rigs te/ de dang 'brel pa gnyis med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ med kyang 'byung na rgyal ba sangs rgyas la'ang 'byung bar nges dgos la de lta na/ rnam rdzun gyi bzang shos dri med mi 'thad cing / 'brel sogs 'gyur te/ bden grub kyi dngos po dang bdag gtsig de byung gang rung du grub pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam sogs te/ sangs rgyas sogs kyis so/ /'di la dpal chos kyi grags pas ni/ bden bzhi'i gnas lugs lta bu yul dngos stobs kyis grub pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ gzhan don du brtse ba chen pos kun nas bslangs te goms rkyen dang ma bra'/ bar yun ring du goms pas/ gsal snang rab kyi mthar phyin pa 'byung bar tshad mas grub pa'i sgo nas/ ston pa dang bstan pa la shin tu yid ches par grub mod lgi ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya mkhyen tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ gzugs sogs dang ni sems de ltar/ /gzung ba'i mtshan nyid dpyod pa 'di / /ma das blo can la yin gyis/ /rnal 'byor rtogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang / rgyud gzhin grub par yang bcom ldan 'das kyis don thams cad thugs su chud pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ zhes sogs gsungs la/ de'i 'grel byed

ra༅༅/ /slob dpon dul ba lhas ni/ mnyam par gzhag pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rjes las thob pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis gzhan gyi sems mkhyen la ye shes gzhan gyis ni ma yin no/ /ye shes de ni gzung 'dzin dang bcas kyang / de nyid kyis log pa nyid du gzigs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs ni dri bcas pa dang / byams pas/ de ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i/ /ye shes yul med dmigs med cing / /mtshan ma thams cad mi dmigs pas/ /rab phye ba ni yin phyir ro / /zhes dang / thogs med kyis/ mi rtog ye shes rgyu ba la/ /don kun snang ba med pa'i phyir/ /don med khong du chud par bya/ /de med pas na rnam rig med/ zhes dang / zhi ba 'tshos/ tshad ma'i de nyid bsdus par/ dmigs pa can gyi gzhung lugs la/ /gzhan gyi 'dod chags sogs rig na/ /sgrib pa yod pa 'thob 'gyurate/ /rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /des na gzigs pa med par bstan/ /zhes dang / rgyan mkhan pos/ da lta'i skye bo la bltos nas/ /gnod byed zhes pa med pa la/ /ma 'khral bar bshad don dam du/ /dmigs pa thams cad 'khral pa yin/ /zhes bshad pa rnams ni dri med pa ste/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med pas rab tu sgo/ /zhes spyod 'jug las dang / sems 'gags pa de hūṃ yis mngon sum mdzad/ /ces sogs 'jug par bshad pa dang shes bya mkhyen tshul mthun zhing / snga ma dang rnam bden pa dang dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams ni ma

dag pa'i shes bya yang snang nas mkhyen par 'dod de/ rgyas par 'og nas bshad par bya'o/ /'phros don ni/ rnam rdzun pa gnyis po 'di dag dbu ma thal 'gyur bas dpyad na rtog shes bzhag pa thams cad mi 'thad la/ ma brtags ma dpyad na 'jig rten rang dga' ba 'bod pa thams cad kyang 'khrul ngor khas len pas/ lta ba mchog tu gyur pa bzhin du/ ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i rtog sogs yod par bzhed de/ phyi rol don ni yod na yang / /zhes sogs 'bras rtogs gsum par phyi don gzhal byar byas pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa'i phyir/ phyi don rig ngor mi bzhed de/ phyi don rig ngor don la yod na/ de phyir gzhal bya rtogs pa yi/ /sgrab byed gzhal bya'i rang bzhin nyid/ /ces pa 'bras rtogs dang po dang tshad ma 'dra bar bzhed rigs pa las/ de tshe don snang 'di nyid ni/ /tshad yin/ zhes gzung rnam tshad mar mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis kyang sngo 'dzin tshad ma'i gzung rnam sngo 'odzan tshad ma nyid yin par 'dod pa la gnod de/ de lta na 'bras rtogs dang po dang khyed med du 'gyur bas zlos skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rig ngor don la grub pa'i dbang du byas na phyi don rig pa lta ci smos/ gnyis snang can gyi gzhan rig gi sems dang sems byung tsam yang med de/ de la gcig nyid med pas kyang / /gnyis ga'ang nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /de phyir gnyis stong gang yin pa/ /de yang de yi de nyid yin/ /zhes sogs dang / 'jug pa las/ phyi rol gzung ba med par 'byung 'gyur zhing / /yod dang spros kun yul min rang bzhin yod/ /ces sogs mdo

ra༅༅/ /dang bstan bcos las mang du 'byung ngo / /de dag gis ni/ gnyis stong gi shes pa de yang de kho na nyid dam gnas lugs kyi don nam don dam pa'i bden par bstan te/ gzhan du na yang sgra la nus pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gnyis stong gi 'gyur med yongs grub 'dus ma byas su ma zad/ gzhan dbang gi gtso bo mdo sngags du ma las gzhi'i ye shes dang bde gshegs snying por gsungs pa de yang zhes de'i dgongs par gdon mi za'o/ /de bas na lugs 'di la bya sogs te/ blo bdag rnam par dbyer med kyang / /mthong ba phyin ci log rnams kyis/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rig pa dag /tha dad ldan bzhin rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / gzung dang 'dzin pa rig pa dag /yod pa min yang gzhal bya dang / /'jal byed 'bras bur gnas pa ni/ /ji ltar rjes su snang bzhin byas/ /zhes don la med kyang / 'khral shes la ji ltar snang ba bzhin du bya byed 'jog go zhes lan mang du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan de rnams kyi phyir na 'bras sogs te / 'bras rtogs dang por mdo sde pas/ rang gzhan gyi sde pas tshad ma dang 'bras bu rdzas gzhan du 'dojo pa rnams legs par bkag nas/ de gnyis don gcig gzhir byas la gzhal bya'i gtso bo nyi don du bsams nas de gzhal byar byas pa'i bya byed las gsum dang / gnyis par de bkag nas rnam bden pas shes pa'i gzung cha gzhal byar byas pa'i shes pa nyid kyi bya byed las gsum tshad grub tu bzhag pa na/ don la phyi ma yang ma grub cing rtog ngor snga ma yang grub pas gnyis ka mi 'thad par

'byung ba min/ /zhes pa'i 'grel bshad du/ kun gzhi khas blangs pa'i phyir dang / sems tsam dang tha snyad sgo bstun gyi rnal 'byor dpyod pa'i dbu ma pa/ zhi 'tsho yab sras deng / 'phagasaseng rjes 'brangadangabacasapasakyang mdosngagasakun tu rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi rnam dag dang gnas gyur sogs rgyas par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo dang sde bdun du rgya cher mi gsal ba ni/ de la brten pa'i bshad pa dang 'brel chung bas yin no/ /sku mched gnyis kyis gsal bar bshad tshul ne+e / theg bsdus su/ shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid der 'jug dang / /de yi rgyu 'bras de rab dbye ba dang / /bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang / /ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sdom tshig mdzad nas/ don dang po drug po kun gzhi kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i dam bca' dang smib byed du ma mdzad cing / sum cu pa las/ bdag dang chos/ su nyer 'dogs pa/ /sna tshogs dag ni gang byung ba/ /de ni rnam par shes par gyur/ /gyur ba de yang rnam gsum ste / /rnam par smin dang ngar sems dang / /yul la rnam par rag pa 'o/ /zhes shes bya thams cad sems kyi chos su dang / sems kyang rnam smin gyi rnam shes kun gzhi dang / ngar sems kyi rnam shes nyon yid dang / yul shes kyi rnam shes 'jug shes drug tu mdor bstan nas/ de la kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni/ rnam smin sa bon thams cad pa/ /de ni len pa dag dang gnas/ /rnam par rig dang mi rig dang / /rtag tu reg dang yid byed dang / /tshor dang 'du shes sems par ldan/ /

ra༅༅/ /de la tshor ba btang snyoms te/ /de ni ma sgribs lung ma bstan/ /reg la sogs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de ni rgyun 'bab chu bo bzhin/ /dgra bcom nyid na de ldog go /zhes pas kun gzhi dang / de la gnas te rab byung zhing / /de la dmigs pa yid ces bya/ /rnam shes ngar sems bdag nyid can/ /bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa'i/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang rtag tu 'grogs/ /zhes sogs kyis nyon yid dang 'jug shes kyang rgyas par bstan pas de dag tu blta bar bya'o/ /rnam sheg brgyad po phan tshun rgyu 'bras te/ bdun pos kun gzhi la dge sdig lung ma bstan gyi bag chags 'jog cing / kun gzhis gzhan rnams kyi rgyu'i rkyen byed pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ byams pas mdzad pa'i mtshan nyid gsum gtan la dbab pa las/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dzo bo yis/ /sems de rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ khun gzhi dang ni 'jug shes so/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du rtsa ba'i dang 'jug pa'i shes pa zhes kyang bya ste/ de las/ dang po rtsa ba'i rnam shes te/ /gzhan rnams 'jug pa'i rnam shes so/ /zhes so/ /de yang rnam bden pas gzhi dus na rnam shes brgyad ka don dam du grub par dang / rnam rdzun pas kun gzhi don dam du grub kyi gzhan kun rdzun snang du 'dod do/ /gsum pa la/ mdor bston/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ rnam rig pa'i lugs kyis snang grags kyi chos kun kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis dang kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub ste mtshan nyid gsum du bsdus nas 'chad de/ bshad ma thag pa'i gzhung

dang / rig pas dpyad bzod du grub pa rnams/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ gzhan dbang nyid kun brtags dang yang dbyer med dang yongs grub dang yang dbyer med du gsungs pa'i don/ de de gnyis dang mi 'gal ba'i don du bshad na gzhung lugs rnams dang mi 'gal bar mthong bas/ ding sang dngos po la gzhan dbang dang / 'khrul ngo'i dang rig ngo'i dngos med la gzhan gnyis kyis khyab par byas nas/ gsum ga 'gal bar 'dong pa la ni/ rnam grangs ba'i kun brtags dang ma dag gzhan dbang gnyis dbye bar dka' zhing / dbus mtha'i 'grel par/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni yongs su grub pa kho na ste/ zhes bshad nas/ de ma thag tu don dam la sgrub pa don dam sogs rgesum du dbye ba'i 'gal spong du/ skyon med de/ yongs grub la 'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa gnyis yod pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams 'chad mi shes so/ /rgyas bshad ni/ de ltar na don la ma grub par rtog pas btags pa'i gtso bo dang / rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag dang / spyi dngos po ba dang rdul phran la sogs pa ni mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun brtags dang / rtog pa la du ma gcig dang gcig du mar snang ba'i don spyi rnams dang / rtog med dbang shes la gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba sogs ni rnam grangs pa'i kun brtags yin no/ /de yang rnam bden pa ltar na/ phyi rol gyi dngos por snang ba'i cha la bya'o/ /de ltar 'khrul pa'i gzhi sems dang sems byung gnyis snang gi 'khrul ldan rngams ni ma dag gzhan dbang dang / gnyis
