༄༄༄/ /gnyis phan tshun spangs te gnas pa'i 'gal ba yin par nges shing khas blangs pas 'grub bo/ /de dag ni gzho bor snang tsam la bden pa 'gog la/ sde pas brtags sogs 'dod pa la sngar bshad pa'i gzugs can phyogs cha dang dngos po tsam la dus chas dgag cing / de ltar rtsom byed khegs pas des sogs khegs so/ /de dag gis dngos po bden grub khegs mod/ nam mkha' sogs dngos med bden grub gang gis dgag ce na/ chos nyid dang nam mkha' sogs la chos can dang rten gyi cha tsam la dpyad pas kyang cung zad 'grub cing / gzhung rnams kun tu ni dngos po sogs bkag pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dngos med sogs phyir ro/ /dngos med ngo bo med pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo med pas brjod bya min / /zhes dang / rig gter las kyang / des na dngos po bsal ba la/ /dngos med ces ni btags par zad/ /ces dang / nam mkha' mo gsham bu dang mtshungs/ /zhes sogs/ dgag bya bkag tsam gyi med dgag ci med cang med du grags par ma go na/ dngos med kyi don spyi ma shar la shar na bden 'dzin shas chung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhung rnams su stong nyid sogs mdzad de/ brtags pa'i dngos la ma reg par/ /de yis dngos med 'dzin ma yin/ /zhes sogs dang / dgag bya yod pa ma yin pas/ /yang dag tu na bkag med gsal/ /zhes sogs dang / de tshe dngos med rten bral ba/ /blo yi mdun na ji ltar gnas/ /zhes sogs dang / rgya cher rngog lo'i spring yig na yod do/ /dpe ni gzugs

brnyan spyir bden sogs grub pas de dper len no/ /gnyis pa gsum pa lhan cig spyod pa la gnyis las/dang po rdo rje gzegs ma'i rtags dgod pa ni/myu gu chos gad/ bdel skye bamed de/rang dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka min pa las skye ba dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /dpe ni gzugs brnyan sogs so/ /de mdor/bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la/'brel byed kha cigarkang pa bzhi pas/bden pa'i skye ba med de zhes pa'i dam bca' dang /rkang pa gzhan rnams kyis gto tshigs bstan par bzhed kyang /dpal ldan zla bas/phyi nang gi dngos po gang dgayul dus grub mtha' gang na yang bdag las skye ba nam yang ngam gzhar yang ste skye tshul cung zad tsam yang yod pa ma yin zhes sogs gzhi la sbyar bas gtan tshigs dngos su bstan pas/ spyir bden pa'i skye med kyi baspras bya shugs la bstan par bzhed cing / 'jug par/ de nyid de las 'byung mi/na sogs de'i sgrub byed kyi rig pa bsgrub pa'i phyir bshad pa zhes gsungs kyang /tshig rkang gnyis po ni gtan tshigs bsgrub rgyu rjes su brjod pa tsam yin la/sgrub byad kyi rig pa ni/de nyid de las 'byung na yon to 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /zhes sogs kyis rgya cher 'chad do/ /da yang lugs 'dis bdag las mi skye ste/yod pa'i phyir/zhes sogs rang rgyud du mi 'god par/ bdag sogs zhi las sle na skon 'di dang 'dir 'gyar zhes

ra༅༅/ /khas blangs rtags su bkod nas mi 'dod par thal bar 'then pa gtso bor mdzad pas kyang thal 'gyur pa zhes zer la/ rang rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang bsgrub ngag kyang mang po 'god mod/ tshul gsum dngos stobs kyis ma grub cing 'thad pa dang bral ba tsam las bsgrab bya 'grub cing rtogs pa dang / dngos stobs kyis grub par gyur pa'i bsgrub bya sgrab byed khas blangs na phyogs gzhan khas blangs pas phrad ma phrad sogs rgyu 'bras dngos stobs kyis grub pa la bkod pa'i skyon rnams 'jug par gsungs te/ mi rbeden bzhin du rang gi byad bzhin mdzes par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'di ni yod pa ji lta sda bzhin 'dir yang shes rab gdong / /sbyang bar bya la nus pa mthong bar gyur pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ /'thad pa dang bral las kyang rang gi bsgrub bya rtogs zhes shes par gyis/ /gal te rang gis bsgrub bya go byed gtan tshigs dngos gyur dang / /dngos su go bya nyid 'gyur bsgrub bya'i ngo bo'am yod gyur na/ /phrad pa la sogs rig pa nye bar sbyor bar 'gyur zhig na/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pas/ gang dag dbu ma thal 'gyur ba la khas len dang dam bca' gang yang med ces smra mkhan byung bar byas nas/ sdom pa khas mi len par thal ba sogs kyi thal 'gyur mang po shog bu zad zad du bkod nas/ gal te ngas dam bcas 'ga' yod/ des na nga la skyon 'di yod/ /ces sogs phyogs gzhan khas blangs pa med par gsungs pa thams cad don dam la dgongs pa yin no zhes dang / spyir yang med ces pa'i tshig gang byung du don dam zhes pa'i khyad par

sbyar nas don de gar song rtog dpyod ye mi 'jug par phyin pas dbu ma'i slob gnyer shin tu sla zhing / mngon sum la tshugs thub tu snang ba dang cha la brtags nas rtog pas bzhag pa'i chos la bden 'dzin che chung khyad par ye med pa'i sgo nas dngos por smra ba mtha' dag las bden 'dzin 'grug pa'i 'jus tshul ni sngar bshad pa rnams rtogs na bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa tshul sgrub pa ni/ khyab pa ni/ dngos stobs sam yul ngos sam/ dgrad ngo'i skye ba mtha' bzhi gang rung las ma 'das pas rtogarme sla ba la dgongs nas gzhung du rgyas par ma bkod pas 'dir yang ma bshad la/ phyogs chos sgrub pa la bzhi las bdag skye med pa'i rtags sgrub ni/ dang po'i sogs te/ grangs can gyi nang tshan lha med pa zhes bya bas/ myu gu ni gtso bo'i rnam 'gyur tsam dang gtso bo ni de'i rang bzhin yin pas/ rang gi rang bzhin grub zin rtag dngos zhi+og las skyes par 'dod la phyogs mthun bod na'ang yod pas/ de dag gis dngos su ma smras kyang zhe 'dod ni myu gu rang nyid las skye bar song bas / de lta na/ myu gu skyes stobs sa bon 'gags pa mi 'thad pas sa ban sags dang / rgyu sa ban ma 'gasas pa de 'dod na 'bras bu myu gu'i skye ba dang sogs dang / myu ga rgyu dus na mi gsal ba gsal du song ba de skye ba'i doni du 'dod pa'i ma/ngon sogs min par thal ba ni/ gal te sngar gyi bdag si dngos po sogs long pa gnyis kyis bstan la gzhon rnams sbyar sla ba dang / gal te myu gu sa bon 'dir gzhin ma yin na/ /zhes sogs kyi myu gu gto mi mthong zhing sa bon rtag tu mthong

ra༅༅ bar thal bas mthong ba dang 'gal zhing / gang phyir rgyu zhig na yang sogs kyis 'jig rten dang 'gal ba dang / gal te bdag las skye na sogs kyis bya byed sogs phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gzhan skye me'i rtags sgrub la / dngos dang / 'phros don yod med skye 'gog gzhan skye 'jig rten las grub pa dgag de la brten nas kun gzhi bden grub sogs mi dgos par grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos smra ba'i mkhas pa dag gis/ grangs can 'dod pa'i bdag skye 'gog tshul ni shin tu legs mod 4 rkyen rnams bzhi ste rgyu dang ni/ /dmigs pa dang ni de ma thag /bdag po yang ni de bzhin te/ /rkyen lnga pa ni yod ma yin/ /zhes shes rig don mthun rnams rkyen bzhi ga dang / dngos po phal cher rgyu dang bdag po'i rkyen las skye zhing / de yang rgyu 'bras gnyis ka blos btags tsam min par yul rang ngos nas grub pa brtags shing dpyad pa'i mthar skye bas/ gzhan skye tshad mas grub pa yin no zhes smra zhing / de yang mdo sde pas rgyu 'bras la snga phyi'i khyab pa dang / gzhan rnams de shas che mod kyi dus mnyam yang yod do zhes smra'o/ /'di ni rang rgyud pa yang tha snyad tsam du ci rigs par bzhed do/ /'di 'gog pa la rig pa mang po ltar gsungs kyang / bsdu na/ gzhan las skye ba mi srid pa dang / skye ba la gzhan mi srid pa gnyis su 'dus pas/ dang po ni/ rgyu min pa kun las 'bras bu min pa kun skye bar 'gyur te/ nas sogs nas las rang gi ngobo sa grub pa'i gzhan du mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab ste/ de 'dra'i gzhan du grub na

phan tshun rag ma las pa'i da ltar ba rwa g.yas g.yon bzhin du 'gyur la/ de lta yin bzhin du yang rgyu 'bras su 'gyur na/ sa lu'i sa bon gyi nyer len gyis nas kyi myu gu mi bskyedapa'idonamedapa'iphyiraro—— 'di'iskyonaspong la/ snang ba nges pa dang / nus pa nges pa dang / rgyud nges pa dang / chos nyid kyi rig pa sogs smra mod zhi snang tsam ni mi bden par 'dod pa'i sgyu ma rmi lam sogs kyis ma nges la/ snang ba ma 'khral ba rig pas khegs pa dang / nus pa yang mngon sum du grub pa'i snang bas sgrub dgos pa dang / rgyud kyang skad cig re re nas 'gags pa'i rang mtshan so so ba la rgyud mi 'thad cing / rgyun can las tha dad pa'i rgyun snang rung ma dmigs shing yojo na rtags dngos su thal ba sogs dang / blos brtags la chos nyed kyi byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab par 'jug kyang / bden grub la chos nyid kyis ci yang byar med pa sogs brjod par bya ste/ mdor na ltos med kyi gzhan du 'dod na bskyed bya skyed byed du 'dod thabs med ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ myu gu sa bon las skye bar 'dod na de gnyis rdzas gzhan du tha snyad du yang 'dod du mi rung ste/ rdzas gzhan pa'i tshul yul ngos nas grub pa ni dus mnyam min pa la mi srid cing rgyu sogs phyir te/ rgyu 'bras 'gag skye srang mda'i mtho dman ltar dus gcig pa mi srid pa'i phyir te/ srid na 'bras bu skye bzhin pa dang rgyu 'gag bzhin pa dus gcig dgos pa las/ skye bzhin pa ni skye ba la phyogs tsam yin pas ma 'ongs pa dang / rgyu 'gag bzhin pa ni da ltar ba yin pa'i phyir dang / cis te ste ldan gyi chos la dus

ra༅༅/ /gcig pa med kyangaskye ba'i bya ba la dus gcig pa yod do zhe na yang / skye ba'i bya ba skye ldan las tha dad pa de 'dra mi 'thad de/ byed po med pa'i bya ba bden pa gnyis char du med pas so/ /zhes dang / mig shes kyi spyon gsum mam sems tsam ltar na kun gzhi rgyu'i rkyen dang bzhi dus mnyam par rang 'bras mig shes skyed cing / lhan cig 'byung ba'i tshor 'du sogs kun 'gro rnams dang bskyed bya skyed byed du mi 'thad de/ rgyu 'bras dus mnyam la 'bras bu yod pa skyed dam med pa skyed brtags pas khegs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan skye 'gog pa 'di la sogs te/ gal te skyed par byed pa bskyed bya gzhan skyed pa de rgyu yin na/ /zhes sogs so/ /'di ni kha cig 'bras bu rgyu dus na yod pa'am med pa gang stes zhes par byas nas/ rang rgyud pa tha snyad du phyi ma khas che/na par grags mod kyang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid yod na/ /rgyu yi dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /'on te de ni med na yang / /rgyu yi dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /ces gsungs pas/ 'bras bu rig dro+or yod na gzhan la ltos med du grub zin pas rgyus ci bya la/ gtan med pa la rirwa bzhin du rgyus nus pa ci yang byar med pa dang / gnyis yin rig pa des khegs shing gnyis min mi srid pas 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog legs par grub bo/ /gsum pa ni/ rig pa mang po mi dgos kyi gzhan skye ni 'jig rten gyi sangon sum tshad mas grub bo zhe na/ ma dpyad pa'i ngor blo 'khrul ma 'khrul dang / yul bslu mi bslu cung zad yod pa la rag las kyang rgyu 'bras rdzas gcig tha dad yin

min gyi de kho na nyid dpyod pa la 'jig rten tshad mar mi 'thad de/ bden 'dzin gyis bslad pa'i sgo nas 'dzin stangs 'khrul pas so/ /gzhan yang / gzhan skye 'jig rten tshad mas mi 'grub ste/ rgyu 'bras ngo bo sogs 'dod de/ gang phyir 'jig rten sa bon tsam btab nas/ /zhes sogs so/ /mdor na 'jig rten gyis dpyad nas rgyu 'bras gcig dang tha dad gang du yang mi 'dod sgo ma dpyad par 'di las 'di 'byung tsam zhig 'dod pa ltar/ rten nas 'byung ba'i 'bor lo 'di/ /khobo rmi lam sgyu 'drar 'dod/ /ces sogs rten 'brel tsam du mngo dang bstan bcos las yang yang gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'o na las 'gags nas yun ring po lon pa las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung bar rgyal bas gsungs shing de ltar 'byung ba mthong bas kyang grub pa ci zhe na/ las 'gags pa ni skad cig la dpyad pa rig ngo'i rnam gzhag yin la/ de'i ngor 'bras bu bde sdug kyang mi 'grub ste/ bde ba'i skad cig 'das ma 'ongs ni 'gags shing ma skyes la/ da ltar ba rang grub dus kyi skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pas skad cig la bya byed mi 'thad par dngos smra nyid kyang 'dod pas so zhes brjod par bya la/ ma brtags pa'i rgyun snga phyi gcig tu 'dzin pa'i 'khral ngor ni 'bras bu'i tshe rgyu gnas pas na 'bras bu 'thad pa yin no/ /'di la kun gzhi dang chud mi za dang zhig pa la sogs pas skyon spong bar smra ba 'di dag gis/ spyir gyi las yul ngos nas grub pas de la 'gags pa yang yul ngos nas grub rā zhig khas blangs pa kho nas nyes shing / khyad par rgya la skad cig gi dpyad pa

༄༄༄/ /zhugs nas 'bras bu la de med par 'gal 'du khur ba yin no/ glu sgrub zhabs ni/ las la dpyad na rang bzhin med pas ma skyes/ ma skyes pas ma 'gags/ des na 'bras bu chud mi za'o zhes dpyad ngor 'gags pa de nyid 'khral ngor ma 'gags pa yin la des 'bras bu 'thad do zhes bzhed de/ gzhung rnams sbyar bar sla'o/ /'khral ngor las dang de byed po ma 'gags pas byed po nyid kyis 'bras bu yang myong bar 'thad pa'i rnam gzhag 'dir 'phros nas kun sogs (rkog ste/ kun gzhi dang de'i steng gi bag chags dang dbang phyug rgyur 'dod pa bzhin de zhabor 'das kyi byed rā por 'dod pa rnams/ kun gzhi med kyang 'di nus sogs kyis zhor la bkag cing / phyi don med pa'i rnam shes tsam yod par rmi lam dang rab rib dang mi sdug pa sgom pa'i dpe gsum bkod pa rnams la 'khral rgyu ma zad kyi bar du blo yod pa bzhin du yul yod pa ni dpe rnams la'ang grub cing / zad nas yul med pa bzhin du blo yang med pa ni don rnams la'ang grub ces dang / gnyis stong gi gzhan dbang myong rig tsam ni 'jal byed med la/ dran jo'ang yul ngos nas grub pa'i gzhan yin pas 'brel ba med pa'i phyir gzhan rgyud kyi shes pa bzhin du mi 'grub pa'i tshul dang / lung las rnam shes tsam du gsungs pa ni byed pa po don gzhan 'gog pa dang phyi don med par gsal kha bud pa rnams gzugs la lhag par chags pa 'gog pa'i drang don yin pa'i tshul rnams gsungs te/ re re nas rgyas par brjod na mang bar 'gyur bas bsdus so/ /de dag kyang spyir 'khrul

r+sha6 nu ba ma ra yin parastodangor 'jog pa dang /khekhyad par sems i pas rtog pas sbyar ba de dag mi lad par bstan pa yin gyi/ma brtags ma stod pa'i rig rgyun brtag pa tsam dang de'i stong gi 'khor 'das kyi bag gas dang / de dag la rgyu rkyen gzhan la brten pa'i gzhan dbang myong ba tsam dang phyi rol sems snang tsam du bzhed pa la 'gal ba med cing rig pa dag gis kyang de tsam dgag mi nus la/ khyad par 'khrul ngo mnyam po la yang snang ba 'di phyi don du byas na yal ngos nas grub par 'dzin pa'i blo skye sla zhing /sems snang tsam du byas na blos bzhag tu 'char sla ba dang / slob dpon gyis kyang /rin chen 'phreng bar/rnam shes bstan med mtha' yas pa/ khun tu bdag po de la ni/ /sa dang chu dang me sdong ni/ /rlung gis gnas mthong 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes dang / rig pa drug cu par/'byung ba che la sogs bshad pa/ /rnam par shes su yang dag 'du/ /zhes sogs gsungs shing /byang chub sems 'grel du yang /sems tsam gyi 'dod pa rgyas par brjod nas gnyis stong gi myong ba bden grub nyid la dgag pa rgya cher mdzad kyis/phyi don med pa dang kun gzhi gzhan dbang yod pa la dgag pa ma mdzad pa'i phyir dang / khyad par sngags kyi phyogs su snang ba sems la brten pa'i khos len dang kun gzhi mang du gsungs nga/'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa gnyis skye dgag pa ni/gnyis sogs khegs las 'gog byed rgyas par ma gsungs so/ /bzhi pa rgyu med dgag pa ni/rgyu med sogs/thams cad che na thams cad skye 'gyur sogs

ra༅༅/ /ha cang thal zhing / nam mkha'i pad mo bzhin du snang mi rung du 'gyur ba las rgyu 'bras gsal bar snang ba'i mthong ba dang 'gal ba dang / skye ba snga phyi med pa sgrub par 'dod nas lus sems 'byung ba'i bdag nyid der 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' 'khral par ni 'byung ba 'dzin pa'i mngon sum 'khral pas 'grub par rgya cher gsu ngas te/ de ltar na rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs dbu ma la 'jug pa las rgyas par gsungs so/ /gsum pa rgyu 'bras gnyis ka la dpyod pa mu bzhi skye zlogog ni/ 'khral ngor ni sa lan gcig las mya gu gcig ces dang /rkyen gsum las mig shes gcig ces dang / pha gcig las bu du ma dang / sa bon dang mu lud du ma las ston thog du ma zhes sogs la 'gal ba med mod / rig ngor ni mu bzhi'i nang nas rno gcig nyid kho na las 'bras bye gcig nyid kho na dang / ldog pa du ma kho na las 'bras bu gcig nyid kho na dang /ldos pa rgyu du ma kho na las 'bras bu du ma kho na dang / rgyu gcig nyid las 'bras bu du ma dang de las ldog pa rgyu du ma las 'bras bu gcig 'byung ba rnams mi 'thad de/ rig ngor gcig nyid mi rigs la des du ma bden grub kyang khegs pas so/ /des na 'di yang gtso bor gcig du bral gyi rtsa ba can yin pas/ 'jug pa sogs gzhung 'ga' rer ma gsungs so/ /'o na 'jug par gcig du bral yang ma bshad da zhe na/ ma grub ste/ gang zag bdag 'gog tu rnam bdun gyi rig pa bshad pas so/ /dbu ma rang rgyud pas 'di'i nang nas gnyis pa rkyen gsum las rnam shes gcig 'byung ba

lta bu dang / de bzhin du bshad ma thag pa'i 'khrul ngo'i bzhi pa dang / mtha' bzhi skye 'gog gi nang nas gzhan las skye ba dang / yod med skye 'gog gi nang nas rgyu dus na 'bras bu med pa skye ba rnams tha snyad tsam du ma dpyad nyams dga' bar 'dod de / rgyan las/ brtag pa ma byas nyams dga' bar/ /bdag rgyu snga ma snga ma la/ /brten nas phyi ma phyi ma yi/ /'bras bu de 'dra 'byung ba yin/ /zhes dang / bden gnyis rtsa 'grel sogs su yang de ltar 'byung bas so/ /de lta na yang 'thad pa min te/ 'di ltar dpyod pa'i rig ngo 'dir dpyad bzod du grub sogs phyir te/ dngos po la don dam mam yul ngos nas grub pa'i skye tshul dpyod pa la 'di sogs pas so/ /des na de ltar dgrad pa'i dgrad mthar grub pa'i skye ba kun kyang don dam lta zhog tha sogs mi 'dod pas thal rang gi tha snyad khas len tshul la dngos 'dzin mngon gyur ba la yang gnod tshul khyad par shin tu che bas/ rmi lam myu ma'i snang ba ltar rdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can byis pa 'drid par byed pa cung zad kyang gtad ra med pa'i za zi ban bun du shes pa'i ngang nas de ltar rig bzhin du bden zhen dang bden snang mi bzlog pa ni/ nang na dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gdon cen po thog ma med pa nas rjes su zhugs pa nyon mongs pa bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor zhing las kyi go mtshon sra ba dang bcas te sdug bsngal gyi me 'obs chen pos bskor ba'i khyim na gnas pa de ma thon pa'i skyon du shes par byas nas de 'don pa'i thabs kyi rnam pa mtha' yas pa zhig de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa la brtson pa brgya 'gyur du bya bar

ra༅༅/ /rigs so/ /bzhi pa snang tsam la dpyod pa rten 'brel gyi rtags ni/ 'dir bstan myu gu chos can/ bden par med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir zhes pa rten sogs ni/ dbu ma pas bden stong sgrub pa'i rig pa'i rgyal po yin te/ gang phyir dngos po brten nas rab 'byung bas/ /rtog pa 'di das brtag par mi nus pa/ /de phyir rten 'byung rig pa 'di yis ni/ /lta ngan drwa ba mtha' dag gcod par byed/ /ces dang / rig pa drug cu par/ dngos por khas len yod na ni/ /'dod chags zhe snang 'byung ba yi/ /lta ba mi bzad ma rungs 'byung / /de las byung ba'i rtsod par 'gyur/ /de ni nyon mongs kun gyi rgyu/ /de med nyon mongs mi 'byung ste/ /de phyir de ni yo ngas shes na/ /lta dang nyon mongs shin tu 'byang / /gang gis de shes 'gyur zhe na/ /brten nas 'byung ba mthong bas so/ /brten nas skyes pa ma skyes par/ /de nyid mkhyen pa mchog gis gsungs/ /zhes so/ /rtags 'di'i chos can gyi steng du phyogs chos 'grub pa ni shin tu sla mod khyab pa nges dka' ba yin te/ dngos por smra ba dag gis khyab pa ldog nas 'bud pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rgya cher grags mod/ kho bo ni ldog nas smra ste/ dngos smra dag gis rten 'brel gyi ming tsam legs par grub kyang rten 'brel gyi don bltos grub tsam yin pas phrad sogs 'byung ba'i chos sogs mi srid par rtogs dgos pa las ma rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gtan tshigs rten 'brel gyi don ni shin tu rtogs dka' ste/ de nyid bden na mi ltos dgos pa las chos thams cad ltos sa la bltos pa'i

phyir zhes pa'i rten 'brel gyi don grub na skabs kyi bsgrub bya'i don yang grub pas rtog ge la grags pa'i tha snyad 'ba' zhig sgrub kyi rtags su shes par bya'o/ /des na rten 'brel gyi don gang la rtsal ci yod kyis 'bad rigs te/ lha sogs rten 'brel rtogs pa 'di yis gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gang zag gi bdag dgag pa la/ spyir ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis dang por nga'o zhes rang nyid la bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di'i 'dzin stangs kyi yul la grub mtha' smra ba dag gis brtags shing dgrad pa'i tshe / thog mar phyi rol pa rnams kyi bdag ni rtag pa dang gcig pu dang rang dbang can dang / za ba por mthong zhing phung po ni de las ldog par mthong bas bdag phung rdzas tha dad du 'dzin to/ /rang sde mang bkur bas ni/ de lta bu'i rtag gcig rang dbang can la gnod byed mthong zhing / bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin byu/ /gzhan ni su zhig mgon du gyur/ /zhes sogs kyi lung gis 'khral nas bdag phung tha mi dad kyi gzhig tu bzung ngo / /de'i nang tshan gnas ma bu pas ni/ gcig la yang gnod pa mthong nas gang du yang brdzod du med par khas len te/ rten dang brten pa dang / ldan pa dang / dbyibs dang / tshogs pa la sogardzu par khas len mkhan ni dngos su mi gsal zhing / mtha' dpyod pa'i phyir du dpyad nas 'gog la/ de yang 'ji ltar ngar 'dzin sogs bden grub kyi bdag de rang gang la 'dogs pa'i 'dogs gzhi'i phung po dang ngo bos grub pa'i gcig dang tha dad dang rten sogs dpyad de/ rtsa bar/ phung min phung po las gzhan min/ /de la de med der de min/ /de

༄༄༄/ /bzhin gshegs pa phung ldan min/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa la sbyar ba bdag la 'don pa spe zhing / rin chen 'phreng bar bdag gam skyes bu la dngos su yang sbyor la/ dpal ldan zla bas/ shing rta rang yan lag las gzhan 'dod min/ /gzhan min ma yin de ldan yang ma yin/ /yan lag la med yan lag dag der med/ /'dus tsam ma yin dbyebs min ji bzhin no/ /zhes lnga po'i steng du dbyebs sogs mtshungs pas rig pas dpyad na mi rnyed par gsungs te / mu stegs 'dod pa'i tha dad la rang la grags pa rgyu las ma skyes par 'dod pa sa dngos po min par thal ba dang / der 'dzin tshad ma ma grub pa'i phyir dang / ngar 'dzin rten du mi 'thad pa'i phyir zhes pas bkag cing / mang bkur ba la / bdag mang por thal ba dang / de 'dzin mngon su ma du thal ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe bdag chad par thal ba dang / bdag med rtogs pa'i tshe phung po med par rtogs par thal ba dang / dngos gnyen med par mig sogs bzhin du 'dun pa'i 'dod chags tsam spangs pa'i sgo nas spong dgos par thal ba lngas bkag nas/ mdo las phung po lnga la dmi gas nas bdag tu lta zhes gsungs pa ni phung po las don gzhan 'gog cing / tshogs tsam 'jig lta'i dmigs yul du bstan pa dang phung po la brten nas 'dogs par gsungs pas tshogs tsam la der mi rung zhing bdag phung gcig na len po dang blang bya gcig par thal bas bkag ste/ rtsa she'i rab byed bco brgyad pa dang nyer bdun pa'i don no/ /rten dang brten pa bden grub la

no rdzas gzhan gyisakhyabacingaldanapa'angadedabye'adrabazhigazhan bkag pas khegs pa dang — dbyibs dang tshogs pa ni dbyebs can dang tshogs pa can las gzhan du mi rnyed pas khegs so/ /da lta mod kyang / 'di ni de nyid du 'am 'jig rten du/ /rnam pa bdun gyis 'grub 'gyur min mod kyi/ /rnam sogs 'dogs pa yi na/ zhes gsal bar gsungs so/ /'og tu yang / de bzhin 'jig rten grags pas phung po dang / /zhes sogs nas/ ma brtags grags par gti mug las yin no/ /zhes 'khral ngo 'ba' zhig gsungs pas/ rang lugs kyi 'chad tshul ni min no/ /gnyis pa ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis rang gzhan la lta ba rnam dag gi rtogs pa skyed pa'i tshe stod smad phal sogs med de/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba zhes bya ba ni grub mjo' thams cad kyi mthar son pas gzhan la nang 'gal ston cing rang gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la mkhas pa'i phyir ro/ /gang dag rtog sogs smra ba ni/ rtog shes btags pa'i thal 'gyur mi srid phyir/ khes thal sogs mi mtshungs te legs par mtshungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'o na lugs 'dis bka' bar pa nges don sgra ji bzhin pa ra 'dod mod spyon dngos po bden grub dang khyad par gzhan dbang rdzas yod sogs ston pa'i gsung rab rnams spong ngam zhe na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gdul bya mchog dman rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can du shes nas shin tu gus par byed rigs te/ phung sogs tsam du 'dod la/ de 'dra'i tshig zur dngos bstan la ma 'byar ba gzhan sogs gsungs pa gang

༄༄༄/ /zhig de ltar gsungs pa nyidakyisaston pa la gus pa bskyerdo pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi dbu ma bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa la/ mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam/ gnas skabs mthar thug gi lam mo / /dang po ni/ 'phags pa nyid kyis rin chen 'phreng bar/ dang po mngon par mtho ba'i chos/ /phyis ni nges par legs 'byung ba/ /de la mngon mtho bde ba ste/ /nges par legs pa thar pa yin/ /de yi sgrub pa mdor bsdu na/ /mdor na dad dang shes rab bo/ /dad can nyid phyir chos la brten/ shes rab ldan phyir yang dag rig /'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste/ /'di yi sngon 'gro dad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir mi dge ba'i las kyi lam zhes ngan song gi lam yang yod mod rdzi 'dir rtogs ldan gyis blang bya'i lam gyi dbang du byas nas lam sogs te/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal las 'phral du thar pa lha dang mi'i bde ba rnam smin dang rgyu mthun gyis bsdus pa dang / 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal las gtan du grol ba thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa ni thob bya'am bsgrub bya yin pas de gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni dad pa dang shes rab bo/ /de yang dad pa gsum las shākho+o bor las/ 'bras la yid ches pa'i dad pas kun nas blangs te dge sdig gi blang dor byed pa'i phyir dang / 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /des na de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin du/ rgyu mtshan khyad par can med par rang phyogs la 'dun pa dang gzhan phyogs la zhe snang ba

dang / blang dor la gti mug pa dang / rje dpon sogs la 'jigs pas 'gro ba ste 'gro ba bzhi yis blang dor gyi chos las mi 'da' ba dang / gzhan don gtso bor byed pa'i snying rje chen po dang mi ldan pa'am ldan kyang rung ste sgo sogs mi ldog pa'o/ /de skad du yang / 'dun dang the sdang 'jigs pa dang / /rmongs pas gang zhig chos mi 'da'/ /de ni dad pa can zhes bya/ /legs pa yi ni snod mchog yin/ /gang zhig lus ngag yid kyi las/ /rnam pa gsum du mi rtog par/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan shes nas/ /rtag tu byed pa de shes rab/ /ces gsungs pas/ dad pas kun nas blangs na spyir da ge ba tsam du yang mi 'gro ba dang / bdag med rtogs shing 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyis ma zin na thar lam du gtan mi 'gro bar gsungs pa 'di ga bshad tsam/ du ma song bar phyag rdog po gsum 'tshal na yang dran pa cig bya 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa/ ni/ ngesalegs kyi lam la rang don gtso bor byed pa'i dbang du byas pa theg pa dman pa dang / gzhan don gtso bor spyod pa'i dbang du byas pa theg pa mchog gi lam gnyis/ bshad ma thag pa'i mngon mthor bcas pa ni skyes bu gsum gyis sgrub cing nyams su len te/ tshe 'di den gnyer gyi bsam pa ring du spangs nas gtso bor ngan song gis 'jigs te bsam pa las 'bras la yid ches pa 'i dad pas kun nas blangs shing sbyor ba dge ba bcu dang sdig pa mi dge ba bcu'i ngo bo rgyu 'bras rme mkhas pas blang dor nan gyis byed pa dang / 'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pas rang nyid 'khor ba las thar 'dod nges 'byung gi

ra༅༅/ /bsam pas sbyor ba 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i 'jug rim sdug kun dang ldog rim 'gog lam la mkhas pas byang phyogs so bdun dang / rang rgyal gyis rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog dang mkhas pare bye ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed cing gzhi rten nges 'byung tshul khrims gtso bor byed pa dang / sems can sdug bsngal bas 'jigs nas rang gi zhi bde tsam 'dod pa spang bya'i gtso bor byas te/ bsam pa byang chub chen po'i sems kyis kun nas blangs te sbyor ba phyin drug rdzogs par spyod pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin du skyes bu chung 'bring chen po de gsum gyi lam du rgyal bas gsungs shing klu sgrub sogs kyang bzhed mod kyi dngos su gsal bar ma thon pa/ 'dzam gling gi rgyan mchog dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na ste mar me mdzad dpal ye shes mtshan gzhan jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha zhes gsal bar grags pa de nyid kyis bzhed cing gsal bar mdzad pa ni/ byang chub lam sgron gyi 'grel pa gsar rnying kun dang / khyad par rje btsun bcong kha pa chen po la / lo chen thams cad mkhyen pas legs par bskul nas mdzad pa ni shin tu ngo mtshar bar bzhugs mod lhag mthong gi skor la cung zad dpyad pa nyid do/ /'o na theg pa gsum dang ji ltar sbyar zhe na/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam mtha' dag theg dman zhes gcig tu bsdus pa las slar yang dman pa dang 'bring po gnyis su dbye bas theg pa gsum du rnam par bzhag ste/ sngar bshad pa bzhin theg sogs bkag zin to/ /gsum pa la/ gnas skabs smin byed kyi dang / mthar thug grol byed kyi

lam mo/ /dang po ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i lam kun kyang nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa mi dgos par bzhed pa rang rgyud pa man chad 'dod pa'i bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug lta bu stong sogs na ni zag med thar lam dngos su mi 'gyur gyis zag bcas las su 'gyur te/ gzhi sogs gnas tshul sogs phyir ro/ /'o na 'dul ba lung la sogs pa'i bka' dang / bstan bcos phal cher du de nyid rgyas par gsungs pa ci zhe na/ de lta mod kyi zab mo stong nyid rdzogs par rtogs pa'i snod rung gi gang zag ni shin tu dkon sogs ltar dngos kyi gdul bya lam dngos la khad kyis drang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'o/ /des na de ltar ston pa'i rgyal ba dang gdul bya'i sems can gnyis ka la shin tu gus par bya yi/ rang gi lta ba la lhag par chags pa dang gzhan gyi lta ba dang gang zag la 'khrag cing sdang bar mi bya ste/ zab sogs phyir ro/ /de yang lam de dag gis rgyud legs par smin cing rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs zhugs pas/ de la sgrib pa'i las sgrib byang zhes nyon mongs pa'i sa bon yang rags pa chod tshar bas/ narmo zhig na blo kha phyogs pa tsam gyis stong nyid rdzogs par rtogs par 'gyur bas na/ gang zag ngangos smra dang nyan rang phal pa/ lam bden bzhi mi rtag sogs rtogs pa la zhal bzhu dang ngan smras sna tsho+ogs byed cing / zla ba grags pa'i lam srol gyis sems khengs par byas na stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i segs kyi las sgrib gsar du gso gnyen che'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta yin pa 'on kyang srid rtsa gcod pa'i thar lam gyi gtso bo ni mtha'

ra༅༅/ /bral dbu ma rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid yin te/ nges legs thar pa'i lam du grags pa kun thar lam dngos su 'gro ba ni dbu ma'i lam 'dir bltas shing rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ /bzod pa 'di la ma brten 'thob par mi nus te/ /zhes sogs mang po dang / stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes dang / gang phyir lung las lam 'di ni/ /med par byang chub med ces gsungs/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa nyid kyis/ gang gis stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de la thar pa ga la yod/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson ra ru/ /rmongs pa de dag 'khor bar 'gyur / /zhes dang / ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa/ /sogs dang / rgyu rkyen las skyes dngos po rnams/ /yang dag nyid du rtog pa gang / /de ni ston pas ma rig gsungs/ /de las yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung / /zhes sogs gsungs te / 'os tu bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan du yang 'di dag drang bar bye'o/ /rang rgyud pa dang sems tsam pas ni/ bzod pa dang stong nyid sogs rnam sa gang zag gi bdag med dang / phung por 'dzin pa dang rgyu rkyen yang dag tu rtog pa rnams gang zag gi bdag 'dzin nyid la dgongs zhes 'chad mod kyi mngon sum la bsnyon pa lta bu'o/ /'o na stong nyid rtogs pa'i rtogs tshul la khyad par med pas/ nyan rang theg chen gsum ga re re zhing tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam

ste3 95 dar / ba / dkar po na ma par mthong ba'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i dang / mthong ba'i dang / bsrabs pa'i dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa ste dman pa sa brgyad dang / theg chen la rab dga' sogs bcu dang / bcu gcig kun tu 'od la sogs pa dang / de dag ra re la yang yon tan gyi khu ba mang po so/gas gang gis 'jog ce na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag sogs kyang so so'i sbyor ba dang / 'jug gi grogs su gyur pa'i thabs mchog dman sogs kyi dbye sogs 'gyur ba yin te/ rgyas par gzhan du bshad pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /lam dbu ma'i gnad ༷sdus te bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'bras sogs ni bzhed de / slob dpon gyis mdo btus dang rin chen 'phreng ba dang sku gsum gyi bstod pa sogs dang / zla ba'i skyabs gsum bdun cu pa dang 'jug pa'i smad la sogs pa na gsal ba ltar ra/ /phal cher zhes pa ni/ gzugs sku dang 'phrin las gdul bya'i gzhan ngor 'jog pa sogs dang / sems tsam man chod 'dod pa lta/ra/ nyan rang gi lhag med du rig pa rgyun chad mi bzhed par/ sems 'grel du/ theg pa gnyis po dag kyang ni/ /theg pa chen pos 'byang bas na/ /srid pa'i lam gyis dub rnams la/ /ngal gso'i don te de nyid min/ /smo thos de dag ji srid du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bskul ba/ /de srid ye shes lus gcig gis/ /ting tshon myos pas bgya la te gnas/ /bskul nas༄ sna tsho+ogs gzugs kyis ni/ /se/mas

ra༅༅/ /bral dbu ma rtogs pa'i shes rab nyid yin te/ nges legs thar pa'i lam du grags pa kun thar lam dngos su 'gro ba ni dbu ma'i lam 'dir bltas shing rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / gang dag bde gshegs nyan thos 'gyur bar bya snyam dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang de bzhin chos rgyal 'gyur 'dod pa/ /bzod pa 'di la ma brten 'thob par mi nus te/ /zhes sogs mang po dang / stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes dang / gang phyir lung las lam 'di ni/ /med par byang chub med ces gsungs/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa nyid kyis/ gang gis stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de la thar pa ga la yod/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson ra ru/ /rmongs pa de dag 'khor bar 'gyur / /zhes dang / ji srid phung po/ra 'dzin yod pa/ /sogs dang / rgyu rkyen las skyes dngos po rnams/ /yang dag nyid du rtog pa gang / /de ni ston pas ma rig gsungs/ /de las yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung / /zhes sogs gsungs te / 'os tu bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan du yang 'di dag drang bar bya'o/ /rang rgyud pa dang sems tsam pas ni/ bzod pa dang stong nyid sogs rnams gang zag gi bdag med dang / phung por 'dzin pa dang rgyu rkyen yang dag tu rtog pa rnams gang zag gi bdag 'dzin nyid la dgongs zhes 'chad mod kyi mngon sum la bsnyon pa lta bu'o/ /'o na stong nyid rtogs pa'i rtogs tshul la khyad par med pas/ nyan rang theg chen gsum ga re re zhing tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam

ste lnga lnga dang / theg dman la/ dkar po rnam par ma thong ba'i sa dang / rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i dang / mthong ba'i dang / bsrabs pa'i dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dang / byas pa rtogs pa'e sa ste dman pa sa brgyad dang / theg chen la rab dga' sogs bcu dang / bcu gcig kun tu 'od la sogs pa dang / de dag re re la yang yon tan gyi dbye ba mang po sogs gang gis 'jog ce na/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag sogs kyang so so'i sbyor ba dang / 'jug gi grogs su gyur pa'i thabs mchog dman sogs kyi dbye sogs 'gyur ba yin te/ rgyas par gzhan du bshad pas 'dir mi spro'o/ /lam dbu ma'i gnad bsngas te bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'bras sogs ni bzhed de / slob dpon gyis mdo btus dang rin chen 'phreng ba dang sku gsum gyi bstod pa sogs dang / zla ba'i skyabs gsum bdun cu pa dang 'jug pa'i smad la sogs pa na gsal ba ltar rol/ /phal cher zhes pa ni/ gzugs sku dang 'phrin las gdul bya'i gzhan ngor 'jog pa sogs dang / sems tsam man chod 'dod pa ltar/ nyan rang gi lhag med du rig pa rgyun chad mi bzhed par/ sems 'grel du/ theg pa gnyis po dag kyang ni/ /theg pa chen pos 'byang bas na/ /srid pa'i lam gyis dub rnams la/ /ngal gso'i don te de nyid min/ /nyan thos de dag ji srid du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bskul ba/ /de srid ye shes lus gcig gis/ /ting 'dzin myos pas brgyal te gnas/ /bskul nas༄ sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni/ /se/mas

ra༅༅/ /bzhed de/ sangs rgyas rang ngor/ de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes dang / ma rig rmongs pa'i gnyid sad na/ /'khor ba 'di dag mi dmigs so/ /zhes shes pa dang shes bya'i snang ba mtha' dag nub pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar lnga po 'di rnams ni lugs 'di'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos kyi gtso bo yin te/ gong du rgyas par bshad pa rnams kyi mjug bsdus pa'o/ /gsum pa sgrub byed lung khungs/ bstan pa la/ lung khungs dngos dang / cha mthun gyi lung dang / de la rtsod pa spang ba dang / der bstan rnams 'phags lam dngos min pa dang / yan lag khyad par can yi na pas gus par gdams pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam gzhag thun mong min pa de dag gi lung gi sgrub byed rgyas par ni dbu ma chen po'i gzhunga'aphags pa'i rig tshogs bstod tshogs sems 'grel rnams dang / 'phags pa lha'i bzhi brgya pa dang / dpa' bo'i don dam sems bsgom sogs dang / dpal ldan zla ba'i gzhan 'grel gsum dang 'jug pa rtsa 'grel/ spyod 'jug sher le rnams la zhib par ltos shig dang ngo 'phrod par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi lung rgyas pa yang 'dir yi ge la brtsegs nas ma bris pas/ 'di smu lde mig byas nas legs par bltas na blo gros 'phel zhing nges pa ster ba dang / ma mtha' yang gzhung mi nub pa'i rkyen du 'gyur bas/ phyogs tsam re mthong ma thag tu gzhung lugs mi nyan zhing mi lta bar rang bzo mgo phur la brtson par mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas mchog legs ldan 'byed kyi shes rab sgron me

dang / 'grel bshad chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi brtul zhugs dang / rtog ge 'bar ba rtsa 'grel dang / de rgya gar lho phyogs su byon pa'i rang rgyud pa yin pas/ rgya gar shar phyogs su byon pa'i ye shes snying po dang zhi ba 'tsho dang ka ma la shī la gsum ni rang rgyud shar pa gsum zhes bya bas de'i gzhung rnams dang / rgyal ba byams pas mdzad pa'i chos lnga las mdo sde rgyan dang 'byed gnyis ni dngos bstan dang bstan bya'i gtso bo sems tsam kho nar gnas pa la/ mkhas pa g.yag gis lnge ga dbu mar bzhed pa dang / de'i log bsnon du/ mkhas pa gzhon blos/ gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ zhes sogs re re tsam ni sems tsam pas kyang 'chad shes la/ gzhan phal cher sems tsam dang mthun pas mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla yang sems tsam du bzhed mod kyi/ de gnyis thogs med dang grol sde la sogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag gis dbu mar bkral zhing / gzhan gsum dbyig gnyen gyis sems tsam du bkral pa la sus kyang bcos pa med pas/ lo chen thamasacad mkhyen pas gnyis dbu ma dang gsum sems tsam du bkral ba'i dbu ma'i gzhung gnyis po kur sogs zad do/ /gsum pa ni/ mngon sogs bzhed de/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi rtsod lan rtsa 'grel du 'phags pa gsum gas chos dbyings bden stong la dmigs par bshad pa'i phyir dang / rgyud bla rtsa 'grel du/ stong nyid bden grub la dmigs pa thabs min la zhugs par bshad nas nyan rang thabs la zhugs par bshad pa dang / las

༄༄༄/ /nyon dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa las 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir zhes sogs rgyas par bshad nas sgrub par byed mod kyi/ 'thad pa min te/ nyi khri snang bar/ ji ltar dmigs pa na 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur 'gyur ba de ltar rigs yin par brngod pa des na 'dir ha cang thal ba cis te 'tshol bar byed/ ces pa dang / 'grel chung du/ ji ltar nyan thos kyi theg pa la sogs pa rtogs pa'i rim gyis dmigs pa de bzhin du/ zhes sogs kyis/ 'phags pa mtha' dag chos dbyings bden stong la dmigs par khyad med du bstan pa yin na/ 'di'i phyogs snga smra ba po/ nyan rang chos dbyings bden stong la mi dmigs par 'dod pa'i dngos smra ba yin pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ dmigs pa de rgol ba gnyis ka mthun snang du grub pa'i dper/ ji ltar dang de bzhin zhes pa'i tshig gis grub 'dug pa'i phyir/ yang na ni rgol bas ma grub pa dper bkod pas 'phags seng brgal brtag la mi mkhas pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /'o na ci zhe na/ dngos smra ne+e /0 skye mched drug pa'i khyad par zhes dang / dge ba'i bag chags zhes sogs/ rigs la dngos pos khyab par smra zhing / dge ba'i bag chags gtan med srid pa sogs kyi sgo nas rigs chad 'dod la/ 'dir chos dbyings rigs su smras pa blor ma shong nas/ rigs chad dang rigs tha dad la sogs pa'i dbye ba mi 'thad do zhes brtsad pa na/ rten la tha dad med kyang brten pa'i dbang lis tha dad du 'byed nus pa'ang 'grub mod rdzi thog mar dngos med dang rigs kyi gzhi mthun rig pas

'grub ste/ spyir rigs su 'jog pa 'phags chos rtogs pa'i rgyu'i sgo nas khyod rang yang 'dod la/ 'dir de yang nyer len kho na'i dbang gis gzhag mi dgos kyi dmigs pa'i sgo nas kyang 'grub cing / /chos dbyings la dmigs te bsgoms pas 'phags chos rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa na/ 'dus ma byas la dmigs pas 'phags chose ji ltar rtogs she na/ bdag med phra rags la dmis/sa pas 'phags chos rtogs par khyod rang yang 'dod pa ji lta ba de ltar ro/ /zhes pa'i don yin pas / gzhung de dag gis khyod kyi 'dod pa'i don de 'grub don med do/ /rgyud bla rtsa 'grel gyi don yang spyir stong nyid bden 'dzin skyon can yin na dngos po tsam bden 'dzin yang skyon can yin dgos mod kyi/ de ltar 'dod pas ni ma khyab ste / sems tsam pa snga ma 'dod kyang phyi ma mi 'dod pas so/ /phyi ma la ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba/ /mig med pas ni mthong ba med/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ nyan rang stong nyid lta ba la mig dang mi ldan par bshad pas nyan rang la de rtogs pa med do/ /ces te nyan rang gis ma rtogs par bshad pas/ nyan rang yin na ma rtogs pa'i khyab pa med de/ so skye dang byang sems las dang po pas ma rtogs par bshad kyang de yin na ma rtogs mi dgos pa bzhin zhe na/ 'o na las nyon dngos po bden 'dzin las 'byung na de yin na des khyab mi dgos so zhes mtshungs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtogs tshul yang mngon sum gyi dbang du byas pas so skye sogs kyis der thal ba 'dod pa yang yin no/ /gzhan yang mdo dang

ra༅༅/ /bstan bcos las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag 'dus sogs phye bar bshad pa tsam gyis mi 'grub ste/ spyir so skye las phye ba'i don ma yin gyi theg pa gsum dang nyan thos kyi yang 'bras gnas bzhi sogs des phye zhes pa yin la de ni spangs sogs tshang ba'i phyir dang / so skye las phye ba yin na'ang gang zag gi bdag med la tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid rtogs par bshad pa tsam gyis kyang mi 'grub ste/ gang sogs la'ang chos nyid tsam du 'dul ba lung las kyang mang du bshad cing mdzod kyi 'grel par yang 'byung bas mkhas sogs dang / khyad par/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir/ /sogs dang / de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /sogs dang / rgyud bla'i yang / 'dod ldan mu stegs nyan thos dang / /rang byung rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi /zhes sogs rang sogs phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi gzhung de dag tu dngos su bstan pa'i nyan rangagi lam de dag ni 'phags lam dngos min te/ de 'dra'i lam gyis srid pa'i rtsa ba bden 'dzin mi chod pa'i phyir te/ gdul bya ma nges pa'i rigs can drang ba'i phyir du gsungs pa'i drang don tsam yin pas so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'o na gzhung de dag tu bshad pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa de rnams dor bar bya'am zhe na/ ma yin te/ lhag par gus pas 'jug bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir te/ 'phags lam gyi khyad par can yin pa'i phyir dang / de dag nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas te 'phags sogs gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa rtag chad gzhan spang ba la/ gang la 'khrul pa'i gzhi

bshad / de la 'khral pa rtag chad du bstan/ rang lugs 'khral med du bsgrub/ dgongs pa khyad par can gzhan yang rtogs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji skad bshad pa 'di dag ni bstan pa 'di'i chos 'khor dang po bden bzhi'i dang / bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i dang / zlo ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khodro gsum las 'khor lo sogs nyid klu sgrub yab sras kyis dbu sogs bzhin du legs par gtan la phab pa yin te/ zhes 'phros btsal nas bka' tha mar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nang nas lam dang 'bras bu la zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang ma 'brel ba'am dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gang rung gis zag pa rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i zag med kyi shes pa yod par ma zad/ zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbyang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa gzhi sogs nyid la bde gshegs snying po'o zhes rgyas par gsungs pa de gsang sngags sogs gyur te/ 'dus pa sogs la lar sogs dang / gzhan kyai rdor bde mchog tu sogs dang / theg nga mtha' dag gi rtse mo dus kyi 'khor lor rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs zhes yang dang yang du gsungs pa 'di/ mdo sngags de dag tu khyad chos 'chad pa'i tshe yang cha med dang kun 'gro dang zhi zhing rtag pa dang / chos dbyings dang don dam bden pa ste blo'i nus pa zhan pa rnams 'khrul pa'i gzhi mang po rnams gsungs so/ /gsungs tshul rgyas par bshad zin pa dang 'dir skabs ma yin pas ma spros so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gsungs pa rnams kyi dngos bstan la 'brul sogs byung ste/ bden stong don dam pa'i bden

ra༅༅/ /pa ni/ phung po rnam gcad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes pa'i chad stong dang bem stong yin pas snying po med la/ bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag rig pas bsdus pa 'di ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid yongs grub gcig pu yin pas cha med dang / sgrib bral gyi srid pa gsum la khyad med du khyab pas kun 'gro dang / rang bzhin rnam par dag pas zhi ba dang / rgyun rtag par ma zad skad cig gis 'jig rten 'brel lam 'dus byas su 'gro bas/ 'dus ma byas shing skad cig gis kyang rtag pyodang / chos nyid de bzhin nyid yin pa dang rig pas dpyad bzod gzhom med yin pas chos dbyengs dang don dam bden pa yin no zhes sogs rgya cher mdo dang rgyud dang sems 'grel gye lung du ma dang bcas te sgrub par byed do/ /de nyid la sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam smin gyi yon tan mtshan so gnyis dang / bral ba'i yon tan stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de so gnyis la sogs pa thams cad gsal la yongs su rdzogs par gdod ma nas bzhugs mod krin glo bur dri ma'i sbubs na bzhugs pa de sbyong ba'i thabs su lam nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no zhes zer la/ mkhas pa kha cig ni/ de lta bu la rig pa du mas gnod pa'i phyir na/ mdo dang bstan bcos kyi dngos bstan de dag ni bden stong nyid la der dgongs pa yin te/ 'gro ba zhi ba'i chos nyid du/ /zhes dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni/ /sems can

thams cad la yod pa/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs nas/ /zhes dang / dri med bzhag dang gsal med chos nyid kyang / zhes sogs chos nyid kyi ming gis mang du gsungs shing / khyad par/ sprin dang rmi lam sgyu bzhin de dang der/ shes bya thams cad rnam kun stong pa zhes/ /gsungs nas rgyal 'dir slar yang sems can la/ /sangs rgyas snying po yod ces ci ste gsung / /zhes dogs pa blangs nas/ lan du/ sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag mi 'dzin yang dag chos la bkur/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang ba'i don du gsungs/ /zhes pas dgos pa lnga'i ched du gsungs pa'i drang don yin pas kun rdzob tu yang bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag de dag gtan med yin zhes smra bar byed do/ /lugs de gnyis ni snga ma rtag pa dang phyi ma chad pa'i g.yang du lhung ste/ snga ma la rtag pa dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun dang / don dam bden pa dang / dngos po'i gzhi mthun dang / sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi gzhi mthun khas blangs pa'i skyon dang / bakhes bor rig pas dpyad bzod kyi chos khas blangs pas dbu ma chung ngu yang min par thal ba dang / stobs sogs de dag gis ma rig pa las rnam par rgyal ba la sosas pa'i bya ba mi byed par 'gyur la/ dpe ko dmar gyis sakhyams pa'i ral gri sosas kyang mi 'thad nge/ ral gri'i bya ba cung zad kyang mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /ches sogs kyis sanong pa'i phyir dang / phyi mas ni/ de mdo las zas pa med pa'i

ra༅༅/ shes pa dang / bde gshegs snying po dang / rgyal ba'i mya gu dang / zhi ba'i yid la sogs pas gsungs shing / khyad par sngags las rtogs yes chos sku dang longs sku'i nyer len rang bzhin lhan stes kyi ye shes dang / shin tu phra ba'i rlung dang / rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs su gsungs༄ thams cad la skur pa btab pas/ mthar thug nges don gyi gsung rab thams cad drang don du khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyas par dus kyi 'azlo+or lo'i mtha' dpyod sogs su bshad zin to/ /gsum pa ni/ de lta bas na/ gzhan rnams dogs pa chung la rtag pa dang zhi ba dang bden pa dang chos dbyings kyi ming gis bstan pa'i rgya mtshan yod de/ rim pa ltar skad cig sogs dang / dri sogs dang 0/ rigs sogs dang / yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi 'odzan stangs kyi yul min sogs phyir ro/ /des na bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag 'di ni don dam pa'i gnas lugasaji ga shes kyis rnyed don min yang tha sogs te/ tha snyad tsam du rgyan gyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ khyab ste/ me'i rang bzhin tsha ba zhes sogs grags kyang 'khral sogs tsam du zad de/ rgyun gyi rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas sogs nus ldan gyi blo ma 'khral ba la bsil bar snang zhes kun la grags pa'i phyir ro/ /des 'khor lo bar pa'i dngos bstan la/ chos can bslu med med skyong tha ma dang sngags la brnye+os nas chos can sogs te/ rgyun bslu med tsam du grub pa'i phyir te/ se/mas med kyi gnas skabs kun dang / mnyam ga'ag

ye shes kun dang / sangs rgyas nas kyang rgyun 'chad ma myong zhing 'chad mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sogs bslu ste/ 'dus byas yin pas skad cig gnyis par mi sdod pas so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gsung rab mthon po de dag las/ sangs rgyas sogs gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sgrub sogs nas gsungs pa'i phyir te/ chos can bslu med 'di sogs gnyis rim pa bzhin snang ba'i dmigs yul dang 'dzin sogs phyir ro/ /de bzhin du sa ngas rgyas kyi yon tan rang chas su gzhi nas yod ces kyang gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes gzhi dus nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan de dag nus pa'am nyer len gyi tshul gyis gnas pa'i phyir te/ 'di sogs pas na ste/ rnam 'grel las kyang / blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /zhes dang / rgyud blar/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang / /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ snying po 'di'i sogs la theg pa dang grub sogs bzhag ste/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo las nor bu mkhan mkhas pas dri ma je phyar sbyong ba'i dpes/ 'khor lo gsu ma dang sbya ra zhing snga gas ni gsu rma pa 'i la rma gyi grogs dang rgyab bsnon du sbyar te/ 'og ma rnam sa kyi sto nga du bsno na par 'dod pa sa / 'alor lo tha ma dang snga gas su dang po gnyis spo nga bar 'dod pa dang ches khyad pa ra che bas rma 'khrul bar

ra༅༅/ /bya'o/ /mi snon par 'dor bar 'dod pa la ni/ dpe'i phyi rags pa rnams kyis tha ma la mi phan gyi steng du gnod par 'dod dgos par 'gyur ro/ /des na'akhor lo dang po ni gnas skabs gsu ma gyi dang po dang / tha ma gnyis ni/ gnas skabs gnyis pa la don dam tshad mas dpyad pa dang tha snyad pas cung zad dpyad pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar na 'dul ba dang mdo sde dang rdo rje theg pa rnams kyi dngos bstan gyi spang bya 'khor ba rags pa dang phra ba dang shin tu phra ba gsum dang / nyon mongs kyi nyon mongs/ las kyi nyon mongs/ skye ba'i nyon mongs te kun nyon gsum dang / rang bzhin rmisdig pa lus ngag gi bdun dang / yid kyi gsum dang / de gsum gyi cha shas khyad par can te gsum rnams rim pa bzhin yi/na la/ gsum po 'di las gdul bya dman pa so so thar pa'i dang 'bring byang chub sems dpa'i dang mchog rdo rje theg pa'i gdul bya gsum du bzhag par shes par bya'o/ /rgyas par bshad pa la/ rnam gzhag gsum tshan gsum bshad/ de'i gsal kha gsar byung du bstan/ de ltar 'chad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad/ sngags lam rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ spyir 'bor ba gsum gyi nang nas rags pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ dag pa rnam byang gi zlas drangs pa'i ma dag las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i skye 'chi yin te/ de gang la ldan pa'i nyan rang dgra bcom lhagabacas pa man dang theg chen gyi sbyor lam chos mchog pa man chad ni/ rags pa'i 'khor ba pa'o/ /ya ma bral ba de dag la las nyon gyis skye ba gsar len med

kyang / zag bcas las kyis 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyi phung po 'dor ma nus par rgyad la ldan pa'i cha nas 'jog go /'khor ba rags pa 'di'i rtsa ba ni nyon mongs bden 'dzin dang mtshungs par ldan pa can gyi rmongs pa ma rig pa yin pas/ nyan rang dgra bcom gyis 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bcad pa'i sgo nas rnam par grol yang sdug bgyol dang las kyi kun 'byung gi lhag ma dang bcas pa'o/ /'khor ba phra ba'i mtshan gzhi ni yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus thob pa'i dag pa rnam par byang ba'i skye 'chi yin te / nyan rang lhag med du zhugs pa dang byang sems mthong lam thob zin nas sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i bar ro/ /'di dag gis las nyon gyi skye 'chi zad par spangs te/ 'phags pas 'chi dang na ba dang / /rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs/ /las dang nyon mongs dbang gi skye/ /de la de med phyir de med/ /ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'khor ba 'di'i rtsa ba ni bka' 'khor lo tha mar gsungs pa'i ma rig bag chags kyi sa'o/ /des na ma rig bag chags kyi sa'i nyon mongs dang zag pa med pa'i las dang / yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang / bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho rnams la dag pa rnam byang gi skye 'chi zhes bya la/ de yang sa bcu pa'i bar du je phrar 'gro ba zhig sangs rgyas kyi sar ma lus par spangs pas rtag brtan 'i ba g.yung drung dang gtsang bde rtag bdag si pha rol tu phyin pa 'es 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dang bstan bcos las rgya cher gsungs so/ /'khor ba min tu phra ba ni rang lam gyi sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs kyang rang 'a/ma/ du sbas/

ra༅༅/ /pa sngags lam du phyang ba'i bem chos phra mo ma spangs pa phar phyin theg pa rkyang pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin te/ 'di'i thugs rgyud la rdo rje theg par bstan pa'i gnyen po'i mthar thug bde chen gyi ye shes ma 'khrangs pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba 'di'i rtsa ba ni༄ rlung dang khams 'pho ba'i chags pa'am 'gyur ba de phra mo yin te/ de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /'pho ba'i chags pa rnam par spang / /zhes sogs mang du gsungs la/ de yang spang bya nyi khri chi| stong drug brgya/ stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis su bsdus pa/ gnyis po mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen de grangs de snyed kyis spang bya'i sa bon rnams bcom nas/ rdo rje snyingari po rgyan rgyad sogs nas gsungs pa'i/ sa dang po kun tu 'od dang / gnyis pa zla ba'i 'od dang gsum pa nyi ma'i 'od la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bcu gnyis rim pa bzhin du bskyed par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la rgya bod kyi mkhas pa phal sbyar/ sngags la ma brten par phar phyin theg pa rkyang pas kyang 'tshang rgya bar bzhed pa ni legs pa yin te/ nyan rang rkyang pa'i lam gyis dgra bcom thob pa bzhin no/ /des na theg pa mtha' dag la bltos pa'i mthar thug gi sangs rgyas 'thob par bzhed pa ni mi legs te/ nyan rang rkyang pa'i lam gyis mthar thug gi dgra bcom mi thob pa bzhin no/ /des na sems 'grel skor gsum dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs las sngags lam gyi snon pa med par phar phyin theg pa rkyang pas mthar thug gi sangs rgyas mi 'thob par gsungs pa la brten

nas / phyis kyi mkhas pa dag phar phyir theg pa rkyang pa'i sangs rgyas tsam yang mi srid de/ spang bya shin tu phra pa ni phar phyin nas bshad pa'i rgyun mtha'i dri ma phra mo yin la/ de sgom lam chen po'i chen pos spong bar ma nus nas sngags lam snon pa yin pas/ 'o skol gyi ston pas sa bcu pa'i ye shes brnyes zin pa'i rjes su sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskul nas/ rim pa bzhi pa'i 'od gsal zhes bya ba sngags kyi mthong lam dang / de'i rjes su slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya ba sgom lam ste rim pa de gnyis/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam mthar thug gi mthar bsnan pa yin pas phar phyin theg pa ba sngags la 'jug pa'i ma mtha' nges pa med kyang / ya mtha' ba ni sa bcu pa las mtho mi srid pa dang / de sngags la 'jug na sngags kyi tshogs sbyor gyi dod thub legs par grub zin pas mthong lam las dma' mi srid pa yin no zhes pa 'di rnams legs bshad khyad par can du grags mod/ 'di la ni/ sgom lam chen po'i chen pos ngo skal gyi spang bya spong mi nus na/ sgom lam gzhan brgyad kyis kyang mi nus par thal ba dang / phar phyin theg pa la byang chub med na de la dmigs pa'i sems skyed log shes su thal ba dang / sngags kyi mthong lam yin na rang lam gyi tshogs sbyor sngon du song bas khyab par thal ba dang / kun tu 'od las gong na gzhan med na de ma mthar byas pa'i sa bcu gnyis mi 'thad par thal ba dang / sngags la phar phyin na med pa'i gnyen po zhig yod na de 'dra'i spang bya zhig yod par thal ba rnams rtags bsal dngos 'gal gyi thal 'gyur/ khyab pa la sangs rgyas kyis

ra༅༅/ /kyang skyon mi rnyed pa yin na ji ltar legs bshad du 'gyur gzu bo'i rnam dpyod kyis rtogs shig rgyu mtshan de dag 'khral pa med pa de'i phyir 'og sogs btsal dgos la/ dgos pa de'i phyir nyan sogs 'gal te/ rgyu mtshan kun nas kun tu mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ nyon mongs kyi dang las kyi dang skye ba'i nyon mongs gsum po rim pa bzhin 'dul sorgos gtso bo yin te/ rim pa bzhin du/ rtsa ba nyon mongs nyid spang dgos mi sdug bsngal gyi phung po grub zin spang mi nus shing / las sgrib sbyong ba yang las zad dub pa don med du gsungs pa'i phyir dang / las kyi sgrib pa yang ched du gnyer nas sbyang dgos shing / sbyang thabs kyang stobs bzhi'i bshags pa sogs du ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / tha mal rnam rtog rgyun las ma gtogs pa'i/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya gzhan med pas/ /de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur ba'i sems/ /de ni mngon sum nyid du rtogs par bya/ /zhes tha mal snang zhen gyi rtog pa nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi ma gzhi yin la/ de bskyed rim nyid kyis kyang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi phung po sangs rgyas kyi skur bsgyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du sdig pa gzugs sogs gsum dang de gsum gyi cha shas khyad par can bla ma'i rdzas dang chung ma sogs la brnab sems dang / bla ma la gnod par sems pa dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la som nyi za ba sogs rnams rim pa bzhin du de gsum gyi spang bya'i gtso bo yin te/ 'dul ba nas lus ngag gi bdun la gnang ba gtan

mi srid cing yid kyi gsum la sdig pa 'byung yang ltang ba ma bcas pa'i phyir dang / byang sems la/ snying brtser bcas na mi dge med/ /ces lus ngag gi bdun la gnang ba yod cing yid kyi gsum po'i cha shas tsam yang ma gnang bar ltang ba yang de gsum gyi steng du bcas pa'i phyir dang / sngags la dbang dang drag po'i las kyi tshe rang don cung zad 'dres srid kyang gzhan gyi lus srog longs spyod la dus kyi kun slong gi tshe brnab sems dang gnod sems dang sems can sangs rgyas su sgom pa sogs gnang bar ma zad sgrub dgos la/ yul khyad par can la brten pa rnams nan gyis bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnam gzhag 'di dag thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la don steng na gnas te/ bshad ma thag pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta mod kyi 'khor ba gsum la sogs pa gsal bar dngos su thon pa'i rnam dpyod rang la ldan kyang gzhan ngor ston mkhan ni sngar ma byung ste/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis kyang ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro / /de phyir sogs ni rlom sems dang zhum sems gnyis gas bskyed pa'i tshig go /gsum pa ni/ sngar gyi 'dod pa la gnod byed brjod pa ste/ mdo sngags 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub pa la nye lam dang ring lam tsam du gzung bar bya'i sngags kyi snon pa dgos par ma smra zhig gal te sngags nas su+os su gsungs pa'i gnyen po bde chen des spang bya'i sa bon thig spong dgos pa yin na ni mdo phyogs su ma bshad pa'i spang bya tshig kyang yod ngagos pas mdo sder sogs rtogs so/ /ba'i pa

ra༅༅/ ni/ rdo rje sogs te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i spyi don chen mo bstan pa'i rgya mtsho sogs la blta bar bya'o/ /grub sogs le'u lnga pa bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa bshad pa mthar phyir pa'i bya ba la/ bka' drin gyi phyag bya / gzhung 'dir 'jug par gdams/ de'i rgyu mtshan brjod/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dge rtsa gzhan la bsngo/ gzhung byed kyi ming dus bstan pa rnams te rtogs par sla'o/ /gang gi drin las srid zhi'i snang ba kun/ /gti mug gnyid kyis bslad pa'i rmi lam ste/ /gnyid sang tshe na spros kun nyer zhi bar/ /legs rtogs blo mchog rtsol der phyag bgyid do/ /rmongs chen gnyid kyis bslad pa'i rmi lam dang / /las nyon sngags kyis bskyed pa'i sgyu ma dang / /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis gzir ba'i smra brjod la/ /bden par rlom pa'i ma rgan 'gro ba rnams/ /thog med dus nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor g.yengs/ /sdug bsngal chu srin chen pos yang yang gtses/ /bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i klong 'khor nang du lhung / /'di dag 'khral ba'i snang bas bslus mthong nas/ /'bral bral rgyal ba'i gsung la gces par bzung / /'phags mchog shing rta che rnams bzhed pa'i gzhung / /nyin mtshan chad pa med par rgyun tu sbyangs/ /khyad par klu sgrub gzhung mchog snying la bcangs khrong gzhan grub mtha'i rgya mtsho che brgal nas༄/ /mtha' bral bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po rnyed/ /lung dang rig pa'i byi dor cher byas te/ /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse la legs par bkod/ /phan bde 'dod rgu'i char chen phab pa 'di/ /yang dag lta

ba'i khu+or pa 'dod la sogs/ /don gnyer skye bo kun gyis longs spyod mdzod/ /lta ngan/ dbul 'phongs mtha' dag zhi gyur bi /'dir 'bad dge dang rang gzhan dge ba yi/ /wo byed dbang po lhag bsam rta bdun gyis/ /lcag ༄la thogs med drangs nas ni/ /lta ngan mun pa mtha' dag sel gyur cig /dge legs kun 'byung dpal ldan bla ma dang / /dngos grub kun stsol skyabs gsum lhag pa'i lha/ /bar chad kun sel mthu ldan srung ma ste/ /mchod 'os kun gyis bkra shis dge legs mdzod/ /ces grub mtha' kun shes kyi rnam par bshad pa legs bshad kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di/lung dang rig pa'i dpal 'byor gyis rnam par rtse ba'i bshes gnyen du mas ༷spril nas/rtsa ba byed pa po rang nyid kyis rgyas bsdus 'bring po tsam du legs par sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ /shes byar srid kun mang thos gser sgong du/ /rnam sto+od drod kyis smin pa tshangs pa'i stan/ /'jig rten mig gcig stag tshang la tsā ba/ /nges pa don ldan ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gang gi phyi nang grub mtha'i dbye ba dang / /sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa'i tshogs/ /kun gyi gnas lugs mtsho la byad ltar du/ /mthong nas glegs bam 'ad kos chos rnams shes/ /rmongs gzhan mun pa'i khung bur bag phab nas/ /phyogs lhung lce gnyis rkyong min blo gros bya/ /gtsug lag nam mkha'i pha mtha' gzhal 'dod pa'i/ /gzur gnas blo lngan kun dga' skyed pa'i yul/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i legs bshad yid bzhin nor/ /lam kha'i rngo ba lta bur dor byas nas/ /deng dus cher

ra༅༅/ /rlom ngag sgros mching bu la/ /rin thang gzhal ba'i tshul des mchi ma dku/ /'on te blang dor shes pa srid pa'i phyir/ /dpyod ldan mang bar phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /tshad med chos sbyin spel 'bras tshe rabs kun / /gsal myur zab pa'i shes rab 'thob par shog zhes 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rig gnas kun shes dang grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel gnyis kyi bar blo gsal mang por phan 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas blangs te dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du brkos pa'i tshe za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o// //maṅga yaṃ// //
ra༅༅/ /rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal sti+or rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ra༅༅/ /na mo mañju shrī ye/ rten gsum bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa'i sgrub tshul rgyas par bshad pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo / /tshogs gnyis rta ljang zhon pa la chibs shing / /legs bshad tsha zer thigs pa'i gzhon nu ma/ /phan bde'i 'dab stong be sar bzhad pa'i dpal/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i nyi mas dge legs mdzod / /thub dbang kha ba'i rdul brtsegs legs 'ongs shing / /lung dang rtog pa'i gting mtha' zad mi shes/ /mkhas mchog klu dbang kun gyi bsten pa'i gzhi/ /thub bstan rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro 'di'i phun tshogs gang la rag las pa'i/ /thub bstan gnas dang 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i thabs/ /dge 'dun sde dang rten gsum bzhengs pa'i tshul/ /mdo rgyud mkhas pa'i rjes 'brang

༄༄༄/ /'dir bshad bya/ /'dir/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ zhes mdo sde brgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas/ bzo rig pa gzhan rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du mkhas par bya dgos pa dang / khyad par skye rgu'i phan bde rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rag las shing / de yang dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la rag las pas de dag gi bzhengs tshul shes pa shin tu gal che bas bshad par bya'o/ /'di la lnga/ legs par bzhengs pa'i phan yon/ gang gis bzhengs pa'i rgyu tshogs/ gang du bzhengs pa'i sa phyogs/ gang zhig bzhengs pa'i rten gsum/ ji ltar bzhengs pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ lung rnam 'byed las/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / /mal stan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /zhes sogs rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi gtso bo dge 'dun gyi sde dang / der gtsug lag khang dang / sku gzugs dang / glegs bam dang / mchod rten bzhengs pa rnams yin par gsungs shing / gnas mal gyi gzhi dang / gso sbyong gi gzhi las gceg lag rtseg cing ri mor bri ba dang / mchod rten bzhengs tshul dang / sku gzugs kyi 'grodo na mdzad tshul dang / bsro khang sgrub tshul dang / dge 'dun bsdus nas bstan pa'i bya ba byed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin du sngon grub chen kum+bha las kyang grub pa thob nas/ bstan

pa la gang phan gzigs pas/ dge 'dun gyi sde bzhugs pa las lhag pa med par gzigs nas/ rgyal por bsam bzhin du skye ba bzhes te/ bi kā ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang / jo bo chen pos kyang 'phags pa rnam grol sde la sogs pa'i rjes su zhugs te/ rgya gar du'ang gtsug lag khang duma'i gnyer kha mdzad cing / bod du ston pa rin po che la yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la/ dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi bzhengs pa las lhag pa med pas gnas gzhi gyis shig ces nan gyis gdams pas na/ 'di dag ni phan yon shin tu che ste/ theg pa thun mong gi lugs kyis/ dkon mchog dang po gnyis sku gzugs la bya bar dus 'khor sogs nas gsungs shing / mdo du ma las/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad kyi bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs ring bsrel gyi snying po can zhig 'jim pa las sgrub pa bsod nams lhag pa sogs mang du gsungs shing / gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i mchod rten byed dam byed bcug pa/ /mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun grims pa dang / /rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtsor 'gyur zhing / /mi de dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rngams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rngams la rdul phun ci yod pa/ /de 'dra'i grangs te snyed kyi rgyal srid dang / /lha yum sa steng mi yis nges par 'thob/ /gzugs ngang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /phun sum tshosas pa'i sa

ra༅༅/ /mchog kun myong nas/ /tha mar skye dang rga ba la sogs pa'i/ /sdag bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob/ /'ji na rgyal ba'i ska gzugs byed pa ni/ /gzugs bzang bskal bzang yon tan nye bar ldan/ /de ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od/ /'jig rten kun gyi mthong na dga' bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa gang / /de yi lus ni dri ma med s+dza dang / /nad dang mya ngan 'jigs dang sdug bsngal bral/ /pad+ma'i nang ltar 'jam dang yangs par 'gyur/ /'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang / /bran du mi 'gyur dbul po'i rang bzhin min/ /las byed ma yin skye ba dman pa min/ /dbang po ma tshang min te skyes mchog 'gyur/ /ces sogs dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo dang / mar me 'bul ba'i mdo dang / mchod rten bskor ba'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa rnams na rgyas par bzhugs shing / bslab btus kyi mjug na mdo du ma drangs nas bzhengs pa dang / bzhengs zin la zhabs tog byed pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams dang / rgyud sde gong 'og kun tu bris sku sogs sgrub tshul dang / de dag gi phan yon rgyas par gsungs pa rnams blta bar bya'o/ /khyad par sher phyin gyi glegs bam bzhengs pa dang / de byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba'i bsod nams ni/ brgyad stong pa'i mchod bstod bkur bsti dang bsod nams rnams grangs kyi le'u na rgyas par bzhugs pa ltar rgyas 'bring gzhan dang / sdud pa tshigs su bcad par/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan

'das pa yis/ /zhes pa nas/ mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod/ /ces dang / bzhi brgya par/ rin chen rang bzhin mchod rten ni/ /'jig rten snyed mtho 'ga' byas pa/ /de bas sems can gcig 'dul ba/ /mchog tu spras par brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'phags pa sdad par/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas/ /gang gi shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ /zhes sogis rgyas par gsungs pa ltar/ sku gzugs ni gsung 'byon 'byon 'dra yang / glegs bam rnams ni de las ldog pas/ mkhas pa la ltos na ni sku gzugs las kyang gsung rab bzhengs pa bsta na pa'i rgyun la phan zhing / mkhas rmongs spyi la ltos na ni/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che lta bus 'gro don mdzad pa tsam/ glegs bam gyis byed par dka' bas/ sku gzugs nyid 'gro don che bar snang ngo / /des na phyogs gcig kho na la zhen nas gzhan la sdang smras byed pa spangs te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la 'bor lo gsum gyi bya ba sgo du ma nas khyad med du dgos pa shes par bya la/ rang gi sgo gsum dang longs spyod kyi nus pa dang bstun/ dngos kyi yongs 'dzin gyis bzhed pa'i gtso bo dngos sra sgrab cing / dngos su grub pa'i dge legs kyi bya ba gzhan gyis smon pa'i gnas dang / gang zag gzhan gyis sgrub pa mthong zhing thos pa dag la bsam pa thag pa nas yi rang bar bya'o/ lto /gnyis pa rgyu'i yan lag sbyin

ra༅༅/ /bdag rkyen gyi yan lag bzo bo/ de gnyis tshogs pa'i yo byad do/ /dang po la skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ sdig la mi 'dzem dad 'dun chung / /phan yon ma mthong yid mi ches/ /sgrub blo med pa'am yod na yang / /tshe 'di'i lo 'dod grags 'dod phyir/ khyen dang mi mtshams blo rgya che/ /ngang thung blodo ga bzod sran chung / /lha dang bzo bo smod byed cing / /'gyod pa skyes nas 'phro 'jog go /yon tan gyi mtshan nyid ni/ phan yon mthong ba'i shes rab can/ khre gcig sems pa'i bsam gtan can/ /brtan cing spro ba'i brtson 'grus can/ /dka' spyad mi skyo bzod sran can/ /ngang ring tshig 'jam tshul khrims can/ /g.yo med gtong phod sbyin par ldan/ /lha dang bzobo ra dad gus ldan/ /rim gyis dga' spro bsgom pa 'o/ lto /gnyis pa/ bzo bo'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ yon tan mi mkhas nga rgyal che/ /'grogs pa mi bde bkur bsnyi 'dod/ /'phral du tshig rtsab phugs 'dod che/ /yon rgyags bla thang tshad med 'bebs/ /des kyang mi chog rgyu cha brku/ /cung zad tsam la bzo 'phro 'jog /'gro bsdigs byed cing chang nag 'tshol/ /dge las sdig par bskyar mkhan yin/ /bzo bo'i yon tan gyi mtsharno nyid ni/ rgyud saspu ṭi las/ dul zhing dad ldan mang tshor bas/ /dbang po rnams gsal rnam rtog med/ /khro med lkog 'chos mi byed cing / khyen tu mkhas la spro ba che/ /bzod ldan snying rje chenarwa 1 can/ /zhes dang / rgyud sdom 'byung las/ dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la/ /cho ga mthong zhing mnyam bzhag pas/ /zhes

dang / rgyud sde du ma nas gsungs pa'i phan yon spyi dang / sngags sku rnams la dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa dang / rab dge slong sogs dang / tha ma'ang bzo 'dzugs dus bsnyen gnas blangs pa'i sdom ldan dgos par gsungs te / 'dodi pa chung zhing bkur bsnyi sla/ /mkhas shing khengs med mkhas la mnyan/ /bzod la gzab cing rkyen ngan bzod/ /lha la gus shing spyod legs pa'o/ lto /gsum pa la/ yon bdag rgyu la mi gzab pa'i/ /'bras bu bzang 'dod ltas ngan yin/ /bzo bo lag cha mi gzab pa'i/ /bzo la gzab 'dod ltas ngan yin/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ rgyu rab rin po che mchog tu gyur pa dang / gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / ra gan dang / li la sogs pa dang / gser ljang brdungs kyi shog bu'am mthing shog ma mtha' shog skya gang bzang yan chad/ shing dang sa rdo sogs kyang gang bzang dang dpus gang dag mi 'grub pa'i blor rgyar ma song tsam gyi rtsal 'don ched gnyer du byas nas bzo bo la g.yo rgyu med par gtad cing dang po nas lhus thengs pa shin tu gal che'o/ /bzo bos kyang skabs der dgos pa'i rgyu cha gang 'grub 'tshol grogs dang gsher mal mkhas pa dang / bzo rgyu'i go rim ma log pa dang / skabs su babs pa'i lag ca la gsar batho rnying bcos bla bcos su ma song ba nan tan chen pos sgrub cing / dang por ha cang zhum ste g.yag shing rgyal sgor grags pa yang ma yin/ ha cang mthos te sbyin bdag rtsormo par 'dor ba'i rgyur 'gro ba yang ma yin pa/ phyogs phyogs nas pha rol po gang byed

ra༅༅/ /kyang / rang nyid lus dang longs spyod la snying po len 'dod kyis kun nas blangs te phan tshun mthun pa gco bor sgrub par bya yis/ thog mtha' bar gsum du kha smras dang kha mchu'i sbyor ba mi bya'o/ /gnyis ka la dgos pa'i zhal bkod pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin cing 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs dang gnas dang rten gsum gyi ma nyid la mkhas pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa sbyin bdag dang bzo bo gnyis ma'i mgo 'don zhing lag rjes kyi/ sa phyis 'byung gi legs dpe thub pa dge rtsa thams cad rdzogs byang gi rgyur sbyor ba la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa nan tan gyis btsal zhing bsten par bya'o/ 7 /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten la 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad phyi nang gi rten 'brel khyad du ma bsad cing legs par bsgrigs pa las byung ba/ rgyud sde rnams las dkyil 'khor dang de'i khang pa gang du bya ba'i sa phyogs btsal bar gsungs shing / de yang sgo du ma nas brtag pa'i thabs gsungs pa ltar/ jo bo chen po la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang sa spyad kyi rnam par bzhag pa mang du mdzad pa rnams la btus nas sa phyogs brtag cing blang dor la mkhas par bya ba yin te/ mthong ba dang reg pas skyon dang yon tan bskyed pa'i dug sprul dang nor bu la sogs pa bzhin du nyes dmigs dang phan yon shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang sngon byung gi lo rgyus thos pas brtag da ltar gyi snang tshul mthong bas brtag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thun mong ba sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu

gnyis sogs bstan pa'i gnas sam/ sher phyin bshad pa'i sa phyogs lta bu rten gyi yul mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa dang / gang zag khyad par can gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas dang / chos ldan gyi bya ba khyad par can 'byung bzhin pa'am/ sngon byung nas re zhig rgyun chad pa'ang rung ste/ bya ba mi shis pas bar du ma chod pa bkra shis pa'i gnas su grags shing grub pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa thi ba pa'i gnas su byed na/ 'dzam gling gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am yul so gnyis kyi nang du gtogs pa la sogs pa yid ches pa'i lo rgyus tshad mar byas te legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i gnas rnyed na/ phyi'i sa/ spyad brtag pa la sogs pa mi shes pa'am ma grub kyang dge legs ngang gis 'byung la/ khyad par gnas chen gyi phan yon la yid ches pa'i dad mos yod na rten 'brel rang 'grig tu 'gro'o/ /spyir bya ba gang byed thams cad bla ma dkon mchog la blo legs par bkal/ khyad par skabs su gang babs kyi mchod gtor la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba legs par sgrub pa dang / nyes pa bzlog pa'i don du gsol ba drag tu btab nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don lhag bsam dag pas zhugs na/ mo dang rtsis la sogs pa'i dgos pa thams cad zhar las 'byung zhing / lam gyi rtsa ba dad pa dang / des kun nas blangs pa'i skyabs 'gro dang / de'i bslab bya thams cad gong 'phel du 'gyur bar legs par 'dod cing / nyes pa mi 'dod pa'i blo sna nam skyes dus/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs phong de'i ngon du dbe ba sang 'grub la 'bad pa gtso bor

ra༅༅/ /bya zhing / de ltar byed pa'i ngang nas legs par shes pas rtsis dang dpyad la sogs pa la yang blang dor bya'i/ gtso bor bya rgyu dor nas/ phywa dang mo rtsis 'ba' zhig dang du len pa la ni las 'bras khyad du gsod pa'i ltas ngan gyi 'dres yod pas spang bar bya'o/ 7 /gnyis pa ni/ yul la dge bcu tshang ba de/ /khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge /'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtsa yi dge /khang shing bud shing shing gi dge /khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge khor gnyis 'di dag gcig yod par/ /gceg shos yod par dkon pas na/ /sngon tshe dkon pa rje gung gis/ /btsal bas la stod la tshang ma/ /dang po brgyad po tshang badz+ra mthong / /dpyad kyi gtsu+o bo byang skyabs shing / /lho la mdun bstan lho nub zhol/ /rgyab re nye zhing mtho ba dang / /mdun ri rings zhing dma' ba dang / /nyi ma 'char snga gos pa phyi/ /chu rgyun g.yas su 'bab pa rnams/ yi/na tshangs dpal ldan sa skya sogs/ /re re tsam las med par grags/ /sa dpyad thog ma rwa pa'i mdun rgyab dang / /gdags sribs legs par phyed pa shin tu gces/ khor dang lho mdun gzhan gnyis rgyab tu 'dod/ /'on kyang rang rang lung pa'i shis la sogs/ /gang du kha ltas shar du byas la rtsi/ /lho dang shar gdags gzhan gnyis sribs su 'dod/ /sa la pho mo 'di ltar 'dod/ /gyong rtsub rdo ba mang ba pho/ /'jam snyem rngo nyung chu mang mo/ /mdog la brtag pa 'di lta ste/ /dkar dmar nag dang 'dres pa la/ /lha btsan bdud dang 'dre rnams gnas/ /sngo smug rin chen nor

gyi dpyad/ /mdangs gsal snum chags za 'og bkram/ /gser g.yu brgyus 'dra mar khu'i snod/ /rgya zho mnan 'dra dur pa'i rgyab/ /stag lpags rma bya'i mdongs kyi mdog /zhe dud brnyal 'dra gcan gzan spu/ /me tog lug mig lta bu bzang / lto /ri la rgyal blon btsun mo'i ri/ /rtse mtho sked pa brjid la lhun/ /rgyab gzar mdun rnyel thu ba skyor/ /srab 'thug ya yo med par brtan/( khre na gangs g.ya' spangs nags 'dzoms/ /mdun nas chu dang ri yis bskor/ /g.yas brag g.yon chu zur na gshong / /me tog bsung chags gong mo rgod/ 7 /de 'dra ri yi rgyal po yin/ /bzang po'i ri brgyud bar ma chad/ /lho byang gzhung tshugs rtse mo mtho / /ri phran gral bcas za 'og 'dra/ 'ang mangs gcan gzan bya rgod gnas / lhe /de 'dra ri yi blon po yin/ /ri stod 'od 'bar smad na chu/ /de ris mtha' bskor 'thu ba skyong / /'ja' 'od rin chen ltar brgyus 'dra/ /ngos 'jam ba tshwa zug ngu med/ lnge /de 'dra ri yi btsun mo yin/ /de gsum mdun du gnas 'debasashin tu bzang / lto /srog chags rdzas kyi 'dra gzugs ni/ /mi ltar 'greng la 'dug langs dang / /nyal dang 'gros dang rnyes pa lnga/ /dang po gnyis ni rab dang 'bring / /gsum pa nad 'byung gzhan gnyis ngan/ /phyug ltar 'dug dang nya ltar 'phyo/ /bya ltar lding ba rnams kyang 'bring / /rdzas gzugs nor bu rdor dril sogs/ /bzang zhing dug sbrul la sogs ngan/ /'dra gzugs 'dres na bzang ngan 'dres/ /sa la bzang dpyad lha bzhi dang / /ya rabs lnga yin yon tan

ra༅༅/ /dang / /phyag dang mdzes dang snying po'i sa/ /re re'ang drug cu smu yad brgyad/ /'dod pa brgyad dang yon tan brgyad/ /gang ba brgyad dang bzhad sdang brgyad/ /so sor gnyes dgu bzang po bcu/ /gdab 'os pa dang mi thub pa/ /nyi shu nyi shu sa yi rigs/ /rāzang po drug cu rtsa gsum dang / /nor nyen snye shu rtsa brgyad dang / /spog po chu dang shing rgi dpyad/ /la sogs mkhas pas shes bya ste/ lto /lha bzhi shar lho nub byang du/ /stag skya bya dmar 'brag sngon po/ /rus sbal ser po zhes byar grags/ /lam dang shing mtsho brag ri 'o/ /stag la sa mda' zug pa dang / /bya la mgul rnyis bzin pa dang / /'brag sngon thag gis 'thag pa dang / /rus sbal tsha bas thebs pa ngan/ /lam la las gzhan zug pa dang / /nags bar g.ya' yis bcad pa dang / /chu bar sa yis bcad pa dang / /brag ri gas shing grum pa 'o/ /lha bzhi gnas dang nye ring tshardo/ /gom pa sum cu drug cu dang / /dgu bcu rab 'bring tha ma 'o/ 7 /ya rabs lnga ni thes skas dang / /grum brtsegs rgyal po gdan la bzhugs/ /gser dril g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal 'dra/ lto /yon tan sa ni pad ze dang / /āt+pal rin chen ljon shing rgyas/ /chos sgrigs mar me 'bar 'dra 'o/ thā /phyug btsan mtsho lud gzhag 'khyil dang / /glang gcer sto tshil dmar khu'i snod/ /ba lang mkhal khung lta bu 'o/ 7 /mdzes pa rgyal pang blon po'i lkog /maṇ+ḍal dbus dang ne tsho'i lce/ /par phu'am mtsho yi snying po 'dra/ /snyim pa mar spungs yar bzed dang / /dbus gshong g.yas

g.yon 'khyud pa 'dra/ /sa srabs ri srabs med pa 'o/ 7 /smu yar brgyad ni mkhal khung dang / /nu 'bur phyag rgya bsnol 'dra dang / /stag 'dzum rnga mo'i nog 'dra dang / /mar skyugs lug gi dom bal dang / /brang zhol rgyas pa lta bu 'o / lto /'dod brgyad rtse mo caganam lado snyag /sked pa brjid chags thu ba gdengs/ /rgyab ri 'phyongs 'dra mdun ri dma'/ /phyogs mtshams skyob cing nags shing rgyas/ /gtsang po rgya mtsho mthong ba 'o/ lnge /yon tan rin chen brgyus 'dra dang / /dbus skyob mtha' sdad thu ba brkyangs/ /za 'og bkram 'dra gru bzhir mngon/ /rgya dpe brtsegs 'dra sang gshong med/ /mgo lus ma bral ba tshwa med/ /gad brgyad mtsho 'khyil ri bong sna/ ga sbyang gzhag brgyangs mchin btsos 'dra/ /me long ngos dang kha sbyar brla/ /tshangs sbur bsags rnams 'dra ba 'o/ lnge /gzhad brgyad rang ri mdog snum mtho/ /gzhan ri kun zhum dgra ri bros/ /rang phyogs kun 'dud shing thog rgyas/ /sribs bra ma mdun phyag nam mkha' yangs / lnge /gces dgu nam mkha' gru bzhi dang / /gangs ri la thod g.ya' ri smug /brag ri mkhar thabs spangs ri rmog /nags ri so 'dra yol ri ber/ /lu ma na lung mig 'dra 'o/ /bzang bcu dpal be sgrorno me 'bar/ ༄/khal brtsegs brung rtser rgyal mtshan sgreng /dar brkyangs bum pa mchod rten brtsegs/ /pho ltar sgeg dang na chung ltar/ /brgyan pa bcu tshang don kun 'grub/ 7 /gdab par 'os pa nyi shu ni/ /lha da nga 'dra ba'i thugs kur gdab/ /rgyal mtshan 'dra ba'i rtsa ba

ra༅༅/ /cha/ /dpal ltar dbus dang rgyal po'i khri/ /blon po'i 'jam snon btsun mo'i lte/ /skyes pa'i sta zur na chung steng / /mchod rten bang rim stag gi 'dzum/ /seng ge glang chen 'brug dang rta'i/ /mkhal khung g.yon dang sprul gyi lto/ /khyung snying 'brong mjing rma bya'i mdongs/ /rnga mo'i nog dang nya 'dra'i skog /'di dag thub na shin tu bzang / /lha yi cod paṇa rgyal mtshan rtse/ /mchod rten bum pa rgyal po'i thod/ /la sogs mi thub nyi shu spang / /pi waṃ rgyud 'dra rin po che/ /spungs 'dra la sogs drug cu gsum/ /rgyal po mkhar bas 'gying 'dra dang / /sprang po dbyug thogs rgyug 'dra sogs/ /nor nyer nyi shu rtsa brgyad yod/ /rgyas par gzhan du blta bar gyis/ /ngam brog phal cher ngan na yang / /brog rtse la khar phyi nang gyes/ /lug dang sprin pa bkram 'dra ba'i/ /bud kyis brog sgor spungs pa dang / /drang po brtsug 'dra rtsa ba ni/ /lam dang nags dang na chus chod/ /mgo lnga shing lo 'dra ba dang / /āt+pal rma bya'i mdongs 'dra bzang / 7 /chu la'ang 'dur rgyug 'bru chad dang / /dal brjid sma lkugs la sogs pa/ /bzang ngan chu ris bcu gnyis bshad/ lho/ 'ang la'ang nags chen 'grug pa dang / /skye legs 'gag tu byung ba dang / kheng chen shing phran mang po yis/ /legs par bskor na bzang po sogs/ /phal cher rang gis dpyad pas shes/ /'di dag bzang dpyad mdor bsdus te/ /ngan dpyad phal cher ldog pas shes/ /gzhan ni sa dgra bcom pa'i thabs/ /skabs su 'og tu bshad par bya/ /bzang dpyad shes nas sangab pa
