ne / /gdab 'os nyi shu bshad pa dang / /pad gdong āt+pal gyis mtshams dang / /rdo rje'i 'chang bzung dril bu'i sgyer/ /ba dan lce mtshams 'phan gyi dbus/ /mkhar spel ba gam ljon shing rtse/ /gzhu 'gag nya gshul sha pho'i brang / /lug gi dom bal bya rgod mgo /rus sbal lkog ma dpal be'i rwa/ /gos dang 'phying pa'i gong ba la/ /brangs dang nas dang mig dang ni/ /lug khyung 'dra ba'i dbus su gdab/ /mthon po'i ri la sked par bzang / /sgang dang gzar po'i sde sa dang / /skyongs kyi 'bur sa 'bur gyi skyongs/ /g.ya' dang spang gi skabs gsher mtshams/ /na dang zhing dajo thang gi dbus/ /'jam po'i rtsub pa rtsub mo'i 'jam/ /de yang skabs kyi 'dod dang sbyar/ /nor 'dod nags la rtsal 'dod brag /rta dang lug la spu 'dod na/ /lam dang zhing dang spang la gdab/ /rgyal sa dpa' bo bu 'dod na/ /rgyal thugs btsun dpang stag mdzum la/ /tshe ring snyan pa bgrang thub 'dod/ /rdo rje dril bu pu sti la / /nor rdzas rje bo dgos dgu 'dod/ /nags chen āt+pal rin chen dbus/ /mi nor zas bcud dgra 'dul 'dod/ /glang chen sha pho seng ge'i ral/ /gshin rje'i bka' nyan bkur bsti 'dod/ /dkyil 'khor rgod mgo zla tshes dbus/ /kha drag gzhan bstod bang mdzod 'dod/ /rus sbal khyung dang sgrom gyi dkyil / lto /mchod rten phal cher sgang du bzhengs/ /'on kyang grong sogs shar dang ni/ /chu mig mgo dang brog ral zug /sa mtshan yod dang sa rlan che/ /srog chags mang dang rgyu srang yod/ /grong dang gnyan sar grib ma 'bab/ khor

ra༅༅/ /nas chu bo res 'jog dang / /lho na shing skam yal ga med/ /nub na shing gcig kha khrag lam/ /byang na sa dgra mang po'i sar/ /mchod rten gnas gzhi sogs mi bya/ /gzhan yang gsang ba spyi brgyud las/ /mtho dman snyoms shing gtsang la snum/ /zug rngu'i nyes pa rnam par spangs/ khor dang byang du gzhol ba yi/ /sa gzhi las rnams kun la shis/ /zhes sogs dkyil chog du ma las/ /bshad pa thams cad 'dir 'dus so/ lto /rgyud dang dkyil chog rnams las/ shar dang byang dma' bar dgos par bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten spyi'i shar dang byang min gyis/ sa phyogs sam/ dkyil 'bor de nyid kyi mdun dang g.yon la bzhed pa yin no/ /gnas kyi yon to gyi gtso bo ni/ gang na sa skyongs chos ldan zhing / /skye rgu bde gnas rtsod pa med/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi rgyal pos legs par skyong zhing skye rgu bstan pa la dad pa dang 'byor pa che zhing rtsod pa med pa gal che ste/ mdo sde brgyan las/ blo ldan gang du bsgrab pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang ba/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yo byad dang lus dang sems dang gnyis ka dang / rnal 'byor rnams la mi gnod cung phan pa bsod snyoms rtsal sla ba dang / chu bzang ba dang / gzhi bdag bzang ba dang / mthun pa'i grogs dang / nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu lugs dang / mtshan mo klag col gyi sgra chung ba sogs te mthun pa'i yul la gnas pa zhes bya ba la rkyen 'khor lo chen po bzhi'i gya

gcig yin pas/ gnas kyi ma nyid thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams legs par shes par bya ste/ blang dor la 'bad pa gal che'o/ lto /bzhi pa gang 'ig bzhengs pa'i rten gsum la dkon mchog gsum gyi'am/ ska gsung thugs kyi rten no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rten la chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'i rten no/ /dang po ni/ mchod rten du grags shing / de la yang dbye ba lngar grags te/ lto /rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dang / 7 /bla na med pa'i dang / lnge /spyon gyi rlabs pa'i dang / lnge /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dang / 7 zeg pa sa so'i mchod rten no/ lto /dang po la/ lung mchos bla ma zhes grags pa las/ gling bzhi ming / gser ri rab dang bcas pa bang rim/ yong 'du'i ljon shing bum par bshad pa phyi snod dang / kun gzhi ming / rnam shes tshogs brgyad ka ba/ dbang po gzugs can bang rim/ yid dbang bum pa ste nang bcud mchod rten du bshad pa dang / rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud las/ 'dod khams rmang gi ri bo la/ /gzugs khams bang rim khri 'phang can/ /gzugs med bum rten bum par bcas/ /ska gdung chen po rgyun du gnas/ /zhes dang / smṛ ti'i de kho na nyid drug par/ lnge /sa yi khri 'phang zur bcu gnyis/ /gling bzhi gling phran brgyad yin te/ /bang rim bdun du brtsegs pa ni / /gser gyi ri bdun shes par bya/ /dril bu'i dbyibs skya bum pa ni/ /lha gnas ri rab yin zhes bya/ /bum rten 'bor lo gdub bu'i dbyibs/ /klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas yin/ /kha khyer rim pa drug ldan pa/ /'dod khams lha rigs drug tu

ra༅༅/ /grags/ /dbus su srog shing yar sbreng ba/ /chos dbyings zag med spre+o sa bral yin/ /'bor lo bcu bdun gyis brgyan pa/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun rtags/ /char khebs gzugs med /bams yin te / /chos dbyengs ton tu shes par bya/ /zhes snod bcud spyir mchod rten du bshad ces zer zhing / dus 'khor du/ dkyil 'khor bzhi po bang rim dang / ri rab bum pa dang / ri rab kyi mgrin pa dang / gdong pa man chad bre dang / de yan chad skra / chos 'khor char khebs kyi rnam par gsal ba bshad pa lta bu'o/ lho /gnyis pa ni/ tshad med bsam yas las byung 'bras/ khor du byams pa rdo rje rtsegs/ /lho ru snyi rje rin chen brtsegs/ /nub tu dga' ba pad+ma brtsegs/ /byang du gtang snyoms rgya gram brtsegs/ /rang byung rin chen snang ba 'o/ /zhes pa shar du byams pa tshad med rdo rje du ma brtsegs pa la sogs pa bzhir/ thig (be dbang gi rgyud ces bya ba las bshad do zhes grags so/ lto /gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rgyud du grags pa las/ byin rlabs sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir snang / /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ shar lus 'phags na/ byams ldan bsod nams gter ngang / mthar legs g.yung drung rdzogs gnyis/ lho 'dzam bu gling na thugs rje sprul pa dang / yid bzhin lhun grub gnyis/ nub ba lang spyod na dpe med bsam 'das dang / smad grags chos dbyings gnyis/ byang sgra mi snyan na yon tan rin chen brtsegs dang / khams gsum bde rgyas sgron gyi mchod rten gnyis bzhugs par bshad

do 7 /bzhi pa ni/ bdud rtsi mchog gi rgyud las/ ro yi bsrung ma chen mo ni/ /ma mo chen mo brgyad bzhag go /de dag rten gnas chen mo yang / /mchod rten brgyad du rnam par bzhag /ces pa'i 'grel par/ sngon he ru mas drag po btul ba'i tshe/ yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du ma mo brgyad kyi rten dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad byung ba ni/ ma ga dhar bde byed/ sing ga lar ri bo ta la/ bal por bya khri kha shar/ seng ge'i gling du ge'u dā+o na/ li yul du go ma la sa la gan+dha/ sil ba tshal du ro langs/ kha cher kā na ga za hor du bde spyod gzhon nu'i mchod rten no/ lnge /lnga pa la/ nyan rang thig chen gyi gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ chos gos bzhi bltab kyi steng du lhung bzed spub pa la mkhar gsil btsugs pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ming gru bzhi'i steng du/ ngos bzhi zlum po bang rim bcu gnyis pa 'khor lo 3bas brgyad pa can no/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis lhung gzed spub pa lta bu bim pa'am zlum po dang / khang bu lta bu dang / rgyal mtshan lta bu'i mchod rten brgyad la sogs pa'o/ /'dul ba lung las ni/ chos 'khor la gdugs dang gdugs la char khebs su btags nas/ so skye'i gdugs med nga/'i byi bo/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu'i grangs kyi gdugs/ rang rgyal gyi gdugs bdun sangs rgyas kyi gdugs bcu gsum char khebs tog dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad par gsungs pa'o/ /rgyud sde so so'i dbang du byas nas bya spyod kyi mchod rten bang rim nang du bcag cing phyir 'bur ba'am/ dbus

ra༅༅/ /'bur la mtha' gnyis nang du bcums pa 'khor lo bcu gnyis la sogs pa'ang bshad par grags so/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sngar bshad pa'i rdo rje rtsegs pa sogs/ bla med kyi dus 'khor nas gsungs pa sogs so/ /khyad par las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/ sprul pa mdzad pa sngon bstan phyir/ /mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag /ces bshad pa ltar/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten la rnam bzhag dang bstod pa mdzang pa ltar / ston pa 'di yi mdzad pa khyad par can la rten/ yul ljongs de dang de'i skye bo spro ba skyes te dus ston bya ba'i phyir du brtsigs pa shwaka thub mchod rten brgyad du grags pa ni/ dang po/ 7 /gnas grong khyer ser skyar dus sku bltams pa'i tshe byung ba bde gshegs mchod rten du grags pa dbyebs bla ma dag zlum po pad+ma'i 'dab ma can bang rim bzhi pa'am bdun pa/ bltams pa'i mchod rten nam pad+ma'i 'dab ma can zer gsung ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo la gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa sgo bzhi'am brgyad la sogs pa gsungs pa yang / snga ma la bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchod rten du 'phags pas gsungs pa/ kho bo ni de gnyis ldog par 'dod de/ gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa glo 'bur dang bcas pa sbo rab brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'bring nga drug tha ma bcu drug pa'o/ lnge /gnyis pa gnas rgyal po'i khab tu dus mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su byung ba byang chub chen por grags pa dbyibs gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa'o/ lto /gsum pa gnas wa ra na mir dus chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe byung ba chos

'khor mchod rten nam/ ye shes mchod rten du grags pa zlum po bang rim bzhi pa'am/ bdun nam brgyad du bshad pa pad+ma dang 'khor los/ spras pa9ོ2ོ/ lnge /bzhi pa gnas gnyan yod dze ta'i tshal du dus cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe byung ba cho 'phrul chen po'am/ mu stegs pham mdzad du grags pa gru bzhi bang rim bzhi pa phyogs rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'o/ lnge /lnga pa gnas sum cu rtsa gsum du lha'i dbyar gnas mdzad/ yum la chos gsungs/ snga dro dgag dbye mdzad/ phyi dro mkha' las babs nas gsal ldan du phebs dus su byung ba/ bang rim bzhi'am brgyad pa/ ngos rer glo 'bur dang bcas pa'i glo 'bur gyi dbus na them skas yod pa lha babs sam/ sum cu'i lha'i mchod rten du grags pa'o/ 7 /drug pa rgyal po'i khab tu lha sbyin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa/ mchog zung gis bsdum pa'i dus su byung ba/ dbyen 'dum sam/ 'od zer can nam/ byams ngos mchod rten du grags pa/ bang rim bzhi pa gru bzhi'i zur bzhi mnyam par bcad pa'o/ lnge /bdun pa yangs pa can du sku tshe zla ba gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe byung ba/ rnam rgyal lam byin rlobs mchod rten du grags pa/ zlum po bang rim gsum pa'o/ lto /brgyad pa rtsa mchog gi grong du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe byung ba chos rgyal mya ngan med dam / myang 'das mchod rten du grags pa/ bang rim med pa gdan khri'i steng du bum rten yan chad bzhugs pa'o/ /de la yang sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rten che/ po brgyad/ ras tshig pa'i/ཿ ma tshig pa'i sol ba'i mchod rten te

ra༅༅/ /bcu gcig tshems che ba lha dang srin pos khyer ba'i mchod rten/ phyis chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bye ba dus gcig la bzhengs pa'i sogs dang / mya ngan las ma 'das gong du dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten sogs dpag tu med de/ gtso bo snga ma brgyad du ci rigs par 'dus la/ deng sang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs na ni/ gang zag su'i ched du bzhengs kyang / brgyad po gang rung gi rnam pa can du/ rnam pa thams cad par bya dgos so/ /de la yang dus 'khor sogs nas 'byung ba'i mgul pa thung ba'am/ dri med 'grel pa nas bshad pa'i mgrin rings sam/ rgyu dang bzo bo sogs kyis ji bzhin ma thon na/ ji ltar 'tshams shing mdzes pa'ang bya rung zhing / 7 /gnyis pa longs sku'i rten la'ang / rang bzhin lhun grub sogs ci rigs pa rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa'ang shes/ par bya la/ bod na rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs rgyan can la longs skur grags pa dang / sprul sku kun la grags pa thun mong gi mchog gi sprul sku rab byung gi cha byad can byed pa la ltos nas grags pa ltar/ tha snyad du byar rung mod kyi/ rgyud sde nas gang bshad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sprul skus khyab pas na / mtshan nyid du bzhag tu ni mi rung ngo / /des na longs sku dngos ni ngo bo ye shes kyi sku 'byung lus rags pa dang bral bas/ sa bcu'i byang sems las gzhan pa'i sems can la mi snang bas mtshan dpe'i cha shas phra zhing phra ba yang yongs su

rdzogs pa snang ba nges pa can/ gzhi kha dog thams cad pa yin par dkar po'am/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi rang mdog sngon po gang rung du nges pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ bla med kyi dbang du byas na longs sku dang kha sbyor gyi yan lag sogs yan lag bdun du nges la/ sprul sku ni gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi ngor 'byung ba rags pa'i mdog can zhal phyag du ma snang ba ma nges pa yin la/ cha tshad kyi cha nas/ rang sor brgya nyer lnga pa longs sku'i sangs rgyas dang / de nas brgya bcu gnyis pa'i bar longs sku'i byang sems dang / de man chad sprul sku'i sangs rgyas byang sems te/ sangs rgyas khro bo'i cha byad shin tu khros pa la ni rang sor lnga bcu yang bshad pa sogs su shes par bya'o/ lnge /sprul sku yongs grags rab byung gi cha byad can ni dbu reg zhabs brjen gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing dul la mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ na bza' chos gos gsum pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung dang sku mdog ser po shas che ba ste/ la la dmar po dang sngon po sogs kyang yin la zhabs bzhugs pa la/ phyag g.yon mnyam gzhag g.yas sa gnon/ mchog sbyin skobs sbyin chos 'chad sogs dang / zhabs bzhengs stabs la g.yon chos gos kyi gra 'dzin cing / g.yas mchog sbyin skyabs sbyin gang rung dang / glang po che nor skyong 'dul ba dang / sbyin len gyi phyag rgya sogs kyang mthong ste/ mdor na mdo dang lung nas 'byung ba rgya gar mkhas pas bzhengs pa dag la brten nas rtogs par bya zhing / rgyan can zhal mang phyag mang sogs ni rgyud sdeso so dang / ma mtha' de

ra༅༅/ /dag nas btus pa'i lha 'bum gsar rnying dag las shes par bya ste/ 'dir mang gi dogs pas ma bris so/ lto /chos kyi rten gyi gtso bo ni/ po sti glegs bam ste/ mdo sde chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong / rgyad sde nang tshan gsum khri gsum sto+ong / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las bshad la/ pha rgyud bye ba phyag drug ma rgyud bye ba phyag bcu drug theg pa thun mong gi mdo sde dung phyar brgyad/ sher phyin dung phyur lnga dang sa ya lngar bde mchos sngom 'byeng du bshad cing / de dag kyang sh+lau ku'i grangs min gyi mdo rgyud kyi ming gi grangs su bshad pa sogs/ bka' yang mtha' yas shing de dag gi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa yin zlo/ lnge /thun mong min pa'i gsung gi rten ni dril bu dang bgrang phreng ོ༵gas so / /dge 'dun la theg chen gyi dge 'dun sar gnas kyi byang sems ni/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bzhengs bkod lta bu la tshangs par spyod pa'i cha byad rab byung gi rnam pa'ang bshad cing / phal cher dbu skya zur phud lnga pa'am/ thor cog bcings pa na bza' dang rgyan du mas brgyan pa rdo rje'am/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can gzhon nu'i cha lugs 'chang ba'o/ snye /nyan rang ni/ rab byung gi cha byad shin tu mdzes pa 'khar gsil lhung gzed dang pu sti 'dzin pa'ang bya ste/ rang rgyal ni gtsug tor cung zad yo ba dang ldan pa'o/ 7 /sku gsung thugs su dbye na/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can dang / gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten la sogs pa sku'i rten/ pu sdi bgrang phreng dril bu la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag rnams gsung gi rten/ rdo rje gri gug la

sogs pa'i phyag mtshan phal cher thugs kyi rten du bshad do/ /da ni de dag gi cha tshad bshad pa la/ mchod rten gyi/ sku gzugs sgi phyag mtshan gyi/ gsung rab kyi cha tshad do/ /dang po la/ che chung gi tshad ni gang 'byor te/ skya ru ra'i 'bru tsam dang / dpag tshad du ma yang bshad pas so/ /de yang 'byor pa che yi bzang bas/ che ba la skyon brngod pa dang / 'byor bzhin du snang ba ni nyes dmigs shin tu che bas so/ /rgya dpangs ni/ rgyar dparatshad tsam du 'phang du de'i phyed pa bshad pa la / ngos bzhi sdoms pas rgyar 'dod pa'ang yod la/ ngos re rgya yin kyang / rgya ches grags pas 'phangs su de'i phyed pa las slong sma thub pa la dgongs zhes kyang zer zhing / dkyil 'khor la mchod rten du bshad pa'ang mang bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgya phyed dpangs su bstan pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /de ltar na che chung gang byed kyang rang rang gi cha tshad dang ldan pa dgos pas cha tshad shes par bya la/ mchod rten yongs grags kyi dang / gzhal yas khang gi tshad do/ /dang po la dri med 'grel pa'i dang / dus 'khor gyi cha tshad do/ /dang po ni/ lnge rgyal ba gnyis med gsung de la/ /btud nas bde gshegs mchod rten tshad/ /dri med 'grel pa las gsungs pa/ /bde blag rtogs phyir bshad par bya/ /tshangs zur rtsa thig gru bzhi dang / /ngos rer cha chen bcu gnyis sogs/ /tshegs che don chung snang mod skya /kho bo ldog te 'di skad smra/ /ji tsam 'byor pa'i tshangs thig gdab/ /smad nas seng khri ci mdzes bcad/ /bad chen 'og thig bya ba'i phyir/ /tshangs thig gnyis pa'i 'debs

ra༅༅/ /lugs bya/ /yan chad phyed dang de phyed sogs/ /cha 'a bcu gnyis ri mo bya/ /cha 'a rtsa nas sko+o rtse'i bar/ /mchod rten srid kyi tshad yin te/ /bre yi rten nam bum khebs zhi khya ba'i masgos ni phyed rdzo yin/ /cha chen bzhi cha cha chung ste/ /ma ngang bur yang tha snyad bya/ /bad chen dpangs la cha phran gsum/ /dge ba'i ming la cha phran gcig /bang rim bzhi po gnyis gnyis so/ /bum pa'i dpangs la cha chen gsum/ /'og nas bu gcig bum gas bya/ /bum rtses phyed kyi tshad du sleb/ /bum khebs bum pa'i gsum char 'dod/ /bre yi dpangs la cha phran gcig /gdong la gcig dang gsum gnyis te/ /de steng pad+ma cha phran gcig /por lo bcu gsum mdo gzungs dang / /bcas la ༅ bdun byed rnams la/ /ha cang rings pa'i skyon khung bas/ /re re cha phran re re bya/ /de yang go+o tsor bcu gsum i/ /stong du gsum gakho gdong dang ni/ /smad du gsum cha bugs par bya/ /bang rim bzhi pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /thugs rje mdo gzungs ut+pal bzhin/ /smad lkom gdeng ka cung zad gyes/ /de steng ka gzhu rgya gram ni/ /cha phran phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan/ /de steng rtsibs brgyad gsum cha'i dpangs/ /gdugs dang gdugs khebs sdom pa la/ /cha phran gcig dang gsum gnyis dpangs/ /khrogadan gcig la kro+o la bzhi/ /bad r+sā 'og tu bad chung la/ /cha phran phyed kyidapangs bya zhing / /seng khri'i smad kyi gsum cha la/ /pad gdan ji ltar mdzas par bya/ /da ni rgya tshad bshad kyis smo+o/ /tshangs thig nas gzhal

gsil bzhag 'dra 'o/ /'di rnams kun gyi rnam dag ni/ /slob dpon shān+ti gar+bha'i mchod rten gyi cha dbye ba las/ bad ni rjes dran drug ming rten ni dge ba bcu/ bang rim bzhi bum gdan/ bum pa bre rnams dran pa nyer bzhag nas 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi bar/ srog shing ni kun rdzob shes pa la sogs pa'i shes pa bcu/ pad+ma thabs dang shes rab/ 'bor lo bcu gsum ni stobs bcu dran pa nyer bzhag gsum/ char khebs thugs rje chen po/ tog ni chos kyi sku/ mchod rten gyi 'khor la rdo ring mi 'jigs pa bzhe/ them skas srung ba med pa/ rgyal mtshan bdud bzhi las rgyal ba/ me tog gi phreng ba mtshan dpe/ rgyal chen bzhi bden pa bzhi/ dril bu gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ nyi zla ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed pa / me long ye shes bzhi/ cod pan chos kyi rgyal srid 'thob pa/ ba dan ni chos kyi snyan pas kun la grags pa ste byang chub chen po'o/ lto /sgo mangs kyi sgo ni bden bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ stong nyid bcu drug la sogs pa'o/ /glo 'bur ni gzhan las khyad par 'phags pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o/ 7 /lha babs kyi them skas ni/ sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la 'byon par mtshon pa'o/ 7 /myang 'das la bang rim med pa ni/ 'khor ba'i 'jug pa dang bral zhing spros pa med pa'o/ lnge /pad+ma can gyi pad+ma ni/ 'khor ba'i 'dam pas skyes kyang des ma gos pa'o/ lnge /dbyen bsdums zur bzhi bcad pa ni/ dbyen gyi rgyu/ dug gsum lta ba dang bzhi bcad nas rnam thar zad par zil

༄ོ༄༄/ /gnon brgyad ma pa'o/ 7 /gnyis pa dus 'a/bor nas 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i lte ba man chad bang rim/ lte 'bur bum gdan/ de nas dpung pa'i bar bum pa/ mgrin pa bre/ rkos ka nas sna rtse dang / de nas mdzod spu'i bar bre gdong / de nas ral pa'i thor ci+og gi bar zhal gang la chos 'khor char khebs tog dang bcas pa byed pa ste/ phyi 'jig rten gyi dkyil 'bor bzhi dang / ri rab kyi lus dang / mgrin pa gdong pa skra rnams dang tshad gcig pas phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyar ba'o/ /rnam dag kyang de nyid yin la/ cha tshad tshigs bcad du brjod na/ dus kyi 'khor lo la btud nas/ /de nas gsungs pa'i mchod rten bshad/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i tshangs thig gdab/ /thig de dum bu lnga ru gtub/ /lnga po re re zhal re re/ /sor mo phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa/ /de lnga lus kyi gsang gnas nas/ /ya mtha' gtsug tor bar gyi ni/ khya 'khor drug gi bar du bshad/ /de phyir 'og ma gdan khri'i dpangs/ /de nas zhal do bum pa'i dpangs/ /de nas zhal gang bre dang gdong / /de nas zhal gang gdugs 'phreng ngo / /'di lhag sor mo lnga bcu po/ /mchod rten dngos kyi dpangs su bshad/ /de yi phyed kyis gdan khri'i rgya/ /de dang bum pa'i ldir pa mnyapa/ /de phyir zhal tshad dbus nas bskor/ /de yi phyed kyis bre gdong dang / /gdan gyi gsum cha bre mgal rgya/ /gdan dang bre dang gdong kun la/ /rang rang gsum cha glo 'bur bya/ /gdan ni sa gzhi gru bzhi nyid/ /bya bar gsung pa ma gtogs pa/ /bang

rim bshad pa med pas na/ /myang 'das lta bur mngon na yang / /bad chen dang bcas seng khri ni/ /'og tu byas nas 'dir bshad gdan/ /bzhi gtubs bang rim bzhi brtsegs te/ /kun kyang glo 'bur dang bcas bya/ /bang rim sor mo gnyis gnyis zhum/ /bum pa'i smad nas sor mo bzhi/ /pad+ma'i gdan bya bum pa yi/ /sked rma ra pad+ma'i phreng ba ni/ /kha sbyar dpangs dang bum stod nas/ /pad+mas bkab pa'ang sor bzhi 'o/ /bre mgul sor bzhi de lhag gdong / /gdugs phreng char khebs tog dang bcas/ /zhal gang po la ci mdzes te/ /mgul phra char khebs che na mdzes/ /glo 'bur kun dang pad+ma rnams/ /'bur tshad sor mo phyed dang gsum/ /sa la bzhengs na bum pa dang / /bre gdong skyung zhing gzhan rnams bskyed/ /mdzes shing dge legs 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa la thig gi bshad pa rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes dgos shing 'dir mang par 'gyur bas bzhag la/ lto 'dir ni blo langs bzhings tshul la rten pa'i log rtog snang che ba rnams bkag nas/ rang lugs gsal bar brjod par bya'o/ lto /'di la gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje la dang / rta babs la dang / dngos kyi dpangs la dang / yan lag gzhan la mi 'thad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rwa la dang / 'thug rngams la'o/ /dang po ni / phyis kyi mkhas pa dag phreng bar rwa rnams ni cha phran bcu drug pa'o/ /zhes pa'i lung la rten nas/ snga ma dag gi g.yas g.yon gyi rwa phyir bskyed nas bris pa dag bkag ste/ rwa so so'i dkyil thad la dbus rwa'i tshad kyi skud pas gzhal bas

༄༄༄/ /gang sleb las lhag pa gtan mi rung bar 'dod la/ snga ma'i rjes 'brang dag de la rmog ltar mi mdzes pa'i rnam pa 'byung ba sogs rgyu mtshan du byas nas snga ma kho na las gzhan mi rung bar 'dod do/ /kho bos ni gnyis ka yang mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i sgrub byed ma mthong ste/ phyi rabs pa'i lugs des kyang mtha' rwa'i tshad mi 'grub ste/ dbus rwa bzhi la bshad du rung bas so/ /dbus rwa dang mtha' rwa tshad mnyam du phyag mtshan rdo rje'i cha tshad kyi skabs su bshad pas mi mnyam pa mi rung ngo / /der gsum cha mnyam du bshad pas/ rwa la cha chen bzhi las lhag pa mi srid pa dang / lte ba cha chen bcu gnyis byed pa mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /gsum cha mnyam du phyag mtshan rdo rje'i dgos bcos yin gyis/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gdan yin pas skyon med do zhe na ni 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /des na gnyis ka ltar yang rung bar sems so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje bsnol nas lcog rtse'i steng du bzhag pa dper phyogs bzhi'i rwa 'bur bzhi sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la reg cing bzhi steng du drangs thad du sgur mor byas te/ rta babs kyi mdun bkag pa ltar byed pa mi 'thad de/ de ltar na lte ba'i 'thug rngams cha chen bzhi pa las dma' ba mi/ rung la/ de la ni rwa yi gseng rnams shin tu ches pas/ sgo'i mdun du 'gro'o nga sogs shin tu mi bde ba'i phyir ro/ /ye shes kyi snang ba gang yang rung zhing / lha rnams nam mkha' nas thogs med 'jug pas skyo na med zhe na/ 'o na sgo dang them skas dang skar khung la sogs pa mtha' dag mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten dang

sgo bstun nas dgos na 'dir yang mtshungs so/ /des na rwa dang lte ba phyag mtshan rdo rje bzhin du mi byed pa'i dmigs bsal bzhin du/ 'dir yang lte ba cha chen gcig gi 'thug rngams las/ lhag pa byed don med cing / de'i cha phran gnyis steng du lhag tu bcug nas/ rwa'i 'bur cha phran gnyis pa la rtse mo lnga pa byed na'ang / gcig 'phags na gcig cung zad mngon pa tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa la bslangs pa la dang / bslong tshul la dang / srab 'thug la mi 'thad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po rne / sngon dang phyis kyi bla ma kha cig sangs rgyas gsang bas byas par grags pa'i gzhung las/ sgo yi phyi zur gyi grwa bzhir/ ka ba bzhi bslong bar gsungs pa'i lung / sgo yi phyi zur bzhi po la/ /ka ba bzhi bzhis gdung sna ni/ /brgyad brgyad bteg pa rta babs ming / /ka gdan ka gzhu ci rigs pa'o/ /zhes dang / dbus phyur bu dang bcas pa'i lcog gam/ lnga pa ltar mdzes par gyur pas so/ /zhes rigs pa ltar snang la rten nas/ sgo 'khyams kyi steng du bslong bar mdzad pa ni mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas gsang bas byas par grags pa'i lung de/ mkhas pa dag gis bod mar bzhed pas/ brdzun lung yin pa dang / lcog gi mdzes cha las/ sgo mdun rgyan med du lus pas mdzes pa che ba'i phyir dang / ko sa lar sgo la 'jug pa'i gnas su byas nas/ de'i phyi rol tu rta babs bya bar bshad pa lta bu/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa mang pos/ sgo ba'i'i so so'i mdun du ka ba ba'i bzhis btes pa'i rta babs gsal bar ba'id pa'i phyir dang glang rgyab dang bcas/ pa/'i gan+dho lar

༄༄༄/ /grags pa yang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi sgo rgyan la yod par grags pa'i phyir dang / steng du bslong ba la bri bya'i ka ba cha phran lnga pa las lha ga pa mi byed na/ gzhal yas khang gi thog dpangs dmas par 'gyur zhing thog dpangs stod na ka ba bri bya las lhag pa'i blo bzo dgos par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /kha cig cha phran lnga pa'i thog dpangs nyid 'dod pa ni/ thog dngos kyi 'thug rngams la'ang cha phran gcig dgos pa na/ thog dpangs cha phran bzhi par 'gyur la/ de lta na lha snam cha phran bzhi las chung thabs med pas/ thog la gtugs par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod do/ /kha gcig dus 'khor dbang len na 'grel pa med pa'i rtsa ba/ rta babs rnams ni gsum gyis bsgyur bas bcu yi re'u mig dag tu rab tu 'gyur / zhes pas rta babs dang dngos gzhi sgo yi gsum 'gyur du nges shing / dus 'khor ba sgo tshad re la cha phran drug pa byed pas bco brgyad dang lhag ma ka ba'i dpangs yin pas/ ka ba dus 'khor ltar na cha phran bcu gnyis pa dang / gsang sngags gzhan la brgyad par bya rgyu yin pas/ thog gi phyi'i dpangs la cha phran bdun pa bya zhing rta babs kyi 'og dang thog si steng gnyis cha phran gcig gis ma reg pa cig grub pa yin no/ /zhes zer zhing lag len la yang byas yod par snang na yang / rgyud tshig de las 'grel pa yang med cing / 'os med kyi 'gru gnon na'ang bri bya'i skabs yin pas/ rtsa thig nas bum rtse'i bar gyi bri bya'i tshad la cha phran sum cu yod par bzhed pa yin gyis/ 'dis ka ba'i dpangs la cung zad kyang mi phan

no / /gal te phan na 'dod snam dang rtsig pa bcad nas/ ka ba bzo dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rta babs sgo mdun du slong ba gzhir byas pa'ang / rdo rje phreng bar thig skud ring thung gnyis gsungs pas/ thung ba la rta babs sgo tshad gcig ma dpangs la byed pa de bri cha la bshad pa bzhin du sgom don slang bya'ang byed gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ gzhal yas khang dngos kyi mda' yab dang rta babs kyi mda' yab ngos mnyam byed na rgya phyed dpangs mi chung la mi mnyam par byed na sgo mdun du slong 'phro la lus pa lta bu 'byung bas/ sgo'i rgyan du mi 'gyur zhing / ka ba ring du gtong na'ang / blo bzor 'gyur ro/ /des na sgom don gyi rta babs la sgo tshad gsum mas khyab pa cig gsungs pa rnams bri cha kho na'i dbang du bya'o/ /kha cig lhung gzed che tshad chu tshad sogs kyi rig pas 'bring po sgo tshad gnyis ma yang 'dod pa ni/ gzhan de gnyis rgyud du thig skud ring thung gnyis gsungs pa yin na/ khyed kyi thig skud de ga nas gsungs pa tshol spyon cig gsum pa ni/ ma/khas mchog kha cig gser dang shar bu sogs dpangs la cha phran re re las med pa ltar/ 'thug rngams kyang de dang 'dra ba thig shing brtsegs su bzhed pa grags pa dang / da lta kha cig dus 'bor thugs dkyil gyi rta babs zheng dang 'thug rngams la khad kyi gru bzhi byas 'dug pa gnyis ka yang mi 'thad de/ snge ma ni gtod mi nyan pa dang / ka ba bzhis 'dregs mi gshes la/ phyi ma ni gsung dkyil dpangs chung gi nang du shong thabs med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ka ba cha phran re re ba gnyis gnyis kyi phyogs re nas

ra༅༅/ /'degs dgos shing / ka ba gnyis kyi bar du cha phran gcig mi zhog pa'i thabs med la/ mtha' gnyis su'ang gser sogs gdung rnams cha phran phyed phyed ma lhag na mi mdzes pas cha phran bzhi par grub bo/ /de yang phyi 'gro'i dbang du byas sgo dus 'bor ltar na drug ste mdor na sgo tshad gcig go /gsum pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ kha cig cha phran lnga pa dang bdun pa 'dod pa ni ha cang khang leb ltar shin tu mi mdzes pa mngon sum gyis grub la/ phyis kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po kha cig dpangs la lnga gsum dang / rgya la nga gnyis/ kha cig de las ldog par bzhed pa dag la ni/ mdo nas bshad pa'i mchod rten gyi dpangs tshad la sogs pa'i lung gi g.yar po re tsam ma gtogs rgyu mtshan yang dag ye mi snang la/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams dang / lo chen rin bzang rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang / bu ston chos kyi dzol po dang / rje btsun btsong kha pa la sogs pa rnams rgya phyed dpangs su bzhed pa ni shin tu legs mod kyis/ de dag gis kyang sgrab byed kyi rgyu mtshan yang dag ni ma rnyed par snang zhing / bu ston rin po ches/ ka ba rtsig 'gram du btsugs nas dbus su rtse mo sleb par rtse mo'i dkyil chog gi sgrub mod kyis/ khyab pa 'grub par byas kyang rtags de shin tu sgrub dka' bar snang rdza / /de thams cad kyang rta babs sgo mdun du slong ba sha stag yin la/ kho 31 yang de dag gi rjes su 'brang bas/ der steng rta babs kyi dpangs bri bya la ji ltar yod pa ltar/ bslang bas rgya phyed dpangs su 'bad med du 'grub ste/ rta babs ka ba dang bcas

pa'i dpangs la spyi 'gro'i cha phran bcu bdun yod la/ gzhal yas khang gi rtsig thig shar mtha' nas nub mtha'i bar la so bzhi yod pas/ phyi'i rgya phyed dpangs su grub cing / rtsa thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la so gnyis yod pa'i phyir dang / bcu drug nang gi dpangs la byas pa'i/ thog gi 'thug rngams la cha phran gcig pa 'grub bo/ /'o na mda' yab lhag go zhe na/ bya 'dab cung zad chu babs su byas pa'i sna mo la shar bu dang / de'i steng du mda' yab byed pas lhag pa yin no/ /de ltar na khyams rgya phyed dpangs su byas pa la bri bya la mi gsal ba'i ka ba brgyad kyi g.yabs sgor gyi tshul du phub cing / de'i nang du gsang 'dus gnyis lta bu gzhal yas khang gi phyed tshad du rdor phreng yod pa rnams ni de la bsten cing / kyai rdor gshed dmar lta bu pad+ma 'dab brgyad la sogs pa ma gtogs/ ka ba bri bya la med pa rnams la'ang phyed tshad kyi pad+ma'i shun bar sogs su ka ba brgyad dang des bteg pa'i gdung zlum dang / de la bsten pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas thog bar pa dbub cing / de yang khyams dang cha chen gcig gi dpangs khyad yod pa chu 'bab dang bcas pa bya/ de'i mthong ka ba gru bzhir bzhag pa'i grwa bzhir ka chung btsugs nas rgya phibs steng ma phub ste/ bar der steng gi khro bo'i bzhugs pa dgos na yang byas pas rgya phibs gsum thog khang brtsegs kyi rnam pa shin tu mdzes pa 'byung ba mngon sum du 'grub ste/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung rnams su bri bya'i dbang du byas pa 'ba' zhig gsungs pas/ thog 'bub rnams mi gsal yang / rig pa'i rgyal po

ra༅༅/ /ma/tha' gzhan ma bkag pa zhes bya ba 'os med kyi rig pas 'bad med du grub kyis/ tshegs che yang don chung ba'i thog 'bubs kyi bshad pa kho bos mi shes so/ /'on kyang bde mchog la ni khyam sa kyi ka ba mi dgos kyi / sku 'khor gyi ka ba la gdung bskor btang ba'i steng du khyams kyi lcam rnams ngos kyi thung ba dang zur gyi ring ba byas nas btang ste g.yabs sgor ltar bya zhing / de'i steng du ka thung btsugs pa la yang gdung skor dang / bsrung 'khor ka ba'i steng gi gdung skor gyi bar la lcam thad dkar btang zhing snga ma bzhin du rigs bsgres nas dbub par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bri bya la mun snam yod de/ gang yin kyang rta babs rnams cha phran gcig gi gzhal yas khang la ma reg par bya ba dang / glang rgyab kyi snam bu lnga pa'i steng gi ni/ zhes sogs snam bu la 'chad na/ sbab le ltar bya bar 'grub la/ thig la bshad na'ang rung bas snam bu phyed gshags sogs mi 'thad do/ /phyis kyi mkhas rloms dag kha cig 'dod snam kha khyer du bshad pas zer nas pu shu'i steng du 'gel ba dang / kha cig mtha' rin po che pha gus brtsig pa zhes sogs la bsten nas pha gu thang la phab ste 'dod snam gyi phyi ru 'jog pa sogs mang du snang mod kyis/ 'dod pa rang dga' ba'i 'jug tshul la mtha' med pas / log pa'i lam la mtha' med phyir/ /de dag 'dir ni spro bya min/ /zhes rnam nges las gsungs pa ltar/ dgag gis mi lang bas/ mkhas pa dag gi bzhed pa dgag sgrub cung zad byas so/ lnge /gnyis pa la tshad ldan dgos pa'i rgyu

mtshan dang / des na rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mi ldan pa'i nyes dmigs dang / ldan pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ mgrin pa dkos ko khyin pa ste/ /gsum po ring ba skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par ni/ /gnas las nyams shing bskad par byed/ /snyan dang shangs dang phyag sor ste/ /gsum po thung na skyon chen po/ /dngos grub nges par 'joms pa dang / /de bzhin dpal yang nyams par 'gyur/ /byin pa zhal dang 'khur tshos te/ /gsum po sbom na skyon chen po/ /sngags pa bdag nyid nges par yang / /dpal las ring zhing bdud bgegs 'byung / /'gram pa gnyis dang rtsib logs te/ /gsum po gzhom na skyon chen po/ /don rnams nyams par 'gyur ba dang / /'dir ni bgegs 'byung the tshom med/ /nu ma shangs dang dpral ba ste/ /gsum po yo na skyon chen po/ /sgrub pa po de myur ba ni/ /dgra yi rtsod pas brdung bar 'gyur/ /brla dang kyu dang nam tshom ste/ /gsum po nyams na skyon chen po/ /chom rkun sogs kyis 'joms pa 'am/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /mig g.yon sna dang rna ba dang / /mchu dang dgral ba dag nyams na/ /nges par sngags pa rnams la ni/ /sna tsho+ogs bgegs dang 'chi ba 'ongs/ /gyen du gzigs shing dbugs bskyod tshul/ /gdanalas yo zhing bskyod 'dra na/ /rang gi gnas nas nges 'apo zhing / /don rnams 'joms par nyid du 'gyur/ /mgrin pa nam rdzong la sogs sku'i/ /skyon ni grangs med bzhin du gnas/ /'dir ni spyan sogs yo ba

ra༅༅/ /'am/ /phyag rgya mtshan nor gyur pa na/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal gyis rab gdung / /de phyir skyon rtags bcos par bya/ /rgyab yol dang ni gdugs dang gdan/ /gsum po chung zhing dog pa'i skyon/ /mdza' bos mi snyan brjod pa dang / /dpal nyams 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /'di dag nyes pa chen po ste/ /legs par rnam dpyad rtag par bya/ lto /gnyis pa ni/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs / /gzugs mdzes cho ga mthong ba ste/ /dul ba bzo rnams thams cad la/ /legs par mnyam par bzhag pas bris/ /zhi ba la ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ /drag cing 'jigs rung drag po ste/ /dpa' zhing nga rgyal sku dpa' bo/ /bzhad pa'i zhal ni sgeg pa ste/ /'di ltar mtshan nyid ma byas la/ /sngags pa rnams kyis thang sku bri/ /las dang po yi sngags pa yis/ /gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ /thang sku sgrub cha rgya chen gyis/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /zhes sdom 'byung le'u sum cu par gsungs shing / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du'ang bris sku'i phan yon rgyas par gsungs so/ lto /brdzis pa ni/ sdom 'byung 'grel pa la brten pa zhig gzhan du bshad zin mod sgo 7 'dir yang dus 'khor sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel dang / kṛ ya sa muts+tsha dang / bod snga ma dag gis/ shā ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo la brten pa'i cha tshad mang du bshad pa rnams bsgrigs te rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /de yang zhal phyag spyan la sangs rgyas kyi sku so so dang / 'gro ba gzhan gyi lus so so'i dbang gis lus kyi sor grangs dang mchu zheng la sogs pa

shes dgos te/ dus 'khor 'grel chen du/ rgyal ba'i sku la rang sor brgya nyer lnga mchu zheng mnyam pa dang / mi phal pa la zheng du rang sor go drug mchur gya bzhi las med pas mchu zheng mi dgab pa dang / de gnyis kyi bar byang sems gzhan la yod par gsungs pa cung zad zhib tu sbyar na/ mi phal pa la las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig 'gags/ sa dang po thob na brgya dang brgyad/ de nas sa dgu po re re la sor gnyis gnyis 'phel te brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa sor gasdig 'phel bas brgya nyer lngar gsal bas mi mkhas pa dag rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las 'gyur ba med/ /zhi ma khro la zhal tshad brgyad/ 8na tu khros pa zhal tshad drug /ces pa ni kha bton du byed cing / zhal re sor bcu gnyis mar byed par bzhag nas/ zhal dgu la brgya dang brgyad yod pa 'di ring mthar byas te/ dus 'khor nas sor mo brgya nyer lnga dang / sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs su zhal bcu gnyis pa yang gsungs pa rnams rang dgar 'jug pa dgag pa'i drang don du 'dod pa dag gis ni tshul 'di lta bu khong du ma chud pas nongs so/ /yang kha cig phugs kyi zhal grangs la khyad med kyang / zhi khro rnams kyi sor mo 95 sbom 'phra khyad yod pas/ zhal gang la sor mo phyed dang bcu drug ma dang / bcu gnyis ma dang / phyed dang bcu gcig ma dang / shin tu khros pa sor mo shin tu sbom pas zhal re re la rang sor dgu mar byed pa yin no/ /zhes kyang zer mod kyis/ de ni mi 'thad de/ shin tu khros pa de sor mo sbom pa tsam

༄༄༄/ /du zhal gyi 'khor yang shin tu che ba'i phyir dang / zhi ba la zhal dgu dang / zhi ma khro la brgyad/ shin tu khros pa la drug la sogs par rang gi khas blangs pa dang yang 'gal zhing / dus 'khor dang sdom 'byung du longs sku zhal tshad bcu pa/ zhal re la rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum ma dang / bde mchog sogs la sor bcu gnyis ma'i zhal bcu dang / phag mo dang bdag med ma sogs/ dang / tshangs pa dang dbang po nyi dbang drag po chu lha rlung lha sogs la zhal dgu pa dang / gzhin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo dang / thag bzang ris dang lus ngan dang bden bral dang gzhin rje dang me lha dang drag gza' rnams la zhal brgyad pa dang / ro langs ni zhal bcu gnyis pa dang / kṛ ya sa muts+tshar mi'u thung dang tshogs bdag la sogs zhal lnga par bshad la/ 'byung po 'dul byed zhal gsum pa/ zhes nag po chen po lta bu rang zhal gsum par bshad pa'ang yod par grags pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal grangs ni dbu che chung dang yan lag ring thung sogs kyis bzhag la/ sor grangs ni zhal so so'i bcu gnyis cha'am/ phyed dang bcu gsum cha la bzhag nas brtsi bar bya ba yin no/ /de ltar na/ dang por sor mo brgya nyer lnga pa brngod par bya ste/ gtsug tor sor mo bzhi/ de nas ska mtshams phyed dang lnga/ de nas mdzod spu sor bzhi ste de ltar zhal gang ngo / khangs rtse kos ko mgrin phreng 'og ma'i bar yang de ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas snying lte gsang ba'i bar la zhal re re ste/ de ltar na gtsug tor nas gsang gnas kyi bar

la zhal lnga'o/ /brla dang rje ngar gyi long la zhal do do/ dbye dang pus mo gnyis la sor ba'i bzhi/ long bu man la phyed dang lnga ste/ de ltar gsang gnas nas rting pa'i bar la zhal lnga ste bcu po thams cad sor mo phyed dang bcu gsum par mnyam pas brgya nyer lnga/ zhabs mthil gyi dkrus la sor mo bcu bzhi ste/ de ni sku'i srid la brtsi don med do/ /kha cig de dang thor cog sbrags pas zhal do ste zhal bcu gnyis bshad zer mod kyis kho bo ni sdom 'byung 'grel par ro langs zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma gtogs/ longs sku zhal bcu gnyis par bshad pa ma ma/thong ngo / /de bzhin du zheng du brang gi tshangs thig nas phrag pa'i bar la zhal gang / bar lhu sor nyi shu/ la/ga ngar bcu drug phyag mgo bcu gnyis/ gru mo dang 'khrig mar sor re re/ 'grel chen dang sdom 'byung 'grel par gsungs mod kyis/ sdom grangs drug cu re phyed dang gsum du gsungs shing / mchu zheng gab par gsungs pa dang cung mi 'grig pas na/ gru mo 'khrig ma phyag mgo rnams dus 'khor rgyud kyi rtsa bar ma thon pa 'grel pas kha bka/ nga pa la rags rtsis shor bar snang bas/ dang po gnyis la gsum cha re dkri zhing phyi ma la sor phyed mnan par bya'o/ /'di ni sor mo brgya dang brgyad pa la ring shos byed pas bzo bo sogs kyis bltas na lhu lag shin tu ring par snang mod kyis rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pa 'di gtso bor bya'i/ mi phal gyi mig sngar mdzes pa gtso bor ma byed cig der ma zad cung zad khros pa'i bde mchog kyai rdor dang / dag pa'i byang sems kyi sku la ni/ zhal tshad bcu po 'di'i steng

ra༅༅/ /nas sor phyed phyed kyi cha phri ste/ sor mo brgya nyi shu pa byas na'ang de ltar snang mod kyi snga ma bzhin no/ /zhal tshad dgu pa rnams la ni gtsug tor sor drug nor bu sor gnyis byed kyang dgu la mi 'the bar byas/ sngar gyi sor phyed dang lnga pa thams cad bzhi pa dang zhal thams cad sor bcu gnyis par byas nas/ gzhan 'dra ba la dbye dang pus mo'i sor bzhi po dang gtsug tor gyi sor bzhi po bor ba yin no/ /zhal tshad brgyad pa ni/ gzhan mjal lugs dgu pa ji bzhin la / zhal gyi dbyebs dkyil 'khor gru bzhir mngon pa snga ma las che ba cig byas la/ zhal tshad gzhan thams cad zhal de'i rang sor phyed dang bcu baṇig pa la zhal du ming btags shing / sor mo bzhi pa rnams phyed dang bzhi par byas pas/ zhal de'i tshad brgyad yong ba yin zhing / drug pa dang lnga pa dang gsum pa sogs kyang des 'gres nas shes par bya'o/ /dper na zhal lnga pa la bcu pa dang bzhi khyon mnyam pa la zhal nyis 'gyur gyis che bar byas/ zhal tshad gzhan thams cad de'i phyed phyed la ming du btags pa bzhin no/ /de bzhin du zhal gyi rnam pa yang / khyim bya'i sgo nga til rnam pa/ /gru bzhi dang ni zlum por bcas/ /thun mong sku rnams thams cad rdzi /zhal gyi dbyibs ni rnam pa bzhi/ /skyes bu che dang lha mo yi/ /khyim bya'i sgo nga til gyi dbyibs/ /mdzes shing lta na sdug pa yi/ /zhal gyi rnam pa gnyis nyid bya/ /yi dwags sha za 'byung po dang / /khro bo rnams kyi rnam 'gyur dbyibs/ /zlum po dag dang gru bzhi ste/ /zhal chi gnyis dag bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs

pas / zhi zhal sangs rgyas byang sems kyi khyim bya'i sgo nga dang / lha mo rnams kyi til/ khro zhal la/ khro bo spyi'i zlum po ha cang khros pa'i gru bzhi rnams/ zhal gyi gzhi gru bzhir byas pa'i grwa bzhi ka nas cha phran phyed dang gnyis bcad pa dang / stod de dang 'dra ba la/ smad zur gnyis nas cha phran phyed gsum bcad pa dang / gnyis ka nas gnyis gnyis bcad pa dang / gnyis ka nas re re bcad pa 'byung bar bshad kyang / dang po gnyis la logs nas kyang re re bcad dgos la/ zhal bzhi po de 'khor lo bde ma/chog gi g.yas dang rgyab dang mdun dang g.yon zhal gyi dbyibs su bshad cing / rim pa ltar sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang / phag mo gzugs can dum skyes ma rnams dang / khro bo rnams dang / mā ma ki dang dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi zhal yang de dag dang 'dra bar bya bar gsungs la/ spyan ni rtsa zhal zlum po zheng du nas bcu dang / dkrus la nas bcu bzhi/ rgyab zhal la zheng nas drug dang dkyus nas bco brgyad ste nya lta bu/ gzhan gnyis la zheng sor gcig dang / dkyus sor gnyis te pad+ma lta bu bya bar bshad/ nas ni sor gyi brgyad cha la bya bar gsungs so/ /spyan rnams ni phal cher khro zhal gyi spyan du snang la/ zhi ba'i spyan ni/ sangs rgyas rnam sa la bsam gtan gyi gzigs stangs/ zheng nas gnyis dang / dkrus nas nyer gnyis pa gzhu'i rnam pa/ byang sems rnams la nas bzhi dang nyi shu ste 56tal lnga bu/ lha mo rnams la bde mchog gi nub zhal lta bu/ 7 de ltar zhil phyag rngams ldan lha/ 'an tu 'i dang 'i ma khro/ /khro dang r+shan tu

ra༅༅/ /khros pa bzhi/ /dang po'i cha tshad gtsor byas nas/ /gzhan rnams khyad par cung zad brjod/ /phal cher zhugs la rtogs par 'gyur/ /dang po la yang longs sprul gnyis/ /longs sku bzhugs dang bzhengs pa gnyis / /gnyis rka'i thun mong mchu zheng ni/ /sangs rgyas sor mo brgya nyer lnga/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gnyis pa/ zhal bcur mchu zheng mtshungs phyir ro/ /dag pa'i byang sems longs sku dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku bde gshegs sogs / /sor phyed bcu po sri ba yi/ /brgya dang nyi shu mchu zheng mnyam/ /sar gnas byang sems longs sku dang / /phag mo spyan so gas gshegs ma dang / /sangs rgyas sprul sku shāka thub sogs/ /zhal dgu sor mo brgya dang brgyad/ /dgu brgyad gnyis ka zhi ma khro/ /khro bo phal cher zhal tshad brgyad/ /sor mo dgu bcu drug par 'dod/ khen tu khros la zhal lnga dang / /sor mo drug bcu re gnyis sogs/ /zhal tshad gsum pa'ang bshad ces grags/ /rgyal ba'i sprul sku yin na'ang / /khro bo rnams la mtshan dpe yi/ /phyag ring mdzes sogs mi dgos rdzi /mi sdug bco brgyad la sogs pa/ /gang la gang 'dul nges med yin/ /rgyal ba'i zhal tshad bcu po ni/ /gtsug tor skra mtshams mdzo+od spu rnams/ /sor bzhi phyed dang lnga dang bzhi/ khangs rtse mgrin pa dkos ko yang / /de bzhin snying lte gsang gnas rnams/ /zhal re phyed bcas bcu gasmo pa'o/ /brla dang rje ngar zhal do 'o/ /dbye dang pus mo long bu man/ /bzhi bzhi phye da bcas bzhi pa ste/ /zhabs

mthil bcu bzhi 'dir mi bgrang / /de bzhin 'dom la zhal bcu ste/ /dbus nas phrag par zhal gang dang / /bar lhu phyag ngar phyag mgo rnams/ /nyi shu bcu drug zhal gang ste/ /gru mo 'khrig ma gsum gnyis re'o/ /gtsug tor dbus su tshud pa yi / /thor cog srid la bcu gnyis dang / /dpa' bo sems dpa' brgyad dam dgu/ /thor cog srid la mi rtsi 'o/ /zhal la sogs pa'i zheng tshad ni/ /zhal stod dgu dang zhal skyed bcu/ /zhal smad bdun sogs ci rigs bya/ /snyan zheng gnyis te srid du bzhi/ /snyan zhal bzhi sogs ci mdzes yin/ /spyan dkyus gsum lhag zheng du ni/ /nas gnyis bzhi sogs mdzes par bya/ /smin dkrus bzhi po gzhu lta bu/ /snyan gyi rtse dang thad rma nyam ste/ /snyan dbug spyan las cung zad dma'/ /smin phrag phyed dang gnyis su bya/ /mdzod bu sor gcig zlum zhing mdzes/ /spyan dkyus sor gcig bshad pa ni/ /bde mchog khro zhal dbang byas pas/ /smin ma'i phrag dang mnyam pa mdzes/ /spyan ni nag cha sor gcig ste/ /'bras bu sor gyi lnga cha 'o / khangs rtse'i zheng ni sor gnyis te/ /mchu dang kos ko'ang de dang mtshungs/ /mchu sgros ma mchu sor gcig dang / /ya mchu sor phyed cher mi rung / khangs rtse dang ni ya mchu'i bar/ /sor gcig bshad pa'ang bde mchog sogs/ /cung zad zhal gdangs la dgongs pas/ khyen tu zhi la phyed gnyis lhag /kos bo'i dpangs la gnyis bshad la'ang / /de dang 'dra bas cung zad bskyed/ /zhal dkyus sor mo bzhi pa ste/ /grwa gnyis gyen du cung zad stod/ /smin ma'i sbom sar nas

ra༅༅/ /gnyis te/ /snyan gyi sgril kha sor phyed bskor/ /rdo gzhong lta bur sor gcig dang / /bu ga sor gcig zlum zhing 'dril/ /mgul zheng sor mo brgyad pa ste/ /snyan 'og mgul gnyer sor mo do/ /de yi phrag pa gong zhal re/ /sku stod sbom sar sum cu 'o/ /dpu ri lhu'i sbom sar sor drug ste/ /gru mor phyed lnga 'khrig mar ni/ /gsum zer phras pas phye dang bzhi/ /phyag mthil gru bzhi drug zer yang / /srid bdun zheng la lnga par bshad/ /gung mo sor lnga mdzub mo ni/ /de yi sen mo'i rtsa bar sleb/ /ming med de las sor phyed ring / /de gsum skye pa mnyam po ste/ /mthe'u chung de las sor phyed dma'/ khre mos ming med gsum gnyis sleb/ /mthe bong skye sa sor gsum dma'/ /mdzub mo'i gsum cha cung mi sleb/ /mthe bong tshigs gnyis mngon pa ste/ /gzhan bzhi sum char mngon pa ste/ /sen mo'i tshigs kyi phyed nas bcal/ /mdzub rtser cung zad ma sleb pa'o/ /byang stod sor mo bco brgyad ste/ /byang smad bcu gnyis sta zur smad / /bco brgyad byin gyis 'phel ba 'o/ /brla yi zheng tshad sor bcu ste/ /nywa la sor drug byin zhug bzhi/ /zhabs mthil che sar sor drug dang / /chung sar phyed dang bzhi yin te/ /gab pa'i tshul gyis cung zad skyang / /mthe bong sor gsum sboms su gnyis/ /gzhan kun mchu zheng rim gyis skyang / /bzhugs pa rdo rje'i skyil krung la/ /pus mo'i rtsenas rtse yi bar/ /zhal tshad bzhi ru nges pas na/ /zla gdan steng nas mdzod bu dang / /mchu zheng mnyam po yin pa la/ /bod 'ga' skyil

krung dpangs dmas par/ /mthong nas skyed par sor bzhi mnan/ /de nas shangs rtse dang mnyam zer/ /pus mo'i dpangs la sor mo bzhi/ /rting pa sor gsum steng du ste/ /rting pa gnyis par sor bzhi lhag /bzhengs pa g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum dang / /ldog dang sa ga zlum po dang / /rol pa la sogs gang gsungs rnams/ /dang po bzhi po sor mo rnams/ /logs su bstan par khyad par med/ /dang po gnyis po mtho lnga'i 'gyangs/ /bshad kyang zhabs gnyis tshad ldan du / /btang nas brkyang bskum tshul bzhin du/ /byas pa nyid kyis kun la 'grub/ /sa ga ting pa'i bar sor bzhi/ /brla dang byin pa drang por bsrongs/ /zlum po de dang 'dra ba la/ /pus mo phyi la gdengs pa 'o/ /rol pa g.yon gyi sor mo rnams / /mdun du drang bstan de'i long bur/ /g.yas pa'i rting pa bkal nas ni/ /sor mo logs su bstan pa nyid/ /g.yas rol zhes bya g.yon rol ldog /mnyam pa sa ga lta bu la/ /bar med mnyam par gcer ba 'o/ /gzhan yang bzhugs stabs mang bshad pa/ /dkyil chog sa chog skabs rnams dang / /rang rang mngon rtogs rnams su blta/ /de rnams zhal tshad bcu pa'i tshad/ /dgu pa la ni zhal ras nyid/ /cung zad bskyed de brgyad po rnams/ /rang sor phyed dang bcu gcig la / /zhal re'i ming ste mdor nas ni/ /mchu la bcu cha phri ba la/ /zheng la bcu cha kun tu bskyed/ /de bzhin zhal tshad lnga pa la/ /mchu kun phyed la zhal ming ste/ /zheng kun 'dab kyis bskyed pas 'grub/ /'on kyang sbom sar sbom zhing

༄༄༄/ /grims/ /phra sar nyag cing 'phrang la 'dril/ /zhib rgyas sdom 'byung 'grel pa sogs/ /gzhan du blta zhing mkhas la bslab/ /gzho bo rgya bod mkhas pa yi/ /phyag rjes nan tan gyis btsal nas/ /bltas shing bcad la lag len gdab/ /slob dpon blun po'i ngag rgyun dang / /rang gi sdug goms ngan goms kyis/ /dad ldan yo byad chud mi zan/ /thub pa chu lon mar grags sogs/ /cha tshad rnams dang mi mthun yang / /mkhas pas byas shing grags che ba / khun gyi mthun snang grub pa yi/ /kun la mdzes par snang ba 'ga'/ shes na'ang mkhas pa'i phyag rjes ltos/ /phyag ni gnyis ga'am gang rung gcig /mnyam bzhag yod na 'gying med bya/ /phyag mang yin na 'gal ba med/ /phyag g.yas gdengs la g.yon pa 'gying / /ga yon gdengs ldog bya zhabs stabs kyang / /gang brkyang phyogs su dbu 'gying yang / /ldog na 'grel ba'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhal 'brung gang du byas phyogs ni/ /ldog par byang stod 'bur ba dang / /rang sar sta zur 'bur ba gces/ /sum khug drang na mdzes par 'gyur/ /drang srong cha byad skem pa dang / /gzhon nu'i cha lugs gzhon sha rgyas/ /pho rnams stod rgyas smad zhum dang / /mo rnams de las ldos par bya/ /khro bo gar gyi nyams dgu ldan/ /rgyan dang mdangs kyis sgeg pa'i nyams/ /'gyong dang rol pas dpa' ba ste/ /spyan ldog khro gnyer mi sdug pa/ /'dzum zhing dgod 'dra bzhad pa'i nyams/ khā+e phaṭa sgrog 'dra drag shul che/ /mtshon cha char gdengs 'jigs su rung / /spyan dmar

gzhog yo / /zhal gdangs rkan sdebs dang 'dra rngams/ /gnyen lcug sha 'jam zhi ba'i khos/ /dbu skra zhal gang shri mdzas shing / /zhog tshom smin ma'ang r+sā brjes 'khyog /mdor na yid la legs shar ba/ /lag tu btab pas nyams kun 'byung / /yid 'phrog bstan pa'i phyi mor 'gyur/ 7/ /da khri rgyab bshad par bya ba la/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dum bu las/ khri la khri stan dang / khri gdong dang / khri rkang dang / khri ming gnyis dang / ba gam dang / lan kun nam / pu shu ste bdun po byang phyogs sde tshan bdun dang / dag pa sbyar ba tsam dang / rgyab yol la brgyan na drug phar phyan drug dang sbyar te/ bya khyung gi ka ru na ste snying rje dang / chu srin pu ra na ste grong khyer dang / mi chung bh+ya ra na ste tshogs dang / glang chen gu ra na ste bla ma dang / ri dwags sha ra ba ste dbang phyug dang / klu phrug ta ra na ste sgrol mdzad rnams rim pa bzhin du shes rab nas sbyin pa'i bar phar phyin drug lugs ldog dang dag pa sbyar nas gsungs shing / khri la seṅge glang chen rta rma bya shang shang gi 'degs byed dang /nor bu nyi zla dang pad+ma'i gdan rnams ni/ rim pa bzhin/ mi 'jigs pa dang / stobs dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / dbang bcu dang / smon gnas shes pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs dang / don dam e dang /kun rdzob waṃ dang / sgrib pa gsum gyis ma gos pa rnam dag pa dang / tshad med bzhi dang / bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs pa rnams mtshon par byed pa seng rgyan dang dar gyi glo stan la sogs pa gsungs so/ /bod snga ma dag

༄༄〉༅/ /gi khri la brtsegs nyi shu rtsa gzhig la sogs pa'i spros pa dang / rgyab yol rgyas pa phub la gzhol btags pa lta bu dang / 'bring po pad 'dab lta bu dang / bsdus pa lcags rtse ma dang sgong gzugs ma la sogs pa'i lag len mang du snang ya nga 'bring po tsam gyi tshad dang / bzo lugs shes na gzhan rnams shugs la 'byung bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ gdan khri'i 'phang du zhal drug bya/ /sa 'dzin zhal gang de steng du/ /rdo rje'i rgyan phreng sor bzhi'i dpangs/ /nor bu gsum brtsegs sor gnyis te/ /lha snam sor brgyad nor bu gsum/ /phyed dang gnyis re de steng du/ /pad 'dab sor mo drug gi dpangs/ /nor bu nyis brtsegs sor re dang / /gsum cha re re bre sor bzhi/ /de steng nor bu snga ma tsam/ /glang rgyab sor mo phyed dang bzhi/ /nor bu sor gang bzhi cha'i tshad/ /seng khri sor mo bcu pa ste/ /nor bu snga ma tsam stong du/ /bad chung sor do bzhi cha'i tshad/ /bad chen sor bzhi bzhi gsum ste/ /tsaṇ+ḍa sor do bzhi chas dman/ /steng khebs sor bzhi bzhi cha 'o/ /srid du sa 'dzin zhal bcu gsum/ /lha rnams so sor zhal bcu gzhig /seng khri zhal brgyad sor bzhi'i brgya/ /bad chen zhal tshad bcu yin phyir/ /gzhan rnams skyong 'bur shugs las shes/ /'on kyang zhib tu sbyor 'dod na/ /tsaṇ+ḍa bad las sor bzhis gtung / /de bas steng khebs sor do bcag /bad chung bad las sor drug gcing / /de bas nor bu sor dos dman/ /de bas seng khri sor dos bcag /de 'og nor bu sor gsum bsring / /de 'og nor bu steng dang

mnyam / /de bas bre ni sor gang thung / /nor bu gnyis ni 'phang tsam bsring / /pad 'dab rtsa ba sor gang bsring / /'dab ma'i rtse mo sor lnga bsring / /nor bu gnyis dang lha snam dag /sor mo do do phyi la bskyed/ /nor bu gsum po snga ma bzhin / /rdor phreng sor mo sa 'dzin ni/ /sor mo gsum chas bsring bar bya/ /rgyab yol sku tshad nyis 'gyur dang / /zhal gang tshad kyi tshangs this gdab/ /'og nas steng du zhal lnga dang / /sor gang tshad kyis rtags byas la/ /de nas steng du'ang de tsam bskyed/ /steng 'og btags nas g.yas g.yon du/ /bya rog rjes rtsal thig gcig btab/ /de la dpung khri'i steng 'byung mod/ /'on kyang mtha' gnyis sor lnga lnga/ /stod nas thig gdab ci mdzes bya/ /tshangs thig dpung thig 'joms sa nas/ /steng rgi phyogs su zhal do bsnur/ /nor bu ma gtogs sku de yi/ /lta stangs gtsug tor bar tshad rdzi /srad bus dpung khri'i stong nas bskor/ khye mo cung mnan g.yas g.yon du/ /cung zad steng stod ci mdzes bya/ /rgyab yol dpung par sor brgyad tsam/ /bsnan la stod rgyas dbyibs legs bya/ /skor thig sna yi ci ran bya/ /'og tu tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /zhal gcig sor lnga'i tshad tsam gyi/ /sa nas gyen mthur thig re gdab/ /de dag rgyab yol phyi rgya'i tshad / /stong rgyas smad phyogs cung zad zhum/ /pad 'dab zlum rgyas dbyibs 'dra bya/ /mtha' bskor me ri pa ṭa dang / /rdo rje phreng dang zlum bskor rnams/ /sor mo phyed dang bzhi dang ni/ /sor do dang ni sor brgyad tsam/ /de dag bar bar mu stag

ra༅༅/ /phreng / /sor mo phyed phyed mdzes pas brgyan/ /de nas bar skor ldem la rtse/ /bkod legs mdzes shing khyad 'phags bya/ /lugs 'di deng sang mdzes par grags/ /'on kyang phyi dus gdan khri rnams/ /bzhengs pa shin tu nyung bar snang / gang na shin tu gal che bas/ /gang 'grub nan tan bskyed par bya/ /gsum pa la/ rdor dril ni/ bla ma snga ma rnams phyi dril nang dril gyi tha snyad mdzad pa la/ phyi rabs pa dag nang gi rdor dril ni nges don ye shes la byed dgos pas/ rtags kyi rdor dril la phyi dril gyi khyab bo zhes snga rabs pa la tshig ngan bcas nas smra'o/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ 'o na nang gi gsang sngags nges don ye shes la byed dgos pas/ brjod byed kyi gsang sngags la phyi gsang sngags dang nang gi gsang sngags med par 'gyur la/ de 'dod na gsang sngags phyi nang gi dkyil 'bor zhes sogs rgyud sde 'og ma la phyi dang / bla med la nang du grags shing grub pa dang / yo ga nas bshad cing grags pa'i de nyid bcu la/ phyi'i de nyid dang / bla med nas byung ba'i de nyid bcu la nang gi de nyid du mkhas pa kun la grags shing / rang gi kyang bden zhen gyi khas blangs dang 'gal lo/ /des na rdor dril gyi tha snyad tsam mdo sde 'ga' zhig nas kyang 'byung zhing / bya spod nas lag len byed mod kyi na cha tshad sogs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ yo ga dang bla med nas ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'byung la/ yo ga'i bshad rgyud rtsemo nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can la phyi dril dang dus 'khor/ sdom 'byung / saspu ṭi la sogs snas bshad pa la nang dril bu

tha snya da nges par byed dgos pa yin pas ma dag pas dag pa sun ma 'byin cig 'di gnyis kyi ngos 'dzin la yang / mi shes pa dag rtsedagu dang rtse lnga la phyi nang du byed pa mi 'thad ste/ gnyis ka nas gnyis ka gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhi drag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /de nas de gnyis kyi khyad chos kyi gtso bo ni/ rtse lnga dang rtse dgu gang yin kyang / rwa rnams chu srin gyi kha nas ma thon zhing pad+ma la gnas pa dang / mtha' rwa'i rtse rnams dbus rwa ngos la ma zug par dbus rwa'i mtha' pad+ma dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshon byed kyis bskor ba la zug cing / rwa rnams ni ba dī ra'i tsher la ltar sna zhing zur dang ldan pa min par/ zlum por gnas pa dang / dril bu'i tshangs mgo'i zhal gyi 'og tu bum pa'i dod du bus pa yod pa dang / rdza mar grags pa'i steng gi pad 'dab kyi shar du/ spyan ma'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan yod pa rnams ni phyi yin la/ de las ldog cing sgrol ma'i sa bon nam/ phyag mtshan yod pa ni nang yin no/ /de ltar phyi nang gnyis las/ 'dir nar gi rdor dril gtso bor bshad par bya ba la/ ma nyid dang / dag pa'o/ /dang po la/ dus 'khor las/ za ra rlung me chu sa 'dod lha lha min mi rnams kyi rdo rje'i tshad rim pa bzhin sor gcig pa dang / gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang / brgyad pa dang / dgu pa/ bcu gnyis pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin spyi bo'i nor bu dang / mthe bo'i rdo rje dang / dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / phrag par 'phyang ba'i rgyan dang / snying khar gdags pa'i rgyan dang / lag tu so ra ba'i rdo rje rnams kyi tshad du gsungs shing / thams

ra༅༅/ /cad kyang lte ba dang phyogs kyi ra rnams gsum cha mnyam du bya la/ khyad par tha ma kha gyes pa khro bo'i dang / zlum po zhi ba'i rdo rje dang / dril bu la tshangs mgo de gnyis dang / kha sangs pad+ma rgyas pa dang ba lang gi kha'i rnam par gnas pa ni/ de gnyis su bshad do/ /rdo rje'i bar gyi gsum cha yang / gsum cha gsum du byas pa'i bar la lte ba dang / gzhan gnyis la pad 'dab rwa rnams kyi dbus rwa'i bzhi cha mtha' rwa zug mtshams las phyir lhag pa gru bzhi pa / mtha' rwa'i 'og gi gsum cha chu srin gyi kha nas thon pa phyi la sgyed pa steng gsum gnyis nang du sgar ba/ ba dī ra'i tsher ma ltar gru bzhi rno ba/ dril bu yang de bzhin du gsum cha mnyam du gnas pa/ de yang dus 'khor dgos kyi dbang du byas na / rdo rje'i lte ba la lha'i zhal bzhi bya ba ni tshad med bzhi dang / dril bu'i tshangs mgo la'ang zhal bzhi bya ba ni rnam thar bzhi rnam par dag pa yin la/ bla med spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas na/ kā li thabs/ ā li shes rab tu grags la/ gsal byed la dbyangs med pa mtshon pas rdo rje la zhal med cing / dbyangs brjod pa dang bcas par mtshon pas dril bu la bcom ldan ma'i zhal gcig go /zhes pa tsam gsungs la/ sgom pa'i rdo rje ni rtsemo gsum pa dang / lnga pa dang / bdun pa dang / sor gcig pa dang / sor gsum pa dang / re lnga pa sogs kyang bshad do/ /sdom 'byung dang saspu ṭi la sogs par ni spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas pa/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ rwa dang pad+ma'i bar du zla gdan nam/ 'od kyi phreng ba zhes pa gcig bshad

la / dbus rwa'i rtsa ba zlum po dang sked pa nas ltar sbom pa/ gru bzhi pa/ ri mo gsum yod pa bshad la/ dril bu la sher phyin gyi zhal gyi 'og tu stong nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi bum pa dang / de'i 'og tu bre'i ming can tshangs mgo 'jug sa'i bug pa / de'i 'og tu pad+ma'i ge sar ri mo gsum/ de nas 'dab mgo mthur du bstan pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar lho nub byang du sgrol ma/ spyan ma/ mā ma ki gos dkar mo rnams kyi phyag mtshan ni/ sa bu+on/ hūm̐ mā+oṃ mā+oṃ ṭ+wāṃ/ me nas g.yas bskor gyi mtshams bzhir nor rgyun ma/ tsun dā/ khro gnyer can/ phreng ba rnams rdzi boṃ rgyu k+ṣiṃ māṃ rnams dang / 'dab ma'i 'og tu phreng ba ste/ 'di la rigs gzhan gyis byed na 'khor lo dang pad+ma sogs kyi phreng ba dang / de la 'phyang ba'i drwa ba drwa phyed / kha khyer gyi gong du yang rdo rje'i phreng ba bya zhing / nang du lcags kyi dbyi gu zur brgyad pa bya la/ drwa ba drwa phyed kyi khongs su shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir g.yas bskor gyi 'khor lo rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir / spyan/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ āt+pal lo/ /dril bu yang sor bcu gnyis pa cha mnyam du bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dril bu kha cig sor dgu pa drwa ba drwa phyed med pa tshangs mgo rtse lnga pa dang rtse dgu pa dpa' bo'i dril bur bshad la/ rdo rje rtse dgu pa ye shes kyi rdo rje dang / rtsi lnga pa dam tshig gi rdo rjer/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud nas bshad do/ /rnam dag ni/ dus 'bor nas sor gcig pa nas/ bcu gnyis pa'i bar rnams/ lus kyi nor bu dang / gtsug tor dang / dgal ba dang / mgrin pa

ra༅༅/ /dang / snying ga dang / lte ba dang / gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor gyi tshad dang rnam dag sbyar ba tsam las ma gsungs la/ saspru snyir/ phyogs gcig gi rwa lnga ni rnam snang dbus su byas pa'i rigs lnga/ rwa gzhan lnga ni / dbus ye shes/ shar rdo rje/ byang 'jigs byed/ nub ro langs/ lho gtum mo ste/ gdan bzhir gsungs pa'i khro mo'am/ gshegs ma lnga/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad cha gnyis kyi rigs lnga phyogs ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa / mkha' snying / kun bzang / phyag rdor/ 'jam dpal/ sgrib sel/ sa snying rnams shar nas g.yas bskor ram/ bla ma gong ma rnams gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi sems dpa' brgyad ltar bkod/ yum lnga phyogs ni/ phyogs bzhi lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu ma/ mtshams bzhir/ tsun dā/ rin chen sgrol ma/ lu gu brgyud ma/ gzhan gyi mi thub ma rnams su bsgom zhing / ye shes pa bcug nas mchod de zhu ba las byung bar blta zhing mos pa lha'i rnam dag dang / bde stong dbyer med kyi ngo bor mos pa bden pa gnyis ma'i dang / stong nyid 'od gsal rkyang par mos pa don dam gyi dang / lam lnga dang 'bras bu thams cad kyi rang bzhin du mos pa kun rdzob kyi rnam dag rnams bshad la/ dril bu la sa bon ni/ phyag mtshan sbyar ba'i lha'i dang / rdza ma 'dod khams/ steng gi pad 'dab sa bon dang bcas pa gzugs khams/ bum pa shes rab kyi zhal la sogs pa gzugs med de khams kyi rnam dag dang / khong stong phyag rgya'i pad+ma/ lce zur brgyad

pa thabs kyi rdo rje ste des pad+ma'i nang gi rtsa brgyad bskyod pas bde chen 'byung ba ltar/ lce zur brgyad pas nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskyod nas dkrol ba ni dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol ba'i don du man ngag snye mar bshad la/ kṛ ya sa muts+tshar/ lte ba de nas snying ka mgrin/ /kha dang sna yi bu ga gnyis/ /rna ba das dang mig dag dang / /de bzhin spyi bor dril bu dkrol/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ /der rdor dril thig sgrom gyi khog nas 'don lugs sogs rgyas par bshad pa ni/ spro zhing nus na der blta'o/ /tshangs mgo dang rdo rje rtse dgu pa ni/ phyogs gnyis ka rigs lnga yab yum bzhi'am/ bha wa bha tras dbus rwa rnams snang / phyogs gcig gi ra sem sa dpa' brgyad/ phyogs gcig gi rwa sems ma brgyad du bshad mod kyi / pad 'dab brgyad la dag pa mi sbyor na ma gtogs bzlos par 'gyur ro/ /rwa rnams chu srin gyi kha nas ma thon pa ni/ snying rjes sems can mi gtong ba'o/ /kṛ yar ḍa ma ru dang rtse gsum dgra sta ral gri sogs kyi tshad rgyas par bshad pa'ang spro na der blta 'a// phyag mtshan gang dang gang gi mgo bo 'dzin mkhan de'i mtho re dang / yu ba can gyi yu ba rnams khra gang las mi thung ba yu ba'i mthar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ 7 'aral gri srid sor drug cu pa dang / zheng du sor bzhi pa/ yu ba'i mtshan nyid rgyas pa sogs gsungs mod sgo phal cher sgrub pa sla la/ ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni/ rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga rdzogs pa/ sdo'i 'og tu mi mgo skam po gsum brtsegs dang / de'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dang / yu ba'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i mtshan pa lugs

ra༅༅/ /gcig dang / yang na rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas mi mgo skam po gcig de nas rlon pa gnyis/ de nas rdo rje rtse rdzogs pa la ba dan gsum pa 'phyar ba/ de nas bum pa bzang po shing los kha brgyan pa yu ba dang bcas pa'i lugs gcig dang / gnyis ku'ang yu ba'i stod sbom zhing smad 'phra ba dril chung dang bcas pa dgos pa der bshad la/ gzhung gzhan du lugs snga ma bzhin las/ mi mgo skam red rlon pa gsum gyi 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje/ de nas bum pa yu ba dang bcas pa'ang bshad do/ /bum pa la/ zhi rgyas kyi ni lto ba'i sboms su sor bcu drug zhabs nas kha'i bar gyi dpangs sor nyi shu las/ mgrin pa sor drug kha'i rgyab sor brgyad kyi dbus su gsum cha bug pa/ mthar mchu sor gnyis 'phyang ba yin la/ lto bsad bskrad la/ sbom por bcu gnyis/ dpangs su nyer bzhi las mgrin pa sor brgyad yon po kha sor drug mchu sor gcig sto dbang dgug la/ bzo bo mkhas pas ji ltar byas pa/ lto rengs pa la / rgya dpangs mnyam pa bcu drug pa/ mgrin pa sor bzhi/ kha sor drug mchu sbor 'ing sor gnyis pa ste/ thams cad la rtsa ba med par gsungs pas lhung gzed kyi gsham lta bu/ bod la grags pa'i mchu med pa yin mod krin kha nas chu sbyin pa mi bde bas/ mchu byas par snang ba 'gal ba med do/ 7 /bzhi pa la bri bya ni/ gro kha'am shing shun nam shog bu dkar po'am tshos ma rang rang gi mdangs gsal ba/ ma tshad ni/ rgyud gong ma 'ga' zhig las/ skra dang mchan du sba

bar gsungs pas/ sor bcu gnyis pa'am/ bcu drug pa'ang gsungs mod krin brgyad stong pa'i mjug tu glegs bam shin tu chen po la yi ge gsal bar bri bar gsungs pa sogs kyang yod pas 'byor skabs dang bstan la/ rgya dpe la bug pa gcig pa dang gnyis pa gnyis gsungs pa'i dang po cha lngar byas pa'i lnga gsum lnga gnyis kyi mtshams su dang / gnyis pa la cha gsum du bgos nas bu ga gtod pa'i thad skor gru bzhi'am/ zlum po rgya ha cang che chung min pa mdzes pa'o/ /bod na'ang spyan skor du grags pa'ang gsung rab chen po la rung ngo / 7 /yi se/ ni/ rgya gar na tshangs pa'i yi ge la sogs pa yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa rnams las/ bod kyi mkhas pa mthon mi sam+bho ṭas/ kha che'i yi ge dper byas nas/ bod kyi yi ge ma sum cu/ bu drug dang bcas pa mdzad pa las/ rim gyis brgyud de khyung po g.yu khri dang / gsum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa/ zab chen dang zab chung / 'bru chen dang 'bru chung / 'bru chen la li lugs dang 'dan lugs / gshar ma dang dkrus yig la sogs pa'i nang nas/ gsung rab chen po dag ni zab chen dang zab chung dang / rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams ni 'bru chen sogs dang / bod kyi gzhung lugs rnams 'bra chung sogs su bri bar bya la / yi ge'i mtshan nyid cha tshad brda' dag sogs ni spro bar nus/ mod kyi ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas ma spros so/ /snag tsha yang rab gser dngul la btso chen dang / btso chung sogs sbyang 'dul la legs par sbyangs pa/༄tha ma snag tsha dngos kyang

ra༅༅/ /rung ste mdangs gsal ba dang / dam ran pa dang / spyin sha chod pa/ lag cha smyu gu dang smyu gri bdar la sogs pa thams cad tshad gcig la khel ba/ sla bcos su ma song ba sngon du legs par sbyangs shing bslabs te bri bar bya ba yin no/ /de bzhin du khang bzang dang rta babs dang khang brtsegs dang de dag tu dgos pa'i shing gi ma nyid dang so bag gi mtshan nyid dang / sgo gzhug pa dang / ka ba zugs pa dang / rgya phigs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la sogs pa yang kṛ ya sa muts+tshar rgyas par gsungs pa shes par bya la/ gtsug lag khang che chung gang byed pa la cher gyi brgyad cha'am/ bcu cha sgo'i zheng dang / de'i nyis 'gyur srid dang / sgo'i bcu cha ru bzhi la bya ba sogs kyang skabs dang sbyar la/ thog 'bubs kyi shing brtsegs la sogs pa'ang dgos mod kyi/ rgyas par byas na yi ge mang la/ rags rim ni bzo bo phal cher gyis shes shing / gnas mal gyi gzhi la sogs pa nas bshad pas 'bubs tshul ni/ da lta sgrub pa yang dka' bas 'dir ma spros so / lto /lnga pa ji ltar bzhengs pa'i cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la sa chog dang / sta gon no/ /dang po la brtag pa dang / slang ba dang / sbyang ba dang / bzung ba dang / bgegs bzlog pa rnams phal cher dkyil chog rnams su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bya/ khyad par 'ga' zhig 'dir yang brjod na/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang rten gsum sogs bzhengs pa'i sa 'am/ yo byad 'tshol tu chas pa'i tshe phyi'i bltas dang / ma sa bon 'debs dang ljon shing 'jug /rta dang

phyags lugs 'ded pa dang / /khur bzang khyer nas 'ongs dang 'phrad/ /phyogs der longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /lha gsol mkhar rtsig bag ma len/ /khye 'u mang po brtse ba dang / /bkra shis rab gnas bya ba dang / /bzhad gad dang 'phrad drode bskyed 'byung / /dkon mchog gsum dang chos sgrog dang / /kha ton bsam gtan sgom pa dang / /ngur smig rgyu+on pa sogs mthong na/ /slob dang 'chad nyan 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ldan pas de dus dang / /de yis gling mo byed dus kyi / /rlung gi bltas la khyad par brtag /gzhan yang bya dang khyi sogs kyi/ /skad dang kha yi blta phyogs sogs/ /dus sbyor chen mor bshad rnams/ brtag /bltas mtshan bzang na skyar du brtsams/ /ngu dang snod stong khyer la sogs/ /ngan pa byung na phyi la mnur/ /yang yang ngan na rim gro dang / /gzhan du spo ba la sogs bya/ /gza' skar dus sbyor la sogs rtsam/ /byed pa'am sa rdo sko ba'i sar/ /rdo legs byang ngam shakhro ram steng / /kha bltas mthong na dge bar bshad/ /rdo ngan phyogs gzhan bltas na ngan/ /sa brkos pa yi kha dog sogs/ /zug rngu rnams kyi brtag tshul dang / /gang du dang po bsko ba'i tshe/ /lto 'phye brtag tshul la sogs pa/ /kho bos dus 'khor 'jam rdor sogs/ /dkyil chog mang por bshad la bltos / /lto 'gye brtag tshul mdor bsdu na/ /ston zla gsum la mgo bo shar/ /de bzhin g.yas bskor byed pas na/ /ji tsam 'os pa'i zlum thig la/ /phyogs rer gsum gsum tshad pa yis/ /dum bu bcu gnyis snyoms par bya/ /re re'ang

༄༄༄/ /gsum gsum bgos pa rnams/ /zhag bcu'i gnas yin rags rtsis ni/ /de tsam gyis rtogs rgyas par ni/ /de yang bcu bcur mtshan ma rnams/ /zlum thig nyid las bgos byas la/ /srid tshad mtha' nas mthar sleb cing / /zheng tshad bcu cha'i tshad ltar bgyis/ 'ang ngam shog bu la sogs k+shi /lte bar drang por gzer nas ni/ /ston zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la/ /stod mdun byang shar ri mo dang / /smad rgyab lho nub ri mo la/ /reg par byas la bzhag re bzhin / /stod kyi mdun la g.yas su bskor/ /dus tshes gang yin de nyid du/ /gnas pa'i mdun du ri mo lnga/ /phyed bcas nang gi rko sa der/ /srid la bcu char byas pa yi/ /stod la gsum dang smad du drug /bor bas bcu cha de nyid yin/ /ri'u mig mang po dgos pa chung / /rko sa'i dmigs nas rko ba ni/ /chos don 'dod pa dngos grub 'byung / /yon tan thams cad 'phel bar gsungs/ /mgo bor brkos na nye du 'chi/ /rgyab tu rang nyams gnas nor bskrod/ /mjug ma rta glang phyugs rnams dang / /'bangs dang stobs ni nyams par 'gyur/ /kham lnga bko+os par shing grog sbur/ /ska sen thal bas 'tshe bar 'byung / /rdo las rlung gis 'jigs pa dang / /rus pas nad 'byung 'gal dum gyis/ /sna tshogs rims rnams 'byung bar bshad/ /de bzhin du dkyil chog rnams nas bshad pa'i kha dog dri ros brtag pa sogs kyi sas brtag pa dang / chus brtag pa yang byas la sa gzhi 'dom gru bzhi/ ba byung dang bdud rtsi la sogs pa byugs pas/ slob dpon rang nyid

khras byas nas chas gos gtsug tor sogs dang ldan pas yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod gtor dang bcas pa bya zhing / chos skyong dang zhing skyong la gtor ma byin nas/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor du bshad pa'i/ khams rgosum gnas pas lha rnams dang / /zhes sogs nas/ de ltar bdag gis khyod la ni/ /mchod cing gsol gyis ma bslu bar/ /rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma dang / /legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / e mu tsi li swā hā/ e mo ha ni swā hā/ i dan+ti li swā hā/ zhes pa rmi lam brtag pa'i sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te kha la bsngags na/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi mdun pas mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mgo lho dang kha shar du phyogs pa gos gtsang ma rgyu+on te nyal nas rmi lam brtag cing / ngan na bzlog pa bya ste bskyar zhing / bzang na mngon pa dang mi mngon pa la blang ba dang / gnang ba gsol ba dang / sbyin sreg zhi drag dang / rdzas sngags lta ba dang / stong pas sbyang ba dang / sa bzung ba la sogs pa dkyil chog ji bzhin bya la/ dkyil 'bor bri ba 'tshal zhes pa'i gnas su/ lha khang ngam/ mchod rten nam/ rten gsum bzhengs par 'tshal/ zhes sogs skabs dang sbyar ba'i 'don pa spo bar bya'o/ /sta gon la'ang / sa dang lha dang bum pa/ sta gon gyi dkyil chog bzhin du byas te/ lha la 'don pa spo ba'i gsol ba btab nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /khyad par du bzo bo dang rgyu cha sta gon nam/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan

༄༄༄/ /pas/ bacho 11 dang rgyu cha rags rim gang bsogs dang lag cha rnams bsags pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ bzo bo sogs kyang las sngags dang bgegs mthar byed kyi phreng sngags dang bdud bgegs bsreg pa'i sngags la sogs pa dang / las bum gyi chus bgegs bsangs/ swa ghā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bzhengs par bya ba'i lha de'am/ rnam snang ngam/ bgegs mthar byed du cho ga gsum gyis bskyed/ dbang bskur thob pa yin na de rang yang bsgom du gzhug cing / grub na dbang yang bskur/ rgyu dang lag cha rnams kyang bsang sbyang byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam snang du bskyed/ ras bris kyi thig tshon gyi dkyil chog bzhin du bskyed pa rnams la/ rigs gsum mam/ lnga'am/ drug gi sa bon la sogs pa rnams la spyi bo la sogs par bkod/ ye shes pa yang dang yang du bcug dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ mchod cing bstod/ na mo bha ga wa te stak+ṣa mu na ye ta thā ga ta ya arta te /myag saṃ bhū d+ngha ya/ tabya thā/ e+o mu ne mu ne ma hā mu rne ya swā hā/ zhes dang / e na mo bha ga wa te be+e ro tsa nā ya pra bha rā dzo ya/ ta thā ga ta ya arta te/ simyag saṃ bud+dha ya/ tabya thā/ e susnye susnye/ sa me sa ma ya/ shan+ti dadhe/ sa mā ra mya/ a na lam̐ bhe/ ta ra be/ nir ku le nir wa zhe/ ya sho wa te/ ma hā te dze/ sarba bud+dha dhiṣ+ṭha na dhikhyi te swā hā/ zhes dang / rten 'brel snying po bdun la sogs pa bzlasati byin gyis rlabs/ lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rgyu cha

rin po che'i phung po dang / lag cha rang rang gi gzugs su bsgyur/ me tog gtor zhing shis pa brjod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /phreng ba sogs su yig mkhan 'od dpag med du bskyed pa dang / smyu gu dang snag tsha byin brlab bshad pa ni dngos gzhi yig mgo 'dzugs pa'i dus su byed pa yin no/ /rnying pa gso ba'i mchod rten la/ ar+gha'i cho gar grags pa ni/ chen po chung ngu gtong ba sogs ni gtan mi rung la/ rgyu dang tshad bzang du gtong ba'am/ gnas 'o rgyal ba nas mi rgyal sar spo ba byed pa ni / rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung las gnang ba rig pas kyang 'thob la/ 'chos rgyu'i rten gyi drung du mchod pa gang 'byor bshams/ bdag bskyed gang 'grub bzlas pa dang bcas pa'ang byas te/ lha la mchod bstod rgyas par byas nas/ lha sta gon nam / rab gnas kyi snyan gsan gyi tshigs bcad la/ khyed kyi dkyil 'khor bri ba 'am/ /rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal gyi gnas su/ khyed kyi rten ni mchod par 'tshal/ /zhes pas 'don pa spo ba'i gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ phyogs skyong la'ang gtor ma byin/ legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol/ /gyi bar lan gsum dang / rmi lam brtag pa yang snga ma bzhin byas la/ rung bar shes na/ skabs su bab pa'i tshe cho ga snga ma la sang ni bgyid par 'tshal gyi gnas su da lta bgyid par 'tshal bcug pas gsoci+o ro gdab ra na gsum gyi bar du byas nas/ rgyud sde 'og ma nas me long la gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug ste/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa mtha' dag me long li nang du bzhugs par mos pa brtan po bya/ dar dmar pos

༄༄〉༅/ /zhal bkab/ rgyab tu rgya byas/ mgo mjug mi log pa'i mtshan ma byas nas mchod gral du bzhugs pa la mchod pa rtag tu 'bul bar bshad cing / kṛ ya sa muts+tshar rdo rje'am/ phreng ba'am/ srad bu kha dog lnga pas bcings pa la bzhugs pa'am/ yang na bum pa rgyan dang ma mas brgyan pa'i nang du bzhugs pa la mchod pa 'bul bar bzhed/ dus 'khor rgyud du rang gi las pa'i rdo rje la bzhugs par yang gsungs mod kri/ slob dpon rang nyid kyi snying kha'i sa bon la bzhugs pa ne+e/ bla med kyi thun mong ma yon pa'i chos yin pas/ de rnams gang yang rung ba ji ltar mos pa byas la/ gtsug khang dang mchod rten ni rnam snang du bskyed nas sngar bzhin bya'o/ /de nas rgyu cha rnying pa rnams bzhig ste/ gsar pa la gang 'dre bsre ba dang / mi 'dre ba'am/ bskyed pa'i mi thub pa sogs yin na/ ri'i phug gam chu chen po sogs la dor ste/ rnying pa'i rjes mi mngon par byas la/ gsar pa sgrub tshul bshad zin dang 'chad 'gyur ltar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi la sngar med gsar du sgrub pa dang / grub zin gyi skyon bsal ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam mchod rten dang khang bzang sogs la 'og gzhir bum gter gzhug par gsungs pas 'byor na rin po che'am/ ma 'byor na rdza bum gsar pa mchu lung med pa bre gang yan chad shong ba lnga byi dor byas pa'i nang du 'bru/ sman/ dri/ rin po che/ snying po rnams lnga lnga/ zas sna dar zab la sogs pa dang / rigs brgyud ma nyams pa'i btsan po'i pho brang / phyug gi khang pa'am bang mdzod/ gnas

gzhi'i sgo khang / grong khyer gyi dbus/ bod kyi zhing / 'brog gi lhas bzang po rnams kyi sa sna rdo sna/ rdo'i sgrom bu bya ba'i phyir du g.yam leb bzang po la/ 'og tu 'ding rgyu'i pad+ma dang / steng du 'gebs rgyu'i 'khor lo dang / logs su bskor rgyu'i bkra shis rtags brgyad legs par bris pa rnams bshams/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dang / bzo bo la ltad mo la ston mo la sogs pa yang tshags su tshug par byas/ rigs dang gzugs dang lang tsho dang dpal 'byor dang ldan pa'i khyi'u 'am/ bu mo gzhon nu bzhi dang / de dag gi lag tu gzung bar bya ba'i snod bzang por bcud nyer lnga dpal bshos la sogs pa yang mi 'thogs par bya ste/ gza' skar dang sbyor byed bzang po'i snga dre'i char dus sbyor bzang ba la/ slob dpon rang gis sngags dang bstun nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi chas gos bzang pordo ra dril dang ldan pa'am/ 'dul ba ltar na chos gos rnam gsum legs par bgos dbu reg zhabs rjen/ dge 'dun tsam yod kyang de bzhin du byas/ bzo bo dang las byed pa dang khye'u sogs kyang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan/ bza' btung bzang po bzos zin pa'i mjug tu/ gang du byed pa'i gnas der phyin te me tog 'thor/ ye dharma dang bkra shis brjod cing / phyogs der ji tsam mtshams par g.yas bskor du bcags/ shes na nag rtsis kyi phyogs brtag pa dang / dkar rtsis kyi sgra gcan gdong mjug sogs la 'gram 'tshol ba po'i gdong ma thug par bya zhing / mi shes ni phyogs thams cad rang bzhin med par mos shing / byang dang shar gang rung du kha

༄༄༄/ /blta bar bshad pa bzhin du byas/ 'dir yang lngo 'gye brtags nas dbang ldan gyi zur nas g.yas bskor gyi 'gram 'gru zhing / las mi yang las thams cad par bskyed pa sogs byas nas bya'o/ /'gram legs par rnyed pa na/ khye'u 'am bu mo bzhi pos lag pa g.yon du snod bzang po bcud kyis bkang ba dang dpal bshos la sogs pa bzung zhing / g.yas pas srad bu bzung ste/ zur bzhir 'then du bcug nas/ phyogs cung zad kyang ma 'chugs par byas nas zur bzhi por phur bu gdab la/ srad bu brgyangs te thig skud las ma 'chugs par 'gram gzhug go /phyogs 'tshol ba na/ pha la cher smin drug 'char sa la shar du byed na'ang / smin drug ni byang shar nas nub byang du nub par mngon sum gyis grub pas / khang pa phal cher byang shar du 'chus pa mang bar snang ba ni skyon yin pas/ smin drug nam mkha'i dbus su slob dus kyi nar stabs ma 'chugs pa'am/ yang na ston dbyed nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i nyi ma 'char ba dang nub pa la shar nub drang thad du bya zhing / sa cha dang lung pa'i stabs kyi byar med na/ gtsug lag khang lta bu'i nar stabs dgos pa/ dgos kyi lung pa'i 'phrad gcod du yong zhing / sa phyogs de nyid kyi mdun la mdun yong bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe/ phyogs bzhi'i ri bzang dpyad dang ldan pa bzhi nas/ rdo legs tshad dang ldanapa re re skyes bu bzang ltas tshang ba re len du btang la/ zur bzhir bzhag par bya zhing / gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che gang 'byor yang der gzhug par bshad do/ /bum gter yang 'gram gyi

phyogs bzhi dang dbus su sa bras par rdo rje'i sgrom bu legs par byas te bzhag phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin/ gter chen po'i bum par bsgom nas/ khyed dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba dang / khyad par gnas gzhi'am/ gtsug la ga khang dzom/ mchod rten 'di bsrung ba'i srung ma thams cad longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter la spyod par gyur cig phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i skye bo thams cad la yang dgos 'dod zad med du 'byung ba'i rogs mdzod cig ces sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol zhing shis brjod bya/ yid kyis gzhi der gang 'dod pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes las grub pa bzang zhing gya nom legs par grub zin pa la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs cing rgyan du shis brjod mdzad pa dang / lha dang chos skyong thams cad kyis sgrub grogs dang bsrung skyob la g.yel ba med pa dang / lha mi thams cad kyis nyin mtshan kun tu mchod pa 'bul ba dang / de thams cad srung 'khor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nang du tshud pas/ bdud bgegs nag po la dga' ba gang gis kyang mi mthong bar mos shing sa chog gi skabs su phur gdab byas pa'i phur bu bsrung ba'i khro bo dang chos skyong phyogs skyong la gtor ma byin pa sogs byas pas bgegs med cing 'grub che zer 'jir ro/ /lha khang la sogs pa shin tu rgya khyon dang ldan pa byed na/ gling bzhi gling phran/ gser gyi ri bdun ri rab dang bcas pa'i bkod pa'am/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la grong khyer lta na sdug

ra༅༅/ /tshal gyi bskor ba'am/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bkod pa'am/ gnas mal gyi gzhi nas 'byung ba ltar/ dri gtsang dang / khyams dang / sgo khang dang / glo 'bur la sogs pa'i bkod pa'am/ chung ngu la ji ltar 'tshams pa'i dpyad dang bkod pa mdzes pa// phyi nang gi sa dgra med pa mkhas pa yid 'phrog cing mthong dgu dang ba 'dren pa/ snod mi 'jig pa'i bar du 'jig mi srid pa tsam gyi brtan cing bsra ba/ thog gi shing brtsegs la sogs pa yang 'byor pa dang bstan pas gang shom dang gang mdzes mthangs gsal zhing sa rdul chung ba la sogs pa sgo du ma nas legs par 'bad de/ rang gzhan gyi lus dang longs spyod don yod par bya'o/ /mchod rten dang lha sku lha khang glegs bam la sogs pa sgrub tshul cha tshad dang sbyar te gong du brjod pa bzhin no/ /bzo bo rnams rgyan gos bzang po rgyu+on/ gso sbyong la gnas pa'i lag tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag cha rnams gtad/ khyad par yig mkhan skad cig gis 'od dpag med du bskyed/ e badz+ra sa twa :ོ gis smyu gu dang / e āḥ bisnan ta kṛta hūm̐ gis snag tsha'i snod la lan nyer gcig re mngags te/ rdo rje dang chos 'byung du mos pas lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du gtad la/ i rnyiḥshu tri smṛ ti bi dza ye sarba ā dz+nyā na pa ṭa la a pa ha ri ṇi hri swā hā / zhas bzlas shing / shes rab dang ye shes sbyar te 'od zer rnam par 'phro bas gang bris pa de rnams des yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mos par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgon gnas grong khyer la sogs la/ /sa'i dgras skyon bskyed
