bcos par bya/ /gzhin rje'i kha dang srin po'i gdong / /brag dmar spre 'u khros 'dra dang / /mtshon cha'i zur gtad logs zur nor/ /brag ri mi gnyis shibs 'dra dang / /sngon po zer khrab rgyu+on 'dra rnams/ /rme dang gri 'dzings dmar ngo yin/ /brag phug dmar po kha bltas na/ /glo bur nad 'byung nor la gzan/ /nag po 'phongs 'dras glen lkugs yong / /'khon gzan gdong sogs mi mdzes pas/ /don med rkyen ngan sna tshogs 'byung / /kun la mchod rten mdzes 'dra ba'i/ /ri las srubs med rdo blangs te/ /gser ram dngul gyi rin po che/ /'bar dang gtsug gi nor bu'i sngags/ /bris nas der gnas thams cad thub/ /mi gnyis gzhags 'gyed 'dra ba dang / /seṅge bya khyi 'thab 'dra na/ /de dag rdo la snga ma bzhin/ /sa bo stod smad ral dang 'khyoms/ /grags ngan 'byung phyir rdza las ni/ /rin chen sgrom byas shing thog dang / /'gron bu dung dang rin po che/ /sman dang 'brus bkang rin po che'i/ /gter du byin rlabs sbas pas thub/ /sprul nag mthur rgyug nya sbal dang / /sdig nga 'am chu srin kha gdangs 'dra/ /glo lcong smu chu mdze nad 'byung / /sa lcags rdo la bya khyung gzugs/ /mtho gang lhag byas bstan pas thub/ /rnga mo'i gdong dang ru sbal mgo /bya 'khon sder mos brad 'dra na/ /yan lag skyog dang gzhon dar 'chi/ /chu ser nad 'byung mi mi chags/ /rdo 'am rdza la seng ge'i gzugs/ /byas te der kha bstan pas thub/ /ri sna sems can gzugs 'dra dang / /khyi tshugs bsgyid chom re sna zug /skyes pa gri dang byes su 'chi/ /mi nor gnyis

ra༅༅/ /ka med par 'gyur/ /rdo 'am rdza la seng ge'i gzugs/ /bzhi byas phyogs bzhir kha bstan cing / /zur bzhir gdugs dkar rgyan mtshan 'dzugs/ /dur khrod chu 'gram sdig pa'i rwa/ /bkrag nyams sa mdog skya la lod / /bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang chung / /zas nor dgra mang tshig mi btsan/ kho ba yu thod dngul chu dang / /rin chen 'bru snas bkang la sba/ /rdza yi kong bu phul re la/ /dgu ru sman sna bag phye dang / /bsres pa'i ril bu ba dmar gyis / /'o mas btsos pas kong bu bkang / /rin chen gter du byin rlabs nas/ /dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad sbas thub/ /srin mo'i 'doms dang mo mtshan 'dras/ /tshul 'chal 'khrig pa la srid 'gyur/ /rdo yi dbang phyug ston bcas la / /tshogs bdag gzugs bris bstan pas thub/ /ri yon thal mdog mya ngan byed/ /rgan mo nyal 'dras mi phyugs nyams/ /rdza yi ga 'ur dri med gzungs/ /rten 'brel snying po gur kum gyis/ /bris gzhug rgyal ma rtse mor btags/ /mtshon cha'i rtse dang hom khung gzugs/ /gcan gzan mche gtsigs bya mchu 'dras/ /gri dme gzhon dar 'chi nad ring / /mtsho nang blangs pa'i rdo leb la/ /gser dngul rdo rje rgya gram bris/ khor sogs phyogs bzhir mchod rten dang / /me 'bar ri dang rkang gcig shing / /mtsho rnams yod na skyon 'byung zhing / /rgyal blon mi chen grar ldang bas/ khor du shel gyi mchod rten dang / /lho ru bum pa chus bkang bzhag /nub tu mi bsad mtshon cha zugs/ /byang du rin chen bzhi yi sa/ /

blangasahe mtsho der blug pas thub/ /stong ngam 'og tu rgya gram la ma/ /brag dang chu 'thab pa yi sna/ /sbrul lce 'dra na god che zhing / /mi 'thor ngag gtsug gza' zla 'gras/ /phur pa'i mchod rten phyogs mtshams btsig /bkra shis ri las rdo blangs la/ /gser dngul bkra shis rtags brgyad bris/ /grong khyer bzhig 'dra zangs gog gzhom/ /rgan po bya ra byed 'dra dang / /rgan mo ngu 'dra tshig mi btsan/ /brjid chung nor rdzas mi 'du bas/ /rdza gsar gser dngul zangs lcags bsres / /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs byas nang / /ston pa'i ring bsrel sman bcas gzhug /mkhar ram dbu rtse'i rtser btsugs thub/ /stag skya kha gdangs zor gzhu 'dras/ /longs spyod sgrub dka' rtsodamang zhing / /tha mar myar du 'jigs 'gyur bas/ /glang chen sha can rta rus la/ /stobs po che'i gzugs bris nas/ /phyogs bzhir gdab cing rtsa brgyad bya/ /sā ts+tshas bskor bas sa dgra 'joms/ /gzugs dang yi ge la sogs kun/ /rab gnas byas nas phyogs rdor bstan/ /sa dgra'i rdo blangs 'gram 'og tu/ /sbas na ngan dpyad mtha' dag thub/ /sa sgo gnam sgo ri bye dang / /gong nyag ri gdong thag ring gi /lu chu'i rgyang mda' shar gyi brag /mchod rten 'dra la sā ts+tsha dang / /gab rtse bkra shis kyis bkang ba'i/ /rigs gsum rigs lnga'i rtsa brgyad bya/ /ri bye'i steng du swā ts+tsha 'am/ /khang stong rdo bzang ba'ag pas thub/ /gangs zer mthong sa ra me dpung bri/ /pha wam pho rang sa 'og gzhug /yang na de steng mchod rten bya/ /nub byang stag skya rgyu srang

ra༅༅/ /bcad/ /yang na shing gi khram gnyer bstan/ /lho byang 'brug sngon zam pa bya/ /lho yi rus sbal dbyung ngam sgrib/ /byang gi bya dmar brag gis mnan/ kheng skam gang na 'dug kyang bcad/ /khyung glang 'dra la seng ge bstan / /seng ge 'dra la mchod rten bstan/ /chu rgyun sa yis bsrubs pa dbye/ /lam la khram gnyer mang du bya/ /sa grum phug dang sa dong sub/ /gong gi lam chen grog po yang / /mgo zlum ri la rtse mo gdags/ /yid du mi 'ong gang mthong sgrib / /phyi yi sa dgra de ltar bcos/ /nang gi bcose thabs bshad kyis nyon/ ka ba mthong kha gru gsum la/ /ka mthongs ngos la gru gsum bri/ ka brgyad g.yu rung ris re bri/ /nyi ma phyed 'grib me shes bzhag /gang 'og gdung gi mtho dman la / /stag pa shing la pho gzugs dang / /glang mar mo khris gong 'og brlan/ /rgya gram gdung gi steng 'og la/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pad+ma bri/ /ro mthon gdung la gro ga la/ /rus sbal lkog sngags bris la sbyar/ /de rnams ma bcos skyon mthun par/ /chom rkun 'byung zhing 'thab mo mang / /byes su 'chi dang nor lag zan/ /sgo la dngur gdong gtad pa la/ /stag dang nor bu 'khyil pa bri/ /ral po gru gsum grus la bsub/ /phyogs la zur song shing cha rnams/ /drang por phub pas bcos par bya/ /ma bcos tshe thung nor mi chags/ /'khor g.yog mi 'phel mi kha snang / /phug mthos dkar khung mthos pa la/ /me tog rin chen 'phyang ba btags/ /khyams kyi stod las smad mtho na/ /rim bzhin rdo rje g.yu rung bri/ /

snod las khyams smad shing bzang na/ /rim bzhin āḥ dang hūm̐ re bri/ /gdung las phyam rnams sbom pa la/ /rim bzhin zla rdzogs zla tshes bri/ /ma bcos dpon g.yog go ldog cing / /pha la bu mi snyan pa dang / /khyo las chung ma dbang cher 'gro / /phyi sgo gnyis byas bo sar bstan/ /sgo gong byang chen mchod rten bzhengs/ /sgo gong gdung bkal rtags brgyad bri/ /gzhan gyi khang zur zug pa la/ /lha babs mchod rten legs pa bzhengs/ /tshang bang gzhan las mthos na dmad/ /'khor sar rang 'thag btsugs 'khor na/ /khro bo'i drag sngags bris pas thub/ /bres la gdong btsugs bum gter gzhug /ro mchan bton la gter gzhug bsub/ /ma bcos nang 'thab 'bra mi smin/ /nor phyugs god che gang stongs yong / /khang bdag 'phos ngang zhig mang la/ /'khor lo rtsibs lngar 'byung ba lnga'i/ /sngags bris rtse sman dkus la dril/ /rus sbal khog par rin chen bcas/ /bcug nas gdung la kha phyir bstan/༄ /g.yos ma gdung gi thad song dang / /nyal ba'i thad du gdung byung na/ /gdung la khram gsum bris pas thub/ 'ang gi mgo mjug los pa la/ 'ang le khri bya ma bcos na/ /'khor 'chi na tsha 'byung phyir bcos/ /bug pa mang na bsris mi rme/ /sgo la bug mang nang tshags chung / /nang du brag cha 'byung ba dang / 'ang kha hrag shar bstan pa dang / /phyam sna gdung sna phyir mthon dang / /phyi sgo byang ngam nub bstan dang / /khang pa gru gsum gyen la nar/ /ka ba kha yar rtsig zur mang / /nyi zla la na gnyis 'char ba dang / /nyi zla khal du

ra༅༅/ /bkal ba dang / /sgo kun thad kur zang thal rnams/ /nad dang sdug bsngal yid mi bde/ /mgron mang 'thab rtsod 'byung phyir bcos/ /spyir na yon tan mang ldan yang / /skyon chen gcig gis 'joms pa dang / /skyon mang de las ldog pa'i phyir/ /chos kun mnyam nyid du shes shing / /tshogs gnyis rgya chen sngon song ba'i/ /bshes gnyen yon tan kun ldan dang / /rten gsum byin rlabs khyad 'phags dang / /skyes bu bsod nams cher ldan pa'i/ /ngan dpyad mtha' dag thub par 'gyur/ /de phyir de dag 'bad pas btsal/ shes pa'i skyon rnams legs par bcos/ /mi shes bzlog phyir dge la 'bad/ /yul khams bkra shis 'byung 'dod pas/ khor du ljon shing khyad 'phags 'dzugs/ /lho ru bum gter bzang po gzhug /nub tu rigs gsum mgon po brtsig /byang du mtshan ldan mchod rten bzhengs/ /bkra shis dge mtshan gzhan yang bya/ /zhes bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa dang / 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / phan bde 'byung ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can yin pas/ legs par bslabs te blang dor bya'o/ /mjug ni legs par grub nas/ thog mar bzo bo rnams yon dang rdzongs la kha smras med par mnyes par bya zhing / rten gsum thams cad rab gnas dang mnga' gsol gyi bkra shis shing bstan par bya ba yin pas/ rab gnas kyi sngon du dgos pa'i gzungs zhugs ci dgos rnams ma 'chugs pa shin tu gal che ste/ dus phyis mkhas rloms bstan pa la dbang za ba dag gis rtog bzo mang du byas shing / rten

dus kyi 'khor lo dang / kyai rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang / de nas ma rgyud bde mchog 'khor lo dang bcas pa dang / de nas pha rgyad gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs te bla med rnams thugs ka dang / de nas rnal 'byor rgyud rnams lte ba dang / bya spyod rnams sku'i smad dang / chos skyong dang nor lha rnams pad gdan la bzhugs te/ gzungs 'bul chen mo'i rim pa ji bzhin no/ /smi tshud na btus te ji ltar 'os par gzhug par byas la/ gzungs kun la'ang sngon du rab gnas bsdus pa re grub na'ang legs shing / ma grub kyang rung ste/ rab gnas dngos kyi dus su yig 'bru'i rab gnas rgyas par bya'o/ /rgyad sde'i rigs dbye la sogs par ni gzhan du mang po bris zin pas 'dir ma spos so/ /gzungs rnams kyang rab gser dngul / 'bring zangs/ tha ma snag tshas bris pa'am spar du byas pa'ang rung ste/ yi ge dag pa shin tu gal che zhing / rdobu gzungs rnams kyang gdung rus kyi bris pa'ang rung zhing / yi ge'ang rab lad+dhi/ 'bring dbu can/ tha ma dbu med du bris pas kyang 'grub ste/ thams cad sgril lugs shin tu dam pa mi 'jig pa dang dbu zhabs mi ldog pa'i mtshan ma byas/ dri zhim po cung zad bkus/ rten gyi nang yang dri bzang po'i ko ba tsam byugs pa skams te bgegs bskrad gu gul gyi dud pa bdugs pa dang bcas pa byas nas/ blo shin tu zhib par stod gzungs smad gzungs rnams ma 'chol ba dang mgo mjug ma log par tshags r+shan tu dam pas gzhug par bya'o/ lto /gnyis pa la ga'an 'dod dgag pa 'i/ phyis kyi bstan 'dzin rang

ra༅༅/ /bzo shes pa la mkhas par byed cing / rang gis myong ba dang mngon sum ltar snang rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ shin tu lkog gyur gyi zhal lugs lung rnam dag 'ba' zhig gis mjal dgos pa rnams la dbang za bar byed pa dag gi 'dod tshul du ma byas te/ kha cig gis pho zhabor steng du byas pa gzhir byas la/ gtso bo dbu shar bstan mdun nub bstan/ 'khor thams cad dbu nang bstan la 'og ma phyogs mtshams ji bzhin g.yas bskor dang / steng ma g.yon bskor du byas pa'i yab yum so nu+o/ra zhal sbyor ba 'ong zhing / langs pa'i tshe pho nyi nas zhal nang bstan dang mo nang nas de la zhal bstan pa shog gu pad 'dab so sor bkol nas dras te sbyar nas grub pas/ 'di las lhag pa med do zhes zer zhing / deng sang lugs 'di shin tu dar bar 'gyur ro/ /kha cig steng 'khor g.yon bskor dgos pa bden mod sgi gtso bo dbu shar bstan du byas na/ zhal gang bstan shar du byed dgos pa dang 'gal zhing / shar gyi gtso 'alor gtso bo'i rgyab tu 'byung bas skyon yod pas/ dbu nub bstan yin la/ 'khor gyi dbu nang du bstan pa'ang phyin ci log yin pas/ phyir bstan du byed la/ de la langs pa'i tshe/ gtso bo yab yum zhal nub tu bstan la thod par mthong zhing / lto dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyad du / mo 'khor nyis brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa la brten pa dang / ras bris sgyel ba'i tshe pho 'og tu 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ mo rkyang nyis brtsegs ni dgos pa chung la/ pho gtso bor byed na mo 'og dang / mo rgotso

bor byed na po 'og tu byas nas bri ba'i rnam bzhag rgyas par byed do/ /'di dag ni 'thad pa min te/ lung rig dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lung ni/ rten gyi gzungs zhugs la 'ulor lo byed pa mi gsal yang / dpa' bo gcig sgrub tu/ spyir nor sgrub pa la/ gser dngul sogs kyi snod steng 'og la/ mo 'khor nyis sbyar ram/ pho 'khor sbyar bar bya ba gsungs pa'i steng 'og gnyis ka la phyogs dang phyogs bral g.yas bskor kho na bya bar gsungs pa 'dis/ khyed ltar na rdo rje 'chang gi gdul bya bslus par 'gyur te/ 'di la steng 'og mi 'grig pa mngon sum gyi grub pas nyes dmigs shin tu chen po yod pa gang zhig rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung kun tu skyon phra mo la'ang blang dor bya bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /steng 'khor la g.yon bskor bya ba dngos su ma gsungs kyang / don la mi byed dka' med do/ /gnyis ka g.yas bskor byas na shar rnya'i lha dang byang shar gyi lha/ lhe'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyor du 'ong bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na de ltar rig pa dang 'gal te/ logs bris dang 'dres sam/ thang ma'i steng gi lha gtsug tor 'khor los bsgrur ba lta bu nub kyi nub tu bri bar ma gsungs kyi/ shar gyi shar du 'dri bar gsungs kyang / don la ldog dgos par gsungs te/ ma ldog de dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi 'og tu 'byung zhing / 'og gi gnod mdzes steng du 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /lha shar phyogs pa thams cad dbu nang bstan du 'dri dasos par 'gyur te/ phyir bstan la ma go ma jug lo ga yo nga ba ma ngon su rma

ra༅༅/ /gyis grub pa'i phyir/ khyad par gtso bo dbu shar bstan ni shin tu'ang tha chad de/ lugs phyi mas bkag pa ltar/ purba zhes pa shar dang mdun gnyis sha'i skad dod yin zhing / pañci ma zhes pa nub dang rgyab kyi skad dod yin pas ming gi rnam grangs yin par phyir rgyab tu kha bltas pa las skyon che ba ci zhig yod/ 7 yig mgo nang du bstan pa ni/ rje btsun grags rgyal gyi sngon du'ang byung 'dug pa/ bla ma des las 'jam po gsum la yig mgo phyir bstan bya bar rgyad las gsungs pa dang 'gal zhes bkag pa bzhin du/ dus 'khor sogs su gsal bar 'byung ngo / /lugs phyi mas nyes pa 'di mthong nas zhal shar du bstan kyang steng 'khor g.yon du bskor bas skyon zhugs te/ g.yas sam shar rnam grangs slan pa las/ gtso bo'i g.yas kyi lha g.yon dang / g.yon gyi lha g.yas su 'byang ba'i phyir ro/ /pho gtso bor gyur pa la/ pho'o ga tu 'byung bar ras bris sgyel ba'i mngon sum gyis grub na lho nas kyang khas blangs dgos par 'gyur te/ rkaka ṇi sogs kyi gnam rgyan la pho steng du 'byung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /rmingon sum la rtsis byed na/ po 'og tu mi rigs te/ 'og tu byas na pho mo go log par mngon sum gyis grub cing / de 'dra don thob kyi rigs pa dang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad thams cad dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de dag ni mngon sum phal pa la snang ba tsam yin gyi/ don la bzhengs nas pho mo zhal sbyor mdzad pa yin pas skyon med do zhe na/ de ltar na lho'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyor bar mngon sum la bris pa phal pa la

snang ba yin :ska don la lde'i pho mo dang byang gi pho mo zhal sbyor du 'ong pas shog ldebs lag tu bzung ba'i mngon sum la brten pa'i nga ro ma byed cig 'gal rtags 'di dag la 'dzems nas/ lder sku sogs kyi 'bur ma byed pa rnams kyang mi 'thad de / rgyud du snod dam byang bu bris pa kha sbyar gyi bar du nor 'bru dang zas la sogs pa bcug te sbrang rtsis kha bsdams nas sgrub par nan gyis gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ lje /des na/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rtsen dag na yod min te/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bzhig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes rgyad blar byams mgon gyis gsungs pa ni/ tshul lugs 'di 'dras mats+tshon nas/ rang bzos bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la go rgya re nas gsungs pa'o/ /gzhan yang mngon sum phal pa la stong 'og ji bzhin ma 'grig pas/ thabs shes ma 'gribaca pa sosas kyi skyon byung na/ steng 'og gang rung gi yi ge rnams kyang go ldog dgos par 'byang zhing / de ltar 'dod cing lag rlan la 'gel na/ yab yum thabs shes sbyor ba'i tshe/ g.yas zhal dang g.yas zhal/ phyag zhabs g.yas pa dang g.yas pa/ nu ma ga65sa pa dang g.yas pa sogs mi 'grig pas/ yab yum gang rung btsug be+e g.yas sayon thams cad go ldos dasos par 'gyur 'ing / 7 thang sku'i rgyab yis sogs la'ang / yis lo/sa bri dasos/ nga/ra 'gyur te ter7 nga dru tshon pa sa/ chos so 7 des na rang nyid kyi lu sas ni/ dpa 'a bo gcig sgra ba kyi rgyud le 'u

ra༅༅/ /gnyis pa las/ e ba su dhā ri smyu swā hā/ e tsan+t+ra kun n+t+ra swā hā/ e dad tā ye swā hā/ e su dad tā yi swā hā/ e ār+ya yi swā hā/ e su ghā tā yi swā hā/ e gup+ta yi swā hā/ e de wi swā hā/ e swa ra swa t+ya swā hā / gser gyi snod dang zangs ma'i snod rnams kyang rung ste/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i /bus su nor 'dzin ma dang / shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi dang phyogs bral gyi 'dab ma rnams la tsan+ti shan+ti la sogs pa'i gnod sbyin chen mo rnams mngon rmir bris pa'i snod gnyis kha sbyor te/ mar dang sbyang rtsi dang ka ra rnams bcug nas sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas/ sngar gsungs pa'i las thams cad byed do/ /i dzam+bha la dza len tra ye swā hā/ i ma ṇi bha tra ya swā hā/ e su rba bha tra ya swā hā/ e d+ngha na dā ya swā hā/ e bai shra wa ṇa ya swā hā/ phyogs su'o/ /phyogs bral du/ e gī li mā li ni swā hā/ tshuli tsi kun+dha li ya swā hā/ i mu khen tra ya swā hā/ i tsa rin+t+ra ya swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi dzol po chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/ ba su ༵ ri dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das gser gyi mdog can ne'u le dang bīn dza pū ra 'dzin pa gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sngar gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin mo rnams dang bcas pa'i gnod sbyin gyi dbang pos/ 'jig rten gsum gya rgyal srid ster bar 'gyur ro/ /thun gsum du mngon par mchod de/ bsam gtan dang bzlas pa bya zhing / tho rang chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad byin la/ bya rog gi sgra mi sgrag pa na chu yi nang du zhugs te bzlas pa byed pa de'i nor dang 'byor pa mi zad par

'gyur ro/ /yang na gser la sogs pa'i snod du ba su d+ngha ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / snod gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba bris nas kha sbyor byas te mnyes par byas nas/ grub pa chen po brgyad kyang ster bar 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na pho la/ ma ṇi bha tra sogs shar nas phyogs dang / gī le mā li la sogs pa bzhi phyogs bral la 'khod pa dang / mo la'ang / dang po bzhi dang phyi ma bzhi de dang 'dra bar gsungs la/ rgyud sde 'di rnams su g.yon du bskor ba'i rnam bzhag gakhog kyang med pas/ g.yas bskor dang / phyogs shar nas mgo rtsom pa bzhin du/ mtshams me nas rtsom pa sha stag yin pas/ cho ga la sogs pa'i 'gros mi gsal ba rnams skabs kyi rgyad gang yin rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin sbyar dgos kyi rgyud sde gong 'og bde mchog la sogs pa'i rgyas bkab mi rung ste/ 'di bya rgyad rigs drug bi nang nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs/ de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa dang pad+ma dang rdo rje'i rigs gsum gyi nang nas dang po/ de la yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang / 'khor spyo5ོsa basmar ba dang / yum dang gtsug tor dang ༄/ sems dpa' sems ma la sogs mang ba'i nang nas/ 'khor los bsgrar ba 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang sbrel bar bya ba/ 'jam ngapal dpa' bo gcis sgrub tu grags pa'i phyir rori+o/ spyir dzam+bha 'a sacig nyid snro ga dang bla me da kyi'ang gas nga 'dus dang dus 'khor so gas nas bshad pa'i sgya ba thabs ma nga bas skabs 'dir ni dma'

ra༅༅/ /bo gcig sgrub la rten daso/sa te/ bya spyod kyi gzungs thams cad kyi 'og tu bla med kyi lha sngags gzhag tu mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rten gang yin gyi zhabs dang tshad pa'i gser dngul zangs kyi 'dab ma'i shog gu sogs la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte ba la gtso bo yab yum dang / 'dab ma la rgyud las bshad pa de rnams ji skad brjod pa bzhin go rim dang yi ge 'bra len ma nor ba shin tu dag pa bris pa swā hā'i gong du/ dha na bra haṃ shrī bhū ti puṣ+ṭi ku ru zhes pa'i spel tshig rgyas bsdus gang shong / mi shang na sngags rkyang pa/ de yang ma shong na/ yab dgu la dzi dang / yum dgu la bam̐ yig rkyang pa rung ste/ gtso (ོ 0yab yum dbu nub bstan dang / zhal shar bstan/ 'khorarā mas cad dbu phyir bstan dang zhal nang bstan du byas pa bri zhing / shong na phyi ru mu khyud gsum rim gyis nang ma la dbyangs gsal/ bar ma la ye byur/ phyi ma la rdo rwa/ de'i mthar me ri'ang rung ste/ dbyangs gsal ni sngags/ thams cad kyi gzhi la/ ye dharma ni stod smad kun tu ji ltar mang gin bzang ba'i phyir dang / rdo rwa me ri ni rgyad kyi lha thams cad kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyir dang / sheX na lha bris pa'i thugs shar sngags bris na'ang rung la/ lha ni yab thams cad g.yas bi dza pu ra dang / g.yok+ta ne'u le/ yum thams cad g.yas mchog sbyin dang / g.yon rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ gsus pa che ba la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /legs par grub nas kha sbyar gyi nang du rin po che dang / gos dar/ 'bru dang zas la sogs pa bzang

dgu gang shong bcug sbrang dang ka ra dang mar gyis kha sbyar te/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'os gtsu+o bo yab yum gyi mdun phyogs su 'ong bar byas la/ dar dmar pos dril nas ma nor bar gzhug go 7 /gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ 'o na bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas yig mgo phyir bstan mdzad kyang lho byang go lngog steng 'khor la byed pa man ngag yin gsungs pa dang / bla ma dam pas kyang steng ma g.yon bskor dang / 'khor gyi yig mgo nang bstan mdzad pa ma yin nam zhe na/ phyi mas de ltar mdzad pa'i yig cha ma mthong la/ mdzad du chug kyang sla ste/ de dag bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo yin mod kyi/ dus dang bstan pa'i ska chags kyi dbang gis yi ger bris 5 la 'khral pa cung zad srid pas gang gsungs khas mi blang ngo / /rgyu mtshan ni sngar rgyas par bshad pa'i rigs pa rnams la lan gsung rgyu med pa'i phyir dang / 7 rje btsun gong ma rnams dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig steng 'khor g.yosna bskor dgos te/ bka ṇi'i dkyil 'khor sogs la sa rgyan dang gnam rgyan gyi khyad par sogs kyis/ lho byang go ldog dgos kyi/ lag len la yang byed pa mang gis/ khyed kyis bshad pa ni byed mkhan nyung bas mi 'thang do zhe na/ dgos pa gang gis sgrub/ rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi lung ni med/ man ngag yin gsung ba la ni lan brjod zin to/ /ris pas grub ste ra/ slog na 'jis rten spyi'i lho byang dang mi mthun pa 'i phyir zhe na/ lho byang la sogs pa'i phyogs thams cad ltosa'ajog kho na yin la/ 'dir ltos pa'i gtso be3 / rang rang sa'i dkyil 'khor

ra༅༅/ /gyi gtso bo de yin gyi/ 'jig rten spyi dang bstan don med cing / gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon ldog pa'i skyon 'byung bas mi 'thad do/ /mi 'byung ste gtso bo'i dbu shar la ston no zhe na/ rgyab mdun log pas de las kyang skyon che'o zhes brjod zin to/ /mang bas nyung ba sun 'byin pa mi nus te/ dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis phyi ma ches mang ba'i phyir te/ shes pa dang mi shes pa gnyis phyi ma shin tu'ang mang ba'i phyir ro/ lnge /gsum pa ni/ de ltar na gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor yang / sa rgyan ji bzhin du bris nas/ steng du sbyar bar bya ba yin gyi/ mngon sum lta ra snang gi 'khral pa bskyed par mi bya'o/ /de ltar na lho byang 'chugs pa dang / 'khor gyi lha rnams bzhengs pa'i tshe/ dbu 'thur du 'phyangs par 'gyur bas / sa rgyan dang mi 'dra bar/ gnam rgyan la ni 'khor gyi lha rnams dbu nang bstan du bya dgos so/ /zheshā kha cis lag len du yang byed do/ /de la ni/ de ltar na gnam rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor la mda' yab nang du bri dgos par 'gyur bas rgyan ltar bris na/ bslang ba'i tshe bī kha spub pa ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod na de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor ni rdo rje 'chang gis kyang mi mkhyen no/ /skyon med par snang / de nyid du bsgyar nas steng du ldang bas so zhe na/ rten gyen du langs nas/ brten pa mgo mthur du 'phyangs yong par gzigs pa de 'dra'i blos long ngo mtshar che'o/ /de ltar legs par grub nas rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtshor ji skad bshad pa'i tsho ga thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa skabs su gang babs kyi rab gnas

legs par bya'o/ /de ltar na rab gnas bya ba'i rten gyi sgrub tshul mdo tsam brjod pa ste / shin tu rgyas par ni rdo rje slob dpon chen po dag gi spyod yul yin pas/ da ltar gyi slob dpon rnams kyi yul las 'das shing / yi be mang gis dogs pas ma spros so/ lto /phan bde'i rtsa ba thub bstan nam mkha'i ngogs/ /rten gsum dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa yi/ /nyi zla rgyu skar snang bas khyab phyir du/ /de dag sgrub tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho 'di/ shes bya'i gnas kun lhag pa'i mun bral ba/ /ji bzhin snang byed blo gros rta ljang can/ /phan bde'i pad tshal cher rgyas 'dod pa yi/ /skad gnyis smra ba pra dz+nya rasnos sbyar/ /'dis mtshon dge ba'i gzi 'od du ma 'bar/ /mi shes mun pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal ste/ /chos kyi ༄la srid gling la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig /myos ldan gyi lo snron gyi zla ba'i bcu dgu mchod pa la grub pa'o// //maṅga lam̐// //
ra༅༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs/ dpa' gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs kyi lugs so//

ra༅༅/ /na mo mañju badz+ra ya/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'dod rgu'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ 'phangs pa ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan dge legs rin chen bye ba'i rdul brtsegs mchog /yon tan sku bzhi rim par brtsegs pa'i dpal 'bar ba/ /bde chen stong nyid chu gter dbus na brtan gnas shing / /rgyal ba gser ri'i dbus na gzi 'bar 'jam dbyangs rgyal/ /khyab bdag mchog de dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /lam gyis tshe 'di nyid la sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de sras sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis ni/ /ji ltar bzhed bzhin sgrub pa 'dir bshad bya/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dge legs rnams/ /gcig bsdus bla ma dzo ༈chog rnams kyis/ /slar yang srid mtha'i bar du skyongs/ /ma lus phan bde'i

ra༅༅/ /rin chen 'byung gnas mchog /tsha bas mi dmangs bsrang pa'i gdengs can dbang / /tshangs dang me lha'i gdong lag mthu ldan sogs/ /las byed de dag don 'dir ci mi 'bad/ /de yang zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phangs sgrub par byed pa'i thabs kyi yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa ni rnal sdubyor bla na med pa'i lam yin la/ de yang spang bya skye shi bar do gsum gyis gtso bor bsdus pa'i nyes skyon mtha' dag gnyen po don dam 'od gsal dang / kun rdzob sgyu lus te/ mnyam bzhag gis sems dang lus gnyis dang / rjes thob kyis gzhan don te/ gsum gyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu chos longs sprul pa'i ska gsum myur du sgrub par byed pa yin zhing / lam la skye rdzogs gnyis kyi spang bya spong byed dang 'bras bu sgrub byed dngos ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin la/ de'i smin byed phul du byung ba ni bskyed pa'i rim pa yin no/ /zhes bya ba ni bla med kyi lam spyi'i snying po bsdus pa'o/ /de yang slob dpon nag po spod pas bde mchog gi rdzogs rim du / dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam 'di ni/ /rgyud rnams kun gsungs gtso bo ste/ /rim pa gnyis ma'i ngobo la/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lhag yid 'ong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nyid sdom gnyis kyi gnad gzhan las med du byung ba yin no/ /'di la slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba gtso bor mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bzhag gcig dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dgrangs la dngos su zhus pa/ gtso

cher rtsa rgyud la brten nas mdzad pa'i rnam bzhag gcig ste/ gsang 'dus lugs gnyis ྅6 6 bod gnyis na nyi zla ltar grags la/ de la rgya gar gyi phyis kyi paṇa grub tshad ldan mtha' dag gis lugs phyi ma gakho bor mdzad de/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i bde mchog gi mngon rtogs dang / bram ze dpal 'dzin la sogs pas mdzad pa'i gzhin rje gshed kyi skor mtha' dag la sogs pa'i bla med kyi sgrub thabs phal che ba zhig lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyi 'gros la rten pa yin la/ khyad par kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa dang / jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis ni 'di'i sgrub thabs kun bzang gi tshig bcad tshig lhug tu dkro/la ba'i tshul gyis ༷sgyur zhing / rin chen rdo rjes ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang por grags pa las kyang cung zad kha bkang ste mdzad do/ /de yang lugs 'di'i bskyed rim gyi chings ni/ ya na lag drug dang rnal 'byar bzhi la sogs pa'i tha snyad mi mdzad sgo gsang 'dus kyi rgyad phyi mdze dang dus 'khor nas 'byang ba'i bsnyen bsgrab yan lag bzhi dang ting nge 'dzin gnyis dang rnal 'byor gnyis kyis bsdus la/ ting nge 'dzin gnyis ni dang po sbyor ba dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /rnal 'byor gnyis sno / thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'bye+or ro/ /mdor na de lta bu'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim/ ston pa'i ye/ shes zhabs kyi gzhung dang / de'i dngos slo ba rma/ra me ma dzad bzang po 'i dkyil rma chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rnam sa la tshad mar byas nas de'i rjes su

ra༅༅/ /mi 'brang ba'i mkhas pa ni su yang med do/ /de'i phyir lugs 'di ni 'bad pa chen pos btsa la te nan tan chen pos bzung zhing rgyas par bya ba'i lam srol zla med pa yin pas bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis lugs 'di la gtso bor bya'o/ /de ltar na 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs 'di nyams su blang pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / 'jug go /dang po la ring ba'i dang / nye ba'i sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ 'di'i sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang / /'jig rten skye bo dam pa phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes/ rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byed pa'i mchog de bsgrub par bya/ /de la sngags pas snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni brtan po dang / /zhes sogs legs par gsungs pa ltar dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba la sogs pa'i lam thun mong ba rnams kyis rgyud legs par sbyangs pa'i gang zag dbang po mchog tu gyur pas/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa nas gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma mchog las 'di'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ lhag pa'i lha la mchog tu sdod pas/ de'i go 'phangs sems can gyi don du myur du sgrub par 'dod pas / la lar dri med chu ni phun tsho+ogs shing / 'ang mchog mdzes pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /ri bo'i phyogs gcig tu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba sgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i gnas su/ tsan+dan bzang po la

sogs kyis byugs shing / /dri zhim me tog cal dkral mchog gi cha'i/ /bsam gtan gnas su bde ba'i mal stan la/ /zhes sogs/ dang mthun pa'i gnas khang dang yo byad la sogs pa dngos su 'byor pa'am/ med na mos pas tho rangs stan bde ba la kha shar du phyogs pas skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mi yig dmar ser 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i snang ba chen pos rang gi sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs shing phyir 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha thams cad spyan drangs te 'od zer chen pos dbang bskar ba ltar rang la khras gsol zhing dbang skur bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam par byas la kha dang gdong la sogs pa bkru ba dngos sam der mos par bya'o/ /de nas thun mtshams kyi lha gsal btab ste yo byad byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir du/ rang snyad 'jam pa'i rdo spro sku mdog dmar ser ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug bi dang po gnyis rang 'dra'i yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis la gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis āt+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ de nas nang mchod byin gyis rlob tshul la/ deng sang gi gang zag 'ga' zhig nyis kyi mkhas pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi lam rim nas bdud rtsi bskyed chog gsungs pa de spyi 'gro yin par byas nas lugs/ 'di la'ang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste rdzas bcu ka bskyed pa ni mi rigs

ra༅༅/ /te/ de lta na gsang dus 'phags lugs la'ang rdo rje phreng bar bshad pa sngags rim du bkod pa de nyid byed rigs pa'i skyon du'ang 'gyur la/ 'dir sgrub thabs kun bzang dang kun tu bzang mo gnyis/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ rin chen rdo rje/jo bo rje la sogs pa sus kyang sha lnga ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ des na 'gro mgon 'phags pas rdzas bcu bskyed pa'ang mi rigs so/ /de yang sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo gnyis las ni bdud rtsi lnga la rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan par bshad pa tsam las med la/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu par/ zla ba nyi ma cha sman dri/ /zhes byang sems dang / rak+ta dang /dri chu dang / sman sha chen dang / dra chen rnams gsungs so/ /de ltar na 'di skad ces brjod cing bsams te / e āḥbi ghān+ta kṛta hū+oṃ/ e shu n+ya tā sno na badz+ra swa bhā wa ā0 ko3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ lasarlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs ༅ rgyal mtshan la yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'bor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de' steng du kai las mi mabo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba sal ba rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang gi shaX sa snro las dri chen bh+rūṃ gyis ma pa/ lhor e+o las rak+ta oṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dz+rī las byang sems sbyo gis mtshan pa/ byang du khoṃ las sha chen khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su /ོ las dri chu hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ thun mong gi steng du oṃ yig dkar pa 'ad zer 'phro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs kha'i rmi gyi

'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te rang rang gi sa bon la thim zhing rlung g.yos te me sbar bas rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs shing kha dog dmar ser nyi ma 'char sha'i mdog can gsal zhing dwangs par gyur / de'i rlangs pa gyen du phyur ba las byang ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rjedakar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba gsum yang bar snang de nyid du zhu ba thod par lhung pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag pa med pa'i ro dang bcud kyis brgyan par byas/ i yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas r+sha'i snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas stim pas rgya cher spel zhing byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ 'bra gsum brjod/ 'di ya nga jo bo dang rin chen rdo rje sogs dang cung zang mi mthun yang slo/ba dpon nyid kyis kun tu bzang mo gtso bor byas pa 'o/ /de nas legs par bshams pa'i mchod rdzas rnams/ snga ma ltar bsang zhing sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang zlos a las byang pa'i thod rma yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du e paṃ e kru la sogs pa mchod dzo sa so so'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri mchog zhal zas rol mo zlo/ sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad/ rang bzhin bde stong gi ye/ shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin spungs/ byed las rang gzhan gyi dbang po mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshim par byed pas/ phyi nang kun tu gang bar gyur/ e arnya āḥ lha/ de bzhin du/ pā byi/ āñca ma ṇi/ puṅge dh+wa pe/ ā lo she gan+dhe/ nai wi

ra༅༅/ /bye/ shasdi/ rū pa/ shasdi/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar+sha/ d+ngha rma dhā tu/ āḥ hū+oṃ/ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsam ste/ chu gsum yang gzhung de nyid las 'byung ngo / /de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byed na yang / dgos su mchod gtor bshams pa sngar ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs mi bskyod pa'i phyogs skyong gi gtor chog da lta grags che ba 'di/ slob dpon a bha yas rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa yin la/ phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam rdor yin pas/ rang gi thugs kha'i hū+oṃ gi dod du mai dmar ser gyis 'od zer 'phros pas zhes pa bcug pa nyid kyis 'grub la/ yang na bu ston rin po ches 'di'i dkyil chog tu phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul bar gsungs pa ltar byed na/ rang si thugs kha'i mai las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang chen la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ lhor gzhin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon ri dwags la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa ne'u le 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa lha ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa

pad+ma 'dzin pa rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las 'dus pa'i lha shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags r+ghaṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can rnams su gyur/ e āḥ hrīḥ pra wa raṃ ༈ saska raṃ/ arnya pra tīts+tsha hū+oṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā traṃ/ āñca ma ṇi pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ tshud in+da/ asni/ ya ma/ nai ra h+ye/ wā ru ṇa/ wā ya bya/ ku be ra/ ā+oṃ shā na/ brah+ma/ pyi bī wī de wī swā hā/ e a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma r+ṇa ākhya nut+pan+ma tā ta/ e āḥ hū+oṃ/ zhes pa gsum gyis phul/ dril bu bsil zhing / khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phral cher ldan zhing / /rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan mnga' ba/ /sa la gnas tsha'irā khyang po rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol / /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan dorno du/ /sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'jeng ba / /ji ltar bsam pa'i las byed na/ /khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ /i badz+ra ga sa pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ /de bzhin du/ dh+ra pe nas shasdi'i bar brjod/ da sha dika lo ka pā la i āḥ // ma rnyed yongs dz+nyā ma shes dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed rnams bzod mdzad rigs/ /yig brgya brjod/ i āḥ/ badzo muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas sgrub mchod dang

ra༅༅/ /'brel na gsol gdab maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yid kyi rol pa nas byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi'i bar lan gsum brjod/ yig brgya'i bzlas brjod byed pa'ang spyi dang mthun no/ /gnyis pa nye ba'i sngon 'gro la mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang / 'gal rkyen 'gog pa srang 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la ni/ gang dag bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi skabs su tshad med pa bzhi mi bsgom pa ni/ kun tu bzang mo las tshad med bzhi rgyas par bsgom tshul gsungs pa dang 'ga'/ zhing phyag 'tshal mi byed pa ni jo bo chen po sgosung dang mi mthun no/ /des na rang nyid 'a jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa la gnas pa'i mi yig dmar ser rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar 'jig rten gyi dbul ba sel bar byed pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa myur du sgrub pa'i phyir du / 'od kyi sna la rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'bor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsdus pa'i bdag nyid mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ i sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya wāka tsin+ti pra ṇa mya badz+ra ban dhā nī ka ro mi/ dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing / shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rab mdzes pa 'jam

dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e bha ga lhan mañja badz+ra dī ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arnya pā dza me gha sa mu dra sma ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin du 'dir/ pā bye/ puṅge t+na pe/ ā lo she gan+dhe/ nai wi dre/ shap+ta/ rū pa / gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar+sha dharma dh+wa tu badz+ra rnams sbyar ro/ /gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klang du/ /ma/ lus༄ kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan span sngar de dag ni/ paṃ/cho ga bzhin du thams cad gshegs pa ra bsgri/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang rmedzad nga// /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su baṭ+wā+oṃ bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras sgabs/ /snyi/nga rje dam pa ma/tha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang rgi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing / /sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos rbo+o thamasacad mo chig ngo bo nyid / /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las nges par grol gyur cing / /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su ma chi / /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub ngan pa bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi la/ma cig pu/ /

ra༅༅/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ri gnas par bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cis bdag gis sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan zhing sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i don du 'jam pa'i rdo rje thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan thams cad 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes don dran bzhin pas brjong do/ /rang gzhan snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras gsum rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur par nges par bya zhing / khyad par rin chen rdo rjes gong gi mchod bya mchod byed bshags bya bshags byed la sogs pa thams cad la bden stong gi lta bas rgyas 'debs pa'i bsam pas/ ngo bo nyid dang bral phyir stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin rgyu dang bral bas mtshan ma med / /rtog pa rnams dang bral phyir dngos rnams kun/ /ma lus smon pa las ni nges par grol/ /e shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ār+ya ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /kha cig na re 'dir bden stong gi lta ba bskyangs pa'i sgo nas gong 'og gi rnal 'byor thams cad de'i rtsis zin par byed pa yin zhi snang ba bsdud pa ma yin zhing de'i phyi bskyed rim gyi lam gyi /nad sku gsum lam khyer gyi 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam du byed pa yang mi bde ste/ 'di dang 'og gi srung 'khor la sogs pa rnams

bskyed rim gyi sbyor ba ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ba ni 'thad par ma mthong ste/ dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang bde mchog sogs la de ltar bden mod kyang / 'dir ni sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ gong gi tshig bcad sngags dang bcas pa las gzhan pa'i 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba'i lam cung zad kyang ma gsungs la/ kun tu bzang mor 'di'i skabs su bar srid nam mkhar 'jog pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lugs 'di la bar do mtshon byed ni/ 'og rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa la bar srid 'jug pa'i skabs nyid du/ e āḥlha zhes bya ba'i sems nyid ni/ 'od ldan ho dang spel ba cho ga bzhin/ /zhes kun bzang las gsungs pa ltar/ 'di'i dngos kyi rjes 'brang thams cad kyis kyang skabs der bshad la/ dang por gang du 'jog gi bshad pa ni kun tu bzang mo las gzhan du gsal po cung zad kyang mi 'byung ngo / /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'chi srid sbyong byed kyang mi gsal mod krin srung 'khor gyi 'og tu lhag mos 'od gsal du bsngad pa dang / phung sogs dang 'byung ba rnams rim gyis thim pa dang / he ru ma'i don bdag med gnyis sgom pa lta bu med pa rnams la ni srung 'khor gyi sngon gyi ye shes kyi tshogs nyid 'chi srid sbyong byed du rigs pa dang lung 'dis grub bo/ /spyir r+ya shes kyi tshogs bskyed rim gyi sbyor ba yin pa tsam gyis 'chi srid sbyong byed du mi 'dod na ni bde mchog lo hi pa dang dus 'khor lta bu la'ang der 'gyur ro/ /des na skabs 'dir rnal 'byor pa'i lus kyi 'byung ba thim rim sogs dngos su med

ra༅༅/ /kyang / mnyam bzhag gi ngor snang ba mtha' dag bsdus pa'i 'od gsal de nyid 'chi srid sbyong byed du byas na ni skye gnas mtha' dag gi 'chi srid sbyong bar nus rdzi 'byung ba thim rim dngos su yod pa'i 'od gsal gyis ni mngal skyes kyi 'chi srid las gzhan pa sbyong bar mi nus pas lugs de ni khams drug 'dus 'dzam bu gling pa'i mngal skyes kho na'i lam du gsungs so/ /des na gnyis pa ni/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ stong pa'i ngang las kun rdzob kyi snang ba thams cad 'dod pa tsam dang 'brel ba'i gzhi med du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir du/ nam mkha'i khams su a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shin tu gsal ba'i dbus su rang gi bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi ngobo tshusgo dkar po/ āḥ dmar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams thabs shes chags sems kyi rang bzhin ho dmar po gnyis kyi dbus na 'khod pa me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal ba byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ skabs 'dir kun bzang dang jo bo rjes srung 'khor thun mong ma yin pa ma mdzad pa ltar / bu ston sogs kyis kyang ma mdzad kyang / kun tu bzang mo rin chen rdo rje a bha ya rnams kyis rgyas par gsungs shing mar me mdzad bzang pos kyang / hūm̐ mdzad yang na gtsug tor ram/ /yang na rtag pa la sogs pas/ /bsrung phyir khro bo 'khor lo la/ /gnas nas bgegs kun gzhom par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir a bha yas srung 'khor la/ khro bo bcu ma gtogs dbus na lha med par 'dod pa ni 'thad par ma mthong ngo / /rin chen rdo rjes hūm̐ mdzad la dbang phyug dang

dbu ma'i gdan bshad pa'ang kun tu bzang mo nas ma bshad cing 'di la rigs pas kyang mi 'thob bo/ /'dir kun tu bzang mo las srung 'khor thun mong ba ma gsungs shing rin chen rdo rjes gzhan du bshad kyang jo bo dang a bha ya ltar bya'o/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems rdzogs byang gi sems la rdzogs byang gi bar du bdud bzhi'i bar chad bsal ba'i phyir du/ de'i 'og tu i las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du : las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa kha gyis shing rab tu 'jigs pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ nag po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas bgegs thams cad rkyang ring du bskrad de 'od zer slar 'dus nas 'og tu 'phros pas 'og thams cad sra zhing brtan pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs rnams su 'phros pas rgya che zhing spangs mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur dang bla re gzi 'od 'bar ba/ de thams cad du / bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me kha dog lngas rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su e las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du zlo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa g.yas bskor du mgyogs par 'khor ba rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin gyi phreng pa phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtse mo'i steng gi nam mokha' dang / steng 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang la cung zad ma reg pa rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du lho ru dkar po/ nub du dmar po/ steng du ser po/ gzhan rnams su sngon po'i hūm̐

ra༅༅/ /yig re re yongs su gyur ba las/ dbus dang shar nas phyogs dang me nas mtshams g.ya/sa bskor dang / steng 'og rnams su rim pa bzhin du rdo rje dang / tho ba dang / dbyug pa dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje kha gyes pa dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa sngon po dang / rtse gsum dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams la rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su hūm̐ mdzad/ shar du gzhin rje gshed / byang du bgegs mthar byed/ tshor lhor 'dod rgyal/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can/ nub byang du stobs po che/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po de thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / g.yas gnyis pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje dang tho ba dang khro bo'i rdo rje dang / lcags kyu dang dbyug pa dang rtse gsum dang ral gri dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo ba'i g.yas gsum pas rdo rje dang gzhan thams cad kyi g.yas gsum pas ral gri 'dzin cing / g.yon gnyis pa rnams kyis nor bu dang gsum pa rnams kyis pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho ru shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba dang / nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba dang / steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyar ba ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas gnyis pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du dbyug pa dkar po

dang / pad+ma dmar po dang 'khor lo ser po 'dzin cing gsum pa rnams kyis ral gri 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pa rnams kyis nor bu 'dzin cing pad+ma mthar byed kyi g.yon gsum pas 'khor lo dang gzhan gnyis kyi g.yon gsum pas pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba dang 'dod rgyal dang gnod mdzes dang hūm̐ mdzad rnams sgeg pa'i nyams can/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po la rin po che'i co da pan dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can dang / khro bo gzhan thams cad sbom zhing thung ba mi sdug pa'i nyams can zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba drag tu gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur ba/ smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu sgra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ sgrul gyi rgyan dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can te / thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi bstabs kyis bzhugs pa gshin rje gshed la rnam snang dang / pad+ma mthar byed la 'od dpag med/ gzhan thamasacad ri mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dgol bar e/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥ hū+oṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ rang rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyis byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang skur bar gyur/ e ma hā kro d+ngha rā dza arnya nas/ dharma dhā tu'i bar gyis mchod/ ba zlas ba la spro na rtsa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i phreng sngags rnams sam/ 'phags lugs nas 'byung ba'i mtshan sngags rnams

ra༅༅/ /bzla/gal te gzhan gyi byad stems la sogs pa bzlog par 'dod na/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang hū+oṃ mdzad brje ba gtso bo bsgyur ba'i gnad dang /gzhan yang bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad dang / lha'i rnam pa'i gnad dang /'khor lo zhabor ba'i gnad dang /sngags bzlas pa'i gnad de gnad lnga ldan du bya bar rje btsun dam pa sa skya pa rnams kyi man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du bya'o/ /gnyis pa la dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'bor rgyal mchogathig le'i rnal 'byor / phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la rten dang / brten pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skabs 'di'i rnal 'byor rnams la kun bzang gnyis nas gsal bar gsungs pa bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang mi mthun pa cher mi snang bas 'di skad ces bya ste/ srung 'bor gyi nang gi dbus kyi khro bo yongs su gyur pa las/ saṃ las rdo rje saṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/kun bzang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing /lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zla ba'i 'od can zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis zla gdan la bzhugs sheng / rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ de yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i khams bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug cing gdengs kha che ba gyen du phyogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyi 'od zer

rab tu 'phro ba'o/ /de'i nang du paṃ ser po las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa'i lte bar hūṃ nag po las sna tshogs rdo rje yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la/ zlo dkar po las byung zhing rten 'brel bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar yang zla ba la gnas pa'i bh+rū+oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes nas rnam snang tswa rnam par spyan drangs ste bh+rūṃ la thim pa'i 'khor lo zla ba bh+rūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung lis bzhugs shing zla ba'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas blubs pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las thar pa chen po'i khang bzangs gzhal med khang chen po rin po che sna lnga las rdzogs par grub pa thub pa'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsig pas yongs su bskor ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum dang gru bzhi la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang pa'i mu tig gi do shas dngado shalha phyed

ra༅༅/ /pa dang me long dang rnga yab dang nyi ma dang zla ba dang me tog gi phreng ba rnams kyis brgyan pa/ de'i phyi'i ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dkar po rtse mo thur du dud pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis yongs su bskor ba'i bar bar du gser gyi bum pa nas 'thon pa'i rgyal ma dang ba dan brgyad brgyad dal bu'i rlung gis legs par bskyod pa'i rnga yab rnams las dpyangs pa'i dril bu g.yer kha las yan lag dgu dang ldan pa'i dam pa chos kyi sgra snyan par sgrogs shing phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la rin po che'i gdugs dkar po bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis stegs pa'i rta babs gser dang shar bu dang rin po che dang rta mig dang mun snam dang wa ran tra dang mun pa dang shar bu dang rin po che dang / mig pa dang mda' yab te snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i mda' yab kyi rtse mor chos kyi 'khor le'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas shing mig pa dang wa ran tra'i sne mor rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gdugs kyis brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che

sna bdun dang bar bar du grub ji / thob pa dang sprin gyi gseb nas 'byung ba'i lha mo me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi tshad kyi phyi ngos su 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rin pa gnyis pa'i grwa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis gnyis ste bum pa brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/ lha dang mi las yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod pa'i sprin spung tshad med pas phyi nang kun tu brgyan pa'i khang bzangs dam pa phyi ltas nang gsal ba nang ltas phyi gsal ba'i nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo bar gyur pa'i nang gi ling tshe dgu dang rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gnyis dang sgo bzhi rnams su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re/ nang gi shar las gzhan pa'i phyogs gsum dang sgo bzhir pad+ma'i lte ba la nyi ma'i gdan re re dang gzhan rnams su zla ba'i gdan re re ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor ye shes kyi gzhal med khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lung dang rtogs pa'i chos thams cad rnam par dag pa ni/ mi mnyam pa dag med pas zur bzhir mnyam/ /dran dang dbang po mchog gis sgo rnams yin/ /bsam

ra༅༅/ /gtan bzhi po rnams kyis rta babs te/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer gyis ni legs par bskor/ /kha khyer der legs bsten pa'i mchod pa ni/ /dam pa 'dzin rnams gzungs kyi tshogs yin no/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /gang phyir 'gro ba'i bsam kun rdzogs byed pa'o/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i ba dan phreng ba dang / /sgra sgrogs dril bus phyogs sgo kun khyab pa/ /gang phyir dam chos gsung rab yan lag dgu/ /gdul bya thams cad la ni bskyod pa 'o/ /me long drwa ba drwa phyed me tog gi /phreng ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan mnyam med pa/ /me long ye shes dri med byang chub kyi/ /yan lag me tog dri ni phun sum tshogs/ /ka ba bzang po brgyad kyis nyer mdzes pa/ /rnam thar brgyad po rnam par dag pa yin / /rdo rje'i thig dang yang dag ldan pa ni/ /rdo rje theg chos 'bor lo rab bskor ba'o/ /bla med mtha' yas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /gzugs sogs yul rnams rnam par dag pa yin/ /mchod pa lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ /chos dbyengs rnam par dag pa'i rgyu mthun no/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar legs garnos pa'i/ /nyi zla mgon bcas lha yi gdan rnams ni/ /skyon gyis ma gos mi shes mun sel zhing / /nyon mongs tsha gdung zhi bar byed pa 'o/ /zhes brjod do/ /'dir gzhal yas khang gi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan kun na rgyas par mi bzhugs pas slob dpon a bha yas bshad pa ltar bkod la/ dag pa sbyar rgyu ma tshang ba 'gazha zhig bsnan pa ni/ dag pa dang sbyar ba'i kun bzang gi tshig bcad 'di rnams kyi dgongs pa bkod

pa ste/ tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis rin chen rdo rjes bshad pa'i don bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa la bsnyen bsgrub chung ngu'i yan lag dang / bar ma'i yan lag go /dang po la bsnyen pa/ nyer bsgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen bzhi las/ dang po la rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ skabs 'dir bar do ma zhugs bar gyi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas skabs thams cad pha ma'i rnal 'byor yin pas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal mi byed par rang las rgyud gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas yab yum mngosna byang lnga las bskyed par kha cig 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ mngon byang gi skabs rnams su/ kun tu bzang mo nas/ badz+ra ār+ya ko3 haṃ dang / ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta thā a haṃ dang / mar me mdzad bzang pos snga ma dang / su bi shud dha dharma dhā tu swa ghā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ dang / rin chen rdo rje dang jo bos sngags dang po nyid bshad pa thams cad la a haṃ zhes pa nga'o zhes nga rgyal 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir dang / kun bzang las/ nga rgyal dang ldan mtha' yas sprul ba yis/ /zhes sogs dang / kun tu bzang mo las zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du skad cig gis rnal 'byor pa rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin par gyur te zhes dang / mar me mdzad bzang pos/ bdag la de'i nga rgyal bya/ /i badz+ra a haṃ zhes dang jo bo dang rin chen rdo rje dang / shān+ti pa rnams kyis bdag nyid rjo rje 'dzin pa zhes/ mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mngon byang lnga po rngams shes lnga gnas gyur zhing ye shes lngar bshad la/ de las sems can gyi don rgyas par byed tshul 'byung ba rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa la phan gnod med

ra༅༅/ /par 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyon mtha' yas so/ /'on kyang bar do rgyud tha dad pa gnyis byed pa'ang mi bde bas/ bar do dngos ni nam mkhar bzhag pa'i yi geyin la/ des rmi lam du yul gzhan du phyin nas bya ba gzhan byed pa dang rjes su mthun par rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon byang lnga'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas te 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rjes su 'dzin pa sogs byas pas/ gzhi la pha ma dang tshul mthun zhing / 'bras bu mngon byang lnga las gzhan don phrin las 'grub pa'i lam du 'gro ba cig skabs 'di'i go ༄dun du bzung ngo / /de'i tshul la'ang dpal 'bras kyis dang po nas zla ba gcig las mi bsgom pa ni kun bzang dang mar me mdzad kyi gzhung la gcig gnyis gang du'ang mi gsal yang / gzhan rnams nas smon 'jug so sor phye ste zla ba gnyis su byas pa dang 'gal zhing / phyis kyi mkhas pa dag gis/ rdor dbyings nas bshad pa'i sngags tshan lnga mngon byang re re la sbyar ba ni gzhung che ba 'di rnams gang na'ang mi bzhugs pas mi bya'o/ /de ltar na spyir rgya gzhung spyi dang khyad par kun tu bzang mo dang bstun nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ dbus kyi zla ba'i gdan la bar snang gi yi ge las 'phros pa'i rang gi sgo gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bas/ bdag nyed 'jam pa'i dbyangs su 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir du phyogs bcu'i sems can gyi don la bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul bas de rnams kyis rang la byin gyis brlabs shing 'od du zhu nas 'og tu/ a ā/ i yī/ u lū/ ṛ

rī / lo lī/ e e a e+o i aḥ rnams g.yas bskor dang / slar yang a ā nas e aḥ rnams g.yon bskor te mtshan so gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyangs so gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'bor dbyangs dkar po so gnyis kyis mtshan pa smon pa sems bskyed dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin dang / steng du ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṣ+ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da d+ngha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kho ya ra la wa ḍa bha rnams g.yas bskor dang / slar yang ka nas/ bha rnams g.yon bskor te dpe byad brgyad cu'i rang bzhin gsal byed brgyad bcu yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gsal byed dmar po brgyad cus mtshan pa 'jug pa sems bskyed dang thabs kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i zla ba gnyis ni thog bcas kyi nyes pa dang bral zhing shin tu gsal bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur pa me long lta bu'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba de gnyis dbyer med du 'dres nas gcig tu gyur pa ni thabs shes gnyis su med pas nyon yid gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /zla ba'i steng du : dmar po las byung ba de rdo rje rtse lnga pa nor bu pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar pa'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dkar po 'od zer 'bar bas ma pa ni brjod bya dang rjod byed las 'das pas yi/da ḍā/sa/ci sanas gyur pa so/ sor rtos pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /hūṃ si 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs ling rdo rje 'dzin pa'i so 'phang la bkod de/ slar 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim pa ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong pas dbang shes

ra༅༅/ /gnas gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /e badz+ra ā t+ma ko3 haṃ/ slar yang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen pos mnyes par byas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams hūm̐ la thim pa'i rkyen gyis zla ba rje sa4 bye dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thub pa'i dbang po kun gyi rdul phra rab las byung ba 'gro ba rnams kyi de kho na nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi yab tu gyur pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhes pa nas/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ zhes/ pa'i bar gong ge kun bzang gi ji bzhin brjod cing bsam pa ni dri ma thams cad dang bral bas rang bzhin gnas rigs gnas gyur pa chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o/ /e ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta ta tha a haṃ/ 'dir kun tu bzang mo las sngags 'di gong du bshad cing / zla ba yongs su gyur nas rdo rje bshad pa ni gzhung 'di dar ma grags kyis rang 'gyur du 'dug pa'i 'gyur skyon yin nam brtag par bya la ma yi/na na ni tshul de yang rung par gsal lo/ /'di rnams dang 'og gi snying rje'i dbang bskur la 'phags pa rin po ches tshul gzhan du bshad pa ni btang snyoms su bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas sems can la dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor 'di rnams ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u dang po'i zil non rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs nas zur tsam gsungs pa 'phags lugs pa rnams kyis lhag mos kyi mdzad par sbyar la/ 'dir de dang khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog tu

gsungs pa'i rnam gzhag dang mthun par skabs 'dir bcud kyi zhing sbyong byed du gsungs shing / de ya nga rin chen rdo rje dang rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa 'dus pa'i rgyan gnyis las sa bon gyis dbyung ba kho na ma gtogs bskyed pa dang mig sogs sbyong ba bkag la/ jo bo rjes sems can rnams sa bon k+ṣiṃ la sogs pa rnams las sa snying sogs su bskyed cing sa bon de nyid kyis/ 'byin par bzhed/ kun bzang du/ de rjes sa bon gyis ni dbyung bar bya/ /zhes dbyung ba dngos su gsungs shing bskyed pa mi gsal la/ dkyil chog rtsa 'grel yang de dang 'dra/ kun tu bzang mo las/ mngal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rnam snang gi bar gyi sa la sems can rnams lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu cho ga gsum bskyed byas nas 'byin pa dang / phyung pa'i sems can lhar gyur ba rnams kyis ched brjod mdzad pa sogs gsungs pa dang / sman zhabs pas sa bon gyis 'byin pa bkag pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa mang du byung yang / lam gyi gnad dang sngags kyi brda' chad kyi grub mtha' chug pa sogs kyi skyon can mi/ bskyed pas/ gang ltar byas na'ang 'gal ba cher med pas/ 'di ltar bya ste/ de nas 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi 'jig rten gsang ba 'dus pa bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i glu dbyangs kyis rgyal ba yab yum thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yum mnyes par gyur cing rang gi lus las spyan sogs yum bzhi dang

ra༅༅/ /gzugs sogs lha mo lnga ste/ rig ma dgu phyir 'phros nas yum la thim pa'i rkyen gyis yum bde ba chen po lhag par rgyas pas yab mnyes par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa lha bcu dgazhi bdag nyid du spyan drangs pa rang gi zhal nas zhugs/ rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpas gtso byas pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal la yongs su rdzogs pa dus gcig tu grub par gyur pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer dang / rang gi thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas slob ma 'jug pa'i tshul du dkyil 'bor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug ste dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'bod par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i rgyal ba 'bor bcas spyan drangs te rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pas sems can de rnams la dbang bskur bas phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas thig ler zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las k+ṣiswā khaṃ gi kai saṃ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ 6 raṃ lam̐ mi paṃ tai blo e snru khaṃ hūm̐ rnams las byung pa'i sa snying dang phyag rdor dang nam snying dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / sgrib sel dang / kun bzang dang / gzugs

dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang / spyan ma dang / mā ma gī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / rnam snang dang / rin 'byung dang / 'od dpag med dang / don grub dang / mi bskyod pa ste / lha nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan mtshan dpe la sogs pa thams cad tshang la yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa rnams k+ṣiṃ dzo nas khaṃ hūṃ zhes brjod pas mngal nas mthon te nam mkhar 'khod nas bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i tshul gyis / de bzhin gshegs pa khyod nyid ni/ /bdag gi pha ma ston pa lags/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad rdzi /byang chub sems kyi 'ju/ pa ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rnyog med rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pached du brjod nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur to/ /'dir kha cig mngal gyi dkyil 'khor la sems can bcug nas phyis gshegs su gsol ba dang / kha cig sems can rnams phyir gshegs pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor yang rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par 'dod mod rdzi dkyil 'khor gshegs pa ni gzhung khungs thub rnams su ma byung zhing 'og tu yab yum gnyis dang lhan cig zhu bar byas na'ang 'gal ba yod par mi sems la/ jo bo'i bzhed pa ltar dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag na'ang rung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ de nas rang nyid bsams bzhin du srid pa don du gnyer ba'i dri za'i nga rgyal gyis rnam mkhar gnas pa yang / sangs rgyas yab yum gyi 'dod chags chen po'i mdzad pa med du byung ba de mthong ba'i rkyen gyis bde

si༅༅/ /ba chen po lhag par rgyas pa yab kyi zhal nas zhugs te rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i 'od kyis reg ma thag tu 'dod chags chen po'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar po'i thig ler gyur/ de'i 'od kyis yab yum gnyis kyang byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dang lhan cig zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le dri ma med pa 'od 'phro bar gyur te/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa chos ska'i ngang du zhugs par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i 'od gsal 'ba' zhig gis 'gro ba'i don mi nus par mthong nas sngon yun ring du goms pa'i rang gi byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi po de nyid lha mo bzhir gyur te mtshams bzhir zhabod pa rnams kyis snyan pa'i glu dgrangs kyis bskul ba ni/ 'dir mā ma gī dang por bshad pa ni byams pa tshad med pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la dgongs nas/ rtsa rgyud dang kun tu bzang mo dang / rin chen rdo rje dang / shān+ti ba rnams kyis gsungs so/ /mā ma kyis/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /spyan mas rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi zhabor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan brtson pa/ /mgon po gal te /'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rjesde

gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag li dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te3 /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas/ 'od gsal las gdul bya sna tshogs dang rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs skur bzhengs pa'i ched du sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'odzin mngon du mdzad pa'i thig le de thig le gnyis su gyur pa'i gcig yongs su gyur pa las/ rmi yig dmar ser dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro pa las skyes pa'i ral gre sngon po gser gyi yu bas brgyan pa 'od kyi drwa bas bskor ba'i yu ba la gnas pa 'i zla ba'i steng du mai yig gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can shin tu gsal ba las 'od zer phyosas bcur 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang lhan cig 'jam dbyangs dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te mai yig la thim/ ral gri zla ba rmi dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gtso ma'i gser gyi lhun po la thun mtshams kyi sprin gyis g.yogs shing nyi ma 'char ma'i zer gyis spros pa lta bu g.yas 'al in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing / sayon 'al ston la'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gsu/ma po re re

ra༅༅/ /yang shin tu zhi ba'i spyan gnyis gnyis dang rab tu mdzes pa'i smin tshugs kyis mdzes pa/ rin po che'i sor gdub kyi spras pa'i phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'byud cing / lhag ma g.ya sa gnyis mthon mthing ltar sngo ba'i ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis rab tu rgyas pa'i āt+pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing skyes bu chen po'i mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ mchog tu sgeg pa'i gzhon nu dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'phro zhing / mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga la dri zhim me tog gi phreng pas brgyan pa nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing sil sil gyi sgra sgrog pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan rgyan / mgul rgyan dang do shal/ dpung rgyan dang gdub bu/ se mo do dang ske rags ste rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan zhing snyan gong āt+pa la'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams shing dngos po 'khor ba dang dngos med zhi ba la mi gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ e dharma dhā tu swa ghā wa khusmo rko3 haṃ/ 'di dag ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu dang bsnyen pa'i yan lag chung ngu ste nyon yid rnam par dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa nyer bsgrub ni/ mig sogs byin gyis brlob pa yin la/ 'dir rin chen rdo rjeḍā/ phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i gzugs kyis ma sbyangs na sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur bas mtha' dag sbyang dgos

la / dngos su mig sogs drug sbyong par gsungs pa ni mtshon pa yin no zhes zer nas/ lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tshang ma lus la bskyed nas 'god pa byas mod kyi gzhung gzhan thams cad nas ma bshad pas 'di ltar bya ste/ rang gi mig gnyis su mig dbang gi rang bzhin k+ṣiṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la gnas pa'i k+ṣiṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur te sa snying gi rnam par spyan drangs nas / de la thim de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sa snying dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis 'bor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rna ba gnyis su rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo dzo nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang zla ba la gnas pa snra nag po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur te phyag rdor gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas de la thim/ de rnams yongs shu gyur pa las / phyag rdor nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma shiyas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sna gnyis su khaṃ ser po dang / rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa las nam snying ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi lhag ma ga yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lce'i dbus su gi dmar po dang pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po

ra༅༅/ /dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis pa d+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams kyi dpral ba'i nang du kai ljang khu dang ral gri ljang khu 'od 'phro ba las / sgrib sel ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drag gi 'og ma/ g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'bor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte bar saṃ dkar po dang / rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa las kun bzang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi 'og ma g.yas gnyis rdo lji dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ drug rka'ang phyag dang po gnyis/ kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis zla ba'i gdan la gzhug shing zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas rgyan zhing dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas kun nas klubs pa'o/ /'di dag ni nye bar bsgrub pa chung ngu dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu'i yan lag chung ngu ste yid shes gnas gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so / /gsum pa sgrab pa ni/ 'dir slob dpon shān+ti pas snying kha la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su sa bon las byang ba'i phyag mtshan gsum ༄7 dbus su rdo rje gsum gyi lha bzhugs par bshad pa ni/ kun bzang las/ ji bzhin bkang nas dri med rang snying zla'i/ /rdo rje'o lte ba'i dbus su yi ge hūm̐/ /thugs kyi rdo rje de bzhin kha dang ni/ /spyi bor pad+ma zhabor lo zlo gnas pa'i/ /āḥ dang sku 3 gsung gi rdo rje dang / /sku yi rdo rje nyid du bsam par bya/ /zhes phyag mtshan la gnas/ pa'i sa bon nyid rdo

rje gsum du bsgom pa ltar gsungs pa'i tshig la 'khral par zad kyi gzhan thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum la cho ga gsum bskyed byas pa ltar bya'o/ /de yang jo bo dang rin chen rdo rje re re nas mchod pa gsol btab sogs bskyed chog dang sbrel la/ kun tu bzang mor dus gzhig la bskyed nas/ de rjes rmochod pa re re nas phul te gsol btab byas shing gsol btab kyi tshig bcad dang pos de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gnas gsum na bzhugs pa'i rdo rje gsum rang gi gnas gsum la 'jug la / gnyis pa rnams kyis rdo rje can de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams rang la 'jug par bshad/ rin chen rdo rjes/ tshig bcad dang pos rang gis phar sprul ba'i rdo rje gsum dang / gnyis pas gdod ma nas bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs par bshad do/ /des na 'di skad ces bya ste/ rang gi nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yang hūṃ nag po de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba rnams thugs rdo rjer byas shing de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par gyur te thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim rdo rje zla ba hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje phyag rdor lta bu'i thugs khar rdo rje sngon po rtselnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du lha sngon po de bzhin du 'don pa spos nas sbyar te/ rang gi mgrin pa'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi ngag gi ngo bo āḥ dmar po dang pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa las/ gsung rdo rje 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu'i thugs khar pad+ma

ra༅༅/ /dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du āḥ dmar po rang gi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i rang gi lus kyi ngo bo e dkar po dang 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa sku rdo rje sa snying lta bu'i thugs khar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du e dkar po/ rdo rje gsum po thams cad kyang phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma zhes pa nas na bzas kun nas klubs pa'o/ /de gsum gyi thugs kha'i sa bon bye āḥ 31 rnams las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas thugs gsung sku'i rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros shing / gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mtha' yas pa sprul te/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa la phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par gyur/ e sarba ta thā ga ta arnya pū dza nas/ shrī āḥ/ de bzhin du pā n+t+ra nas shasdi'i bar sbyar/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su / /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /de+o rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas / thugs rdo rje dang / de'i rdo rje can rnams snying kha'i thugs rdo rje dang rang la thim/ e sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa giyi ko3 haṃ/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /man chad 'dra zhes gsol ba

btab pas/ gsung rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa ghā wa ār+ya ko3 haṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ — /ces gsol ba btab pas sku rdo rje dang de'i rdo rje can rnams dpral ba'i sku rdo rje dang rang la thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa ghā wa giyi ko3 haṃ/ de rnams ni skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu dang bsgrub pa chung ngu'i yan lag ste dbang shes gnas gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ rang gi snying kha'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zla ba la/ gnas pa'i rmi yig dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las ral gri'i yu bar zla ba'i steng du rmi dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba thams cad marnyes par byas te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rmi la thim/ ral gri zla ba mi dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gong du thun mtshams kyi lha gsal 'debs skabs lta bu'i 'jam dgrangs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs zlor ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mai yig dmar ser las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'khod/ /slar yang mi gyi 'od zer gyis sprul pa'i gzugs sogs mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyis mchod par gyur/ i sarba ta thā ga ta aṅgā nas shap+ta'i bar gyis sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes pa'am/ spyo1

ra༅༅/ /na/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar rtsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag rtsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang bcas pa'i bkra shis kyi tshig bcad brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /i sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa cha/ ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur cing / sa/ snying sogs la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbang lha rnams kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ spro na/ rang dang phyag rdor kun bzang thugs rdo rje ye shes sems dpa' rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / sku rdo rje dang / sa snying la rnam snang / nam snying la rin 'byung / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung rdo rje la snang mtha'/ sgrib sel la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ /zhes bya'o/ /'di rnams ni bral ba'i 'bras bu dang / sgrub chen chung ngu'i yan lag ste kun gzhi gnas gyur pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /'di

rnams kyi gnas gyur dang ye shes sbyor lugs 'di gzhan dang mi mthun pa ni/ 'dir spang bya spong sla rims dang / ye shes dang por skye rim sbyar ba yin la/ gzhan du bstan pa rnam sa spang bya'i khyad chos dang ye shes kyi khyad chos ris 'dra ba la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa bsnyen sogs bar ma bzhi la bsnyen pa ni/ 'dir bram ze rin chen rdo rjes 'ga' zhig yum la'ang sbyor ba tshogs sog nas gzhal yas khang sgom pa sogs tshad mar byed pa ni/ kun bzang du/ de nas rang lha dang mtshungs rang snying pos/ /sbul pa'i rig ma nyid ni yang dag lta/ /zhes pa la bltas zhes sogs 'das tshig yod pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan gyis mi 'thad do zhes lugs de bkag nas/ rang lugs skabs 'dir rig ma sngar yab dang lhan cig bskyed nas grub zin pa gasdig gsal 'debs par 'dod pa nyid le gas par mthong ste/ de lta ma yin na/ gzhal yas khang yang skyar nas bsgom par 'dod pa'i phyogs la ni khang pa so sor lha yab yum bsgoms pas mthar thabs shes sbyor ba la'ang mi phan zhing snga ma nyid sbyo ra ba'ang mi rigs so/ /mngon byang lnga bskyed man chad byed pa'i phyogs la'ang bar srid 'jug pa sogs kyang 'di la byed par bshad pas bar do la cha gnyis bzo dgos pa sogs dang / rin chen rdo rjes gsungs pa ltar 'khor gyi bsnyen bsgrub la 'ang smu/tshungs/ nga ra 'gyur ba so/sas/ci kyi skyon 'byung ba'o/ /'on kyang sa bon la sa skyed pa tsam/ 'a/ ni 'gal/ ba me/da par rtosas/ so/ /des/ na kun bzangs/ las/ ni yum gyi skyed chog la/ bshad ma/ thag pa'i rkang pa gnyis kyi 'jug
