ra༅༅/ /tu/ mig sogs dgang zhing de nas yi ge gsum/ /rnam par bkod pas lus ni 'od dang ldan/ /zhes pa las med la/ kun tu bzang mo dang / rin chen rdo rje dang / shān+ti pa dang / jo bo sogs kyis mngon byang lnga bskyed / bar srid 'jug pa sogs byed par gsungs pa rnams kyang / skyar nas byed pam yin gyi snga ma'i zhar la bskyed pa'i sgo nas yum gyi bskyed chog la'ang de rnams tshang dgos zhes par dgongs pa yin te/ de'i phyir na gong du thig sle cha gnyis byas pa yin no/ /des na 'di skad ces bya ste / rang gi mdun na gnas pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yongs su gyur pa las yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu lta bu/ g.yas zhal in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo zhing / g.yon zhal ston ma'i zla ba ltar dkar ba phyag drug gi dang po gnyis yab la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pa la dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud cing gzhon nu lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams kyis shin tu 'dzum pa'i zur gyis blta ba la sogs pa'i rgyu rtsal dang ldan pa/ mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga la/ zhes pa nas/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams shing shes rab kyi yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa gigre ko3 haṃ/ 'di ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu dang bston pa'i yan lag 'bring po'o/ /nyer bsgrub ni/ de'i mig gnyis su mig dbang gi rang bzhin zhes pa

nas / dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas kun nas klubs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar snga ma bzhin te rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang nyer bsgrub kyi yan lag 'bring po'o/ /sgrub pa ni/ de'i nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hū+o nag po las/ zhes pa nas / na bzas kun nas blubs ba'i bar la rang gi sems dang / ngag dang lus zhes pa rnams bor nas/ de gsum gyi thugs kha'i sa bon ṇ+ḍaṃ zhi/ཿ zhes pa nas/ shap+ta'i bar brjod nas/ 'di la gsol gdab rnams mi byed par rin chen rdo rjes bshad / rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad yum gyi gnas gsum du thim par gyur/ 61 sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta zhes sogs sngags gsum sbrel nas brjod pa ni/ byed 'bras dang sgrub pa 'bring pa'o/ /sgrub chen ni/ de'i thugs kha'i thugs rdo rje'i gong du zhes pa nas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zhes sbyar nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa snga ma bzhin bsam pa ni/ bral 'bras dang sgrub chen 'bring po'o/ /yum gyi spyi gtsug nas snying kha'i bar du zla ba la gnas pa'i rnam snang gi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi e dkar po/ snying kha nas lte ba'i bar du mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi hūm̐ nag po/ lte ba nas gsang ba'i bar du rin 'byung gi rdul phra rab gyi rang bzhin can gyi swā ser po gsang ba nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar du 'od dpag med kyi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin gyi āḥ dmar po/ brla'i rtsa ba nas byin pa'i bar du don grub kyi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi hā ljang khu rnams nyi gdan la gnas pas mtshan par gyur/ rang gi

ra༅༅/ /gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung pa'i rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa e dkar po las byung pa'i nor bu dang ldan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ā las byung pa'i ze'u 'bru dang ldan pa/ gnyis rka'ang bu ga phaṭa yig gis bkag par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dga' ba dang bde ba khyad par can nyams su myong ba'i bde ba chen pos sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyur/ e sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsams te/ de yan chad ni dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin te rang don phun sum tshogs pa 'dod chags chen po'i lam gyis sgrub par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa spros shing bsdus nas dkyil 'khor la bkod de yan lag bzhi rdzogs mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du byed pa yin la/ 'dir bu ston rin po ches mngal du yang ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du byed gsung ba ni rgya gzhung khungs thub gang nas kyang ma byung la/ mngal du rdzogs par bskyed nas rim gyi spro ba yang 'di yi lugs ma yin par go ste/ gzhung kun tu bskyed pa dang spro ba lha re re la sbyar nas gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'di'i rgyal mchog gnyis dang rnal 'byor gnyis la sogs pa ni dus 'bor nas 'byung ba'i ba d+ngha chang yin la/ der yang rim gyis bskyed nas rim gyis spro ba rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas

gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du/ lha pho rnams kyi yum dang lha mo rnams kyi yab la rang rang gi ming dang ngos 'dzin zur du mdzad pa yang gzhung rnams su mi 'byung zhing lha grangs mang ba la sogs pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas/ rgya gzhung kun tu rang 'od kyi yab yum du gsungs shing / lugs 'di'i lha sku li ma mang po mthong ba la yang dngos su 'khyud yum med pa zhes gcig tu snang bas rang 'od kyi yab dang yum du rigs so/ /rdo rje gsum byin gyis rlob pa'i skabs su spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas su 'byung bzhi'i gdan mdzad pa'ang gzhung che ba rnams su mi 'byung zhing / kun tu bzang mor ngal gso ba'i skabs dang / rin chen rdo rjes bzlas pa'i skabs su zur tsam gsungs kyang rdo rje gsum dang ma 'brel lo/ /lha rnams kyi mdzad pa la / kun bzang rang dang jo bos mdzad pa ma sbyar zhing / bod dag gis sbyar ba rnams kun tu bzang mo/ shān+ti ba/ rin chen rdo rje sogs kyis mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa rnams dang ma mthun no/ /sems ma drug gi 'byin sngags jo bos 'gru gsum dang mtshan sngags spel ba yang kun bzang gnyis dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ rin chen rdo rje sogs kyis yig 'bru gsum po nyid 'byin sngags su gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing / chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i rigs bdag mi bskyod par ma dzad pa 'ang gzhan rnam sa su rdor se rma sa la sazhad pa dang rma rma thun no/ /des na 'di ska da ces bya sto / rang gi thugs kha'i ting nge 'dzin se rmi sa dpa 'a mai yig la sa 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rmi ba yum 'bor dang bcas

ra༅༅/ /pa thams cad lha bcu dgu'i dkyil zhabor gyi rnam pas spyan drangs pa rnams rang gi zhal nas zhugs te rjes chags kyis mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le dre ma med pa'i rmi yig dmar ser gyis mtshan zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdul phra rab tu gyur pa'i thig le yongs su gyur ba las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par grub pa'i dbus kyi gdan la rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs khar drangs/ badz+ra d+dhika thugs kha nas phyir phyung / phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'bor lo skor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi she sdang sbyangs shing rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur te thugs rdo rje dang chos dbyings ye shes la bkod nas slar 'dus te rang nyid la thim par gyur/ shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing / lhag ma sayas ba'is 'khor lo ngakar po rtsibs brgyad pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs khar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs kha nas

phyir phyung phyogs bcu'i zhing du sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par du sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs shing gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur te/ sku rdo rje dang me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod nas/ slar 'dus te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi ling tshe dgu'i shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lhor rin 'byung nam snying lta bu rin po che ljang gu cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ rat+na :ka khyad par du sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal sbyangs nas tshor ba'iphung po gnas gyur yon tan rdo rje dang mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ lhor nyi gdan la 'khod/ nub tu 'od dpag med 'jig rten dbang phyug lta bu pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa 'dzin pa/ ā ro loka khyad par du 'dod chags sbyangs nas 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur te/ gsung rdo rje dang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ la bkod/ nub tu nyi gdan la 'khod/ byang du don grub sgrib sel lta bu ral gri sngon po 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ pra dzā :ka khyad par du phrag dog sbyangs nas 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur te/ phrin las rdo rje dang bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ byang du nyi gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du spyi mdzad bzhag nas gzhan thams cad sbyor lugs 'dra bar byas te/ rang 'edi kyi ma ba la zhes sbyar nas/ shar lho ra spyan rma dkar mo rnam sna nga lta bu/ rmo ha ra ti/ sems can rnam sa kyi sa 'i kham sa kyi dri rma sbya ngas te rnam pa ra thar di 'i sgo sto nga pa nyid dang snying rje tshad me da rma ngon du byas/ thabs kyi phar phyin dang sa bdun pa ring du

ra༅༅/ /song ba la bkod/ shar lhor zla gdan la'o/ /lho nub tu mā ma gī sngon mo phyag rdor lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ de ṣa ra ti/ chu'i khams mtshan ma med pa dang / byams pa tshad med pa dang / smon lam gyi phar phyin/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu zla gdan la/ nub byang du gos dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ rā ga ra ti/ me'i khams/ smon pa med pa/ dga' ba tshad med pa/ stobs kyi phar phyin/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ nub byang du zla gdan/ byang shar du sgrol ma ser mo rin 'byung lta bu la/ rin po che'i gnas su āt+pal ser po/ badz+ra ra ti/ rlung gi khams/ mngon par 'du mi byed pa/ btang snyoms tshad med/ ye shes kyi phar phyin/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin/ byang shar du zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su me long dmar po 31 āḥlha/ rang gi thugs kha nas phyir phyung phyogs bcu'i zhing du sngal pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi gzugs kyi skye mched dang ser sna snangs te sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la bkod nas slar 'dus te rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor zla gdan la 'khod/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ lde (ba tu sgra rdo rje ma/ mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su pi wang sngon po/ oṃ āḥhū sgra'i skye mched dang 'chal tshul/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang / sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ lho nub tu zla gdan/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma rin 'byung lta bu la rin po

che'i gnas su dri'i dung chos ser po/ oṃ āḥlha/ dri'i skye mched dang khong khro/ bzod pa'i phar phyin dang sa gsum pa 'od byed pa/ nub byang du zla gdan/ byang shar du mo rdo rje ma dmar mo'o da dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su ro'i snod dmar po/ oṃ āḥlha/ mo'i skye mched dang le lo/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dang sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ byang shar du zla gdan la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang gu don grub lta bu la/ ral gri'i gnas su gos kha dog sna tshogs pa / e āḥ// reg bya'i skye mched dang rnam g.yeng / bsam gto gyi phar phyin dang sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ shar sgo'i g.yas su zla gdan la/ shar sgo'i g.yon du chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su chos kyi 'byung gnas dkar po/ e āḥlha/ chos kyi skye mched dang sher 'chal/ shes rab kyi phar phyin dang sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du zla gdan la 'khod/ de thams cad kyang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dbu skra ral pa'i cod paṇa shin tu mdzes pa/ zhal re re la shin tu zhi ba'i spya na gnyis gnyis dang ldan zhing brgyad gnyis lon pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bde ba chen po'i longs spyod la lhag par rol ba/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar zhing sil sil gyi zhes pa nas/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' bsnams shing rtsam snang dang lha mo thams cad zla ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ gshegs pa gzhin gsum nyi ma'i 'ong 'phro ba'o/ /de ba'in du ngag 'don sngar bzhin sbyar

ra༅༅/ /te/ shar sgor gzhin rje gshed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje tho ba/ ya mān+ta kṛ ta sems can rnams kyi ma dad pa dang / phung po'i bdud dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dang 'jig tshogs la lta ba thams cad sbyangs te dad pa'i dbang po dang chos kyi bdag med kyi lta ba la bkod nas slar 'dus te shar sgo ra nyi gdan la 'khod/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rnam snang lta bu la/ 'khor lo'i gnas su rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta/ le lo dang nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bdag tu lta ba thams cad sbyangs te/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po dang gang zag gi bdag med pa'i lta ba la bkod/ lho sgor nyi gdan/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed 'od dpag med lta bu la/ pad+ma'i gnas su pad+ma nyid 'dzin pa/ pad+mān+ta kṛta/ brjed ngas dang 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / skyo ba'i sgrib pa dang mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba thams cad sbyangs te dran pa'i dbang po dang dbu ma'i lta ba la bkod/ nub sgor nyi gdan la/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po mi bskyod pa lta bu la rdo rje'i gnas su rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa 'dzin pa biṅgān+ta kṛta/ rnam g.yeng dang / lha'i bu'i bdud dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang log par lta ba thams cad sbyangs te ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang yang dag pa'i lta ba la bkod nas slar 'dus te byang sgor nyi gdan la 'khod/ khrobo bzhi po thams cad kyang daci skra dmar ser gyen du rjes shing smin ma dang / sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsumyo/ dang ldan zhing mche ba

rnon po bzhi bzhi gcigs pa/ ha ha'i gad sbyangs drag po sgrogs shing bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing stag gi lpags pa'i shakha thabs can/ sprul mtha' yas sngon pos dbu ska bcings shing / 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa la brgyan cing pad+ma dkar pos 'gul rgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing / stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogos byas pa / nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ ska las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las la brtson pas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs khar drangs/ shes āḥlha thugs kha nas phyir byung / phyogs bcur 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi nyes skyon sbyangs nas dag pa'i zhing du byas/ slar 'dus nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ 'di gzhan rnams nas ma mdzad na'ang / 'di skyed phyin chad 'byin pa'ang rigs pas 'thob bo/ /slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i mai yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ji ltar bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs te shar sgo'i thad kyi nam mkhar 'bod/ i ya mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ e pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ e pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ tshuli ghān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ ye shes pa'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs rngams bskrad/ slar yang thugs kha'i mi

ra༅༅/ /las sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi lnga dang me tog dkar pos brgyan pa'i mchod pa du mas mchod par gyur/ e sarba ta thā ga ta arnya nas/shasda pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta dzaḥga'an rje mthar byed kyi dza dmar tsho 'od zer gyis dkyil gsor gyi nang du spyan drangs/ oṃ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/shes rab mthar byed kyi hūm̐ nag tsho 'od zer gyis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la bcug e pad+mān+ta kṛta baṃ/ pad ma mthar byed kyi baṃ ser tsho 'od zer gyis dbyer med du bcings/ tshuli snrin+ta kṛta hoḥ bgegs mthar byed kyi hoḥdakar po'i wo zer gyis ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur te bde stong gis mnyes par gyur/de rnams ni rgyu mthun gyi las bu dang snyan pa'i yan lag 'a po'o/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mig gnyis su zla ba la/zhes pa nas/na bzas kun nas blubs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya ste/nyer bsgrub sogs chen po'o/ /de nas/lha thams cad kyi nu ma gnyis kyi shes pa nas sngags tshan gsum brjod pa'i bar yum gyi ji lta ba bzhin du bya ste sgrub pa sogs chen po'o/ /de nas 'khor rnams la sems dpa' gsum rtsegs ni ma gsungs so/ /de'i phyir/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i mi yig dmar ser las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas / dbang gi lha/zhes pa nas/chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs sugyur pa las/rnam snang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi dang /mā ma gī/sgra rdo rje ma/sheg rab mthar byed/bgegs mthar byed rnams la mi bskyod pa/spyan

ma gzugs rdo rje ma/ gzhin rje gshed rnams la rnam snang / dri rdo rje ma la rin 'byung / gos dkar mo mo rdo rje ma/ pad+ma mthar byed rnams la 'od dpag med/ sgrol ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma la don grub/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing / skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams la'ang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po rnams kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes brjod do/ /spro na de rnams la'ang sngar ltar rgyas par brjod do/ /de ni sgrub chen sogs chen po'o/ /de nas mchod bstod bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i rmi las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan dang mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad bkug ste/ rang gi lus la zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su gyur te/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le bcur gyur pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lam̐ mi paṃ tai dza hū+oṃ baṃ hoḥ rlu raṃ rnams su gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bcu dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ de rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las spyan ma nas chos dbyengs rdo rje ma'i bar gyi lha mo bcu po gzugs dang lang tsho la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs te yul snang sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byed pa rnams phyir 'phros te/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ tshig bcad dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ e bha ga wān mañju badz+ra de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra arnya pū dza me gha sogs nas/ dharma dhā tu'i bar sngar bzhin du

ra༅༅/ /brjod de/ kun bzang du tha dad kun tu rtog las nges grol bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mchod bya mchod byed sogs su 'dzin pa'i 'khor gsum gyi rtog pa thams cad spangs nas rgyal ba thams cad kyi nga rgyal bzung ste / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa byā wa chuyi ko3 haṃ/ mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa'i dkyil zhabor pa thams cad kyis bstod bya bstod byed sgra brnyan ltar shes pa'i sgo nas bstod par gyur/ zhes brjod la dril stabs dang bcas te/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyengs ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'bor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyengs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dgazha ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes / /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yon rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dang / dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs kyis bstod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa yod na de'am/ med na skabs 'dir byin gyis brlabs te/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon nas g.yas su lan gsum dkrugs te/ dbus nas blangs la/ dang por rtsa ba'i bla ma

dang / de rjes brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mas la 'bru gsum btags te smin 'tshams yan chod kyi thad du gtor/ de rjes badz+ra d+dhika e āḥrū/ ma: badz+ra oṃ āḥhū de bzhin du 'byin sngags su bshad pa'i mas sngags rnams dang /sems ma drug la/ rū pa/shasdi/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar+sha/ dharma dhā tu rnams la badz+ra btags pa'i 'jug tu 'bru gsum btags la snying kha'i thad du gtor/ de bzhin du yi dam gzhan la 'bul na'ang de bzhin du bya ste lag pa kha gyen du phyogs pas dbul / phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang gzhi bdag dang rigs drug sogs la lag pa kha 'og tu phyogs pas lte ba man chad kyi thad sor dbul bar bya zhing / rang gis kyang lce rtse smin mtshams spyi bo rnams su reg cing / lce thog tu bzhag la myang te / nga rgyal 'dzin na/ gong gi pū h+phu gnas su a mṛ ta gzhugagong du bstod pa la nga rgyal 'dzin na'ang stu ti gzhug go/de yan chad ni dkyil 'khor rgyas par bsgoms nas gzhan don gtso bor byed pa dkyil 'bor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/'di dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor gnyis la rin chen rdo rje dang bo sa las rgyal mchog gi ming bskos la gzhung gzhan nas de 'dra'i tha snyad mi 'byung ngo / /mdor na ting nge 'dzin gnyis kyis dkyil 'bor gyi 'khor lo la gsal snang yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed cing / de yang gzung tshon dang tshor 'das sogs gnyis su tshon pa'i rnam rtog dang bral ba'i lha sku sgya ma lta bu la reg mthong gi mas ma rnyed rnyed kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /gsal ba i gyis

ra༅༅/ /mi chog gis gnas pa brtan po gtso bor sgrub cing zhar la bying rgod sel ba ni rnal 'byor gnyis kyis byed pas de yang thog mar bying ba sel byed ni rnal 'byor dang po 'di yin la/ de'i tshul ni/ rang gi ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la gnas pa'i mi yig dmar ser de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phangs la bkod pa rnams dang lhan cig de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te de la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rmi yiga'od du zhu nas rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i thig le phra mo'o da zer sna tshogs 'phro ba dwangs shing gsal ba yungs dkar gyi 'gru tsam shin tu 'tsher ba la sems bzung zhing / sems 'phro bar rtsom pa ni thig le de las 'od zer 'phros pas ral gri dang / de las ye shes sems dpa'/ de las rang nyid/ de las dkyil 'bor/ de las snod bcud kyi bar rim gyis kun tu snang bar byas nas slar yang de bzhin du rim gyis bsdus te thig le la thim pa'i thig le las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'ababapar yun ring du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas thig le la sems brtan pa na/ thig le'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis gsal btab la dkyil 'khor thig le dang bcas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rang gi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas 'phros te phyi nang thams cad snang bas khyab par bsgoms pas bying ba mtha' dag sel bar nus so/ /phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i rigs lnga la sogs pa'i de bzhin

gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste rdo rje lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa yongs su gyur pa las zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri nas 'gru tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su tsa na bzhi 'gru tshad tsam gyi thig le ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer shin tu gsal ba'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa skad cig gis gsal btab ste de la yun ring du sems bzung bas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur la/ mtshan ma de 'dra ma mthong gi bar du mi spro zhing / mthong nas dkyil 'khor du ma yang dang yang du spros te 'gro ba'i don byas nas slar yang bsdu ba'i spro bsdu la bslab par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor 'di gnyis kyi skabs su lha bskyed pa rnams la/ jo bo rjes bsnyen sogs chen po nyid yin par bshad cing / kun bzang gnyis nas mi gsal yang shān+ti ba rin chen rdo rje sman zhabs pa rnams rags pa'i dkyil 'bor dang 'dra bar chung 'bring chen po gsum ka tshang bar bzhed do/ /bsgo+om pas skyo na/ bzlas pa bya ba ni / rang gi sku rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje dang ye shes sems dpa' dang thugs rdo rje rnams rim pa bzhin du rlung dang chu dang sa dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par gyur pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i rme yig dmar ser gyi mtha' mar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur cing / rdo rje bzhi'i thugs kha'i oṃ āḥ mi hūm̐ rnams las rlung 'byung ba dang lhan cig sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum rim pa bzhin du'am/ yang na gcig car du 'phros nas nam mkha' gang ba rnams la gzugs sogs

ra༅༅/ /lha mo rnams kyis 'byud pa la sogs pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byas shing 'gro ba'i don rdzogs pa na rmi yig gi 'od zer gyis bsdus te yig 'bru rnams la rlung 'jug pa dang lhan cig thim pa'i spro bsdu'i mdzad pa can du gyur / oṃ āḥ mi hūm̐/ zhes pa nyid gtso bor bzlas shing / mthar oṃ āḥ badz+ra mi hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ mañju badz+ra mai hūm̐/ e āḥdzi na dzika sgri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ rat+na gi i hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ ā ro li ka dzo hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ pra dz+nyā gi khaṃ hūm̐/ de bzhin du hrū gsum gyi dbus su/ mo ha ra trī lam̐/ dī ṣa ra tī mi/ rā ga ra tī paṃ/ badz+ra ra tī rta/ rū pa badz+ra dzaḥ shasdi badz+ra hūm̐/ gan+dha badz+ra baṃ/ ra sa dz+ra ho/ spar+sha badz+ra khaṃ/ sto dh+wa tu badz+ra raṃ/ ya mān+ta dz+nya hūṃ/ pra dz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ pad+mān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ bi ban+dha kṛta hūm̐/ rnams bcug la bzla'o/ /de lta bu'i bsgom pa dang bzlas pa rtsegacig tu byas pas skyo zhing dub na/ lhali bzhi'i glus bskul bar bsams nas dkyis 'bor la mchod bstod bya'o/ /lus stobs nyams par 'gyur na/ rang gi spyi bor rmetho gang 'phags pa'i thad kyi nam mkhar zla ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi 'og phyogs kyi dbus su oṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po babs pa rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te/ rtsa sbubs thams cad gang zhing rlan dang drod kyis khyab par bsams na rgas dka' ba dang lus rgyas pa la sogs pa'i phan yon gsungs so/ /mthar gshegs su gsol ba ni/ dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas nas/ jobo sa shes khyod kyis sems can don mdzad/ /

zhes sogs kyi rgya skad kyis ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdu bar bshad pa ltar/ bod 'ga' zhig gis kyang bshad mod/ de ni yo ga'i cho ga bla med la 'chugs pa yin te/ de ltar byas na rang ye shes pa dang bral bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro / /des na/ sku'i rigs rnams sku rdo rje dang / gsung gi rigs rnams gsung rdo rje dang / thugs kyi rigs rnams thugs rdo rje la thim pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim par gyur pas rdo rje gsum shin tu brtan par gyur / zhes bya ste/ kun bzang las/ 61 la sogs pas dkyil 'khor bsdus nas ni/ /sku la sogs pa brtan pa dag tu bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa 'jug la gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes su smon lam bya zhing / langs te 'gro ba la sogs pa'i spyod lam thams cad du rang la lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang snod bcud rten dang brten pa snang stong sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du dran par bya'o/ /kha zas nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs shing oṃ āḥlha bzlas la snying kha'i mi yig lha thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' zhing phyi nang gi sbyin sreg gis phung po'i bud shing bsregs pa dang / gzhan don thams cad kyang rgyal ba mnyes byed du shes pa dang / lus phyag rgya dang ngag thams cad sngags su shes te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sems kyis zin pa'i bya ba thams cad dge ba kho nar 'gyur bar bya ba dang / sal te dam tshis nyams na rang dam tshig rdo rje don grub du bsams pa'i snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i sna tsho+ogs rdo rje'i lte bar khaṃ ljang khu la sngags kyis bskor

ra༅༅/ /bar bsams nas/ skyes āḥ 6 hūm̐ zhes pa mang du bzla' zhing / dbang rgyas bsdus blang ba sogs bya'o/ /khras ni gong du brjod zin la/ nyal ba'i tshe na'ang dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas nas dkyil 'khor thams cad sngar bzhin snying kha'i mi la bsdus te 'gro ba la snying rje dang stong nyid kyi lta ba la bzhag pa'i sgo nas nyal zhing / ldang ba'i tshe na'ang byamasarā gas tshad med bzhi lha mo bzhir gyur pa'i glus sngar bzhin du bskul nas langs te/ slar yang snga ma lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi'am drug du nyams su blang ngo / /thun mthar gtor ma ni 'di'i gzhung rnams su ma byung yang / a bha yas rdo rje phreng bar bshad pa ltar/ rang gi thugs kha'i mi yig gis khro bo rbecu dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du 'dus pa'i dkyil 'bor rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad dang / de'i phyi rol du phyogs skyong bco lnga'am bcu dang / klu dang sems can thams cad bkug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum/ shar du rnam snang nas byang sgor bgegs mthar byed kyi bar skad cig gis rdzogs par gyur/ phyi'i shar du rdo rje mtshon cha zhes sogs 'phags lugs la grags pa ltar/ yang na gong bzhin bskyed pa la sngar bzhin dbul lo/ /de nas chos skyong rdo rje nag po gdong bzhi pa sogs la'ang dbul/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis las dang po pa dang ye shes cung zad babs pa dang / ye shes la cung zad dbang ba'i cha shas bskyed rim mthar phyin pa na/ zhi sogs kyi las rab 'byams lo'ajug cing / de rjes ye shes la

yang dag par dbang ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi lung las gsung pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya ste gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang bskyed rim gyi rnam bzhag dang yid ches pa'i lung rigs rgyas par ni/'di'i sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo bskyed rim gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed zla med par gyur pa slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun bzang gi rnam bshad byed par 'dod par der bshad par bya'o// //med byung rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /dmar ser gzhon nu'i mtshan dper shar ba gang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas de nyid mnyes pa'i thabs/ /bla med lam gyi dbus na mtho ba 'di/ /bshes gnyen 'ga' yis legs par bskul ba dang / /rang nyid tshul 'dir mchog tu gzhol ba'i mthus/ /dri med gzhung la rigs pas brtags nas sbyar/ /dge bas 'gro kun 'jam dbyangs thob par shog /'phags lam byis pas bshad pa'i rgyu las ni/ khyung zad nongs rnams 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags/ /gsang chen bshad pa'i yul du ma gyur pa'i / /mos pa dman pa rnams kyang dad thob shog khes dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs kyi lugs/rje btsun 'jam pa'i dgrangs kyi sgrub thabs 'di ni/mdo sngags kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i chos 'dzin cing /tshul 'di la lhag par mos pa'i dge ba'i bzhes gasko nam mkha' rin r+sā pa dang /bka' bcu pa bsam grub 'od zer ba gnyis kyis ring mo nas bskul zhing /spyi dang bye brag gi lam zab mo rnams la dad 'dun dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gasko dbon po rgyal mas grags

ra༅༅/ /kyis gsariri du nan tan gyis bskul nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab spyi dang khyad par lugs 'di la thos pa'i bag chags gsal zhing dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rnal 'byor la mchog tu gzhol ba'i dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ khro bo'i lo dbo'i zla ba'i mar ngo'i rdzogs pa gsum pa la dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //phun tshogs snang chen zer 'gyed 'jam dbyangs k+shi /sgrub thabs nyi ma'i mchog 'di chos 'khor ba'i/ /dge 'dun spyi sogs dad ldan rlung shugs dang / /bka' bcu dbang seng nye gnas dpal bzang bcas/ /rta bdun gyis drangs thub bstan nam mkhar shar/ /'dir 'bad bgyid dang gzhan yang 'gror kun gli /ma rig mun pa myur du zhi gyur cing / /thub bstan pad+mo'i tshal chen rgyas gyur cig/ //rkos mkhan mkhas pa chos bzang yin// //maṅga lam̐ / //
